jobs.title: City Research Scientist
jobs.description: **City Research Scientist** =========================== * FIRE DEPARTMENT Posted on 10/30/2026 * Full\-time Location BROOKLYN * No exam required Department Headquarters Inspection Salary range: $87,743\.00 – $110,120\.00 Save **Job Description** ------------------- The Fire Department of the City of New York (FDNY) is the largest Fire Department in the United States and universally is recognized as the world's busiest and most highly skilled emergency response agency. The Department's main goal is to provide fire protection, emergency medical care, and other critical public safety services to residents and visitors in the five boroughs. FDNY members are sworn to serve and protect life and property and the Department works to continually educate the public in fire, life safety and disaster preparedness, along with enforcing public safety codes. Since its inception in 1865, FDNY has helped lead efforts to make New York the safest big city in the nation. This accomplishment requires a steadfast and daily commitment to maintaining the Department's core values. The Bureau of Fire Prevention cultivates a safer city for its citizens, visitors and first responders by preventing loss of life and property damage from fire and other emergencies. We accomplish this 24/7 by identifying fire and life safety hazards; creating, revising, and enforcing the New York City Fire Code; reviewing plans for critical systems designed to protect and alert building occupants; licensing qualified companies to install and service fire protection equipment and systems; certifying individuals to monitor fire safety conditions; and educating individuals and businesses about fire safety. In addition, the Bureau of Fire Prevention is critical partner with the Bureau of Fire Operations (Firefighters) and Bureau of Fire Investigations (Fire Marshals), providing assistance and guidance during post\-fire incidents and investigations; and coordinating with other City agencies on matters concerning fire and life safety. The Bureau consists of Fire Protection Inspectors, lawyers, engineers, explosives experts, and Fire Officers work together to save lives in New York City. The Fire Department, City of New York (FDNY), seeks a full\-time City Research Scientist in the Bureau of Fire Prevention. Reporting to the Director of Performance Management, the City Research Scientist, Level 2, will provide information and data to support evidence\-based decision\-making, lead research aligned with departmental goals, foster external collaborations, develop advanced models and algorithms, ensure research quality, translate findings into practical applications, and mentor within an innovative research environment. CITY RESEARCH SCIENTIST \- 21744 **Minimum Qualifications** -------------------------- 1\. For Assignment Level I (only physical, biological and environmental sciences and public health) A master's degree from an accredited college or university with a specialization in an appropriate field of physical, biological or environmental science or in public health. To be appointed to Assignment Level II and above, candidates must have: 1\. A doctorate degree from an accredited college or university with specialization in an appropriate field of physical, biological, environmental or social science and one year of full\-time experience in a responsible supervisory, administrative or research capacity in the appropriate field of specialization; or 2\. A master's degree from an accredited college or university with specialization in an appropriate field of physical, biological, environmental or social science and three years of responsible full\-time research experience in the appropriate field of specialization; or 3\. Education and/or experience which is equivalent to "1" or "2" above. However, all candidates must have at least a master's degree in an appropriate field of specialization and at least two years of experience described in "2" above. Two years as a City Research Scientist Level I can be substituted for the experience required in "1" and "2" above. NOTE: Probationary Period Appointments to this position are subject to a minimum probationary period of one year. **Preferred Skills** -------------------- Preferred Skills Candidate should have an advanced degree in Operations Research, Statistics, Computer Science, Management Science, Economics, Public Policy or a related field with a strong foundation in research methods and statistical analysis. They must be capable of providing expert judgment in applying analytics and be well\-versed in industry best practices, current literature, and advanced analytics in the context of Operations Research. A candidate with the following skills is well suited for the position: Proven proficiency in SQL, Python, or R programming. Routine use of business intelligence visualization software such as PowerBI. Hands\-on experience with statistical, simulation, and optimization tools. Strong logical reasoning and a solid understanding of data requirements for front\-line usage. Expertise in operations research and statistical methodologies, including deployment analysis, resource allocation modeling, systems/operations analysis, simulation and optimization (both linear and nonlinear), predictive analytics (e.g., deep learning), econometrics and time series forecasting. Experience implementing high\-level quantitative research and mathematical modeling initiatives. Candidate should be an exceptional communicator and a collaborative team player who demonstrates a strong willingness to learn and thrive in diverse, multidisciplinary teams. Candidate should excel at clearly articulating analytical findings and offering practical, data\-driven solutions. Additionally, the candidate should possess strong leadership and interpersonal skills, with a focus on delivering exceptional customer service. **Public Service Loan Forgiveness** ----------------------------------- As a prospective employee of the City of New York, you may be eligible for federal loan forgiveness programs and state repayment assistance programs. For more information, please visit the U.S. Department of Education’s website at https://studentaid.gov/pslf/. **Residency Requirement** ------------------------- New York City residency is generally required within 90 days of appointment. However, City Employees in certain titles who have worked for the City for 2 continuous years may also be eligible to reside in Nassau, Suffolk, Putnam, Westchester, Rockland, or Orange County. To determine if the residency requirement applies to you, please discuss with the agency representative at the time of interview. **Additional Information** -------------------------- The City of New York is an inclusive equal opportunity employer committed to recruiting and retaining a diverse workforce and providing a work environment that is free from discrimination and harassment based upon any legally protected status or protected characteristic, including but not limited to an individual's sex, race, color, ethnicity, national origin, age, religion, disability, sexual orientation, veteran status, gender identity, or pregnancy. jobs.title: Cybersecurity Engineer (Test & Evaluation)
jobs.description: **Cybersecurity Engineer (Test \& Evaluation)** =============================================== * TECHNOLOGY \& INNOVATION Posted on 10/30/2026 * Full\-time Location BROOKLYN * No exam required Department THREAT MANAGEMENT Salary range: $75,000\.00 – $95,000\.00 Save **Job Description** ------------------- The Office of Technology and Innovation (OTI) leverages technology to drive opportunity, improve public safety, and help government run better across New York City. From delivering affordable broadband to protecting against cybersecurity threats and building digital government services, OTI is at the forefront of how the city delivers for New Yorkers in the 21st century. Follow us on social media @NYCOfficeofTech, and visit www.nyc.gov/oti to learn more. At OTI, we offer great benefits, and the chance to work on projects that have a meaningful impact on millions of people. You'll have the opportunity to work with cutting\-edge technology and collaborate with other passionate professionals who share your drive and commitment to making a difference through technology. About Cyber Command Cyber Command is charged with protecting all City systems against cyber threats, including systems that deliver vital services to New Yorkers. Headed by the Chief Information Security Officer of the City of New York, we provide in\-depth support to over 100 agencies and offices to protect, detect, identify, respond to, and recover from cyber threats. Job Description The Cybersecurity Engineer (Test \& Evaluation) will support the Cyber Test team’s mission of conducting technical security testing, including red teaming, penetration testing, and threat/adversary emulation, against systems and environments belonging to City agencies, as well as the team's role in providing technical subject matter expertise to Cyber Command and partner agencies on vulnerability exploitability, technical risk, and review of testing artifacts submitted in support of risk acceptance and policy exception determinations. Responsibilities will include: * Assist in planning and executing technical security assessments, including penetration tests, red team engagements, and adversary/threat emulation exercises, against City agency systems, applications, and network environments. * Help identify and validate vulnerabilities, and assess their real\-world exploitability and operational impact, both to support individual testing engagements and to inform broader risk\-related decisions across Cyber Command and partner agencies. * Document findings, methodology, and evidence in clear, actionable testing reports for technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Assist in evaluating the technical validity of risk review submissions, such as risk acceptance and policy exception requests, including review of supporting testing artifacts, scan results, and assessment documentation, and testing the effectiveness of claimed compensating controls through red teaming or threat emulation. * Translate technical testing findings into language and context tailored to the needs of an agency, or Cyber Command function. * Assist in analyzing findings across multiple engagements to identify recurring patterns, systemic weaknesses, or root causes, and share recommendations with relevant teams and stakeholders to inform broader remediation and mitigation strategies. * Map testing findings and assessments to recognized control frameworks (e.g., CIS Controls, NIST) to support consistent, defensible risk\-informed determinations. * Maintain awareness of current threat actor tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs) and incorporate relevant threat intelligence into testing scenarios, risk discussions, and trend analysis. * Contribute to the continuous improvement of Cyber Test's methodologies, tooling, and reporting standards. * Handle special projects and initiatives as assigned. HOURS/SHIFT Day \- Due to the necessary technical duties of this position in a 24/7 operation, candidate may be required to work various shifts such as weekends and/or nights/evenings. WORK LOCATION Brooklyn, NY TO APPLY * Interested applicants with other civil service titles who meet the preferred requirements should also submit a resume for consideration Please go to www.cityjobs/jobs/search and search for Job ID \# 809073 SUBMISSION OF A RESUME IS NOT A GUARANTEE THAT YOU WILL RECEIVE AN INTERVIEW APPOINTMENTS ARE SUBJECT TO OVERSIGHT APPROVAL OTI participates in E\-Verify IT SECURITY SPECIALIST \- 95622 **Minimum Qualifications** -------------------------- A baccalaureate degree from an accredited college and four years of satisfactory full\-time experience related to projects and policies required by the particular position; or, Education and/or experience which is equivalent to "1" above. **Preferred Skills** -------------------- The successful candidate should possess the following: \- Hands\-on exposure to or experience supporting penetration testing, vulnerability assessments, or red team operations, including familiarity with common testing tools (e.g., Burp Suite, Nmap, Metasploit, C2 frameworks, or network scanners). \- Understanding of how technical findings translate into risk\-relevant language for technical and non\-technical audiences, with an understanding of how testing evidence supports risk assessment, risk acceptance, and policy exception decisions. \- Basic familiarity with control, risk, and threat frameworks such as CIS Controls, NIST (e.g., NIST CSF, SP 800\-53\), and MITRE ATT\&CK, particularly as applied to threat emulation and adversary\-based testing exposure to ISO 27001, SOC 2, or FedRAMP. \- Exposure to or interest in using AI tools to support technical testing, as well as testing and assessing the security of AI systems (e.g., prompt injection, model evasion, adversarial inputs) familiarity with MITRE ATLAS is a plus. \- Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document technical findings clearly, identify recurring root causes, and explain technical concepts to non\-technical audiences. \- Ability to work collaboratively across technical, risk, and compliance teams. Experience in public sector, government, or critical infrastructure environments is a plus. \- Active pursuit or completion of foundational or associate\-level testing and security certifications are a plus (e.g., eJPT, CompTIA PenTest\+, Security\+, CEH, or GPEN). **Public Service Loan Forgiveness** ----------------------------------- As a prospective employee of the City of New York, you may be eligible for federal loan forgiveness programs and state repayment assistance programs. For more information, please visit the U.S. Department of Education’s website at https://studentaid.gov/pslf/. **Residency Requirement** ------------------------- New York City Residency is not required for this position **Additional Information** -------------------------- The City of New York is an inclusive equal opportunity employer committed to recruiting and retaining a diverse workforce and providing a work environment that is free from discrimination and harassment based upon any legally protected status or protected characteristic, including but not limited to an individual's sex, race, color, ethnicity, national origin, age, religion, disability, sexual orientation, veteran status, gender identity, or pregnancy. jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: GM Performance Power Units \- Concord, NC Data Engineer \- Onsite Job Summary Build and operate reliable data pipelines for power unit test and performance activities, using AWS as the primary cloud environment. Make engineering data accessible, traceable and ready for analysis, while retaining the context needed to interpret results correctly. Work with Test, Performance, Controls and IT teams to turn files, measurements and test events into supported data products. Collaborate with the business and manufacturing data role to connect test results with approved engine, build and component information in Microsoft Fabric. Key Responsibilities * Build and maintain ingestion pipelines for agreed dyno, test rig, instrumentation and performance sources. Support batch, file and streaming patterns where requirements justify them. * Preserve source files and relevant timestamps, units, calibration references, run identifiers and acquisition context. Implement validation and make missing or disputed context visible. * Develop documented datasets and processing pipelines using Python and SQL. Implement duplicate prevention, late\-data handling, checkpoints and controlled replay. * Link test runs to approved engine, build and serialize component identities. Work with system owners to resolve mismatches and maintain traceable mappings. * Prepare and publish agreed test and performance summaries from the AWS environment for use by the business and manufacturing data platform. Work with the business \& manufacturing data engineer to establish controlled data exchanges, including the reference data needed to link test results to engines, builds and components. * Monitor data freshness, pipeline failures, processing performance and cloud consumption. Tune storage, retention and compute against agreed engineering and cost requirements. * Use source control, peer review, automated checks and controlled deployment. Maintain separate development and production configurations and protect credentials. * Document pipelines, dependencies and recovery procedures. Train a nominated deputy and contribute to an agreed support and incident response model. Required Qualifications * Practical experience building and supporting production data pipelines on AWS, including S3 and appropriate processing, orchestration and monitoring services. * Strong Python and SQL skills, with experience handling large files, time\-series data or other complex engineering datasets. * Understanding of incremental processing, idempotency, schema changes, data quality controls and recovery from partial failure. * Experience with Git, code review, testing and repeatable deployments. Ability to work with infrastructure as code and CI/CD practices. * Understanding of cloud access controls, service identities, encryption and secure connectivity, working with infrastructure and security specialists. * Ability to diagnose failures, explain cost drivers and document a service so another engineer can maintain it. * Ability to translate engineering requirements into clear data contracts and acceptance tests, and communicate effectively with technical and business colleagues. * Relevant qualification or equivalent practical experience. Candidates should demonstrate delivered outcomes rather than a specific certification alone. Preferred Qualifications * Automotive, motorsport, aerospace, manufacturing or another test\-intensive engineering environment. * Dyno or rig data, signal alignment, timestamp synchronization, calibration context, telemetry formats and engineering metadata. * Parquet or Delta Lake, distributed processing, and AWS services such as Glue, Athena, EMR, Kinesis or equivalent tools selected for the workload. * Cross\-cloud data exchange, Microsoft Fabric or Power BI integration, and linking test results to PLM, ERP or lifing records. * Databricks on AWS where justified by the processing requirements. Databricks experience is beneficial rather than a prerequisite. Why Join Us Ready to be part of a team that pushes boundaries both on and off the track? At GM Performance Power Units, we are developing a new era of performance for the Formula 1 grid. Joining us means entering a startup racing environment backed by a legacy of engineering excellence, giving you the rare opportunity to help build a world\-class program from day one. We believe in rewarding innovation and powering potential. As part of our team, you’ll benefit from a competitive and comprehensive package designed to support your performance, well\-being, and future, helping you thrive at every level. **That includes access to:** * Bonus scheme * Private healthcare * 401(k) plan including company match * Employer\-paid life insurance and disability coverage * 32 days annual leave (including holidays) * Free financial advisor access * Employee Assistance Programs (EAP) * Subsidized on\-site dining * On\-site gym * Discounted GM vehicle purchase/lease program * Free on\-site EV charging for personal GM vehicles It’s all part of our commitment to creating a workplace that’s as high\-performing and forward\-thinking as the people who make it succeed. Join us and help power what’s next. You’ll play a pivotal role in ensuring the reliability and performance of a next\-generation Formula 1 power unit. Our culture rewards precision, innovation, and the relentless pursuit of performance. **Please note:** GM Performance Power Units and all affiliated companies are Equal Opportunity employer(s). Minorities, women, veterans, and individuals with disabilities are encouraged to apply. For more information regarding the EEOC, please visit https://www.eeoc.gov/employers/upload/poster\_screen\_reader\_optimized.pdf. Only direct hires need apply to or inquire about job postings at GM Performance Power Units. We are not accepting calls, resumes or applications from recruiting firms at this time.

jobs.title: Firmware Engineer II
jobs.description: **About Us** ------------ Epia Neuro is a neural technology company developing intent\-driven systems designed to restore function and independence for people living with neurological conditions. Its platform integrates implantable neural interfaces, adaptive algorithms, and assistive devices to translate neural intent into real\-world action. The company's initial focus is stroke\-related motor impairment, with expansion into cognitive decline and other neurological disorders, focusing on long\-term solutions for the growing aging population. **The Role** ------------ We're looking for a Firmware Engineer II who is passionate about developing and testing embedded software for medical devices. You'll contribute to the design, implementation, and testing of firmware for our implantable neural interfaces and external devices, working across the embedded software development lifecycle—from hardware bring\-up and device drivers to application development, integration, and verification. This is a hands\-on engineering role combining strong technical skills with exceptional attention to detail. You'll work closely with hardware, software, and research teams to build robust embedded systems that meet the demanding requirements of regulated medical devices. **What You'll Do** ------------------ *Embedded Firmware Development* * Design, develop, test, and maintain embedded firmware in C/C\+\+ for implantable and external medical devices. * Develop device drivers, communication interfaces, and application\-level firmware for microcontroller\-based systems. * Implement firmware features involving hardware peripherals, real\-time operation, custom ASICs, and communication protocols. * Develop Python scripts and applications to interface with embedded devices for testing, debugging, and characterization. * Participate in firmware design discussions and code reviews, contributing to software quality, reliability, and maintainability. *Hardware Integration \& Testing* * Support hardware bring\-up, firmware integration, and troubleshooting of embedded systems. * Debug hardware and firmware issues using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, JTAG/SWD debuggers, and other laboratory equipment. * Develop and execute unit tests, integration tests, and automated tests to verify firmware functionality and reliability. * Collaborate with hardware, software, and research teams to integrate firmware with the broader medical\-device system. *Regulated Development \& Documentation* * Develop firmware within our regulated quality management system and software lifecycle, contributing to requirements, design, verification, and documentation consistent with ISO 13485 and IEC 62304\. * Document firmware designs, interfaces, test procedures, and verification results to support development and regulatory activities. * Investigate defects, identify root causes, and implement corrective actions to improve firmware quality and reliability. **Qualifications** ------------------ * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * 2\+ years of professional experience developing embedded firmware or embedded software. * Strong proficiency in C/C\+\+ for microcontroller\-based embedded systems. * Experience with microcontrollers (e.g., ARM Cortex\-M), hardware peripherals, interrupts, and embedded communication protocols such as UART, SPI, and I2C. * Experience with Python for scripting, automation, or embedded device testing. * Experience debugging embedded systems using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and hardware debuggers. * Ability to read schematics and understand basic digital and analog electronics. * Familiarity with real\-time operating systems (RTOS) and embedded software design principles. * Experience using Git and participating in collaborative software development. * Strong problem\-solving and communication skills, with attention to detail and the ability to independently develop, debug, and test firmware features and collaborate across engineering disciplines. **Nice to Have** ---------------- * Experience with Nordic Semiconductor nRF microcontrollers, the nRF Connect SDK, and Zephyr RTOS. * Experience with Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE), USB, or other embedded communication interfaces. * Experience developing low\-power, battery\-operated embedded systems. * Experience with automated firmware testing, unit testing frameworks, or CI/CD pipelines. * Experience with static code analysis tools and embedded debugging tools such as Segger J\-Link or GDB. * Experience developing software for medical devices or other regulated or safety\-critical systems. * Familiarity with IEC 62304, ISO 13485, ISO 14971, or medical\-device design controls. * Familiarity with secure firmware development and medical\-device cybersecurity requirements. **Physical Requirements** ------------------------- * Ability to work on site, including hands\-on testing with prototype devices, laboratory equipment, and participation in hardware bring\-up and integration sessions. **How We Work** --------------- * **We are intentional.** We prioritize and are thoughtful about how we use others' time. * **We care for others.** We prioritize safety both for patients and one another. * **We own outcomes, not just tasks.** Our work demands the highest standards because it impacts real patients and real lives. * **Humility is a strength.** We are honest about what we know and what we don't know. Getting it right matters more than being right. **Location** ------------ This role is based in Alameda, CA, on site 5 days a week. **Benefits** ------------ Full\-time employees are eligible for the following benefits: * Competitive base salary with equity * 100% of healthcare coverage for you and your dependents * Generous vacation policy * Paid parental leave * Work from our waterfront office in Alameda, CA, with access to collaborative spaces and labs Compensation Range: $115K \- $140K

jobs.description: Description: **WARE** is one of the nation’s largest and most expansive boiler rental, service, education, and training companies. A family\-owned business founded in 1952, **WARE** has experienced continual growth for nearly 75 years. The company culture strongly rooted in service, growth and generosity sets it apart, with these core values serving as the foundation of the company’s success. Steam power plays a significant role in the daily operations of many large economic sectors, such as health care, education, food, and petrochemical among others, poising **WARE** for expansive growth for years to come. jobs.title: Junior DevSecOps Engineer (Python, CI/CD)
jobs.description: **About Peregrine** Peregrine Advisors is a rapidly growing AI and data innovation hub helping government solve hard problems and deliver better outcomes. We work across the full lifecycle—from strategy and governance through architecture, engineering, analytics, AI, visualization, and training—for clients including the SEC, PCAOB, DDOT, and DCAA. Our clients describe our support as “absolutely excellent” and our people as “instrumental to organization’s success.” Winner of the United Nations COP27 Datathon, our work has earned all Exceptional CPARS ratings, SEC Chair’s Awards, the SEC Vision Award, and recognition from FDA leadership. We are also built differently. Peregrine is the first and only social enterprise organized as a Benefit Corporation and SBA 8(a) company focused on AI and data for government. We believe business success should create client value, social value, and opportunity for our people. As we enter our next stage of growth, we need dependable, motivated, and skilled people who have a combination of intellectual curiosity and intellectual courage. With new clients, larger programs, and expanding responsibilities, the people joining Peregrine now will have the opportunity to help shape the company we become. **People first. Ownership always.** We solve problems through people, process, and technology—in that order. Technology matters, but people make transformation happen. That principle defines our culture. Trust and motivation are the foundational pillars of delivery on which our skills stand. We hire people we can trust, who care deeply about what they do, take ownership, learn quickly, help one another, and refuse to walk past a problem because it belongs to someone else. At Peregrine, you are not joining simply to fill a position. You are joining a team, taking ownership of a mission, and helping build a company. If that excites you, we should talk. At Peregrine Advisors, you will share in operating the automation, continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines, and secure cloud infrastructure that keep federal systems running. But we hire people, not seats. As the work evolves, you will move to where the hardest problems are. This is a hybrid work arrangement based in the Washington, DC metropolitan area, and the commuting cadence varies by assignment. The initial engagement requires United States citizenship and the ability to obtain a Public Trust determination. **Your first project** Expect your first project to put you shoulder to shoulder with engineers, on pipelines a team leans on every day. Depending on the assignment, you may: * Contribute to the Terraform or CloudFormation code that defines infrastructure. * Under senior engineers' guidance, develop and maintain deployment automation and pipelines. * Pitch in on running Docker containers and Amazon Web Services (AWS) environments, from orchestration to monitoring and logging. * Wire vulnerability checks, security scans, and policy controls into the delivery pipeline. * Turn repeatable operational tasks into Python scripts, reaching for Bash or PowerShell when those suit better, and close out every finding that comes back. * Take a hand in mapping and implementing National Institute of Standards and Technology Special Publication 800\-53 (NIST SP 800\-53\) controls, and automate the evidence that shows compliance. * Bring AI\-assisted tools into your pipeline, testing, and scripting work, and verify every output they produce. Code review sees every change you make, and you walk reviewers through the change and your reasons. That is where you learn what makes a change correct, not just that it runs. You automate the team's manual tasks, and you build your share of a practice that designs security in from the start instead of bolting it on later. This is where you start, not the shape of your career here. **Requirements** * 1\+ years of experience in software development, platform engineering, or operations engineering * A bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, cybersecurity, engineering, or a related technical discipline * Practical use of one or more pipeline tools, grounded in a working knowledge of CI/CD concepts * Ability to write scripts in Python (Bash or PowerShell skills a plus) * Familiarity with Docker and containerization, together with the cloud services AWS offers * Exposure to tools that express infrastructure as code, for example CloudFormation or Terraform * A basic understanding of how containers are orchestrated * Experience with the fundamentals of Linux * Knowledge of web applications and application programming interfaces, together with networking concepts and load balancing * Grounding in the principles of cloud security and in practices for delivering software securely * Skill at tracking down and resolving problems in infrastructure and in deployments * Experience generating and reviewing code with AI\-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot * Proficiency in writing, PowerPoint, and Excel **Preferred** * Prior work in information technology for the federal government * Exposure to one or more of these areas: Authority to Operate (ATO) processes, NIST SP 800\-53 controls, or Federal Information Security Modernization Act (FISMA) compliance * An AWS certification or practical experience delivering production workloads on AWS * A background with security tooling or vulnerability scanning, for example dynamic application security testing (DAST), policy\-as\-code, or static application security testing (SAST) **Who you are** For you, security and reliability belong in the build from the first commit, never in a final gate, and you are eager to grow into an engineer whose automation replaces other people's manual work and leaves an audit trail. When you hit a wall, you ask rather than guess. Feedback is your fastest way forward, and when priorities move, you move with them. You experiment, fail, learn, and repeat quickly. You would rather own an outcome than be handed a task. **What you bring** * A grounding in cloud fundamentals, networking, Linux, scripting, and delivery automation, and an appetite to dig deeper into security. * Delivery habits in secure configuration, code review, automated testing, and version control, or a willingness to build them quickly. * Clear, plain updates: what you have finished, where you are stuck, and what you need. * The care to hold up where accuracy and auditability cannot slip. You adapt your development workflow as AI tools evolve, using them to help implement, test, and improve the components you own. You give the tools clear context, review and test their output, and remain accountable for the code you deliver. **When we talk** Be prepared to discuss a difficult problem you worked through, the decisions you made, what happened, and what you learned. The technical assessment is a Python coding exercise. **Benefits** This is a full\-time W\-2 position with a salary of $80,000 to $95,000 per year. Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance with the employee premium fully paid and half of dependent premiums; employer\-paid life, accidental death, and short\-term and long\-term disability insurance; a 401(k) with an employer match of up to 4% of salary; unlimited paid time off; and sponsored professional certifications and continuing education. **What we offer** You will work alongside developers, engineers, data scientists, architects, and strategists, on work ranging from strategy to implementation. We support your development across assignments and clients through extensive onboarding, sponsored professional certifications such as the Data Management Capability Assessment Model (DCAM) and AWS technical certifications, and rotation across functions to expand your skills and perspective. The mission is real, the problems are hard, and you own what you ship. **What we commit to** As a Benefit Corporation, our commitment runs three ways: real, measurable value for our clients; government that works better for the public; and a team that makes everyone in it better. We hire people who want to help build the firm, not just work at it. If that is you, apply. Peregrine Advisors is an equal opportunity employer. Peregrine exclusively works with OPEN Data Jobs to recruit our team. Register with OPEN Data Jobs to be considered for this and future openings.

jobs.title: ML Ops Engineer
jobs.description: **About Coinflow** Coinflow is the next\-generation payment service provider revolutionizing global financial infrastructure with stablecoins, AI\-driven fraud prevention, and instant settlement. Coinflow enables businesses to grow faster with instant settlement, fraud \& chargeback indemnity, global pay\-ins, multi\-currency FX, and unified payouts. Founded in 2023, the company serves marketplaces, fintechs, remittance providers, gaming platforms, and ecommerce merchants worldwide. Since our seed round in 2024, we’ve achieved 23x revenue growth and scaled to multi\-billion\-dollar annual transaction volume. In response to this growth, Coinflow announced a $25M Series A in October 2025—led by Pantera Capital, CMT Digital, Coinbase Ventures, Jump Crypto, and Reciprocal Ventures—accelerating our mission to power the world’s fastest\-moving businesses with innovative, reliable global payments. Coinflow is proudly headquartered in Chicago, IL. Learn more at coinflow.cash. **About The Role** ------------------ We're hiring an MLOps Engineer to own the platform that takes our fraud, risk, and payments models from notebook to production. You'll build the pipelines, serving infrastructure, and monitoring that let us score every transaction in real time, retrain safely. Our models sit in the authorization path of real money, so latency, reliability, and explainability matter as much as accuracy. You'll be hands\-on with AI\-native tooling: we use AI as a force multiplier for building pipelines, writing evals, and automating the boring parts of model operations. If you want to be one of the first ML infrastructure engineers building this way at a fast\-growing PSP, you'll fit in well here. **What You'll Own** ------------------- **Real\-Time Model Serving:** Build and operate the inference layer that scores transactions in the authorization path. Hit tight latency budgets, design safe fallbacks when a model or feature is unavailable, and make sure a model outage never becomes a payments outage. **ML Pipelines \& Feature Store:** Own training, validation, and deployment pipelines end to end. Build reproducible feature pipelines from our transaction, device, and chargeback data, with point\-in\-time correctness so offline training matches online scoring. **Model Deployment \& Rollout:** Make shipping a model boring. Versioning, registries, shadow mode, champion/challenger, canary rollouts, and one\-click rollback. Every change is gated by evals, not vibes. **Monitoring \& Drift Detection:** Instrument models the way we instrument services. Track latency, score distributions, feature drift, approval rates, and fraud and chargeback outcomes, wired into our observability stack with alerts that fire on real problems. **Third\-Party Model Integration:** Integrate and evaluate external fraud and risk vendors alongside our own models. Run parallel and shadow testing, compare performance on our data, and give the team a clear answer on what to trust. **Merchant\-Facing Risk Tooling:** Power the data and scoring behind our merchant\-facing risk products, so merchants can see risky customers and set their own blocking rules on top of our signals. **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- * 4\+ years in MLOps, ML infrastructure, or ML platform engineering, ideally at a fintech, payments company, or other regulated environment * You've run models in production with real latency and uptime requirements, not just trained them. Experience with real\-time inference in a transaction or decisioning path is a big plus * Strong Python and solid production engineering habits. Comfortable reading and writing TypeScript/Node, since that's where most of our services live * Hands\-on experience with ML pipeline and serving tooling (MLflow, Kubeflow, SageMaker, Vertex, BentoML, Feast, or similar) and the judgment to know when not to use them * Solid infrastructure skills: containers, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and at least one major cloud provider * Data engineering chops: you can build reliable feature pipelines over operational, warehouse, and streaming data, and you understand training/serving skew * Experience monitoring models in production: drift, calibration, and tying model metrics back to business outcomes like fraud loss and approval rates * Familiarity with fraud, risk, or credit modeling, and with explaining model behavior to non\-ML stakeholders like banks and auditors * Comfort working with AI\-native tooling (Claude Code or similar) as a daily driver, or genuine excitement to start * A bias toward shipping. We'd rather have a working v1 of a model pipeline today than a perfect platform next quarter The base salary range for this role is $120,000 \- $180,000 USD \+ equity. The actual base salary offered depends on a variety of factors, including but not limited to experience, education, skills, qualifications, and business needs. Join the team rewriting how money moves worldwide—and become a driving force in the $194 trillion cross\-border payments market. Compensation Range: $120K \- $180K

jobs.title: Reliability Lab Engineer
jobs.description: **POSITION SUMMARY** The Reliability Lab Engineer plans, executes, documents, and improves product and process reliability evaluations for SMT assemblies, repaired PCBAs, and assembled server systems. The role validates product robustness, investigates failure mechanisms, supports new product introduction (NPI) and engineering changes, and converts laboratory findings into corrective and preventive actions. Testing includes electrical, environmental, thermal, mechanical, and operational stress evaluations appropriate to product and customer requirements, with particular attention to high\-density GPU/server platforms, power delivery, connectors, and liquid\-cooling interfaces where applicable. **LEVEL I – Reliability Lab Engineer I** **Key Responsibilities** * Execute approved reliability test plans for SMT components, PCBAs, repaired boards, and server assemblies under engineering supervision. * Prepare samples, fixtures, test setups, labeling, and traceability records; verify test conditions and acceptance criteria before starting. * Operate environmental chambers, thermal cycling equipment, temperature/humidity loggers, power supplies, electronic loads, DMMs, oscilloscopes, and data acquisition tools as qualified. * Perform functional checks before, during, and after stress testing; capture failure symptoms, photographs, measurements, and test logs. * Support thermal profiling, burn\-in, power cycling, vibration/shock, and humidity exposure tests when specified by approved methods. * Follow ESD controls, equipment safety requirements, calibration status checks, and laboratory work instructions. * Enter test results and deviations in approved laboratory reports and MES/QMS systems; segregate failed samples for analysis. * Assist with initial failure isolation and collaborate with SMT, Repair, Manufacturing, and Quality teams. **Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in Electrical, Electronics, Mechanical, Materials, Reliability Engineering, or related discipline. * 1–3 years of experience in electronics testing, manufacturing, PCBA repair, or laboratory operations. * Basic understanding of SMT solder joints, BGA/QFN components, PCBAs, server hardware, ESD protection, and test documentation. * Ability to interpret drawings, schematics, test procedures, and equipment measurement data. **LEVEL II – Reliability Lab Engineer II** **Additional Responsibilities** * Develop and validate reliability test plans, sample sizes, test conditions, and pass/fail criteria with Design, Manufacturing, and Customer Quality teams. * Lead environmental and operational evaluations such as temperature cycling, thermal shock, damp heat, burn\-in, power cycling, and vibration/shock as applicable. * Analyze SMT/PCBA failure mechanisms including solder fatigue, cracked joints, head\-in\-pillow, component damage, intermittent connections, and repair\-induced defects. * Investigate server\-level failures involving power distribution, thermal management, fans, interconnects, GPU boards, and liquid\-cooling leakage or interface integrity when applicable. * Perform failure analysis using electrical troubleshooting, microscopy, X\-ray, cross\-sectioning, or external analytical laboratories as appropriate. * Apply statistical methods, Weibull/life\-data analysis where justified, trend charts, and design\-of\-experiments principles to interpret reliability results. * Lead structured root cause analysis (5 Why, fishbone, 8D) and verify corrective\-action effectiveness following repeat failures or RMA trends. * Coordinate laboratory equipment calibration, preventive maintenance, method validation, and controlled records for audit readiness. * Support NPI qualification, process changes, repair\-process validation, and customer reliability reporting. **Qualifications** * 3–6 years in electronics reliability, SMT/PCBA manufacturing, server assembly, or repair engineering. * Hands\-on experience with environmental chambers, electrical instrumentation, and structured failure analysis. * Working knowledge of IPC workmanship and repair standards, ESD controls, and risk\-based qualification methods. * Proficiency in technical reporting, statistical analysis, and cross\-functional problem solving. **LEVEL III – Senior Reliability Lab Engineer III** **Additional Responsibilities** * Own the reliability laboratory roadmap, qualification strategy, test capability, capacity planning, and technical standards for SMT, PCBA repair, and server platforms. * Define risk\-based reliability qualification matrices for high\-density GPU boards, high\-power systems, BGA assemblies, connectors, and liquid\-cooled server configurations. * Lead accelerated stress and life testing strategies, reliability modeling, and failure\-mechanism\-driven test selection; document assumptions and limitations. * Approve test methods, engineering protocols, acceptance criteria, and technical reports in alignment with customer and product requirements. * Direct complex multi\-disciplinary investigations of field returns, recurring RMA issues, and latent failures; integrate findings into design and process improvements. * Partner with R\&D, Supplier Quality, Manufacturing Engineering, and Repair to establish reliability design rules, screening strategies, and corrective actions. * Develop laboratory investment plans for chambers, thermal measurement, power cycling, vibration, inspection, and data systems; qualify external labs as needed. * Lead customer technical reviews and audits; maintain traceability, data integrity, and compliance with applicable QMS and ESD requirements. * Mentor junior engineers and technicians, establish technical training, and drive reliability KPIs such as test completion, failure recurrence, and closure effectiveness. **Qualifications** * 6–10\+ years of high\-reliability electronics engineering, including significant hands\-on laboratory and failure analysis experience. * Demonstrated leadership in server, GPU, SMT/PCBA, or repair reliability qualification programs. * Advanced understanding of thermal, electrical, mechanical, material, and solder\-interconnect failure mechanisms. * Experience with reliability statistics, accelerated testing, customer qualification, and technical team development. **COMMON PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS** * Safe, repeatable testing with complete sample traceability and calibrated equipment. * On\-time, technically sound reports with clear conclusions, risks, and recommended actions. * Timely escalation of critical failures and documented closure of corrective actions. * Continuous improvement of laboratory methods, coverage, and cross\-functional learning.

adaptability, and execution are essential. **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * Experience with Amazon Bedrock, AWS AgentCore, Lambda, Step Functions, S3, DynamoDB, RDS, SQS, or related AWS services. * Experience with LangGraph, LangChain, DSPy, Semantic Kernel, or similar agent orchestration frameworks. * Experience building multi\-step autonomous agents that interact with tools, APIs, external systems, or business workflows. * Experience developing AI evaluation frameworks, prompt regression testing, trace analysis, or human\-in\-the\-loop review systems. * Experience with vector databases and semantic retrieval technologies such as OpenSearch, pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate, or FAISS. * Experience with LLM observability and evaluation platforms such as LangSmith, Arize, Helicone, Weights \& Biases, or OpenTelemetry. * Experience leading technical initiatives within startup or rapidly scaling SaaS organizations. * Experience improving engineering practices, introducing development standards, or helping teams increase their technical maturity. * Experience balancing technical debt, delivery speed, operational reliability, and long\-term architectural decisions. **Who Thrives in This Role** ---------------------------- We're looking for an engineer who naturally takes ownership and leads through technical expertise, sound judgment, and example. Someone who can look at a complicated technical problem, develop a clear approach, bring other engineers along, and drive the work through completion. Someone who cares deeply about code quality and engineering craftsmanship, but understands the importance of pragmatism and delivering real value. Someone who enjoys mentoring engineers, challenging assumptions, providing constructive feedback, and helping teammates become more capable and independent. Someone who understands that technical leadership means being accountable not only for their own contributions, but also for the quality and success of the work they help lead. **Above all, we're looking for someone who makes both our AI systems and our engineering organization stronger.** **What Success Looks Like** --------------------------- * High\-impact AI initiatives are delivered successfully through effective technical leadership, clear ownership, and strong collaboration. * AI systems are reliable, observable, maintainable, and trusted by customers and internal teams. * Engineers working alongside you demonstrate measurable growth in technical ability, independence, and engineering judgment. * Code quality, testing practices, architectural consistency, and operational reliability improve across the teams you lead. * Complex technical initiatives move from ambiguous requirements to production\-ready solutions with greater consistency and predictability. * Engineering decisions balance innovation, delivery speed, maintainability, and long\-term business value. * Your technical leadership enables the broader organization to deliver increasingly sophisticated AI capabilities with confidence.

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer — AI-Native Data Platform
jobs.description: **About Us** ------------ Aarden is a land intelligence platform that helps landowners, investors, and developers figure out what a piece of land can actually be used for, and how to market it. We turn messy parcel, infrastructure, market, community, and ecological data into clear, bankable answers for land\-dependent assets. Our goal is to become the default decision layer for land: helping physical projects start in places where they can be built and supported for decades. We’ve built out a suite of data products to support that goal — pipelines, databases, and AI/ML models that power our maps and AI agents. We have strong product\-market fit, and we're now focused on hardening and scaling our data systems. That’s where you come in. **The Role** ------------ We’re looking for a high\-autonomy senior data engineer to own and evolve two types of assets central to Aarden’s future: our core datasets and the pipeline that keeps them current. The datasets bring together property data, geospatial data, and AI\-derived intelligence to power our insights and products. The pipeline makes it efficient and reliable to refresh, expand, and improve those datasets as our business grows. You’ll be responsible for the quality of the data and the systems behind it, with opportunities to contribute directly to our user\-facing product. **What You'll Do** ------------------ **Own and operate the data platform** * Own the day\-to\-day reliability and operation of our data infrastructure, including S3, Iceberg, Postgres, Lambda, PMTiles, and raster datasets. * Monitor, troubleshoot, and improve pipeline performance, observability, and data quality. * Extend existing pipelines to support new data sources and transformations. * Use automation and AI\-assisted workflows where they make operations more reliable or efficient. **Partner across the team** * Work with product to build datasets that support new features. * Co\-develop intelligence products with the analytics team. * Keep pipeline and dataset documentation useful and current. **Evolve the platform thoughtfully** * Stay current on data and geospatial technologies relevant to our stack. Identify opportunities to improve it, run focused experiments, and recommend changes when the benefits justify the tradeoffs. **You might be a good fit if you have…** ---------------------------------------- **Must\-have** * Owned the operation of one or more production data pipelines for a continuous period of at least 12 months * Experience with relational databases and lakehouse architectures * Strong Python skills; Experience with workflow orchestration (Prefect, Airflow, Dagster, or similar) * Curiosity and excitement about AI and the impact it can have on our ways of working as developers * Comfort working in a git\-based, CI\-friendly workflow * Minimum of 5 years of professional experience **Strongly preferred** * Experience with geospatial data and associated tooling (GDAL, GeoParquet, PostGIS, Apache Sedona, or similar) * Experience working in full\-stack environments, where your work can directly impact the application layer * Comfortable with PySpark or similar distributed data processing * Experience with Apache Sedona or other cloud spatial\-compute platforms * Experience building observability/logging layers for data pipelines (not just app services) * Experience with socioeconomic, property, parcel, real estate, or land data **Nice To have** * Experience using AI agents to improve data architecture in a real production codebase * Experience in real estate/land, energy, forestry, or agriculture tech * Experience in data scraping; ideally via agents. **Our Stack** ------------- **Languages:** Python and SQL. TypeScript/Node is a plus for our Application layer and AWS ingest paths. **Orchestration \& compute** * **Prefect 3** for pipeline orchestration (YAML/config\-driven flows, retries, logging) * **Coiled** for elastic EC2 workers on GDAL\-heavy and batch Python jobs * **Wherobots** (managed Apache Sedona / PySpark) for large\-scale spatial joins, parcel ingest, and lakehouse work **Data lake \& formats:** Apache Iceberg, Cloud\-Optimized GeoTIFF (COG), and PMTiles. Queried with PySpark and DuckDB. **Geospatial:** GDAL, rasterio, GeoPandas, and tippecanoe. Large\-scale spatial work runs on Sedona/Spark via Wherobots. **Databases \& serving:** PostgreSQL \+ PostGIS (and pgvector on the app side) as the production store. **Working at Aarden** --------------------- Aarden is a high\-trust, high\-output team. We’re striving to be intentional about our team growth. This allows us to test the outer boundaries of our individual capabilities, while also going deeper on developer tooling and support. You’ll work hard here, and we’ve got your back. Practically, this means you’ll be asked to take on large projects, have a high bar of expectations to meet, and have a strong support system to help you meet that high bar. That support system includes: * **At least 2 in\-person days per week at our office in Capitol Hill \|** We’ve found that while heads\-down time at home is fantastic for task\-related productivity, in\-person time is magic for longer\-form productivity. Our in\-person days are used to plan, troubleshoot, and check\-in with each other on progress and questions. Expect team lunches and whiteboarding. * **Focused ownership in your role \|** The rest of the team is here to help you and cares about the evolution of our data products. With that said, we’ll be looking to you to own your lane, go deep, and own the development of these products. * **Dedicated monthly AI tooling budget \|** We’re in a golden era of AI\-powered developer tooling. We strongly encourage augmenting your output with AI tools, and have a dedicated \& flexible budget for every team member to support that setup. We care about *what* you ship, not *how*. **Details** ----------- * **Reports to:** CTO * **Compensation:** $150,000 \- $180,000 based on skills and experience * **Location / remote policy:** Seattle\-based, able to commute to our office in Capitol Hill Compensation Range: $150K \- $180K

jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist
jobs.description: **About Us** ------------ Epia Neuro is a neural technology company developing intent\-driven systems designed to restore function and independence for people living with neurological conditions. Its platform integrates implantable neural interfaces, adaptive algorithms, and assistive devices to translate neural intent into real\-world action. The company's initial focus is stroke\-related motor impairment, with expansion into cognitive decline and other neurological disorders. **The Role** ------------ We are generating neural and behavioral data at an increasing pace, across preclinical and early human research studies, with clinical studies ahead. We are looking for a neural data scientist to turn that data into rigorous answers. This ranges from characterizing signal quality and decoding performance to exploring what else our data can tell us, such as which movements and behaviors we can extract and decode. You will design and carry out the analyses and build the analysis workflows that let us do this reliably as our data grows. This is a hands\-on, individual contributor data scientist role on our Research team, reporting to the Director of Research. You will work alongside the scientists running our studies, and your work will shape study design, inform our decoding approaches, and contribute to publications. You will also partner closely with our Software team, which owns production code and the software infrastructure used in our studies. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Own the analysis of our research studies end to end, from analysis strategy and statistical design through figures, readouts, and publications. * Characterize and validate the in vivo recording performance of our neural interface (signal quality, noise, artifacts, and stability), and establish the preprocessing and quality control that downstream analyses depend on. * Develop and evaluate decoding models that relate neural activity to behavior, including those used in closed\-loop study sessions. * Explore neural and behavioral data, including pose estimation and kinematics, to identify new variables and questions worth pursuing. * Build reproducible analysis pipelines and help define data standards across studies. * Work closely with study scientists to shape analysis plans and study design, communicate findings clearly to scientists, engineers, and leadership, and partner with our Software team to hand off research\-grade methods and code. **Qualifications** ------------------ * PhD in neuroscience, neural engineering, biomedical engineering, electrical engineering, computer science, or a related quantitative field, or a Master's degree in one of these fields with 4\+ years of relevant experience in a research\-focused role. * Substantial hands\-on experience analyzing continuous neural time\-series data, ideally field potentials such as ECoG, sEEG, LFP, or EEG. * A strong foundation in neural signal processing, including filtering, spectral analysis (such as band power and time\-frequency methods), artifact handling, and feature extraction. * A solid applied machine learning background, including both supervised and unsupervised methods, particularly with noisy biological data. * Demonstrated ability to independently frame scientific questions, select and defend appropriate methods, and carry analyses through to clear conclusions and actionable recommendations. * Experience aligning neural recordings with behavioral and task data. * Strong Python and scientific computing skills, with a track record of writing reusable, maintainable analysis code and using version control and sound data management practices. * Clear written and verbal communication, and comfort working across scientific and engineering teams. **Nice to Have** ---------------- * Experience with human intracranial recordings. * Experience with motor decoding, cognitive\-state decoding, or closed\-loop BCI. * Experience with video\-based pose estimation or kinematic analysis. * Experience building data pipelines or standards shared across studies. * Experience with cloud\-based data processing. **How We Work** --------------- * **We are intentional.** We prioritize and are thoughtful about how we use others' time. * **We care for others.** We prioritize safety both for patients and one another. * **We own outcomes, not just tasks.** Our work demands the highest standards because it impacts real patients and real lives. * **Humility is a strength.** We are honest about what we know and what we don't know. Getting it right matters more than being right. **Location** ------------ This role is based out of the San Francisco Bay Area and is expected to work on site from our Alameda headquarters at least 3 days a week. **Benefits** ------------ Full\-time employees are eligible for the following benefits: * Competitive base salary with equity * 100% of healthcare coverage for you and your dependents * Generous vacation policy * Paid parental leave * Work from our waterfront office in Alameda, CA, with access to collaborative spaces and labs Compensation Range: $140K \- $165K

jobs.title: Senior Frontend Developer
jobs.description: Good front\-end development is about more than making a page look right. It requires sound technical decisions, consistent performance and an understanding of how people interact with digital products. We are looking for a Senior Front\-End Developer in Waukesha, WI, to take ownership of complex interface development and contribute to the technical direction of our web applications. In this position, you will lead the development of front\-end features, establish reusable component patterns and work closely with product designers, back\-end engineers and project stakeholders. You will also review existing applications, address technical limitations and help improve development standards across projects. The role suits an experienced developer who can work independently, make informed architectural decisions and support other developers through technical guidance. Areas of Responsibility * Lead the development of complex, responsive web applications using modern JavaScript frameworks. * Design scalable front\-end architecture and establish reusable component structures. * Build and maintain application features using React, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML and CSS. * Evaluate technical requirements and recommend suitable approaches for interface implementation. * Collaborate with UX/UI designers to translate product concepts into practical, accessible interfaces. * Integrate front\-end applications with APIs, backend services and external platforms. * Identify performance limitations and improve rendering efficiency, loading speed and application responsiveness. * Establish and maintain front\-end coding standards, development patterns and documentation. * Review code submissions, identify potential issues and provide constructive technical feedback. * Investigate complex application defects and coordinate solutions with relevant engineering teams. * Guide junior and mid\-level developers on implementation practices, debugging and code quality. * Participate in technical planning, feature estimation and discussions concerning application improvements. Skills and Experience * At least five years of professional front\-end development experience, including work on production web applications. * Advanced knowledge of JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML5 and CSS3\. * Strong experience with React or another modern front\-end framework. * Experience designing component\-based applications and managing complex application state. * Practical knowledge of REST APIs, asynchronous operations and front\-end/backend integration. * Understanding of web accessibility, responsive layouts and cross\-browser development. * Experience with Git, code review processes and collaborative software development. * Familiarity with front\-end testing tools such as Jest, React Testing Library or Cypress. * Knowledge of build tools, package managers and modern front\-end development workflows. * Ability to assess technical trade\-offs and make decisions that support long\-term application maintenance. * Strong debugging, analytical and problem\-solving skills. * Experience mentoring developers and communicating technical decisions to different stakeholders. Working Arrangements This is a full\-time position based in Waukesha, Wisconsin, with a standard Monday through Friday schedule. The Senior Front\-End Developer will work closely with the engineering and product teams, contributing to application development, technical reviews and ongoing improvements. How to Apply Candidates with the relevant front\-end development experience and an interest in leading the delivery of reliable web applications are encouraged to apply through this job posting. Equal Opportunity Statement Employment decisions are based on relevant qualifications, professional experience and job\-related skills, in accordance with applicable employment laws. Pay: From $115,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Life insurance * Referral program * Vision insurance Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Senior IT Support Specialist
jobs.description: The IT Support Engineer II provides intermediate technical support, primarily through the service desk queue, and assists senior systems engineers with documented operational tasks and assigned project work. This position independently resolves routine and moderately complex issues, maintains clear documentation, and follows assignments through completion. The role requires sound troubleshooting judgment, dependable execution, and the ability to recognize when an issue needs senior engineering involvement. Expected work allocation: Approximately 75% service desk support and 25% operational and project assistance, used as a planning assumption rather than a fixed weekly quota. The manager adjusts priorities based on service demand, business impact, and scheduled work, reviewing incoming and resolved tickets, backlog age, hands\-on support effort, coverage needs, and committed project hours. Operational and project assignments include agreed work periods and backup queue coverage; significant incidents or rising backlog trigger reprioritization. Support scope: Provide deskside, remote, and on\-site support for corporate departments and supported businesses within SPG’s portfolio, including residential properties and remote users. Provide discreet, high\-touch executive support and travel to supported locations when assigned. Coordinate site visits and executive requests with the manager so urgent business needs are addressed without leaving the service desk uncovered. **Service desk responsibilities** ================================= * Own assigned tickets from initial investigation through resolution, user confirmation, and documented closure; maintain timely updates and follow up on dependencies. * Troubleshoot Windows devices, Microsoft 365 applications, account access, printing, mobile devices, and network connectivity using a structured approach. * Perform approved onboarding, offboarding, account and group changes, device deployment, software installation, and equipment replacement. * Provide delegated support for Okta authentication and application access, Microsoft 365 and Entra ID account lifecycle tasks, and Egnyte client, synchronization, and approved file\-access requests. Verify identity and required approvals before access changes; document fulfillment and validate the user outcome. During offboarding, complete assigned access revocation, session termination, license recovery, and equipment\-return checks using approved checklists. Escalate authentication\-policy, integration, and data\-governance changes to the responsible senior engineer or business owner. * Provide Tier 2 support for escalated tickets and help service desk colleagues resolve recurring issues and improve support procedures. * Prioritize work by business impact and urgency; raise aging tickets, competing commitments, and blockers early. Participate in scheduled phone, email, and collaboration\-channel coverage, recording requests in the service desk system regardless of how they arrive. Complete queue handoffs before planned absences, site visits, and project work. Participate in manager\-approved after\-hours emergency coverage and scheduled maintenance when assigned, following documented escalation routes and applicable scheduling and compensation policies. **Systems and project responsibilities** ======================================== * Complete repeatable tasks from approved runbooks, including endpoint maintenance, patch checks, inventory updates, and routine system health checks. * Monitor assigned endpoint patch deployments and exceptions through approved management tools, including Automox where deployed. Investigate failed or missed updates, coordinate device connectivity and restarts with users, perform approved remediation, and confirm completion. Record user\-impacting regressions and escalate unresolved failures or requests for patch deferral. Senior engineers retain ownership of deployment policies, emergency patch decisions, and exception approval. * Assist senior engineers with technology rollouts, migrations, upgrades, testing, and scheduled maintenance through clearly assigned tasks. * Gather logs, reproduce problems, perform approved remediation, and verify results; escalate unexpected conditions before proceeding. * Support conference\-room audio and video equipment, meeting connectivity, and approved voice services through documented checks and troubleshooting. Validate room readiness before assigned critical meetings and after equipment changes. Coordinate unresolved equipment, carrier, and network issues with vendors and senior engineers; production network configuration and voice\-system design remain outside this role’s independent authority. * Create and maintain knowledge articles, runbooks, asset records, and project task updates so work can be repeated consistently. **Responsibility and decision making** ====================================== Independently manage support work within established procedures and assigned access. Senior engineers retain responsibility for solution design and complex infrastructure changes. Follow change and security requirements; obtain the required review before changes outside approved procedures. Escalations must explain business impact, troubleshooting performed, findings, and the assistance needed. **Required technical skills** ============================= * Windows support: Diagnose operating system, hardware, software, printer, and performance problems; deploy and configure business devices. * Microsoft 365: Support Outlook, Teams, OneDrive, and SharePoint; perform delegated administration within approved procedures. * Identity and access: Working knowledge of Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, users, groups, permissions, MFA, and account lifecycle processes. * Networking: Troubleshoot TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, wired and wireless connectivity, and remote access; understand basic VLAN concepts. * Endpoint management: Use device management and patching tools to deploy approved software, check compliance, and investigate deployment failures. * Systems fundamentals: Understand Windows Server, file permissions, services, event logs, virtualization, monitoring, and backup concepts well enough to assist with documented tasks. * Security practices: Apply least privilege, verify identity before access changes, protect sensitive information, and promptly escalate suspicious activity. * Troubleshooting and documentation: Collect useful evidence, test likely causes, validate fixes, and write instructions another technician can follow. **Professional skills and work habits** ======================================= * Own commitments without repeated reminders; communicate progress, risks, and blockers before deadlines are missed. * Explain technical issues clearly and respectfully to users, colleagues, and vendors. * Balance queue responsibilities with scheduled project work; seek manager alignment when priorities conflict. * Follow procedures carefully, recognize limits of authority, accept feedback, and develop technical skills. **Qualifications and preferred experience** =========================================== Typically 2–4 years of hands\-on IT support experience, or equivalent demonstrated capability, including independent resolution of Tier 2 issues. A degree is helpful but not required when practical skills and experience meet the role requirements. Preferred: Basic PowerShell skills; experience with Okta, Zscaler, ManageEngine, Automox, SentinelOne, Egnyte, Rubrik, VMware, or comparable tools. Familiarity with every platform is not required. Relevant Microsoft, CompTIA A\+, Network\+, or Security\+ credentials are beneficial but optional. **Measures of success** ======================= Contribute accurate ticket and task data to team reporting on incoming and resolved demand, backlog age, response and resolution service targets, reopened tickets, user feedback, and time allocated to operational and project work. Review trends with the manager to identify recurring issues, stalled escalations, and coverage constraints. Interpret results by business impact and ticket complexity rather than ticket counts alone; improvement targets are established from validated baselines. * Resolve assigned tickets within agreed service targets, with accurate documentation and clear user communication. * Complete operational and project tasks on schedule, verify outcomes, and report exceptions promptly. * Provide useful escalations that help senior staff act quickly and reduce avoidable rework. * Improve support documentation and grow the range of tasks completed independently within approved procedures.

jobs.title: Senior SRE / Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description: **Our Mission** --------------- Everyone knows the feeling of opening something unexpected and loving it. IcyBox turns that feeling into a business. We started as a watch commerce and mystery box company and are building a consumer brand people trust and come back to. We move fast, sweat the details, and are still writing our playbook. **Our Values** -------------- * **Move Fast, Build Right:** Ship today, fix tomorrow. * **Own the Gap:** If nobody owns it, we step in. * **Clarity Is a Gift:** Turn noise into decisions and action. * **Trust Over Title:** Follow\-through beats position. * **Say the Real Thing:** Hard conversations happen early. * **Do the Unglamorous Work:** No task is beneath us. **About the Role** ------------------ We’re hiring a Senior SRE / Infrastructure Engineer to keep IcyBox fast, reliable and ready to scale. You’ll own our AWS infrastructure and make sure the site and app stay up through our biggest product drops and traffic spikes. **What You’ll Do** ------------------ * Design, build and run our infrastructure on AWS * Manage infrastructure as code with Pulumi * Set up monitoring, logging, alerting and service\-level objectives (SLOs) * Prepare for traffic spikes from drops and promotions with load testing and autoscaling * Lead on\-call, incident response and blameless postmortems * Improve deploy pipelines and container orchestration * Keep cloud costs under control as we grow * Own backups, disaster recovery and database reliability **What We’re Looking For** -------------------------- * 5\+ years in SRE, DevOps or infrastructure engineering * Deep AWS experience, including EC2, ECS or EKS, RDS, S3, IAM, VPC and CloudFront (required) * Strong infrastructure\-as\-code skills with Pulumi, Terraform, or CloudFormation * Experience with Docker and container orchestration on Kubernetes or ECS * Hands\-on with observability tools such as Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana or CloudWatch * Scripting skills in Python, Go or Bash * Experience leading incident response for critical production systems **Nice to Have** ---------------- * AWS certifications, such as Solutions Architect or DevOps Engineer * Handling flash sales or sudden e\-commerce traffic spikes * PostgreSQL or MySQL performance tuning * Cloud cost optimization * Startup or high\-growth company experience Compensation Range: $180K \- $220K

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Platform
jobs.description: **Our Mission** --------------- Everyone knows the feeling of opening something unexpected and loving it. IcyBox turns that feeling into a business.
