It’s the system every team uses to run the business: merchandising builds and prices boxes in it, operations ships items and manages stock, finance reconciles payments and payouts, growth runs promotions, affiliates and experiments, and support helps users. This is a full\-stack product role. You’ll talk to internal users, decide what to build, and ship it end to end, usually within days. This role is in person at our New York City office, five days a week. **What You’ll Do** * Design and build features across a Rust backend and a React frontend, from database schema to UI. * Build tools for operational workflows such as catalog and inventory management, pricing, order fulfilment and customer support. * Turn data into decisions with dashboards, reporting and analytics built on our data warehouse. * Integrate the platform with external services and keep those integrations reliable as they scale. * Make the system safe to operate: role\-based access, audit trails, safe migrations and performance under real production load. * Work closely with the teams who use what you build, learn how they actually work, and replace manual processes and spreadsheets with fast, simple tools. **What We’re Looking For** * 5\+ years of software engineering experience, with real experience on both backend and frontend. * Strong backend skills in Rust, or in another typed language (Go, Kotlin, TypeScript, etc.) plus a clear interest in moving to Rust. * Solid React \+ TypeScript skills, including data fetching and state management (e.g. TanStack Query) and building data\-dense UIs: tables, filters, forms, charts. * Strong PostgreSQL / SQL: schema design, migrations, query performance. * Product sense. You ask why an operator needs something before building it, and you care that internal tools are fast and pleasant to use. * Comfort owning features end to end in a small team with high velocity. **Nice to Have** * Experience with internal tools, admin platforms or ERP\-like systems at an e\-commerce, marketplace or fintech company * Data warehouse experience (Snowflake, dbt) or building analytics and experimentation tooling * Experience working on the AWS platform * Experience using AI coding tools effectively in your daily workflow. * Startup or high\-growth company experience Compensation Range: $180K \- $220K

jobs.title: Senior/Staff Software Engineer, Customer Integrations — PCB/CAD
jobs.description: **Location** ------------ Los Angeles **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- Remote **Department** -------------- Engineering **About Quilter** ================= At Quilter, we are helping electrical engineers save time and accomplish more by automating the tedious and time\-consuming task of designing printed circuit boards (PCBs). Our small team is composed of experts in electrical engineering, electromagnetic simulation, ML/AI, and high\-performance computing (HPC). We are inventing and leveraging novel techniques to solve the decades\-old problem of automating circuit board design where today hundreds of billions of dollars are spent. We have raised $25 million in Series B funding from some of the very best and are charging full\-speed toward our goal. No matter where we come from, we're united by a common vision for the future and a core set of values we think will get us there: * Curiosity * Conviction * Rigor We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer to work directly with our go\-to\-market team and customers to turn integration blockers into production fixes and features. Our File I/O team connects Quilter with tools including Altium, KiCad, Cadence Allegro, and Siemens Xpedition, preserving design intent as files move into Quilter and results return to the customer’s CAD workflow. You’ll work primarily in Python on parsers, exporters, design models, diagnostics, and workflow automation. This role suits someone who enjoys jumping into ambiguous technical problems, collaborating directly with customers, and seeing their engineering work make an immediate difference. You’ll contribute to broader improvements in CAD coverage and fidelity as well as resolving urgent blockers. You’ll also help build workflows using LLMs and agents to investigate failures, find recurring patterns, and automate repetitive integration work, with reliable checks on the results. **Location:** This is a hybrid role based out of our Long Beach, CA office, with regular in\-person collaboration alongside our go\-to\-market team. **What You’ll Do** ------------------ * **Investigate and resolve customer blockers.** Work with customers and GTM to reproduce failures, inspect design data and logs, and identify the cause. Fix File I/O issues and coordinate with partner teams when a problem crosses system boundaries. * **Ship integration features and fixes.** Own Python changes from design through rollout, including parsers, exporters, and shared representations of boards, schematics, and constraints. Make sound implementation tradeoffs and contribute through code reviews. * **Verify the complete design workflow.** Turn representative customer cases into acceptance checks and regression tests. Validate that design information survives import and that exported results remain usable in the customer’s native CAD tool. * **Turn recurring problems into better tooling.** Improve diagnostics and error messages, automate reproductions, and build agentic investigation workflows. Use evaluations and feedback loops to make troubleshooting faster and more reliable. * **Connect customers’ existing workflows to Quilter.** Build reusable scripts and integrations for design\-data preparation and handoffs. Use repeated customer needs to identify capabilities worth supporting in the shared product. * **Work closely with GTM and engineering.** Help the team prioritize urgent blockers and larger improvements, agree on scope and commitments, and explain findings clearly. Pair with customers, demonstrate fixes, and document workflows they can use independently. **What We’re Looking For** -------------------------- * Deep production Python experience, with ownership of maintainable software from design through testing and rollout. * Experience working directly with customers, partners, or technical users to understand a workflow, diagnose integration problems, and deliver working software. * Strong debugging skills across unfamiliar code, files, and structured data. You can isolate causes and test hypotheses with incomplete information. * Clear communication and sound judgment under time pressure. You explain uncertainty, coordinate priorities and dependencies, and follow through on both immediate fixes and lasting improvements. * Practical experience with LLMs and agentic workflows, including evaluating results and improving the tools and feedback loops around them. **Nice to Have** ---------------- These are useful backgrounds, not a checklist—we don’t expect any one candidate to bring all of them. * Hands\-on familiarity with PCB design workflows and ECAD tools. * Experience with parsers, proprietary file formats, vendor APIs, or CAD scripting. * Experience in customer or integration engineering, including troubleshooting in environments with restricted access to systems or design data. * Experience building regression corpora, diagnostic tools, or agent harnesses and evals. **What Success Looks Like** --------------------------- Customer blockers turn into verified production improvements. More designs move successfully through import, Quilter, and native export; recurring failures decrease, and the tests, diagnostics, and workflow tools you build help the whole team resolve the next issue faster. **Please note**: We are an equal opportunity employer. At this time, we are focused on hiring primarily within the US, with occasional exception to accommodate exceptional talent. **What we offer:** ================== * Interesting and challenging work * Competitive salary and equity benefits * Health, dental, and vision insurance * Regular team events and offsites (\~4x / year) * Unlimited paid time off * Paid parental leave

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Full stack
jobs.description: Software Engineer – Full Stack Job Type :\- Freelance Work Location :\- Remote Compensation :\- $50–$100 per hour Schedule :\- 15 hours per week, Flexible Job Summary We are seeking an experienced Full Stack Software Engineer to design, develop, test and maintain scalable, production\-ready software applications powered by Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs). In this role, you will work across frontend and backend development, API integration, cloud infrastructure, databases and intelligent application development. You will collaborate with engineering teams and technical leaders to build reliable software solutions, improve application performance, troubleshoot complex issues and maintain high standards of code quality. jobs.title: Sr. Software Engineer, Agents
jobs.description: **Job Title:** Sr. Software Engineer, Agents **Team:** Engineering **Location:** Onsite \- Sawtelle (Between Santa Monica \& West LA) **Employment Type:** Full\-time, Salary, Exempt **Reports To:** Head of Engineering ### **About Plug** Plug is the marketplace for used electric vehicles. Consumers get an instant cash offer backed by battery\-health data, and dealers across the US bid in real time on that inventory. Former Tesla executives founded Plug in 2023\. We’ve raised a $20M Series A led by Lightspeed Venture Partners. ### **Why Plug** * You’ll help build the biggest infrastructure opportunity in automotive. * You’ll work on a platform built exclusively for EVs, with nothing adapted from legacy automotive. * You’ll be part of an AI\-native company. We’re rethinking how work gets done at a fundamental level. * You’ll work directly with operators who have scaled multi\-billion dollar businesses in automotive, EV, and marketplaces. * You’ll ship constantly, with high autonomy and a direct line to company outcomes. ### **The Opportunity** Plug runs on a lot of manual work: reading titles and inspection reports, chasing paperwork with dealers, checking vehicle details, answering sellers, and moving each car from offer to sale. Much of that work can be done by agents. We already run LLM features in production, and our engineers own the core platform: the marketplace, pricing, and the systems that tie them together. What we need now is someone who can turn a stream of real operational problems into agents that work reliably, one after another. ### **What You’ll Do** * Build and ship agents and multi\-agent workflows for operations, dealers, and sellers: document extraction, inspection and title review, dealer and seller communication, and internal tooling. * Use LangChain and LangGraph to build agents, and LangSmith or Langfuse to trace, debug, and evaluate them. * Write evals, build datasets from real cases, measure accuracy and failure modes, and make regressions visible. * Integrate agents with the services the team already owns, through clean APIs and tools. Work within the existing architecture and raise design concerns with the owning engineer instead of routing around them. * Monitor agents in production: cost, latency, error rates, and human\-review rates. Fix what breaks and tighten prompts, tools, and guardrails over time. * Ship full\-stack when the job calls for it: the TypeScript and React screens where people review and correct agent output, and the backend endpoints behind them. * Help the rest of engineering adopt the same patterns. Build reusable tools, examples, and short write\-ups that make the next agent faster to build. ### **What You’ll Bring** * 5\+ years of full\-time industry software engineering, with a track record of shipping features to production and supporting them after launch. * Strong TypeScript or Python, and comfort working across the stack: APIs, databases, and frontend when needed. * Hands\-on experience building LLM features in production: tool use, retrieval, structured output, and above all, evaluation. * Experience with an agent framework and observability stack, ideally LangChain, LangGraph, LangSmith, or Langfuse. If you’ve used something else, show us what you built and how you knew it worked. * You work agent\-first. You’ve built your own tooling around coding agents, such as skills, MCP servers, custom workflows, or evals. * Comfort building inside systems other people designed. You can disagree, make your case, and then ship the agreed plan. * A habit of writing things down: short design notes, eval results, and runbooks that others can pick up. * You enjoy being part of a small team: pairing, reviewing each other’s work, and sharing credit. * High agency in an ambiguous, fast\-moving startup. You find the most valuable workflow to automate and ship against it without waiting for a perfect spec. * BS in computer science or a related field, or equivalent experience. ### **Nice to Have** * Experience with document\-heavy workflows such as titles, registrations, inspections, lending, or insurance. * Experience with vehicle, marketplace, or auction products. * Experience with human\-in\-the\-loop review tools, or with fine\-tuning and prompt optimization for production LLM features. ### **Compensation and Benefits** Annual salary: $175,000 to $200,000 Salary ranges come from independent, third\-party benchmarking against national compensation data. Where an offer falls within the range depends on relevant experience, specialized skills, training and qualifications, current business needs, and market conditions. We review ranges periodically and may adjust them as the market changes. ### **Benefits \& Perks** * Health, Vision, and Dental insurance * 401(k) plan * Daily lunch stipend * Equity (based on role and performance) * 30\-day remote work from anywhere policy * Unlimited PTO * Fully stocked kitchen * Dog\-friendly office * Ongoing opportunities for growth and development This full\-time position is an in\-person role based in Sawtelle (between Santa Monica and West Los Angeles). Relocation assistance will not be provided for successful candidates. Sponsorship not available at this time. **Acknowledgments** Plug is an equal opportunity employer. We don’t discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, age, marital status, military or veteran status, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by law. Plug will consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records in accordance with the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring and the California Fair Chance Act.

jobs.title: Staff Engineer, Payments & Fraud
jobs.description: **Our Mission** --------------- Everyone knows the feeling of opening something unexpected and loving it. IcyBox turns that feeling into a business. We started as a watch commerce and mystery box company and are building a consumer brand people trust and come back to. We move fast, sweat the details, and are still writing our playbook. **Our Values** -------------- * **Move Fast, Build Right:** Ship today, fix tomorrow. * **Own the Gap:** If nobody owns it, we step in. * **Clarity Is a Gift:** Turn noise into decisions and action. * **Trust Over Title:** Follow\-through beats position. * **Say the Real Thing:** Hard conversations happen early. * **Do the Unglamorous Work:** No task is beneath us. **About the Role** We’re hiring a Staff Engineer to own Payments and Fraud. This role is in person at our New York City office, five days a week. **What You’ll Do** * Implement and own the architecture for payments, refunds and reconciliation in Rust * Build and tune fraud detection, including rules, risk scoring and models * Cut chargebacks, fraud losses and false declines while protecting conversion * Integrate and manage payment providers such as Stripe or PayPal, plus wallets like Apple Pay and Google Pay * Keep our payment systems compliant with PCI DSS and card network rules * Lead the response to payment outages and fraud attacks * Connect with Snowflake and other data analysis platforms * Work with finance, operations and support on disputes, refunds and reporting **What We’re Looking For** * 8\+ years of software engineering experience, with significant time building payments or fraud systems at scale * Strong backend skills in Rust, or in another typed language plus a clear interest in moving to Rust. * Deep knowledge of card payments: authorization, capture, settlement, refunds and chargebacks * Hands\-on experience building fraud detection or risk systems * Strong backend skills and experience designing reliable, idempotent distributed systems * A track record of leading cross\-team technical projects from design to launch * Able to explain tradeoffs clearly to engineers and non\-engineers **Nice to Have** * Strong PostgreSQL / SQL: schema design, migrations, query performance * Experience in e\-commerce or high\-value goods such as watches, luxury or collectibles * Experience with fraud tools such as Stripe Radar * Experience with payouts and KYC platforms * Machine learning for risk scoring * Chargeback management and dispute representment * Multi\-currency and international payments * Experience using AI coding tools effectively in your daily workflow * Startup or high\-growth company experience Compensation Range: $220K \- $300K

jobs.title: Senior Architect - Data Platforms & Architecture
jobs.description: Are you looking for a role that motivates and challenges you? Are you ready for an opportunity for growth? Do you want to work on teams where people roll up their sleeves to take on tough problems together, and regularly blow the doors off our clients with their outstanding teamwork? If you answered yes to those questions, 3Cloud might just be for you! At 3Cloud, we hire people who aren't afraid to experiment or fail. We hire people who are willing to give direct and candid feedback to their managers, leaders, and team members. We hire people who jump at those opportunities because they care about our collective growth and success. We hire people who challenge and hold each other accountable for living 3Cloud's core values because they know that it will result in amazing experiences and solutions for our clients and each other. The Senior Architect in Delivery leads architecture and technical direction for multi\-team Azure programs across applications, platforms, and data. You connect client goals to scalable designs, guide delivery across teams, and shape modernization work so it delivers measurable results. At this level, you influence architecture beyond a single project. You set direction across engagements, work with business and technology leaders, raise the bar on delivery quality, and promote reusable patterns. You mentor architects and senior engineers, support strategic pursuits, and turn working solutions into repeatable delivery models. Responsibilities: Solution Architecture and Technical Leadership * Lead architecture and technical strategy for Azure modernization and transformation programs that span multiple teams and workstreams. * Translate client goals into scalable designs that align with business priorities, non\-functional requirements, delivery constraints, and program\-level outcomes. * Drive architecture across teams so designs follow shared models, standards, and patterns. * Collaborate with architects and engineers in other domains to integrate solutions and maintain a cohesive end\-to\-end architecture. * Provide ongoing architectural guidance during implementation, including reviews of key designs and code, and define patterns and guardrails that teams can reuse. * Apply solid engineering practices in your primary domain—modular design, clear interfaces, testability, and observability—so solutions remain robust and maintainable. * Use AI\-assisted tooling to accelerate design, code, tests, documentation, and analysis, and help teams adopt effective practices at program scale. Delivery and Consulting Excellence * Lead or co\-lead discovery and roadmap work for programs or large workstreams, turning inputs into integrated, testable backlogs with clear non\-functional requirements and dependencies. * Use structured problem solving to clarify scope, dependencies, and risks at program scale, and explain options in terms of value, cost, risk, and time\-to\-impact. * Communicate architecture strategy and decisions clearly to technical and non\-technical audiences, including executives. * Build trusted relationships with product, engineering, and technology leaders, and help shape modernization roadmaps in the client's best interest. * Provide architecture oversight so designs, interfaces, and integration points support predictable delivery and stable team velocity. * Align multiple teams on shared outcomes, contracts, and integration points, ensuring dependencies are identified, owned, and tracked through to delivery. * Help define delivery approaches, working agreements, and documentation practices that keep 3Cloud and client teams aligned across locations and time zones. * Support effective use of Agile at scale by ensuring architecture and backlog structure enable incremental delivery, clear definitions of done, and data\-informed adjustments based on telemetry and feedback. * Apply a consulting mindset by anticipating client needs, proposing options, and tying solutions to clear results and adoption, and handle challenge and pushback by explaining trade\-offs in simple, direct language. Mentorship and Team Development: * Mentor architects, senior engineers, and technical leads, building their design skills, architectural judgment, and ability to work effectively across systems and teams. * Provide architectural oversight across teams or workstreams, modeling pragmatic decision\-making and showing when to keep solutions simple and when new patterns or technologies are justified. * Support hiring and growth by participating in technical interviews, calibration discussions, and mentorship, and by helping shape development plans for future architects. Growth and Innovation: * Contribute to business development by identifying opportunities beyond the current assignment across all our capabilities and assisting the sales director in pursuing them. * Intentionally builds relationship networks within client accounts to deepen partnership and identify opportunities to provide additional business value. * Partner with sales and account leaders on strategic pursuits by setting the technical vision, contributing to solution strategy, and participating in client workshops, demos, and roadmap sessions. * Create solution options, high\-level designs, and estimates for programs, clearly documenting assumptions, dependencies, and risks and tying them back to business value and risk reduction. * Build and evolve reusable assets—such as reference architectures, runbooks, workshops, starter repositories, and templates—that become standard paths for delivery teams. * Champion adoption of modern frameworks, patterns, platform capabilities, automation, and AIassisted tools that improve quality, speed, or reliability in a safe and secure way. * Actively participate in enablement initiatives, share lessons from complex engagements, and help build a culture of collaboration, continuous improvement, and knowledge sharing. jobs.title: Senior Scientist, Machine Learning Research
jobs.description: A\-Alpha Bio is an early\-stage, rapidly growing biotechnology platform company headquartered in Seattle, WA. We are focused on building the foundational data layer for AI\-driven protein engineering. We provide biopharma companies and model builders with access to ground truth experimental datasets, including affinity and structure, for training, benchmarking and validating AI protein models. In parallel, we apply our data and models directly with select partners to engineer next\-generation dual\-specific and molecular glue therapeutics, and to discover and optimize differentiated biologics. ***A\-Alpha Bio is headquartered in Seattle, WA, but remote applicants are welcome to apply. Candidates must reside in the United States.*** **Starting Salary Range:** $164,000 \- $206,000 annually **Exemption Status:** Exempt **Location Expectations**: Remote\-Eligible (expected travel to Seattle HQ once per quarter) **Reporting To**: Director, Machine Learning Research **Role Description** A\-Alpha Bio is seeking a Senior Scientist, Machine Learning Research to turn large\-scale protein interaction data into insights and models that advance antibody and protein engineering. The role focuses on developing innovative AI/ML methods that learn from millions of protein\-protein interaction data points to predict and engineer protein binding. The Senior Scientist will take a technical lead on challenging AI/ML projects within the ML Research team, including *de novo* design of antibodies or minibinders as well as models for affinity prediction and developability optimization. The Senior Scientist will work together with other ML Scientists to design and execute experiments (both *in silico* and *in vitro* with the help of wet\-lab colleagues), support long\-term AI/ML research initiatives, and communicate scientific results to the ML Research team and broader company, as well as to external collaborators and partners. **Key Responsibilities** * **Develop AI/ML methods.** Design and implement novel AI/ML approaches for the prediction and engineering of protein\-protein interactions, drawing on experimental measurements, protein sequences, and structural information, and use these approaches to solve challenges in drug discovery and optimization. * **Evaluate rigorously.** Design benchmarks and evaluations that assess model performance, uncertainty, and generalization, using appropriate baselines and guarding against data leakage so that conclusions are scientifically defensible and reproducible. * **Deliver results.** Generate deliverables (such as data packages, model executables, and technical reports) to a level of quality suitable for use within the company and by external collaborators, in accordance with assigned timelines. * **Contribute code and data.** Expertly contribute to the shared company codebase and database, helping teammates understand judgements and decisions, authoring and reviewing merge requests, documenting methods, organizing data, and ensuring that new capabilities and data are effectively rolled out to the rest of the team. * **Advance our scientific capabilities.** Apply scientific discipline and critical thinking to propose and analyze experiments, stay current with emerging technologies and trends, and identify and develop innovative computational approaches that increase the value of AlphaSeq data for protein engineering. * **Lead, collaborate, and communicate.** Take a technical leadership role on assigned projects interfacing across departments, provide mentorship to colleagues, help write and publish technical blog articles or scientific papers, and represent A\-Alpha Bio publicly at conferences and/or in scientific discussions with key collaborators. **Qualifications \& Experience** Required * PhD in a quantitative or life sciences field (biology, chemistry, physics, computer science, etc.) with 4\+ years of professional experience in software development and AI/ML, including 2\+ years of hands\-on experience with AI/ML using biological sequence and/or structure data; or Bachelor's degree in a quantitative or life sciences field with 12\+ years of relevant experience, including 6\+ years of professional experience in software development and AI/ML; or an equivalent combination of education and experience * Strong experience with deep learning, spanning modern software frameworks (PyTorch, JAX), model architectures and approaches (variational autoencoders \[VAEs], transformers, graph neural networks \[GNNs], diffusion, and flow matching), and common protein engineering tasks (protein language models, inverse folding, and protein structure prediction) * Strong proficiency with data science best practices, including wrangling and transforming data, model training, model selection, cross\-validation, and deployment at scale * Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to explain methods, findings, and limitations to computational and experimental audiences, as well as to external collaborators and partners Preferred * Expertise with cloud computing, particularly Amazon Web Services (AWS) * Proficiency with best practices using large language models (LLMs) and agentic AI tools to assist in code generation and modeling * Experience analyzing large experimental datasets and making scientifically defensible decisions about data quality, statistical methods, and interpretation * Thorough understanding of concepts from biology, chemistry, and physics that govern molecular properties and interactions * Familiarity with the state of the art in antibody engineering, protein engineering, synthetic biology, or other high\-throughput biology environments with particular emphasis on the relationship between sequence, structure, and function In 2018, A\-Alpha Bio spun out of the University of Washington's Institute for Protein Design and Center for Synthetic Biology – both communities filled with brilliant and highly entrepreneurial scientists. Since the company's inception, we have built and scaled AlphaSeq, our high\-throughput platform for quantitatively measuring protein\-protein interactions at unprecedented scale. What began as a technology for generating large, standardized affinity datasets has grown into a broader data engine for AI\-driven protein engineering. New members of the team should expect a fast\-paced, highly dynamic, and interdisciplinary work environment. We are building a diverse, meritocratic, and supportive team that shares our values of speaking the truth, shooting for the moon, taking the reins, playing for the team, and improving the world. A\-Alpha Bio is headquartered in a custom designed lab and office space in downtown Seattle's Belltown neighborhood. We are fortunate to be situated in a region that is renowned for its premier outdoor activities, including hiking, biking, climbing, skiing, kayaking, sailing, and more. At A\-Alpha, you'll find many who love the outdoors, but also gamers, amateur chefs, explorers, sports fans, bakers, crafters, photographers, brewers, jetsetters, animal lovers, and artists. Whatever your passions, you belong at A\-Alpha Bio!

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: **COMPANY DESCRIPTION** At AirLife, we are dedicated to improving the quality of every breath. *Excellence with Every Breath* is not just a tag line, but the way we work and take care of our customers. With a mindset to evolve, innovate, and grow, we are a premier manufacturer of the highest\-quality and market\-leading breathing consumables. This growth philosophy has positioned us to increase our global footprint and business reach, impacting even more people around the world. Our expanding family of the most trusted brands offers a product portfolio that spans the continuum of care from first responder to home care, with safety, patient comfort, and clinical performance in mind. Collective expertise allows us to provide quality products and experiences to our patients, customers, and our people. Our values of Customer first, Differentiate with our People, Bias for Action, Continuous Improvement and Accountability define who we are and how we work. Join us! **POSITION SUMMARY** The Data Engineer is the hands\-on builder and operator of AirLife’s Databricks Lakehouse, reporting to the Data Engineering \& Platform Manager. This role builds, operates, and improves the pipelines that bring data from SAP ECC, Microsoft Dynamics GP, Salesforce, and other operational systems into the Lakehouse, and applies the governance, architecture, and cost standards the Manager defines. As AirLife’s analytics and AI platform matures, this role is the execution layer that keeps pipelines reliable, documented, and ready for business and AI consumption. **POSITION QUALIFICATIONS** **Knowledge, Skills, \& Abilities:** * Hands\-on, production experience building on Databricks: Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Databricks Workflows / Lakeflow Jobs, and Lakeflow Declarative Pipelines. * Strong Python and PySpark for data engineering; advanced SQL. * Experience ingesting ERP and CRM data into a lakehouse; SAP ECC required or strongly preferred, Microsoft Dynamics GP and Salesforce a plus. * Working knowledge of Azure data services: Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2, Azure Data Factory, Azure SQL, and Azure Key Vault. * Software engineering practices applied to data: Git, pull requests and code review, CI/CD (Databricks Asset Bundles, Azure DevOps, or GitHub Actions), and automated data quality tests. * Practical understanding of Unity Catalog access controls, row\- and column\-level security, and data classification. * Experience implementing medallion architecture (bronze/silver/gold) and dimensional modeling for analytics consumption. * Working knowledge of data cataloging, lineage, and metadata management practices. * Awareness of data privacy and classification expectations in an FDA\-regulated / ISO 13485 manufacturing environment. * Ability to read someone else's pipeline, figure out what it does and why, and take ownership of it. **Preferred:** * Building data products for AI consumption: Databricks Genie / AI/BI, Databricks Apps, vector search, or serving curated data to LLM\-based tools. * Experience with cost\-aware engineering on Databricks — cluster and job right\-sizing, serverless trade\-offs, and reading system tables for usage. * Experience taking over work from consultants or offshore partners, running it in\-house, and mentoring less\-experienced engineers through the transition. * Exposure to Power BI as a downstream consumer of lakehouse data. * Infrastructure\-as\-code (Terraform) for Databricks/Azure resources. * dbt (data build tool) or equivalent transformation framework experience. **Level of Experience:** * 2\+ years of hands\-on Databricks pipeline development in an enterprise environment. Manufacturing, healthcare, or life sciences data experience preferred. **Level of Education:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Databricks Certified Data Engineer Associate or Professional preferred. **Travel:** * Up to 10% as required by the business. **ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES** * Build, test, and deploy data pipelines — including medallion (bronze/silver/gold) layers — that ingest data from SAP ECC, Microsoft Dynamics GP, Salesforce, and other operational systems into the Databricks Lakehouse, using batch and incremental patterns and the architecture standards set by the Data Engineering \& Platform Manager. * Take ownership of pipelines, notebooks, and data models built by external implementation partners: lead the technical side of knowledge transfer, document what exists, close gaps, and run it in production. * Operate what you build: monitor job health and data freshness, triage failures, fix root causes, and keep downstream teams informed when data is late or wrong. * Write data quality checks into pipelines (expectations, reconciliations to source, row\-count and null\-rate monitors) and act on what they find. * Apply Unity Catalog governance standards in daily work — naming, tagging, ownership, lineage documentation, metadata management, and access grants — as defined by the Data Engineering \& Platform Manager. * Implement data security and access controls on the data you manage, consistent with AirLife's data classification standards and FDA 21 CFR Part 820 / ISO 13485 data\-integrity expectations. * Participate in integration design reviews and new data source onboarding evaluations led by the Data Engineering \& Platform Manager, and partner with Commercial Analytics, Supply Chain Analytics, Master Data, and the AI Lead to translate their requirements into pipeline and data model changes that support self\-service BI and AI use cases. * Support integrations that write data back to operational systems; keep code in source control, work through pull requests, and deploy through CI/CD. * Write and maintain runbooks and technical documentation, including data lineage and pipeline architecture documentation. * Watch compute cost and performance on the jobs you own — right\-size clusters and schedules, tune queries and pipelines (partitioning, caching), flag risks early, and provide usage data from Databricks system tables to support the Manager's cost governance. * Bring forward improvements to standards, patterns, and tooling. * Support the onboarding and technical mentoring of junior data engineers or offshore/outsourced engineering resources as the team grows. **OTHER RESPONSIBILITIES** * Uphold and embody AirLife’s values in all aspects of work. * Demonstrate accuracy and thoroughness in daily work; look for ways to improve and promote quality \& safety. * Inspire the trust of others; treat people with respect and dignity and embrace the value of diversity. * Use time efficiently; perform job accurately, thoroughly, and conserve Company resources to improve profits. * Contribute to building and maintaining a positive team environment. * Assure all policies and guidelines are implemented and followed. **QUALITY POLICY** At AirLife, Quality is our promise. It is our commitment to customer satisfaction and our dedication to product excellence in an evolving global healthcare market. This promise is kept through a continuously improving and effective Quality Management System and compliance to Regulatory Requirements. **DEIA STATEMENT** At AirLife, we are committed to building a diverse workforce and an inclusive workplace that reflects the communities and customers we serve. We believe our philosophy on Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Advancement (DEIA) encourages excellence and equips us to serve an evolving global marketplace. **BENEFITS** AirLife offers a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, 401(k), paid time off, paid holidays, bereavement leave, Employee Assistance Program resources, and medical leave benefits, subject to applicable eligibility requirements. Certain positions may also be eligible for bonus, commission, or other incentive compensation. **Please note:** The responsibilities outlined above are not exhaustive and may evolve over time. The role holder may be required to undertake additional duties as reasonably expected to meet the needs of the company.

Working at Armada means taking ownership, driving autonomy, and delivering impact. You'll tackle challenges that haven't been solved before and help build something transformative from the ground up. What you do here will not only define your career but help further Armada's mission to bridge the digital divide for customers around the world. **About the Role** Armada is hiring a Senior Data Center Commissioning Engineer to support the Galleon, Leviathan, and Orion product lines, a brand\-new capability for the company. As we scale Modular Data Center (MDC) deployments for AI workloads across a growing number of sites, we need someone who can own the commissioning thread that runs from factory acceptance testing through site start\-up, functional testing, Integrated Systems Testing (IST), and handover to operations, and make sure every system performs as designed before a customer takes over. You will build Armada's commissioning program from the ground up: the commissioning plan, test scripts, and turnover standards for Level 1 through Level 5 commissioning across MV/LV electrical distribution, UPS and battery energy storage (BESS), liquid and air cooling, BMS/EPMS controls, and fire and life safety systems. into product engineering. **Location.** Remote, USA (approximately 40–50% travel to domestic and international project sites, factory/integrator facilities, and vendor locations) **What You'll Do (Key industry\-standard Level 1 through Level 5 testing framework), including the commissioning plan, OPR/BOD alignment, pre\-functional checklists, functional performance test scripts, IST procedures, and turnover requirements, so every Galleon/Leviathan/Orion deployment commissions against one repeatable playbook instead of a one\-off plan per site. * **Factory acceptance testing:** Define and lead yet. * **Customer, CxA, and vendor coordination:** Act as the commissioning point of contact for customers, third\-party commissioning agents, general contractors, and OEM vendors; coordinate witness schedules and readiness reviews, direct vendor start\-up activities, and align commissioning scope with the Armada/customer responsibility matrix. * **Turnover, operational readiness, and product feedback:** Own turnover packages (test records, as\-builts, O\&M manuals, warranties, training) and the final commissioning sign\-off for operational handoff, and feed failures, lessons learned, and test data back into product engineering so each product generation commissions faster than the last. **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering (or relat ications** * Commissioning certification such as CxA (ACG), BCxP (ASHRAE), CCP (BCA), or CBCP (AEE); a Professional Engineer (PE) license is a plus. * Prior commissioning experience with modular, prefabricated, or containerized data centers, including factory acceptance testing at integrator facilities. * Experience commissioning high\-density, liquid\-cooled AI/GPU deployments (direct\-to\-chip, CDUs, technology cooling systems), including flushing, filtration, and fluid quality programs. * Experience with battery energy storage (BESS), GPU power stabilization, load step jobs.title: AI and Image Processing Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Overview** ASP Health is an early\-stage commercial company working to develop and bring to market novel medical devices. Our first device is used in the operating room to take a biopsy sample, deposit it on a microscope slide, and then dry, fix, and stain the slide for immediate evaluation of the sample adequacy. Our second device is a digital microscope designed to specialize in specific workflows and applications. The device is combined with AI and image processing capabilities to aid in the assessment of the microscope slides. Developing robust software and models with excellent usability will be instrumental to the success of this role. We are looking for a highly skilled Software Engineer specializing in medical image processing, software development, and AI to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in computer science, mathematics, and engineering, with a focus on developing and optimizing algorithms for image analysis, enhancement, and recognition. This role will be responsible for designing, implementing, and testing software solutions that process and analyze images of cytology and pathology slides, from image acquisition through AI\-assisted assessment. It will involve collaborating with cross\-functional teams to understand requirements, develop innovative solutions, and ensure the highest quality of software deliverables. If you are passionate about image processing and eager to contribute to cutting\-edge projects, we would love to hear from you. We offer a competitive salary and benefits package to full\-time employees that includes health/dental/vision, company\-paid life insurance, optional medical/dependent care FSA, HSA, 401k, and many other benefits. Our team enjoys paid holidays and paid, flexible PTO (paid time off) as well as an adaptive work schedule. **Duties** * Develop, optimize, test, and validate image processing models/algorithms/software. * Create, maintain, and improve image processing systems, libraries, and frameworks. * Work with cytopathologists to design annotation protocols and manage labeled image datasets and annotation workflows, including integration with annotation platforms such as CVAT, data quality auditing, cloud storage, and traceable dataset versioning. * Design model validation studies with appropriate data splits and clinical performance metrics (e.g., sensitivity and specificity for sample adequacy), ensuring consistent performance across sites, operators, stain batches, and devices. * Conduct performance analysis and optimize models for real\-time, on\-device inference (e.g., ONNX, TensorRT, embedded GPU), meeting defined latency and reliability targets. * Develop and maintain cloud\-based AI infrastructure (e.g., Google Cloud Platform (GCP)), including data storage, compute resources, automated data pipelines, resource optimization, and model deployment workflows. * Develop and maintain production software that integrates AI models into the company's imaging platform, connecting image acquisition, inference pipelines, prediction metadata, image visualization, and clinician\-facing user interfaces. * Build, optimize, and troubleshoot GPU\-accelerated training and inference workflows, including multi\-GPU training, checkpoint/restart functionality, memory optimization, and performance benchmarking. * Design, develop, and maintain production Python applications, including backend services, APIs, and multiprocessing workflows. * Develop, maintain, and troubleshoot Windows\-based software applications, including desktop user interfaces, software packaging, installation, and release management. * Implement software engineering best practices, including automated testing, logging, error handling, debugging, version control, and reproducible software builds to ensure reliability and maintainability. * Independently own software solutions across the full application stack, collaborating with cross\-functional teams to ensure system performance, reliability, and scalability. **Experience** * Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field. * 3\+ years of experience in a related position. * Strong programming skills in Python and C\+\+. * Experience with medical image processing, specifically microscopy and cytology/pathology (e.g., whole\-slide imaging or digital pathology systems). * Hands\-on experience training and evaluating deep learning models for segmentation, detection, or classification using frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow, including with limited labeled data. * Understanding of computer vision techniques. * Experience developing and operating machine learning workflows on cloud infrastructure, such as Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including cloud storage, GPU compute, Python\-based training pipelines, and resource monitoring (e.g., Prometheus). AWS or Azure experience is acceptable. * Experience with software development lifecycle and methodologies. * Experience with version control for code, data, and models (e.g., Git, DVC, MLflow). * Knowledge of signal processing and mathematical modeling. * Experience with GPU programming and optimization. * Experience working in healthcare, medical devices, or biotech. * Knowledge of image preprocessing, compression, and enhancement techniques. * Experience deploying models on edge or embedded hardware (e.g., ONNX, TensorRT, NVIDIA Jetson). * Eagerness to learn, grow, and take on many challenges and opportunities across the company. Pay: $70,000\.00 \- $90,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Dental insurance * Disability insurance * Flexible schedule * Flexible spending account * Health insurance * Health savings account * Life insurance * Paid time off * Retirement plan * Vision insurance Work Location: In person

Responsibilities : Azure Repos Administration and Source Control • Administer Azure Repos repositories, repository permissions, branch security, and access controls. • Define and maintain branching strategies, repository standards, and pull request workflows appropriate to the team’s delivery model. • Configure and enforce branch policies, including: o Minimum reviewer requirements and automatically included reviewers. o Pull request build validation and required status checks. o Comment resolution and linked work item requirements. o Permitted merge strategies and restrictions on direct pushes. o Controlled permissions to bypass policies. • Manage pull request completion practices, including squash merges, merge commits, and rebase\-based workflows. • Resolve complex merge conflicts and troubleshoot Git history, tagging, and repository issues. • Establish commit, tagging, and versioning standards; manage large files and repository maintenance where needed. Azure Pipelines and Reusable Templates • Design and create YAML\-based CI/CD pipelines from scratch and maintain existing pipelines. • Implement multi\-stage pipelines covering build, test, package, publish, and deployment activities. • Design and maintain reusable stage, job, and step templates to standardize pipelines across repositories. • Use template parameters, variables, variable groups, conditions, dependencies, and output variables appropriately. • Manage shared template repositories, template versioning, and controlled rollout of template changes. • Configure CI triggers, branch and path filters, scheduled runs, pipeline\-resource triggers, and Azure Repos PR build validation policies. Configure and securely manage pipeline access to repositories, service connections, variable groups, and other protected resources. Cross\-Platform Build Agents • Configure and administer Microsoft\-hosted and self\-hosted build agents and agent pools. • Install, register, configure, and maintain self\-hosted agents on Windows and Linux; support macOS where required. jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer
jobs.description: **Senior AI Engineer** Apptopia is seeking a Senior AI Engineer to join our dynamic, data\-driven team at a high\-growth startup backed by powerhouse investors like Mark Cuban and ABS Capital. We specialize in providing actionable competitive intelligence to investment firms and financial institutions by estimating worldwide downloads, revenues, and active users for every mobile app. We also provide a unique, highly valued product with app user behavior insights. Our actionable app\-store data and intuitive business intelligence tool help companies like Google, Facebook, and top hedge funds make smarter decisions. Apptopia is hiring a Senior AI Engineer to lead our push into LLMs, agentic systems, and AI\-driven product innovation. You'll design and build intelligent systems that combine LLM reasoning, structured data, and tool orchestration—shaping how we use AI across our product and company. **Responsibilities** * You will be a Senior AI Engineer on the Product team where you will work on incorporating LLM powered systems into new data products, advance our existing products and help shape Apptopia's long term AI strategy. * You will spearhead efforts to incorporate LLM powered systems as we bring new finance focused products to market * Design and implement agentic workflows that combine LLM reasoning, structured data, and external tools to accelerate new product delivery * Experiment with multi\-step reasoning systems, RAG, tool orchestration, and emerging paradigms to improve analyst workflows * Design, develop, and implement machine learning algorithms to advance a broad set of use cases including app usage trend forecasting, consumer behavior prediction,, stock price movement estimation, user segmentation * You will take part, and in many cases lead the thought process for improving core modeling efforts: * Identify opportunities to extend existing modeling work into AI\-native systems that integrate predictions, reasoning, and automation * Identify opportunities to augment core datasets with LLM\-derived features, classifications, and insights * Research, identify, and test ensemble methodologies to continuously improve accuracy and coverage in our models used for core app usage estimates * You will be a key thought leader in development of our AI platform and infrastructure: Contribute to the design of internal AI platforms that enable teams to leverage LLMs at scale * Lead rapid experimentation cycles to evaluate new LLM capabilities, architectures, and vendors * Define frameworks for evaluating LLM quality, reliability, and cost\-performance tradeoffs Partner with product and engineering to take ideas from 0* production * Help define best practices for prompting, memory, tool use, and system architecture **Required Qualifications** * 5\+ years in data science, ML, data engineering, or applied AI * Experience building production ML systems end\-to\-end * Hands\-on experience with LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Bedrock, etc.) * Experience with RAG, tool use, or agentic systems * Strong Python \+ experience with APIs and cloud (AWS preferred) * Databricks tooling experience preferred * Comfortable with ambiguity and fast experimentation cycles * Familiarity with click stream, app usage, and/or observational panel data preferred

jobs.title: AI Enablement Engineer
jobs.description: **Company Description** ======================= ASG is backed by Alpine Investors and acquires market\-leading vertical SaaS companies, accelerating their transformation into AI\-native platforms. Serving industries ranging from behavioral health to transportation to childcare, ASG believes deeply in the power of people and data to grow great organizations, and that sharing knowledge, expertise, and resources across its community of businesses drives exponential growth. ASG has acquired over 60 businesses since its inception in August of 2016\. Founders of leading SaaS companies continue to trust ASG to grow their businesses and build even stronger legacies for the future. To learn more, visit www.alpinesg.com. **Job Description** =================== ASG is looking for an AI Enablement Engineer to help our portfolio companies fundamentally rethink how they operate using AI. This is a hands\-on, customer\-facing role at the intersection of business problem\-solving, solutions architecture, and AI engineering. You'll partner directly with business and technical leaders across a diverse portfolio of software companies to untangle complex challenges, challenge existing ways of working, and create practical AI\-powered solutions. Your work could mean reimagining customer onboarding, surfacing operational insights, eliminating manual work in finance or support, or discovering new ways to reduce costs and improve customer experiences. We want someone who doesn't just take requirements and build what's asked. You'll help companies discover what's possible, take ideas from discovery through production, and demonstrate measurable business outcomes. **You're Excited About This Opportunity Because You Will:** =========================================================== * Partner with OpCo executives, CTOs, functional leaders, and frontline teams to diagnose complex business problems and identify high\-value opportunities for AI. * Redesign, improve, remove, or replace outdated internal workflows across customer onboarding, support, go\-to\-market, finance, and other business operations. * Architect, build, integrate, and deploy AI\-powered workflows and agentic systems from initial discovery through production, with clear owners and success measures. * Create AI\-powered operational intelligence and observability that exposes bottlenecks, anomalies, risks, and actionable insights across fragmented systems and data. * Identify and deliver opportunities to reduce operating costs, increase capacity, improve margins, and elevate customer experiences. * Work with OpCo product and engineering teams to explore AI\-enabled customer and product opportunities when appropriate. * Recognize patterns across companies and develop reusable components, integrations, and deployment approaches that accelerate future projects. * Balance business value, usability, technical feasibility, and responsible data handling when evaluating solutions and emerging capabilities. **We're Excited About You Because:** ==================================== * You have strong software engineering fundamentals and a track record of personally architecting, building, and shipping production systems, not just managing delivery or configuring tools. * You have customer\-facing experience in solutions engineering, forward deployment, technical consulting, or a similar role that requires working with varied stakeholders. * You can engage credibly with CTOs and senior business leaders, ask insightful questions, challenge assumptions, and translate ambiguity into an executable plan. * You understand business operations and economics, can prioritize by potential impact, and measure results beyond technical completion. * You have experience with APIs, enterprise integrations, data flows, orchestration, and practical AI approaches, including models, agents, and multi\-step workflows. * You have demonstrated creative problem\-solving across different customers, industries, or operational environments and can learn unfamiliar businesses quickly. * You are resourceful, pragmatic, and comfortable owning outcomes independently in a fast\-moving environment. * You understand responsible handling of business data, permissions, and system access while partnering with established security and governance teams. * You bring substantial relevant experience; senior engineering depth and stakeholder maturity matter more than a specific title, tenure, employer, or framework. **Base Salary Range** ===================== The target salary range for this position is ($200,000\-$225,000\), and is part of a competitive total rewards package including an annual bonus, employer\-paid benefits, L\&D stipend and incentive pay for eligible roles. Individual pay may vary from the target range and is determined by a number of factors including experience, location, internal pay equity, and other relevant business considerations. We review all employee pay and compensation programs annually at minimum to ensure competitive and fair pay. **A Secure Candidate Experience** ================================= All official emails and messages regarding opportunities at ASG, LLC, will come from our alpinesg.com email domain. Please be wary of communications from similar domains that may contain misspellings or slight variations. These could be attempts at phishing or impersonation. ASG will never ask you for sensitive personal information during the hiring process such as social security numbers, banking information or other personal details.

jobs.title: AI/ML Software Engineer

ASG believes deeply in the power of people and data to grow great organizations, and that sharing knowledge, expertise, and resources across its community of businesses drives exponential growth. We hire and unleash a diverse array of leaders across ASG whose will to win \- and ability to do so with love \- is the true magic behind our success. **Job Description** This role is a hands\-on builder for ASG’s portfolio companies, focused on developing AI/ML systems and data platforms that unlock new value from data. The AI/ML Engineer will lead and contribute directly to projects such as internal LLM applications, data pipelines, ML\-powered product capabilities, and scalable data infrastructure. This person will work closely with operating companies to turn data into practical business outcomes, whether by enabling new products, improving decision\-making, or building the technical foundations for AI adoption. **What You Will Do** * Lead high\-impact AI/ML and data engineering projects across ASG portfolio companies, partnering directly with operating companies to design, build, and deliver solutions * Build hands\-on across AI/ML systems, including data pipelines, model integrations, internal LLM applications, APIs, and supporting infrastructure * Develop LLM\-powered tools and workflows that enhance business operations, internal productivity, and product capabilities * Partner with portfolio companies to identify opportunities to commercialize data through new products, features, and analytics offerings * Serve as a technical leader and trusted advisor to engineering and data teams across the portfolio, helping shape practical approaches to AI and data adoption * Contribute to enablement efforts across the portfolio by sharing practical guidance, examples, and best practices for AI/ML and data engineering * Support training sessions, workshops, and working sessions that help OpCo teams build stronger capabilities in AI, ML, and data infrastructure * Help establish repeatable patterns, playbooks, and best practices for building and deploying AI/ML and data solutions across multiple companies * Collaborate closely with portfolio leadership, product stakeholders, and engineering teams to identify where AI, ML, and better data infrastructure can drive measurable impact * Own the full delivery lifecycle from scoping through production handoff, including structured knowledge transfer that leaves teams capable of owning and extending what was built **Who You Are** * Demonstrated experience in deploying machine learning, data engineering, and applied AI solutions to solve customer and business challenges at scale * Familiarity with LLM\-based applications, model APIs, retrieval workflows, evaluation approaches, and production deployment patterns * Have developed production solutions with several (but certainly not all) of the following technologies: Bedrock, Sagemaker, Vertex AI, Glue, Airflow, Spark, Hadoop, Storm, time series databases, Parquet, Iceberg, Redshift, Kafka, Kinesis, Big Query, Cassandra, Open/Elastic Search, dbt, operating effectively across multiple companies, teams, and priorities **Base Salary Range** The target salary range for this position is ($200,000 – $250,000\), and is part of a competitive total rewards package including an annual bonus, employer\-paid benefits, L\&D stipend and incentive pay for eligible roles. jobs.title: Sr. Data & AI Platform Engineer
jobs.description: At AltimateMedical, we improve the quality of life for the individuals and clinicians who rely on our products every day. Our story began with EasyStand, our line of standing devices. Over the years, we have expanded our brand portfolio through both innovation and strategic growth, adding respected healthcare brands including MedicalPositioning, ActiveAid, Therafin, and Leggero. Today, AltimateMedical designs and manufactures differentiated medical equipment across multiple sectors of the healthcare industry. AltimateMedical’s portfolio includes specialty product lines in four main areas: * **Standing** * **Mobility \& Positioning** * **Hygiene, and** * **Diagnostic \& Imaging** Learn more at www.altimatemedical.com As a Granite Partners company, we believe in sharing success and investing in our people. We offer meaningful career growth opportunities, a collaborative and values\-driven culture, and the chance to make a direct impact on the lives of those who depend on our products every day. Our innovative, dynamic, and collaborative culture drives us to develop and deliver high\-quality solutions that make a meaningful difference in people's lives. **Sr. Data \& AI Platform Engineer** **Lead the platform. Shape the future.** *Guide the data and AI strategy that will set a growing medical technology company apart in a competitive market.* Our mission is improving lives with thoughtfully designed medical technology, and data is behind every decision we make. As our Sr. Data \& AI Platform Engineer, you will manage our data and AI platforms, including NetSuite and Domo, and serve as a thought leader who guides our direction, shaping the data foundation, design, and applications that will serve AltimateMedical well and differentiate us in the market. You will oversee both structured and unstructured data and lead data exploration and visualization to uncover patterns, trends, and anomalies, increasingly applying AI and machine learning to accelerate and scale how we discover insights. Working independently, you will use statistical, machine learning, and AI\-based methods to analyze and model the data that drives decisions across the business. **WHY THIS ROLE STANDS OUT** * **Ownership, not tickets.** You will own our data platforms and lead platform projects start to finish, with the independence to choose the right approach. * **Build the foundation for AI.** Bring AI and machine learning into the platform and into production, and help shape where AI and automation go next. * **Work that is seen.** Your insights reach decision\-makers across the business, at a company whose products change lives. * **Room to grow.** A growing portfolio of brands means new data, new questions, and new problems worth solving. **WHAT YOU’LL DO** * **Own and evolve our data platforms,** NetSuite and Domo, including integrations, ETL pipelines, data models, and data quality across structured and unstructured data. * **Lead platform and AI projects** from planning through delivery, directing work and partnering with cross\-functional teams. * **Run AI and ML models in production** on the platform, monitoring them for performance and drift. * **Tell the story,** turning complex findings into clear visuals and narratives for audiences of every background. * **Shape the roadmap** with IT and business leaders, spotting where AI and automation fit. **WHAT YOU’LL DO** * **Own and evolve our data platforms,** NetSuite and Domo, including integrations, ETL pipelines, data models, and data quality across structured and unstructured data. * **Lead platform and AI projects** from planning through delivery, directing work and partnering with cross\-functional teams. * **Run AI and ML models in production** on the platform, monitoring them for performance and drift. * **Tell the story,** turning complex findings into clear visuals and narratives for audiences of every background. * **Shape the roadmap** with IT and business leaders, spotting where AI and automation fit. **WHAT YOU BRING** * **M.S. in Information Management, Data Management, Computer Science, or a related field** (an advanced certificate may substitute) and 5\+ years of relevant experience. * **Data platform experience:** ETL frameworks, database systems, data modeling and schemas, and data warehousing. * **Working scripting skills** in SQL, Python, and/or R to build pipelines and automate platform work, with good practices like version control and testing. * **Hands\-on AI/ML experience** with real tools; Domo or NetSuite experience is a plus. * **The ability to work independently** and explain technical work in plain language. In office or hybrid role based in either the Minnesota area or Chicago area, with occasional travel to our business locations in Frankfort, IL, Lenexa, KS, and our headquarters in Morton, MN in the scenic Minnesota River Valley, about 100 miles west of the Twin Cities. Days in office are negotiable based on proximity to our MN or IL locations. **Pay range:** **$125,000 \- $140,000, plus annual bonus and profit\-sharing opportunities.** AMHI offers competitive pay, annual bonus and profit\-sharing opportunities, and market\-leading benefits designed to support your wellbeing both at work and beyond. Full\-time team members are eligible for a comprehensive benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, and life insurance; short\- and long\-term disability coverage; a Health Savings Account (HSA) with company contributions; a Vanguard 401(k) with employer contributions; generous paid time off, including volunteer time off and paid holidays; and access to the Granite Assistance Fund for support when it's needed most. Part\-time team members may be eligible for select benefits based on scheduled hours and plan requirements. AltimateMedical is an equal opportunity employer. \#LI\-JF1

jobs.title: Manager, Applied AI Engineer
jobs.description: Location: New York, NY, United States Date Posted: Oct 30, 2026 **About Alvarez \& Marsal** Alvarez \& Marsal (A\&M) is a global consulting firm with entrepreneurial, action\- and results\-oriented professionals. We take a hands\-on approach to solving our clients' problems and helping them reach their potential. A\&M is different by design: we give people ownership and impact from day one, fuel development through real opportunity, and provide direct access to leaders who invest in our growth. Our culture celebrates independent thinkers and doers who positively impact clients and shape our industry. Guided by A\&M's core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity, our collaborative, globally minded environment is why our people love working at A\&M. **The Team** The AI Lab Team sits within A\&M's Global AI \& Knowledge Organization (GAIKO). GAIKO brings together the firm's AI and Knowledge Management capabilities to put trusted, governed AI into everyday consulting work. The Lab’s job is to turn repeatable business workflows into scalable agents and AI skills. Many of these workflows run today on Microsoft tools such as SharePoint, Power Platform and Power BI, and the pod reworks them into AI\-first solutions that can be reused across the firm. Others will be built from scratch as internal teams bring new requests. In this role, you'll work closely with the leads of A\&M's business units, the Knowledge Management (KM) and Data team leads, and the AI Skills lead and engineers, product partners and knowledge specialists across GAIKO. Together you'll design and build headless skills and agents: reusable capabilities that work behind the scenes and connect to the AI tools our professionals already use. You'll be the bridge between the business and the build: translating what each business unit needs into working skills and agents, and teaching the rest of the pod to do the same. As the pod's go\-to technical expert for skills and agents, you'll report to the AI Skills Pod lead with technical direction from the Intelligence Layer tech lead. Your work will directly shape how thousands of A\&M colleagues use AI in their work with clients. The team is growing, the work is technically demanding, and priorities will move quickly, so this role requires sound judgment, adaptability, and a willingness to contribute wherever the build needs support. We're looking for a fast builder who can take an idea from prototype to working capability quickly, learn from feedback and keep momentum without sacrificing quality. Just as important, you make the people around you better. You teach, share knowledge openly, step in across workstreams when needed, and adjust quickly when priorities shift. **How You Will Contribute** * Own end\-to\-end delivery of applied AI solutions, from proof of concept to production: problem framing, build, deployment, monitoring and iteration. * Partner with business unit leaders and their teams to understand how they work, translate their needs into skills and agents, and agree clear success metrics. * Work with the Knowledge Management and Data team leads to gather and clarify requirements, and translate them into skill and agent designs. * Partner with our Data Engineering, BIU, and Intelligence Layer teams so that solutions are built on reliable, production\-grade data. * Design, build and operate headless skills and agentic workflows, including multi\-step orchestration, tool routing, retrieval, guardrails, evaluation and human\-in\-the\-loop controls. * Build and maintain automated skill\-building pipelines (templates, scaffolding, testing and evaluation harnesses, packaging and deployment) so new skills can be created and released quickly and consistently. * Build integrations with large language model platforms and use the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to make skills available to approved AI tools and the Intelligence Layer. * Integrate structured and unstructured content from enterprise systems while preserving source permissions, metadata and governance requirements. * Guide the team in assessing current Power Platform and wider Microsoft stack processes, reimagining them as AI\-first workflows rather than one\-to\-one rebuilds, and converting them into, or connecting them to, skills and agents. * Train the wider team on how to build skills, through workshops, playbooks, templates, worked examples and office hours. * Mentor engineers through pairing, code and design reviews and hands\-on coaching, raising the quality bar for skills and agents across the pod. * Apply and help shape engineering standards for skills and agents, working with the Intelligence Layer tech lead, including evaluation, CI/CD, versioning, reproducibility and performance monitoring. * Bring forward recommendations on tools, frameworks and design patterns. Technical decisions are made by the Intelligence Layer tech lead together with the Intelligence Layer lead. * Support respo requirement: confirm 5\+ years (including 2\+ on LLM or agent systems) is right for the Manager level. * Work arrangement: confirm remote, hybrid, or office\-based expectations. **Your journey at A\&M** At A\&M, professional growth is tied directly to performance, not tenure. Our people take on meaningful, hands\-on work supported by a performance development process that rewards contribution and fosters a culture of meritocracy. Stretch roles, evolving business needs, and firm growth create ongoing opportunities for ownership and building new skills, while direct access to senior leaders provides mentorship and real\-time coaching along the way. We also prioritize your wellbeing through comprehensive benefits and resources. Together, these elements create an environment where high\-performing professionals can continue to grow and advance from day one. Regular employees working 30 or more hours per week are also entitled to participate in Alvarez \& Marsal Holdings’ fringe benefits consisting of healthcare plans, flexible spending and savings accounts, life, AD\&D, and disability coverages at rates determined periodically as well as a 401(k) retirement savings plan. Provided the eligibility requirements are met, employees will also receive an annual discretionary contribution to their 401(k) retirement savings plan from Alvarez \& Marsal. Additionally, employees are eligible for paid time off including vacation, personal days, seventy\-two (72\) hours of sick time (prorated for part time employees), ten federal holidays, one floating holiday, and parental leave. The amount of vacation and personal days available varies based on tenure and role type. Click here for more information regarding A\&M’s benefits programs. The salary range is $140,000 \- $160,000 annually, dependent on several variables including but not limited to education, experience, skills, and geography. In addition, A\&M offers a discretionary bonus program which is based on a number of factors, including individual and firm performance. Please ask your recruiter for details. **Culture \& Values** --------------------- At Alvarez \& Marsal, our core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity guide everything we do, shaping a culture rooted in entrepreneurship, impact, and integrity. We trust our people to take ownership early, contribute to meaningful challenges, and drive results that matter. We empower growth and champion diverse perspectives. Above all, we value doing the right thing. For those ready to roll up their sleeves, lead with integrity, and be difference makers, this is where it starts. **Equal Opportunity Employer** ------------------------------ It is Alvarez \& Marsal’s practice to provide and promote equal opportunity in employment, compensation, and other terms and conditions of employment without discrimination because of race, color, creed, religion, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, sex or gender, gender identity or gender expression (including transgender status), sexual orientation, marital status, military service and veteran status, physical or mental disability, family medical history, genetic information or other protected medical condition, political affiliation, or any other characteristic protected by and in accordance with applicable laws. Employees and Applicants can find A\&M policy statements and additional information by region here. **Unsolicited Resumes from Third\-Party Recruiters** ---------------------------------------------------- Please note that as per A\&M policy, we do not accept unsolicited resumes from third\-party recruiters unless such recruiters are engaged to provide candidates for a specified opening. Any employment agency, person or entity that submits an unsolicited resume does so with the understanding that A\&M will have the right to hire that applicant at its discretion without any fee owed to the submitting employment agency, person or entity.
