jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- We're looking for a Senior Technical Product/Program Manager to own a portfolio of these business\-facing products and programs end to end: shaping what each one should do and for whom, driving its design and delivery with engineering, science and data technicians, and proving it changes business outcomes. This role is oriented toward business problems and the products/programs that solve them, not toward running shared platform infrastructure. You'll be as comfortable reviewing a system architecture or challenging a recommendations quality as presenting a roadmap to senior executives like VPs. \#\# The portfolio you'll own * \*\*Self\-service analytics, to production.\*\* Take our natural\-language and SQL analytics product over the governed data lake from team tool to a production service leaders rely on: accuracy on governed metrics, onboarding new domains, reliability, access controls, and adoption. * \*\*Recommendation engine delivery and quality.\*\* Deliver the AI\-assisted recommendation engine from pilot to broad use, own its quality bar: what it recommends, with what confidence, when it should stay silent, and how we know it worked. * \*\*Business domain decision products.\*\* Our operation runs on a few core business domains, each with its own leaders, metrics, data sources, and decisions. For each one, you'll own the product that moves a leader from "what's happening" to "what should I do about it": define the decisions it supports, the metrics and data it needs, and how we measure whether it improved the domain's outcome. Today that means: data products that cover repair backlog and aging, repair throughput and turnaround time, parts availability and other blockers, and repeat failures. The core decision is where to focus the effort so it returns the most capacity to customers fastest. Data products track deliveries from plan through install and hand\-off, show what's on track, what's at risk, and why (parts, labor, facilities, network readiness), and route each blocker to the owner who can clear it. The core decision is which at\-risk deliveries need intervention now. Success is more capacity delivered on its committed date. Key job responsibilities * \*\*Own program strategy and roadmap\*\* for each product/program in the portfolio, tied to a business outcome (repair turnaround, labor productivity, capacity on time), and phase scope deliberately from pilot to GA. * \*\*Define and enforce quality.\*\* Set the bar for each products/programs, such as answer accuracy for self\-service analytics or recommendation precision, confidence, and abstain behavior for the recommendation engine. Partner with engineering and science so no product presents correlation as causation or claims more confidence than it has earned. * \*\*Prove business impact.\*\* Define how actions are captured, how impact is measured against matched baselines, and how outcomes feed back into the product. Success is not "recommendations accepted" or "queries run"; it's decisions that changed outcomes. * \*\*Run technical delivery with the engineering team.\*\* Own the delivery cadence, sprint planning, and release management for your products/programs. Review design docs, understand the architecture well enough to weigh tradeoffs (build vs. reuse, latency vs. cost, coupling between services), and keep scope, sequencing, and dependencies honest. * \*\*Drive launch readiness\*\* across security review, penetration testing, operational readiness (ORR), and privacy reviews for each product moving to production. * \*\*Lead cross\-org dependencies\*\* with Supply Chain, Hardware Engineering, Facilities, workforce planning, and peer data teams: write the asks, negotiate data contracts, and escalate when a partner dependency blocks the roadmap. * \*\*Write the narratives\*\* (PR/FAQs, 6\-pagers, pilot readouts) for Director and VP audiences, with honest accounting of what is proven vs. pending. jobs.title: Software Development Engineer II, Selection Monitoring
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Help Amazon understand every brand in the world and make sure customers can find the brands they love in our store. As a Software Development Engineer on the Universal Brand Catalog (UBC) team, you'll design and own large\-scale data systems, AI/ML\-powered services, and self\-serve tools that show brand recruitment teams which brands are missing from Amazon and where to act. This is a new space with key architecture decisions still on the table, so you'll have real influence over the technical direction from day one. You'll work across the full software development lifecycle, collaborate closely with applied scientists and product managers, and see your work translate directly into wider selection for Amazon customers. Key job responsibilities * Design, build, and operate scalable, highly available services and large\-scale data pipelines (Spark on Amazon EMR) that process brand, product, and marketplace data across Amazon's global catalog. * Own features end to end — requirements, design documents, implementation, testing, deployment, and operations — and lead design reviews where you make sound tradeoffs between accuracy, latency, cost, and scalability. * Partner with applied scientists to put ML models into production, measure data quality through precision and recall metrics, and iterate on brand\-matching and gap\-detection signals. * Turn ambiguous business problems into clear technical plans, break large projects into shippable deliverables, and build self\-serve tools that let business teams slice brand and selection data by market, category, and competitive trends without engineering support. * Mentor junior engineers and interns through code reviews, design guidance, and pairing, while driving operational improvements in monitoring, alarming, and on\-call health. A day in the life You might start the day at stand\-up, then review a design document for a new pipeline that scores brands across marketplaces. Later you could meet with a product manager and a scientist to figure out how to measure whether a brand gap signal can be trusted, then turn that into a data model and plan. In the afternoon you'll write code, review a teammate's pull request, and help a junior engineer debug a Spark job. Your internal stakeholders include category and vendor management teams who use your data to recruit brands, partner catalog teams, and science teams. About the team The UBC team builds the foundation for how Amazon understands brands: which brands exist, how they relate to each other, where they're sold, and where they're missing from our store. jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help. You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion AWS PrivateLink carries private connectivity for roughly 200\+ AWS services and third\-party providers, without traffic crossing the public internet. For many customers it sits on their critical availability path, and for those whose policies prohibit public egress it is the only route. We are hiring a Senior SDE to build the next generation of PrivateLink: a control plane engineered for 20x our current tens of thousands of TPS, a data plane to match, and the product vision behind both. The goal is private connectivity that keeps pace with AI. Inference platforms, agentic systems, and ML pipelines now provision and reconcile connectivity continuously, at machine speed, and move far more data over it. The limits in our way are structural, not numbers we can raise. The read path, the tenant isolation model, the provisioning architecture, and how bandwidth scales with demand are all open decisions, and you will make several of them. We have built real agentic tooling for migration, test generation, and operational analysis. You will use it and extend it. Key job responsibilities * Shape the product vision for private connectivity in AI\-native environments, working directly with AWS service teams and large external partners on what they need from us next. * Own the architecture and delivery of core components of the next generation of PrivateLink, across both the control plane and the data plane, targeting 20x current scale. * Make the foundational design decisions that are still open, and bring AWS service teams and senior engineers along with them. * Build for multi\-tenant isolation and fairness, and scale capacity with demand rather than manual intervention, so one customer's growth never becomes another customer's latency. * Execute against live production traffic with no maintenance window, operate what you build, and extend the team's agentic tooling for migration, test generation, and operational analysis. About the team The AWS PrivateLink team builds and operates the technology that enables customers to securely access AWS services, third\-party applications, and their own services over the Amazon VPC network—without exposing traffic to the public internet. As a Sr. SDE on this team, you'll design and scale highly available, low\-latency networking infrastructure that powers private connectivity for millions of endpoints worldwide. You'll tackle complex distributed systems challenges, drive architectural decisions, and mentor engineers—all while helping customers simplify their network security posture at cloud scale.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS** ------------------------ * 5\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience * 5\+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience * 5\+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience * Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ---------------------------- * 5\+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience * Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. loading, memory planning, quantization, and multi\-device or distributed inference. * Collaborate across model\-serving, framework, compiler, runtime, kernel, and hardware teams to deliver a cohesive, high\-performance AI software stack. * Optimize model execution through graph compilation, operator fusion, precision optimization, efficient attention, and hardware\-specific execution strategies. * Influence future accelerator architecture through hardware/software co\-design, translating real\-world AI workload requirements into product recommendations. * Establish technical direction, design standards, benchmarking practices, and performance\-validation processes for the serving platform. * Evaluate, integrate, and contribute to relevant open\-source AI serving and runtime technologies. * Experience with technologies such as vLLM, llama.cpp, TensorRT/TensorRT\-LLM, ONNX Runtime, OpenVINO, Triton Inference Server, TVM, XLA, MLIR, or comparable systems. * Expert proficiency in modern C\+\+ and strong experience in C, including concurrent programming, memory management, and systems\-level performance optimization. * Strong understanding of AI inference performance, including batching, scheduling, latency/throughput tradeoffs, memory bandwidth, KV\-cache behavior, quantization, and accelerator utilization. * Experience with profiling, benchmarking, performance analysis, jobs.title: Data Center Electrical Engineer – Design
jobs.description: **About Anthropic** ------------------- Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. **About the role** ------------------ Training and serving frontier AI models requires compute infrastructure at a scale and density that pushes past what conventional data center designs were built to handle. Anthropic's Data Center Infrastructure team is responsible for delivering that physical infrastructure — partnering with build partners, equipment manufacturers, and utilities to stand up facilities that can reliably power some of the largest accelerator clusters in the industry. As a Data Center Electrical Engineer – Design, you'll own the electrical architecture of our facilities from the utility service entrance through to the rack — substation interface, medium\- and high\-voltage distribution, on\-site generation and storage integration, UPS, switchgear, busway, and rack power. You'll develop and maintain the basis of design, reference architectures, and technical specifications that our build partners and A/E firms design against, and you'll be the point of technical authority when their drawings and calculations come back for review. You'll run the engineering studies — short\-circuit, protection coordination, arc flash, load flow, and power quality — and you'll keep the architecture ahead of rapidly increasing rack densities and the unique load characteristics of large\-scale ML training. A central part of this role is speed\-to\-capacity through prefabrication: you'll shape Anthropic's offsite\-manufactured electrical strategy — modular skids, e\-houses, and prefabricated power assemblies — and drive its standardization across sites. You'll work closely with colleagues across the infrastructure team, with our hardware and compute teams to translate accelerator requirements into electrical design criteria, and with supply chain to qualify and diversify regional equipment vendors. Expect roughly 10–25% travel for design reviews, partner and vendor meetings, factory witness testing, and site visits to support commissioning and startup. **Responsibilities** -------------------- ### **Electrical design \& engineering** * Lead the electrical design of critical data center infrastructure across the US portfolio, including the utility interface and substation, site medium\- and high\-voltage distribution, generators, UPS, switchgear, transformers, busway, and grounding * Develop and maintain Anthropic's electrical basis of design, reference architectures, and technical specifications for critical power distribution — covering switchgear, UPS systems, PDUs, busway, and rack power delivery — producing designs that meet our reliability and maintainability requirements while staying within budgetary targets * Perform and validate engineering studies — including short\-circuit, protection coordination, arc flash, load flow, and power quality analysis — and use the findings to steer topology, redundancy, equipment\-selection, and protection\-setting decisions * Design and plan data center hall power distribution layouts for newly allocated spaces in coordination with the telecom, mechanical and cooling design ### **Prefabrication \& modular delivery** * Drive Anthropic's prefabricated and modular electrical strategy — developing modular skids, e\-houses, and prefabricated power assemblies, and partnering with external engineering and manufacturing teams on a productization roadmap that accelerates deployment and reduces onsite labor * Design for offsite manufacture and onsite assembly: define the interfaces between prefabricated components and site\-built work, and the electrical interfaces and switchover points for temporary\-to\-permanent power sequencing * Drive standardization of modular electrical designs across sites to compress deployment timelines while preserving flexibility for site\-specific constraints and evolving hardware generations ### **Partner, vendor \& utility coordination** * Work with regional vendors and manufacturers to specify and qualify major electrical equipment, and partner with supply chain to build a diversified vendor base that mitigates lead\-time and single\-source risk * Work with utilities and interconnection/transmission operators (e.g., ISOs/RTOs) to define site utility service and interconnection requirements, and with local authorities having jurisdiction to ensure designs comply with the National Electrical Code (NFPA 70/NEC), NFPA, IEEE, UL/ANSI, and local requirements * Work with Anthropic's hardware and compute teams to translate accelerator power, density, and power\-quality requirements into electrical design criteria, and keep the reference architecture aligned with upcoming hardware generations * Present oject experience delivering data centers in multiple US markets (e.g., Virginia, Texas, Arizona, Ohio, Oregon) The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $320,000 \- $405,000 USD **Logistics** ------------- **Minimum education:** Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience **Required field of study:** A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience **Minimum years of experience:** Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position **Location\-based hybrid policy:** Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. **Visa sponsorship:** We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. **We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.** Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. **Your safety matters to us.** To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. **How we're different** ----------------------- We believe that the highest\-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large\-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long\-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest\-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT\-3, Circuit\-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI \& Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. **Come work with us!** ---------------------- Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. **Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage:** Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

jobs.title: Principal Engineer & Technical Lead — Azure / Containers
jobs.description: **About Aperia Solutions** Aperia Solutions is a leading payments SaaS company headquartered in Dallas, Texas. We build risk management, residuals accounting, compliance, and analytics platforms used by merchant banks, ISOs, payment processors, and other participants in the credit card payments ecosystem. Operating under PCI DSS 4\.0 compliance across dual on\-premises datacenters (Allen, TX and Chicago, IL) plus Azure cloud, we process high\-volume payment data for some of the industry's largest players. We're in the middle of a significant platform modernization program: a next\-generation risk analysis and scoring platform on Microsoft Fabric, an AI\-powered ingestion platform, new AI\-native applications, and ongoing evolution of the products our clients rely on every day. The teams executing this work are deliberately small and senior, with executive\-level support and minimal bureaucracy. Every senior hire is a founding contributor to the architecture and the code. **Role summary** We are hiring a Principal Engineer and Technical Lead: a builder first, with deep architecture and enterprise design pattern experience behind every line of code. This person is the SVP of Technology's chief lieutenant on technical execution. You will take on the heaviest technical lifting, prove risky ideas with working prototypes, turn approved architecture into production systems, and hold distributed engineering teams to a high technical bar. This is a hands\-on role, not an architecture\-only or slideware role. Target architecture is set with technology leadership; you own making it real, from implementation design, code and IaC through the hard production problems, and you push back with evidence when a design won't hold up in implementation. The platform is a regulated, multi\-tenant payments SaaS built on Azure, Microsoft Fabric, AKS, C\#/.NET and Python. You will report directly to the SVP of Technology and act as the senior hands\-on technical authority across platform, data and AI initiatives. **Title options:** Principal Engineer, Lead Software Engineer / Technical Lead – Cloud Platforms, or Staff Engineer – Azure. **What** **you'll** **do** **Hands\-on engineering, POCs and heavy lifting (****50%)** * Build working prototypes and POCs for advanced concepts (LLM/RAG services, event\-driven pipelines, multi\-tenant patterns, new Azure services) to retire technical risk before teams commit. * Own the hardest technical slices end to end: write and ship production\-quality C\#/.NET and Python, debug production issues, and unblock teams by doing the work rather than delegating it. * Implement enterprise design patterns in real code: event\-driven and messaging (outbox, saga, idempotent consumers, retries and dead\-lettering), CQRS, resilience (circuit breaker, bulkhead, backpressure), caching and multi\-tenant isolation. * Author and review IaC (Terraform/Bicep), Helm charts and CI/CD pipelines; build the golden\-path templates teams adopt. * Benchmark and load test candidate designs; bring numbers, not opinions, to technical decisions. * Take on heavy\-lift tasks directly from the SVP: technical spikes, hands\-on vendor evaluations, migration tooling, and performance and cost investigations. **Design and implementation patterns (****25%)** * Turn target\-state architectures into implementation designs: service boundaries, contracts, data models and deployment topology across AKS, Container Apps, Functions, APIM, Service Bus/Event Hubs, Cosmos DB and Azure SQL. * Build and harden integration paths into Microsoft Fabric (OneLake, Lakehouse/Warehouse, mirroring, Real\-Time Intelligence), knowing where the sharp edges are from having hit them. * Write ADRs and design docs for the decisions made during implementation, and contribute to architecture reviews and threat models with implementation\-level detail. * Implement regulated\-workload controls in code and IaC: network isolation, private endpoints, identity (Entra ID, managed identity, workload identity), secrets, encryption and audit. * Bring run\-cost to every build: estimate before, measure after, and flag designs that won't scale economically. **Technical leadership with delivery teams (****25%)** * Act as the SVP's chief lieutenant on technical execution: carry decisions into teams, keep builds aligned with approved designs, and stand in on technical matters when the SVP is unavailable. * Run design reviews, code reviews and technical checkpoints with onshore and offshore teams across multiple time zones. * Track technical status and surface risk early: integration gaps, drift from approved designs, quality and security debt. * Mentor senior engineers and tech leads; raise the bar on implementation quality, testing and observability. * Translate implementation status and risk into concise options for technology leadership, and work directly with security, product and vendors. **Technical stack** Candidates should be expert in the core column and fluent in most of the adjacent column. Area Core (expert) Adjacent (fluent) Cloud Azure: AKS, Container Apps, APIM, Functions, Service Bus, Event Hubs, Key Vault, Front Door Azure Policy, Landing Zones, AWS/EKS equivalents Data Microsoft Fabric, OneLake, Cosmos DB, Azure SQL Databricks, Synapse, ClickHouse, Kafka Languages C\# / .NET 8\+, Python TypeScript, SQL/KQL, Go Design patterns Event\-driven/messaging (outbox, saga, idempotency), CQRS, resilience patterns, multi\-tenant isolation DDD, hexagonal/clean architecture, API versioning, enterprise integration patterns Containers Docker, Kubernetes, Helm Dapr, KEDA, service mesh, GitOps (Flux/Argo) IaC and delivery Terraform, Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions Bicep, policy\-as\-code, container image signing/scanning AI Azure OpenAI / AI Foundry, RAG patterns Semantic Kernel, LangChain, vector search, evaluation tooling Observability Azure Monitor, App Insights, OpenTelemetry Prometheus, Grafana Security Entra ID, managed/workload identity, private networking Defender for Cloud, PCI DSS controls **Required qualifications** * 12\+ years in software engineering, including 5\+ years as a lead or principal engineer shipping production cloud systems. * 4\+ years building and operating containerized workloads on Kubernetes in production, preferably AKS. * Deep, current hands\-on Azure experience: you have personally built, deployed and debugged the services you work with. * Code you can show: substantial, active C\#/.NET and Python work in the last 12 months, not just reviews. You are still one of the strongest individual contributors on any team you join. * Deep, applied command of enterprise design patterns (messaging, resilience, integration, multi\-tenancy); you can explain their failure modes because you have hit them in production. * Track record of taking a novel concept from whiteboard to working POC in weeks, then building or leading the first production slice. * Working architecture depth across operational and analytical data stores, including event\-driven and streaming implementations. * Fluency with IaC and CI/CD; you write the Terraform and the pipeline, not just the diagram. * Security\-first implementation in a regulated environment (PCI DSS, SOC 2, or financial services equivalent). * Proven ability to lead distributed and offshore teams through design and code reviews without direct authority. * Clear written communication: ADRs, design docs and status summaries that stand on their own. **Preferred qualifications** * Payments, card processing, risk/fraud, or merchant services domain experience. * Production Microsoft Fabric work, including mirroring from Cosmos DB or SQL and Fabric capacity sizing. * Shipped LLM\-backed features: RAG, agent/tool patterns, content safety, evaluation and red\-teaming. * Multi\-tenant SaaS design: tenant isolation, noisy\-neighbor controls, per\-tenant cost attribution. * Azure certifications such as Azure Developer (AZ\-204\), DevOps Engineer Expert (AZ\-400\), CKAD/CKA, or Fabric Analytics Engineer (DP\-600\). Nice to have, never a substitute for demonstrated work. * Open\-source contributions, technical writing or conference talks. **Eligibility Requirements** * Must be willing to submit to a background investigation and drug test as part of the selection process. **Job Type** * Full\-time **Schedule** * Hybrid: Monday to Friday **Work Location** * Dallas, TX **Benefits** * Health insurance * Health savings account * Dental insurance * Vision insurance * 401(k) matching * Life insurance * Paid time off * Parental leave * Disability insurance * Childcare assistance * Education reimbursement * Fitness membership * Volunteer time off

jobs.title: Sr. Software Systems Safety Engineer
jobs.description: Apptronik is a human\-centered robotics company developing AI\-powered robots to support humanity in every facet of life. Our flagship humanoid robot, Apollo, is built to collaborate thoughtfully with people, starting with critical industries such as manufacturing and logistics, with future applications in healthcare, the home, and beyond. We operate at the cutting edge of Applied AI, applying our expertise across the full robotics stack to solve some of society's most important problems. You will join a team dedicated to bringing Apollo to market at scale, tackling the complex challenges like safety, commercialization, and mass production to change the world for the better. **JOB SUMMARY** Own the safety assurance of the software and AI that run our humanoid robots, from architecture analysis through verification evidence. You will analyze software and AI safety architectures, lead the safety analyses, and assess whether the evidence supports our safety claims. You will draw on IEC 61508\-3, ISO/IEC TS 22440, and deep experience with safety\-critical software systems. **ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES or KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES** * Collaborate on system\-level risk assessments, allocate risk reduction measures to software and AI elements, and own the breakdown of software\-domain safety requirements into subsystem and element\-level requirements * Analyze and define the software safety architecture, including partitioning and freedom from interference, watchdogs, diagnostics, plausibility and timing monitoring, communication integrity, startup/shutdown behavior, and fault handling * Lead software safety analyses, including software FMEA, fault tree analysis, dependent/common\-cause failure analysis, and timing and resource analysis * Specify safety\-related software behavior, such as monitors, diagnostics, and safe\-state logic, and review software team designs against IEC 61508\-3 requirements for the target SIL / SC * Define the IEC 61508\-3 software safety plan and lifecycle, and assess team conformance through reviews and audits, including existing in\-house, open\-source, and third\-party libraries, RTOS, and middleware * Assess software systematic capability and review verification evidence, including coverage, static analysis, fault injection, and software\-in\-the\-loop and hardware\-in\-the\-loop test results, for adequacy against safety claims * Apply the AI safety lifecycle (ISO/IEC TS 22440\) to AI/ML\-enabled functions, defining the safety architecture around them, including independence of safety functions from learned components and the safety mechanisms that monitor them * Assess AI/ML safety evidence against the AI safety lifecycle, including data and model assurance, performance limitations, and operational design domain * Own software requirements traceability and the software portion of the safety case, including gap assessments against standards * Support product safety and compliance teams in certification and demonstration of standards conformity **SKILLS AND REQUIREMENTS** * Demonstrated experience analyzing and assuring safety\-critical software architectures, including software safety analyses and safety case development * Practical application of the IEC 61508\-3 or ISO 26262\-6 (automotive) software lifecycle, with depth in software safety activities and qualification of existing software and tools, and experience with IEC 62061, ISO 13849, ISO 10218, ANSI/A3 R15\.06, or ISO 25785\-1 as relevant * Strong knowledge of embedded software architectures, including RTOS, mixed\-criticality partitioning, watchdogs, communication buses, and diagnostics * Hands\-on experience with FMEA/FMEDA, FTA, and dependent failure analysis, and with reviewing verification evidence such as fault injection, software\-in\-the\-loop and hardware\-in\-the\-loop testing, and test coverage * Working knowledge of safety for AI/ML\-enabled systems, such as ISO/IEC TS 22440; familiarity with ISO/PAS 8800, UL 4600, or SOTIF preferred * Experience with requirements and traceability tools such as JAMA; familiarity with Git, CI/CD, and static analysis; certification or third\-party assessment experience preferred * Ability to work cross\-functionally and make sound, risk\-based engineering decisions * Experience with common Product Development Processes / Product Lifecycle management including Agile, CMMI, Waterfall, etc. helping teams to deliver to organizational milestones. **EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE** * Bachelor's Degree in Systems Engineering, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Robotics, or a related field (or equivalent experience); Master's preferred * 8\+ years of relevant engineering experience, including substantial responsibility for safety assurance or analysis of safety\-critical software in complex electromechanical products **PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:** * Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer * Must be able to lift 15 pounds at times * Vision to read printed materials and a computer screen * Hearing and speech to communicate The annual salary range is $200,000 \- $240,000 base * This is a direct hire. Please, no outside Agency solicitations. jobs.description: **Location** Boston, Massachusetts, United States **Job ID** R\-263158 **Date posted** 29/10/2026 About AISI AI Strategy \& Innovation (AISI) sits at the centre of AstraZeneca's R\&D AI transformation. Clinical Agentic Products * Own the path of the CRA agent from proof of concept through silent pilot to GxP\-validated release, including sign\-off from business owners across therapeutic and operational areas. * Translate clinical operations needs into product requirements and measurable outcomes, such as monitoring effort saved and trial capacity gained. * Make human\-in\-the\-loop design, auditability and validation planning product requirements from the first release. Cross\-Functional Collaboration * Build strong relationships with clinical development and operations leaders, AISI science teams, Enterprise AI and R\&D IT. * Communicate clearly about readiness, trade\-offs and uncertainty so that leaders can make decisions. Experience * 10 or more years of experience in product management or product leadership, including leading other product owners or managers. * Experience in pharmaceutical, biotechnology or other regulated healthcare technology settings. * Track record of taking a product from proof of concept to validated production use in a regulated environment. * Working knowledge of clinical development or clinical operations processes, such as site monitoring and clinical data review. * Familiarity with agentic and LLM\-based products, and with how to evaluate their quality and risk. * Understanding of GxP computerised system validation and data privacy requirements. * Experience managing budgets and outsourced delivery partners. * Proven ability to make and communicate prioritisation decisions across senior stakeholders. jobs.description: #### **Join Axon and be a Force for Good.** At Axon, we're on a mission to Protect Life. Adaptable. Unstoppable. As a Mission Engineer II, you'll work directly alongside public safety agencies to turn real operational challenges into working technical solutions. agency's Axon environment. * Lean into critical customer needs when your technical context or involvement can materially improve the outcome. * Help quarterback technical alignment around important deployments without replacing the teams responsible for deployment execution. * Serve as a liaison when complex technical issues require coordination beyond standard Support. * Help customers navigate capabilities across products such as Records, Fusus, AI Era, and the broader Axon ecosystem. * Connect the right resources across Product, Engineering, Support, Deployment, Training, Mission opportunities once immediate customer needs are addressed. ### **Learn in the Field. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer – BPS Monetization
jobs.description: **The Role** ------------ Bloomberg is looking for a **Software Engineer to help build, modernize and operate the platforms that power our marketing websites and digital experiences**. You will work on highly visible digital properties that connect Bloomberg's products, services and brand with audiences around the world. This is a hands\-on engineering role for someone who enjoys solving real business problems, taking ownership and delivering results. You'll work across our web ecosystem—from CMS platforms and frontend experiences to APIs, integrations, cloud infrastructure and developer tooling. We're looking for engineers who are self\-driven and comfortable taking ownership of problems that are not fully defined. You should be able to understand the desired outcome, ask the right questions, work with stakeholders and teammates to determine the right solution, and drive it through implementation and production. You'll be part of a collaborative engineering team, so technical ability alone isn't enough. Strong communication, teamwork, curiosity and a willingness to help others succeed are essential. **Team Culture** ---------------- We're a new team that works closely with our partners in Product and Design to build thoughtful digital experiences. We like to experiment with new ideas, collaborate across disciplines and learn from each other as we shape how the team works. Because the team is still growing, it's a great time to join—many of us are learning the space together, and you'll have an opportunity to help influence our engineering practices and culture from the start. We also encourage participation in Bloomberg's broader employee communities and initiatives and value teammates who contribute beyond their immediate project work. **What Success Looks Like** --------------------------- You'll become a trusted engineer who can take on a complex problem and **drive it toward a successful outcome with increasing independence**. You'll deliver high\-quality software, contribute to the modernization of Bloomberg's marketing technology ecosystem and help establish engineering practices that make the entire team more effective. Over time, your impact will extend beyond your individual contributions: you'll improve the systems around you, make your teammates more effective, identify opportunities before they become explicit requirements and use modern engineering and AI tooling to continually increase the speed and quality with which the team delivers digital experiences. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Design, build, test and operate **modern web applications and digital experiences** supporting Bloomberg's marketing ecosystem. * Build and evolve our web publishing platform on **Optimizely**, helping shape content models and data structures while developing reusable components, templates, integrations, publishing capabilities and supporting services. * Build new digital experiences from the ground up, working with Product, Marketing, Design and other engineering teams from requirements through production. * Take **end\-to\-end ownership** of engineering work, including understanding requirements, evaluating technical approaches, implementation, testing, deployment and ongoing support. * Translate evolving business requirements into clear technical solutions and communicate trade\-offs, risks and dependencies. * Develop solutions with **quality, maintainability, performance, accessibility, security and SEO** in mind. * Build automated tests and contribute to engineering practices that allow the team to release software confidently and frequently. * Contribute to technical discussions, architecture decisions, code reviews and engineering standards across the team. * Experiment with and adopt **AI\-assisted development tools and workflows** to accelerate development, improve quality and increase individual and team productivity. **You'll Need to Have** ----------------------- * At least **5 years of professional software engineering experience** building and maintaining production web applications or digital platforms. * Experience working with **CMS platforms or content\-driven websites**. * Comfort with enterprise, headless or composable CMS platforms is particularly valuable. * Familiarity with automated testing, source control, CI/CD and modern software development workflows. * Understanding of modern web technologies, APIs and frontend/backend application architectures. **We'd Love to See** -------------------- * Experience developing on the **Optimizely platform**, including building or extending CMS\-driven websites, components or integrations. * Experience building web applications using **.NET and its broader ecosystem**. * Experience building websites or digital experiences for **marketing organizations, digital agencies, media companies or other organizations operating large public\-facing web ecosystems**. * Experience with CMS migrations, website re\-platforming or other large\-scale modernization efforts. * Familiarity with **technical SEO**, including site architecture, rendering, structured data, metadata and web performance. * Experience with cloud platforms such as **Microsoft Azure**. * Experience with CDNs, caching, content delivery and performance optimization. * Familiarity with headless CMS architectures, content APIs, design systems and modern frontend frameworks. * Experience with analytics, experimentation, personalization or marketing technology platforms. Salary Range \= 160,000 \- 240,000 USD Annual \+ Benefits \+ Bonus The referenced salary range is based on the Company's good faith belief at the time of posting. Actual compensation may vary based on factors such as geographic location, work experience, market conditions, education/training and skill level. We offer one of the most comprehensive and generous benefits plans available and offer a range of total rewards that may include merit increases, incentive compensation (exempt roles only), paid holidays, paid time off, medical, dental, vision, short and long term disability benefits, 401(k) \+match, life insurance, and various wellness programs, among others. The Company does not provide benefits directly to contingent workers/contractors and interns. Discover what makes Bloomberg unique \- watch our podcast series for an inside look at our culture, values, and the people behind our success. **Accommodations** ------------------ Bloomberg provides reasonable adjustment/accommodation to individuals with disabilities. Please tell us if you require a reasonable adjustment/accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable adjustment/accommodation include but are not limited to making a change to the application process or work procedures, providing documents in an alternate format or using specialized equipment. To request an adjustment/accommodation to apply for a job, please email AMER\_recruit@bloomberg.net (Americas), EMEA\_recruit@bloomberg.net (Europe, the Middle East and Africa), or APAC\_recruit@bloomberg.net (Asia\-Pacific), based on the region you are submitting an application for. We may share your information with a third party provider of accommodations services who may use this information to reach out to you for the purposes of accommodating your application. **Equal Opportunity** --------------------- Bloomberg is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination in employment. It is Bloomberg’s policy to provide equal opportunity and access for all persons, and the Company is committed to attracting, retaining, developing, and promoting the most qualified individuals without regard to age, ancestry, color, gender identity or expression, genetic predisposition or carrier status, marital status, national or ethnic origin, race, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, self\-identified or perceived sex, sexual and other reproductive health decisions, parental or caring status, physical or mental disability, pregnancy, childbirth or related medical conditions, or parental leave, protected veteran status, status as a victim of domestic violence, or any other classification protected by applicable law (each, a “Protected Characteristic”). Bloomberg prohibits treating applicants or employees less favorably in connection with the terms and conditions of employment, in all phases of the employment process, because of one or more Protected Characteristics.

jobs.description: ### **Description** **Work Schedule includes working Weekends and Holidays.** **Onsite Schedule 1st Shift, 7AM to 4PM.** **Onsite: Wednesday/Thursday/Friday/Saturday/Sunday** **Be Part of the Team Behind the Game** Are you ready to bring your network expertise to the global stage of one of the biggest professional sports leagues in the US? Blue Mantis is seeking a highly skilled and versatile, Swiss Army Knife **IT Network Operations Engineer** to support enterprise\-class data centers and ensure seamless network operations. This role focuses on ensuring high availability and performance of network infrastructure while contributing to game\-day success. The ideal candidate will be a proactive and adaptable professional with a passion for innovation, an ability to multitask and reprioritize in real\-time and a commitment to delivering excellence in a fast\-paced, mission\-critical environment. This candidate will be proficient in supporting server and cloud environments but should also have experience with networking as this team will be supporting a wide array of technologies to support the company infrastructure and game day operations. If you thrive under pressure and excel at managing complex technical challenges, this is your opportunity to make an impact. Working for Blue Mantis at this customer, you’ll operate in a high\-pressure, high\-reward environment, directly impacting game\-day success and ensuring a successful fan experience. (Cisco, Palo Alto, Meraki, Arista) * Proficiency in scripting languages (Python, PowerShell, Bash) for automating server and cloud operations. * Familiarity with cloud\-based networking solutions in AWS, Azure, or O365 environments. * Knowledge of infrastructure capacity planning and performance tuning. * Familiarity with security best practices, SIEM platforms, and endpoint protection. * Experience with advanced video streaming technologies and CDNs. * Familiarity with infrastructure performance tuning and capacity planning. **Qualifications*** Provide game day support on major holidays when games are played. * Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or equivalent hands\-on experience. * Certifications: CCNA, CCNP (or equivalent) ITIL and technical certifications in, servers and/ or cloud (preferred). * Experience: Demonstrated expertise in a complex, multisite environment. Base Salary Range: $120,000 to $165,000\.00 **Please note: This range is based on our market pay structures. However, individual salaries are determined by a variety of factors including, but not limited to: business considerations, local market conditions, and internal equity, as well as candidate qualifications, such as skills, education, and experience.** We consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status. Reasonable accommodations will be made to enable employees with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the job. This job description is intended to describe the general nature of the work being performed by employees in this role. It is not intended to be a complete list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required. ### **Benefits** **What You’ll Gain*** The unique opportunity to be part of the league’s technological foundation. * A challenging, high\-energy workplace with direct impact on game\-day success. * Hands\-on experience with cutting\-edge technologies in a mission\-critical environment. * Opportunities for growth, learning, and professional development. ### **About Blue Mantis** Blue Mantis is a leading strategic digital technology services provider with a 30\+ year history of successfully helping clients achieve business modernization by applying next\-generation technologies including managed services, cybersecurity and cloud. Headquartered in Portsmouth, New Hampshire, the company provides digital technology services and strategic guidance to ensure clients quickly adapt and grow through automation and innovation. Blue Mantis partners with more than 1,200 leading mid\-market and enterprise organizations in a multitude of vertical industries and is backed by leading private equity firm Recognize.

jobs.title: Embedded Software Engineer, Cameras & CI
jobs.description: We're Blue River, a team of innovators driven to create intelligent machinery that solves monumental problems for our customers. We empower our customers – farmers, construction crews, and foresters \- to implement safer and more sustainable solutions, driving increased profitability with less reliance on scarce labor. We believe that focusing on the small stuff – pixel\-by\-pixel and task\-by\-task \- leads to big gains. Blue River Technology aligns with John Deere's vision to "innovate on behalf of humanity" by quickly identifying and solving high\-value, high\-uncertainty challenges in AI, machine learning, computer vision, and robotics. BRT acts as a research and development flywheel, building not only new products but also new platforms that reliably create value for both Deere and its customers. From fully autonomous machines to highly precise farming equipment, BRT and Deere are partnering to create technical breakthroughs in industries like agriculture and construction. Our people are at the heart of what we do. Through cross\-disciplinary collaboration, this mission\-driven team is eager to define the new frontier of robotics. We are always asking hard questions, rapidly iterating, and getting our boots in the field to figure it out. We won't give up until we've made a tangible and positive impact on the planet! Blue River Technology is based in Santa Clara, CA. Summary We are seeking a highly skilled Embedded Software Engineer to join our team. In this role, you'll develop embedded software and systems for our computer vision\-enabled agricultural products, including the Bay Area's highest\-density compute platform for robotics. Do you thrive in a fast\-paced, innovative team environment and get energized about delivering solutions to technical challenges? If so, this role will be an outstanding next step in your career! * **Employment Type**: Full\-time * **Work Location**: Santa Clara, CA * **Visa sponsorship:** Available for this position. **Job Responsibilities** * Develop, enhance, and debug new and existing software applications, kernels, and device drivers for impactful robotics computing in C/C\+\+ and Rust within a Linux environment. * Enhance camera and sensor capabilities, image quality, and exposure configuration; support training data collection operations. * Ensure OS (Yocto) support is implemented properly for sensors. * Build automated driver and camera regression tests that run in continuous integration on hardware\-in\-the\-loop platforms. * Conduct embedded design reviews and code reviews, providing guidance to resolve difficult driver bugs which may require extensive troubleshooting. * Implement embedded design best practices and methodologies to ensure high performance and reliability, with a strong emphasis on real\-time programming considerations. **Required Experience and Skills** * Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related field. * 1\-3 years of experience developing embedded software. * Familiarity with cameras/other sensors and camera interfaces (e.g., MIPI CSI\-2\). * Strong attention to detail with a focus on testing and continuous integration practices. * Knowledge of real\-time systems and performance optimization techniques. **Preferred Experience and Skills** * Camera and camera interface testing, including performance testing under physical conditions such as shock/vibe, EMI, and temperature. * Expertise in Linux kernel device driver development and tuning real\-time applications for low latency. * Experience in development on ARM platforms (NVIDIA Jetson) and Linux (Yocto, meta\-tegra) embedded systems. * V4L2 camera driver expertise. * Experience with NVIDIA driver development. * Experience building or maintaining continuous integration pipelines for embedded software. * Middleware experience, particularly with pub/sub architectures. Only individual applicants will be considered. We do not work with unsolicited third\-party agencies or proxy interview services. At Blue River, your base pay is one part of your total compensation package. jobs.description: We are hiring an Analytics Product Engineer to build user\-facing analytics and AI experiences in our healthcare products. alerts, and exports that make complex information easy to use. * Embed analytics agents into dashboard workflows so users can ask natural\-language questions, investigate anomalies, explain trends, receive context\-aware recommendations, and explore supporting evidence. * Design the agent experience in the product: suggested prompts, conversational interactions, insight cards, citations, confidence indicators, feedback mechanisms, and clear handoff paths. * Partner with Product and users to understand decision workflows, validate ideas, and help shape a prioritized product backlog. * prepare and deliver technical presentations. * Conduct pre‑analysis of customer‑reported issues or defects identified during internal validation. * Analyze in‑vehicle performance issues and propose corrective actions. * Record and evaluate vehicle‑environment measurements for further technical assessment. **Qualifications** **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in an engineering discipline (or foreign equivalent). * Valid driver’s license. * 3\+ years of experience in systems or requirements engineering and release processes within automotive applications. * 3\+ years of experience using calibration tools for embedded software/controls. * Knowledge of driver assistance sensors and functions, with strong interest in emerging ADAS technologies. * Hands‑on experience using Vector CANape for embedded system calibration. * Direct experience troubleshooting embedded control systems integrated into a vehicle platform. * Strong verbal and written communication skills in English (additional languages a plus). * Comfortable conducting vehicle testing on public roads and test tracks. * Solid understanding of vehicle architecture, vehicle dynamics, and driver‑assistance interfaces. **Preferred Qualifications** * Master’s degree in Electrical, Computer, Mechanical Engineering, or related field. * Demonstrated sense of ownership, commitment, and innovative thinking. * Experience with Agile methodologies (e.g., SCRUM, Kanban, Lean). * Ability to work independently in a structured, organized manner; Our management team is dedicated to this policy with respect to all aspects of employment. Bosch is dedicated to maintaining compliance with all federal, state, and local law, including but not limited to, affirmative action plan requirements, EEO\-1 and VETS\-4212 reporting, and I9 / work authorization guidance. By choice, we are committed to a diverse workforce \- EOE/Protected Veteran/Disabled. jobs.title: Senior AI/ML Engineer
jobs.description: Senior AI/ML Engineer — Forward Deployed Engineer **Work Location:** Washington, DC — Hybrid; at least three days onsite per week Position Summary The Senior AI/ML Engineer serves as a senior Forward Deployed Engineer and accountable technical lead supporting one or more **Federal Agencies**. The role translates ambiguous mission needs into secure, usable, accessible, and Government\-owned AI capabilities. The incumbent provides hands\-on architecture, engineering, AI assurance, delivery leadership, and stakeholder advisory support across discovery, design, development, testing, deployment, operations, and knowledge transfer. Essential Responsibilities * Lead agency\-specific AI solution discovery, feasibility analysis, architecture, engineering design, integration, deployment, and operational support. * Translate incomplete mission needs into measurable problem statements, user needs, acceptance criteria, prioritized backlogs, experiments, and release plans. * Architect and implement AI\-enabled applications using appropriate methods, including classical ML, document intelligence, NLP, LLM integrations, RAG, agentic workflows, multi\-agent patterns, MCP server\-based components, APIs, and deterministic automation. * Select the simplest safe and effective solution rather than defaulting to generative AI. * Lead the technical design of data flows, identity and access controls, trust boundaries, fallback and rollback methods, observability, and resilience. * Direct MLOps/LLMOps practices, including version control, CI/CD, model/artifact registration, evaluation, monitoring, retraining or refresh workflows, and release management. * Define and oversee AI evaluation methods for accuracy, groundedness, relevance, hallucination, calibration, fairness, robustness, explainability, and operational impact. * Lead AI\-specific adversarial testing for prompt injection, jailbreaks, data poisoning, retrieval manipulation, insecure tool use, agent\-loop failures, secrets exposure, model extraction, and vector\-store corruption. * Ensure human\-in\-the\-loop controls, documented override and escalation mechanisms, audit logging, and clear distinction between AI\-generated and human\-verified outputs. * Produce or direct production\-ready architecture artifacts, technical documentation, model cards, test evidence, SBOM inputs, operational runbooks, and release packages. * Coordinate directly with Federal Agency CIO/OCIO organizations, AI governance teams, enterprise platform teams, cloud organizations, architecture review boards, security authorization teams, privacy, accessibility, legal, records, and other Government stakeholders. * Support RAIA, PIA/PTA, ATO/RMF, SSP, SAP, SAR, POA\&M, and related compliance documentation. * Ensure custom code, prompts, configurations, models, datasets, embeddings, and deployment assets are developed and maintained in Government\-controlled repositories. * Serve as the technical primary point of contact for assigned Federal Agency stakeholders and provide planned/unplanned coverage for other key personnel. * Act as, or work directly with, the designated Security Lead to certify security evidence for each applicable deliverable. jobs.description: Brinks Home™ is a leader in smart home and residential security, protecting more than 1 million people across the continental United States, Canada and Puerto Rico. build and maintain .NET web applications, APIs and integrations in accordance with company standards and REST principles. * Develop solutions across cloud\-based and service\-oriented architectures, integrating core business systems such as CRM, ERP, inventory and monitoring platforms. * Investigate and resolve production issues using application logs, telemetry, databases and AI\-assisted analysis; document fixes and maintain runbooks. * Maintain coding standards, improve application performance, address technical debt and support continuous integration. **AI\-Assisted Engineering** ---------------------------- * Translate Jira stories into clear, testable acceptance criteria, including edge cases and failure scenarios. * Direct AI coding agents, such as Claude Code, to develop file\-level technical plans and implement code, tests and pull requests. * Critically review AI\-generated plans, code and tests for accuracy, security, scope, quality and potential regressions. * Maintain traceability from requirements and technical plans through testing and deployment, including documentation for change approval requests. * Evaluate test results in system integration and staging environments and determine when changes are ready for production. * Improve shared agent prompts, skills and rules, and coach developers on effective AI use and appropriate human review. **Technical Leadership and Collaboration** ------------------------------------------ * Help establish technical and architectural direction for applications and systems. * Partner with product owners and business stakeholders to explore solutions and deliver business value. * Lead peer reviews and quality assurance activities, participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies and recommend process improvements. * Mentor developers and share technical knowledge with engineering, support and cross\-functional teams. * Research new tools and frameworks and assess their impact on business processes, application health and performance. **Required Qualifications****:** ================================ * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. * At least 8 years of experience designing, building and maintaining production web or business applications, including 3 or more years with C\#/.NET. * At least 8 years of experience working in Agile/Scrum environments. * Daily, hands\-on experience using AI coding agents or assistants such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot or Cursor on real development work. * Strong expertise in C\#, .NET Core/ASP.NET MVC and Entity Framework, with solid SQL Server skills, including query analysis and working with large production tables. * Experience designing, maintaining and consuming REST APIs; familiarity with GraphQL and third\-party or legacy integrations is beneficial. * Full\-stack development experience with Angular, React, Vue or a similar framework, as well as HTML5, CSS3 and JSON. * Experience with Azure, cloud application architecture, service\-oriented systems, Git\-based CI/CD and DevOps practices. * Ability to plan, implement, test and troubleshoot complex software and system solutions, and to identify security or quality issues in AI\-generated code. * Experience with Jira, Confluence, technical documentation, code reviews and established quality assurance practices. * Strong communication, problem\-solving and collaboration skills, including the ability to work effectively with product owners, stakeholders and cross\-functional teams. **Preferred Qualifications****:** =========================== AI\-agent skills, MCP servers, custom tool integrations or AI\-assisted software development workflows. * Knowledge of AI\-related risks, including prompt injection, secret handling, data protection and licensing of generated code. * Familiarity with Azure App Services, Key Vault, Application Insights, Log Analytics, Entra ID, Sentry or ConfigCat. * Experience with API management tools such as Sentinet and CI/CD platforms such as CircleCI or Octopus Deploy. * Python experience and knowledge of Linux; familiarity with Ruby, Nuxt.js, Heroku or Selenium. * Experience with ERP/CRM platforms such as Business Central or SalesLogix, home security systems or alarm\-monitoring workflows. * Experience mentoring developers through changes in tools, technology or development processes. **Technology Environment****:** =============================== The team works with C\#/.NET, Python, REST APIs and modern web frameworks; SQL Server and business application databases; Azure services including Key Vault, Application Insights and Log Analytics; Entra ID and ConfigCat; service\-oriented integrations and Sentinet API management; and GitHub, Jira and Confluence. AI tooling includes Claude Code and Cowork, shared agent skills, and MCP connections to systems such as logs, SQL and Jira. **AI\-Assisted Development Expectations****:** ============================================== AI use is a core expectation of this position. Each change request must include an AI\-written technical plan, and AI agents are expected to open pull requests for human review. Acceptance criteria define expected behavior and guide test creation. Human reviewers remain accountable for technical plans, code, tests and production promotion while automated verification is evaluated and improved. **What Success Looks Like** =========================== Within the first 30 days, the Senior Developer is expected to deliver a change through the full AI\-assisted workflow. Within 60 days, the developer should own a feature area with plans and pull requests requiring minimal rework. Within 90 days, the developer should contribute a shared agent skill or rules improvement. Ongoing success includes improved delivery throughput, fewer escaped defects, evidence\-based quality controls and active mentoring of junior developers. **Location and Travel** ======================= This is a remote position open to candidates located in the continental United States. Candidates in the Dallas–Fort Worth area are preferred. jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Description:** **Buehler, a division of Illinois Tool Works,** is a leading manufacturer of scientific equipment and supplies for use in material analysis. Comprised of world\-class products and brands, such as Wilson Hardness, Buehler continues a long history of providing market\-leading technology to support our customers in their sample preparation and material analysis applications. Buehler’s parent company, ITW, is a Fortune 200 global diversified industrial manufacturer of value\-added consumables and specialty equipment with related service businesses. The Company focuses on profitable growth with strong returns across worldwide platforms and businesses. The businesses serve local customers and markets around the globe, with a significant presence in developed as well as emerging markets. This key Software Engineer position at Buehler will be responsible for scoping, developing, and maintaining complex software applications. This position will involve daily local and international interaction with software, electrical, and mechanical engineers to develop top notch software and equipment. The candidate must be detail\-oriented, well\-organized, and enjoy working at a fast pace. This role requires in\-office work with electromechanical machinery but offers hybrid working depending on current tasks and projects. * Provide technical direction for Buehler’s software engineering roadmap for multiple software platforms and strategically look for ways to simplify software portfolio * Design, develop and test software to deliver high\-quality products * Exercise, and coach jobs.title: Innovation Software Engineer 1 New
jobs.description: **Built's Mission:** Connect and simplify doing business in real estate. Built is the AI\-powered platform transforming the way real estate is financed, developed, and managed. Purpose\-built for real estate and construction, Built began by fixing construction draw management for lenders and has grown into a comprehensive operating system addressing some of the industry’s most complex challenges. Today, Built is a partner to more than 350 lenders, over 80,000 borrowers and owners, and thousands of contractors, powering 86,000 active projects valued at more than $300 billion. Learn more at **getbuilt.com**. \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ **Innovation Software Engineer I, Marketplace** =============================================== Built Technologies is the AI\-first platform for construction and real estate finance, managing over $300 billion in annual capital for more than 340 lenders, including 45 of the top 100 U.S. banks. Our technology helps financial institutions and construction companies manage the movement of capital throughout construction projects, from loan draws and inspections to payments, compliance, and portfolio risk. We're bringing modern software and AI into an industry where many critical workflows still depend on spreadsheets, emails, and manual processes. **This role sits on Marketplace**, a business unit focused on expanding Built beyond its core software into the services surrounding construction projects, including inspections, appraisals, insurance, and materials sourcing. The team operates a little differently from a traditional engineering team. We're building the foundational technology that powers Marketplace while also experimenting with new products, getting early versions into customers' hands, and improving them based on real feedback. As an **Innovation Software Engineer**, you'll be part of that work from the beginning. You'll write code, build prototypes, experiment with AI\-powered workflows, and learn how to turn customer problems into working software. You'll work closely with experienced engineers who will help you develop your technical skills, make sound engineering decisions, and gradually take on more ownership. This is an opportunity for an early\-career engineer who loves building things, learns quickly, and wants to understand not just how software works, but why it matters to the people using it. **The Team** ------------ Marketplace is a small, experienced engineering team that recently became its own business unit at Built. It's a collaborative group with a strong culture of mentorship, code review, and hands\-on problem solving. You'll work alongside Senior and Staff engineers, Product, Design, and business leaders, learning how new products go from an initial idea to something customers actually use. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * **Build real software:** Develop features, APIs, internal tools, and reusable components that support Marketplace products, working alongside experienced engineers on design, implementation, testing, and code review. * **Prototype new ideas:** Help turn early product concepts into working prototypes and MVPs. Build quickly, learn from feedback, and improve what you've shipped. * **Build with AI:** Use AI coding tools as part of your daily development workflow and help build AI\-powered features, including document extraction, data validation, agent\-driven workflows, and automation. * **Learn production engineering:** Develop your understanding of backend services, APIs, asynchronous workflows, data models, testing, and the practices that make software reliable and maintainable. * **Get closer to customers:** Participate in customer discovery conversations, observe how people use the products, and help translate what you learn into improvements. * **Improve existing products:** Identify friction in workflows, fix bugs, improve usability, and help make products more reliable and valuable for customers. * **Automate manual work:** Learn how a workflow operates before automating it, then build tools and integrations that reduce repetitive work and improve efficiency. * **Grow your technical ownership:** Participate in code reviews, ask questions, learn from feedback, and gradually take responsibility for larger pieces of engineering work. **What You'll Bring** --------------------- * 0–2 years of experience in software engineering, product engineering, or a related technical role. Recent graduates and career changers with strong hands\-on projects are encouraged to apply. * Experience writing code in **TypeScript, JavaScript, or Python**, whether through professional work, internships, coursework, or personal projects. * Familiarity with APIs, databases, and fundamental software engineering concepts. * Experience using AI coding tools or experimenting with LLMs to build something, along with curiosity about how AI can be incorporated into real products. * At least one project you've built that you can product insights. * Share effective AI use cases and best practices with your team. *Built’s salary range for this position is $80,000\-$110,000 USD per year. The pay range is designed to accommodate upward mobility in the role, therefore it encompasses the full span of proficiency levels for this role and we believe that the midpoint of the range is competitive in the market. Salary is just one component of Built's total compensation package for employees; your total rewards package at Built will include equity, market\-current medical, dental and vision coverage, an unlimited PTO policy, and other benefits.* **\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_** **Travel Requirement:** Employees who are not based in the Nashville area are required to travel to our Nashville office at least twice per year for company gatherings, such as Connect Week. Additional travel to Nashville may be required based on your role and business needs. **Perks:** * The rare opportunity to radically disrupt a $1\.5T industry * Competitive benefits including: uncapped vacation \[US ONLY], medical, dental \& vision insurance * Robust compensation package, including equity in the form of stock options * Learning Grant program to support ongoing professional development * 401k with match and expedited vesting \[US ONLY] Built brings together passionate people who are driven in a variety of disciplines, each bringing their unique perspective to everything they do. We’re committed to building a safe, inclusive workplace where every employee can succeed, and we recruit, hire, and promote fairly \- without bias based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by law. Built is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need assistance or an accommodation during the application process, please share with your Talent Partner or email careers@getbuilt.com. ***Greenhouse Data Disclosure:*** *When you apply to a job on this site, the personal data contained in your application will be collected by Built. Your personal data will be processed for the purposes of managing Built’s recruitment related activities, which include setting up and conducting interviews and tests for applicants, evaluating and assessing the results thereto, communicating with you regarding your application (including via text message),and as is otherwise needed in the recruitment and hiring processes. Your personal data will be shared with Greenhouse Software, Inc., a cloud services provider located in the United States of America and engaged by Built to help manage its recruitment and hiring process on Built’s behalf. Your personal data will also be shared with Grayscale Labs, Inc., a cloud services provider located in the United States of America and engaged by Built Technologies to facilitate candidate communications, including text messaging.Your personal data will be retained by Built as long as Built determines it is necessary to evaluate your application for current or future employment. You have the right to request access to your personal data, to request that your personal data be rectified or erased, and to request that processing of your personal data be restricted. You also have the right to data portability.* *Built Privacy Policy* *By providing your phone number, you consent to receive text messages from Built related to your application. Message and data rates may apply. You may opt out at any time by replying STOP.* *If you would like to contact Built to ask questions surrounding processing of your personal data or to make a request, you can send an email to* *privacy@getbuilt.com**.* *California residents: Please note that Built does not sell your personal data. For details on how your data is shared with our service providers, please see our* *Privacy Policy**.*
