development with one or more of the following: C\#, JavaScript/TypeScript, Node, React Java, PHP, C\+\+, VB/VBA, HTML/CSS or comparable languages. * Cloud development and integration experience with Azure, AWS and/or Google Cloud. + Proper deployment strategy (nomenclature varies across cloud platforms) \- container instances, containers, functions, static webapps, serverless storage types, + Data and credential security – (nomenclature varies across cloud platforms) passwordless methods, managed identity, key vaults, secrets, keystores, POLP everywhere – (Principal of Least Privilege) + Data Compliance – knowledge and understanding of GDPR, PII, HIPAA, SOC2, SOX, and other types of compliance environments. * DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure automation, containers or microservices\-based architectures. * Deep experience with the Microsoft 365 ecosystem, including Microsoft Copilot Studio, Power Platform, SharePoint, Teams, Power BI, Entra ID, Azure AI services, Exchange and Intune integrations. * ERP, financial\-systems, CRM, HR platform, business\-intelligence or data\-warehouse integrations. * Security tooling and practices, including secrets management, least\-privilege access, logging, monitoring and secure data transfer. * Experience building AI\-enabled business solutions with tools such as Microsoft Copilot Studio, Claude or comparable GenAI platforms, including agentic patterns, workflow orchestration and integrations with business data and applications. * Relevant Microsoft AI, Copilot Studio, Power Platform, Azure, AWS, database, security, networking or DevOps certifications. **What Success Looks Like** * Clients can rely on their applications and integrations for day\-to\-day operations, with fewer single points of failure. * Existing solutions become easier for BNC engineers and client teams to understand, support and extend. * New development work is practical, secure, documented and aligned with the client’s business objectives. * Client stakeholders receive clear advice, realistic timelines and professional communication from discovery through ongoing support. * Build a long\-term career with BNC. **About BNC** Business Network Consulting has supported the technology infrastructure of businesses in the Denver, Dallas and Austin markets since 1997\. BNC works in a fast\-paced consulting environment where team members operate independently within a structured system, build trusted client relationships and are directly recognized for their impact. We are looking for someone who combines strong technical execution with curiosity, accountability and a genuine commitment to helping clients succeed.**Compensation** BNC is offering the following per\-hour rate ranges:* Billable time towards scope work: $125 \- $150 / hour * Administrative \& project management time, including meetings: $100? **How to Apply** Please submit a résumé along with a brief summary of your experience with the technologies outlined above. jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description: CCC Intelligent Solutions Inc. (CCC) is a leading cloud platform for the multi\-trillion\-dollar insurance economy**,** creating intelligent experiences for insurers, repairers, automakers, part suppliers, and more. At CCC, we’re making life just work by empowering more than 35,000 businesses with industry\-leading technology to get drivers back on the road and to health quickly and seamlessly. We’re pushing boundaries with innovative AI solutions that simplify and enhance the claims and repair journey. Through purposeful innovation and the strength of its connections, CCC technologies empower the people and industry relied upon to keep lives moving forward when it matters most. Learn more about CCC at www.cccis.com. **The Role** ============ CCC Intelligent Solutions Inc. (CCC) is a leading cloud platform for the multi\-trillion\-dollar insurance economy, creating intelligent experiences for insurers, repairers, automakers, part suppliers, and more. At CCC, we’re making life just work by empowering more than 35,000 businesses with industry\-leading technology to get drivers back on the road and to health quickly and seamlessly. We’re pushing boundaries with innovative AI solutions that simplify and enhance the claims and repair journey. Through purposeful innovation and the strength of its connections, CCC technologies empower the people and industry relied upon to keep lives moving forward when it matters most. Learn more about CCC at www.cccis.com. The Role: You will build and ship LLM\-powered features and agentic workflows for our customers. These features automate the routine parts of a claim and guide customers on the rest, so they have to earn that trust with measured accuracy, not a convincing demo. Agents run as steps inside deterministic workflows, and privacy and security are design baselines, not review gates. Agentic coding tools are how you move fast. What you add is what they are worst at: system design, security, and hard debugging. You own features end to end.**Key Responsibilities:** ========================= * Ship LLM\-powered features and agentic workflows in Python and TypeScript, from a problem scoped with product managers and data scientists through production traffic, and help set the metrics you will be measured against. * Write the evals, guardrails, and feedback loops that make your features trustworthy, and hold them to explicit token and latency budgets. * Use agentic coding tools every day, and own the review of what they produce: catch the correctness, security, and design problems in generated code before you open the pull request. * Maintain and extend the NLP pipelines that turn unstructured claim data into structured data customers can act on, blending semantic search, classical NLP, and LLMs. * Build and operate durable, event\-driven services in which agents run as steps inside deterministic workflows, with checkpointed model outputs so a retry does not re\-invoke a completed LLM step. * Trace every model call and agent step so a recommendation can be reconstructed and audited, with citations back to the source documents, and wire that tracing into your alerts. * Model and query claims data across relational, document, and graph stores. * Design privacy and security in from the start: tenant isolation, least\-privilege access for agents and their tools, and a clear rule for what data may reach a model provider. * Write a technical design document before any significant change, and use it to get feedback and buy\-in from the team before you build. * Take part in a shared on\-call rotation for the services you build. **Requirements:** ================= * 3\+ years of professional software engineering experience, including at least one LLM\-powered feature you shipped and then operated in production. * Python and TypeScript: typed, tested, async code in both, and real depth in one. * Evals you have designed for LLM output, plus guardrails you have shipped. * A clear account of how you constrain an agentic coding tool's context and verify its output, from daily use of Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar on production work. * Pipelines that blend LLMs with semantic search and classical NLP: structured output, tool calling, embedding\-based retrieval, and a case where a classical technique beat an LLM. * Services built on message\- or event\-driven architectures, including long\-running workflows with retries, idempotent handlers, and event\-sourced state, plus an LLM or agent step you ran inside one. * Data modeling and development across relational, document, and graph databases such as PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and Neo4j, including when each type fits and the partition\-key, consistency, and tenant\-isolation calls you made. * Backend services built and operated on Azure or AWS, and exposure to a durable workflow engine such as Temporal or the Durable Task Scheduler. * Technical design documents you have written to API platforms: Experience building API gateways or API frameworks used by many engineering teams. * AI infrastructure: Familiarity with GPU cloud platforms or AI infrastructure. **Benefits:** * jobs.title: Sr. AI Engineer
jobs.description: The Role: Sr. AI Engineer\- Data Analytics \& Artificial Intelligence The Location: Los Angeles, Orange County, San Diego Make a Difference Where It Matters Most At CalPrivate Bank, we believe banking is personal. We have deep roots in the communities we serve, and our client relationships are built on genuine care, thoughtful problem\-solving, and unwavering integrity. Our solutions\-based service, paired with best\-in\-class talent, sets us apart in the market, but it’s trust that defines who we are. It's our gold standard, the currency we trade in, and the foundation of every decision we make. We’re looking for leaders who want more than a title. We’re looking for team players who want to make an impact. If you're driven to lead with purpose, ready to shape the future and have meaningful impact at a relationship\-centered bank, CalPrivate Bank may be the place for you. Your Opportunity: Sr. AI Engineer The Senior AI Engineer will play a key role in advancing CalPrivate Bank’s data analytics and artificial intelligence capabilities, helping translate data, emerging technologies, and business needs into practical solutions that improve how the Bank operates, serves clients, manages risk, and makes decisions. This is a senior, hands\-on engineering role designed for an individual who can operate at the intersection of AI, data, technology, and the business. Working closely with the Bank’s data and technology leadership, this individual will help turn strategic objectives into executable solutions, building the infrastructure, models, tools, and processes necessary to responsibly expand the use of AI and advanced analytics across the organization. The ideal candidate combines strong technical depth with business judgment and a builder’s mindset. They should be equally comfortable developing solutions, evaluating new technologies, improving data architecture, and partnering with business leaders to understand where AI and analytics can create meaningful value. In a growing community bank environment, success will require someone who is resourceful, collaborative, comfortable working across functions, and able to move initiatives from concept through implementation. As CalPrivate Bank continues to grow and invest in its technology and data capabilities, the Senior AI Engineer will help create the foundation that allows the organization to use its information more intelligently and efficiently. This role will support the development of scalable AI and analytics capabilities while helping the broader team successfully execute against its strategic roadmap. The Senior AI Engineer will help identify opportunities to automate manual processes, improve access to actionable information, enhance reporting and forecasting, and responsibly incorporate generative AI and machine learning into appropriate business workflows. Just as importantly, this individual will help establish the technical standards, controls, documentation, and governance necessary to ensure these capabilities are reliable, secure, explainable, and appropriate for a highly regulated banking environment. **What You’ll Do** **Key Responsibilities** * Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain AI, generative AI, machine learning, data engineering, and advanced analytics solutions that address meaningful business needs across the Bank. * Partner with data and technology leadership to translate strategic AI and analytics objectives into technical requirements, development priorities, and executable solutions. * Build and enhance the Snowflake\-centered data pipelines, integrations, APIs, and architecture required to support analytics, AI applications, and data products. * Develop solutions utilizing large language models and generative AI, including Snowflake Cortex AI, Cortex Search, Cortex Agents, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), enterprise search, intelligent document processing, workflow automation, and internal knowledge tools where appropriate. * Design flexible, modular AI architectures that support the evaluation, integration, and substitution of different AI models and providers where appropriate, minimizing unnecessary vendor dependencies while balancing performance, security, cost, and operational complexity. * Evaluate emerging AI technologies, platforms, models, and vendors and provide thoughtful recommendations based on business value, scalability, security, cost, and regulatory considerations. * Develop prototypes and proofs of concept and successfully transition viable solutions into stable, production\-ready applications, taking ownership through testing, deployment, monitoring, and ongoing support. * Partner with business teams to identify opportunities where AI, automation, or advanced analytics can improve efficiency, reduce manual work, enhance decision\-making, or improve the client and employee experience. * Support the continued development of the Bank’s enterprise data environment, including data quality, accessibility, lin ing to BSA and therefore has the obligation to report suspicious activity to the BSA Officer as appropriate. The employee is responsible for understanding and following the Bank’s BSA/AML policies including elevating suspicious activity to the BSA Officer. Additionally, the employee is required to understand and follow the Bank’s compliance program BSA/AML policies including elevating suspicious activity to the BSA Officer. Additionally, the employee is required to understand and follow the Bank’s compliance program. **Who You Are** ***Experience \& Expertise*** * Advanced experience in AI engineering, machine learning engineering, data engineering, applied data science, or a closely related discipline. * Strong proficiency in Python and SQL, with experience applying modern software and data engineering practices. * Demonstrated experience building and deploying production AI, generative AI, data, and analytics applications. * Hands\-on experience with generative AI technologies, large language models, prompt engineering, embeddings, vector databases, RAG architectures, AI agents or workflow orchestration, and model/API integration. * Strong hands\-on experience with Snowflake, including data engineering, data pipelines, security and access patterns, integrations, and building production workloads on the platform. Experience with Snowpark, Cortex AI, Cortex Search, Cortex Agents, external stages, streams/tasks, dynamic tables, or related Snowflake capabilities is highly desirable. * Hands\-on experience integrating data and AI solutions with Microsoft Azure, particularly Azure Functions and Azure Storage/Blob Storage. * Strong understanding of data architecture, ETL/ELT pipelines, APIs, relational databases, data warehouses/lakehouses, and structured and unstructured data. * Experience with modern software engineering and DevOps practices, including Git/GitHub, branching and pull\-request workflows, automated testing, CI/CD, environment management, code review, and controlled production deployment. * Ability to assess business problems and determine when AI is, and when it is not, the appropriate solution. * Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills with the ability to operate independently while collaborating effectively across teams. * Experience working with sensitive or highly regulated data is strongly preferred; banking, financial services, fintech, or another regulated industry is highly desirable. ***Mindset \& Values*** * You lead with accountability, integrity, and consistency. * You thrive in a collaborative environment where transparency and follow\-through matter. * You model professionalism, calm under pressure, and a solutions\-oriented mindset. * You embrace data\-driven decision\-making while maintaining a client\-first perspective. * You embody CalPrivate’s culture, heart for client, excellence in service, and deep commitment to the Bank and its people. ***Physical Demands**** May require some travel in order to support team, department and initiatives. * Ability to sit or stand for extended periods of time. * Ability to physically use a keyboard/mouse * Ability to walk to and from workstations * Ability to frequently lift and/or move up to 10lbs and occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 pounds. * Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision and ability to adjust focus **Why CalPrivate Bank?** This isn’t just another bank job. At CalPrivate Bank, you will be part of something bigger. Our day\-to\-day operations and projects don’t just impact a balance sheet, they influence real people, real businesses, and the communities we proudly serve. We are guided by our commitment to relationships, solutions, and trust. And we’re building a team of people who reflect those values in everything they do. If you’re looking for a place where your work will matter, your ideas will be valued, and your growth will be supported, welcome to CalPrivate Bank! Ready to lead with purpose?

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description: **About Care Access** Care Access is working to make the future of health better for all. **With hundreds of research locations, mobile clinics, and clinicians across the globe, we bring world\-class research and health services directly to communities that often face barriers to care.** We are dedicated to ensuring that every person has the opportunity to understand their health, access the care they need, **and contribute to the medical breakthroughs of tomorrow.** With programs like *Future of Medicine*, which makes advanced health screenings and research opportunities accessible to communities worldwide, and *Difference Makers*, which supports local leaders to expand their community health and wellbeing efforts, we put people at the heart of medical progress. Through partnerships, technology, and perseverance, we are reimagining how clinical research and health services reach the world. Together, we are building a future of health that is better and more accessible for all. To learn more about Care Access, visit www.CareAccess.com. ### **How This Role Makes a Difference** The **Senior Data Engineer** is responsible for designing, developing, implementing, and maintaining scalable data pipelines and enterprise data solutions that support the organization's operational, analytical, and reporting needs. This position oversees the ingestion, transformation, integration, and delivery of complex data from multiple sources to ensure the availability, reliability, and integrity of enterprise data assets. The Senior Data Engineer collaborates with cross\-functional stakeholders to develop modern data architectures, optimize data processing workflows, and enhance platform performance using industry best practices and cloud\-based technologies. This role provides technical leadership in advancing the organization's data infrastructure, supporting data governance initiatives, and delivering high\-quality data solutions that enable informed business decision\-making. ### **How You'll Make An Impact** * **Data Engineering Strategy and Architecture:** + Design and implement scalable, reliable, and efficient data pipelines to support clinical, operational, and business needs. + Develop and maintain architecture standards, reusable frameworks, and best practices across data engineering workflows. + Build automated systems for data ingestion, transformation, and orchestration leveraging cloud\-native and open\-source tools. * **Data Infrastructure and Performance Optimization:** + Optimize data storage and processing in data lakes and cloud data warehouses (Azure, Databricks). + Develop and monitor batch and streaming data processes to ensure data accuracy, consistency, and timeliness. + Maintain documentation and lineage tracking across datasets and pipelines to support transparency and governance. * **Collaboration and Stakeholder Engagement:** + Work cross\-functionally with analysts, data scientists, software engineers, and business stakeholders to understand data requirements and deliver fit\-for\-purpose data solutions. + Review and refine work completed by other team members, ensuring quality and performance standards are met. + Provide technical mentorship to junior team members and collaborate with contractors and third\-party vendors to extend engineering capacity. * **Technology and Tools:** + Use Databricks, DBT, Azure Data Factory, and SQL to architect and deploy robust data engineering solutions. + Integrate APIs, structured/unstructured data sources, and third\-party systems into centralized data platforms. + Evaluate and implement new technologies to enhance the scalability, observability, and automation of data operations. * **Continuous Improvement:** + Proactively suggest improvements to infrastructure, processes, and automation to improve system efficiency, reduce costs, and enhance performance. ### **The Expertise Required** * Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, orchestration tools (e.g., Airflow, Azure Data Factory), and modern software engineering practices. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to address complex data challenges and drive toward scalable solutions. ### **Certifications/Licenses, Education, and Experience** * Minimum Education: + Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field. * Minimum Experience: + 5\+ years of experience in data engineering with a proven track record of building cloud\-based, production\-grade data pipelines. + Strong expertise in Databricks, SQL, dbt, Python, and cloud data ecosystems such as Azure. + Experience working with structured and semi\-structured data from diverse domains. ### **How We Work Together** * **Location**: Remote within the United States. jobs.title: Principal Data Engineer
jobs.description: For more than 45 years, Careington International has been a leader in the health and wellness benefits space. Since its founding in 1979, Careington has been delivering dental discount solutions as its core competency. Today, Careington has expanded to offer a growing portfolio of 150\+ health, wellness, lifestyle and virtual health products and services designed to deliver cost savings across a spectrum of life needs. Through its affiliated nationally licensed third\-party administrator (TPA), Careington also delivers full\-scale administrative services, including customer service, licensed enrollment, claims administration, individual and group billing, and more. This role will be worked from our Frisco, TX, corporate location on Gaylord Pkwy. The Principal Data Data Engineer is responsible for designing, building, and optimizing scalable data pipelines and data platforms that support operational processing, analytics, and advanced data science initiatives. This role will focus on developing and maintaining enterprise data integration frameworks that enable efficient ingestion, transformation, and distribution of critical business data including client eligibility, claims, and provider network datasets. You will play a key role in building and expanding the organization’s Azure\-based data platform, including the implementation of a data lake architecture using the medallion data model (Bronze, Silver, Gold). This role will partner with analytics, reporting, and application development teams to ensure reliable data delivery, improved data quality, and scalable infrastructure to support dashboards, artificial intelligence, and machine learning initiatives. **EXPECTED WORK AND PERFORMANCE** * Design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines using tools such as SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS), Azure Data Factory, and Python. * Optimize inbound data ingestion frameworks supporting client eligibility files, claims data, and provider network data from multiple external partners. * Develop reusable patterns for secure and efficient ingestion of structured and semi\-structured data from file transfers, APIs, and other integration methods. * Design and implement robust data validation, monitoring, and logging frameworks to ensure data integrity and operational visibility. * Build and maintain data lake architecture within Azure following the medallion design pattern (Bronze, Silver, Gold layers). * Develop transformation processes to standardize, cleanse, and prepare enterprise datasets for reporting, analytics, and downstream application consumption. * Collaborate with analytics and reporting to deliver curated datasets supporting dashboards, AI, and machine learning models. * Design scalable frameworks for both inbound and outbound data integrations to support new client onboarding and enterprise data exchange requirements. * Monitor and tune data pipeline performance to ensure efficient data movement, minimal latency, and reliable execution. * Implement data governance, metadata management, and data lineage practices to improve transparency and trust in enterprise data assets. * Participate in architectural discussions and recommend improvements to data infrastructure, tools, and processes to support enterprise data strategy. * Provide mentorship and technical guidance to junior data engineers and developers. * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams including database administrators, application developers, infrastructure teams, and business stakeholders to support enterprise data initiatives. ##### **QUALIFICATIONS** **Required** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Engineering, or a related field. * 10\+ years of experience in data engineering, data integration, or related roles. * Strong experience building ETL/ELT pipelines using SSIS, Azure Data Factory, or similar integration platforms. * Experience with Python for data processing, automation, or pipeline orchestration. * Strong experience working with SQL Server and relational databases. * Experience designing scalable data ingestion and transformation processes for large datasets. * Experience building or supporting cloud\-based data platforms within Microsoft Azure. **Preferred** * Experience designing and implementing data lake architectures. * Experience with medallion data architecture (Bronze, Silver, Gold). * Experience supporting analytics platforms such as Power BI or similar BI tools. * Experience with distributed data processing or big data technologies. * Experience supporting AI/ML data pipelines and analytics workloads. * Experience with healthcare, insurance, or large\-scale transactional data environments. ##### **SKILLS** * Strong problem\-solving and analytical thinking abilities. * Ability to design scalable, maintainable, and reusable data integration frameworks. * Strong communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Experience collaborating with cross\-functional teams including data analysts, data scientists, application developers, and infrastructure engineers. * Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment. * Strong attention to detail and commitment to data quality and operational reliability. * Ability to mentor and provide technical leadership within a data engineering team. jobs.title: Research Scientist - College of Engineering - Mechanical Engineering
jobs.description: Carnegie Mellon University is a private, global research university that stands among the world’s most renowned education institutions. With ground\-breaking brain science, path\-breaking performances, creative start\-ups, big data, big ambitions, hands\-on learning, and a whole lot of robots, CMU doesn’t imagine the future, we invent it. If you’re passionate about joining a community that challenges the curious to deliver work that matters, your journey starts here! Innovation. Interdisciplinary collaboration. Complex problem solving. In Carnegie Mellon University’s Department of Mechanical Engineering, faculty members, researchers, and students are revolutionizing focus areas in advanced manufacturing, bioengineering, computational engineering, energy and the environment, product design, and robotics. In addition, they are using their expertise in interdisciplinary research centers across the university. Carnegie Mellon University’s department of Mechanical Engineering is searching for a Research Scientist to join their team. This is an exciting opportunity for someone who thrives in an interesting and challenging work environment. You will contribute to the department by leading the Safe AI Lab's research program on scenario generation, simulation, and digital twins for embodied AI. The role builds digital twins of industrial work cells and assembly processes, generates safety\-critical and long\-tail scenarios from incident data, standards, and procedural variation, and runs simulation\-based evaluation of robot policies in physics simulators (NVIDIA Isaac Sim, MuJoCo) to produce quantitative safety evidence and sim\-to\-real validation. Therefore, we are in search of a team member who is able to effectively interact with a varied population of internal and external partners at a high level of integrity. We are looking for someone who shares our values and who will support the mission of the university through their work. **Qualifications:** * Master’s degree preferred. * 5\-8 years of experience. * Experience with robot simulation (Isaac Sim, MuJoCo, or game engines), 3D scene and digital\-twin construction, machine learning systems, and research project leadership strongly preferred. A combination of education and relevant experience from which comparable knowledge is demonstrated may be considered. * **Requirements** : Successful background check. * **Joining the CMU team opens the door to an array of exceptional benefits.** **Benefits eligible** **employees enjoy a wide array of benefits including** **comprehensive medical, prescription, dental, and vision insurance** **as well as a generous** **retirement savings program** **with employer contributions. Beyond credentials, we evaluate the role and responsibilities, your valuable work experience, and the knowledge gained through education and training. We appreciate your unique skills and the perspective you bring. Your journey with us is about more than just a job; it’s about finding the perfect fit for your professional growth and personal aspirations.** **Are you interested in an exciting opportunity with an exceptional organization?! Apply today!** **Location** Pittsburgh, PA **Job Function** Engineering, Research and Project Scientists **Position Type** Staff – Fixed Term (Fixed Term) **Full Time/Part time** Full time **Pay Basis** Salary

jobs.title: Continuous Improvement Engineer
jobs.description: **About Carolina Foods** Carolina Foods LLC produces high\-quality Duchess branded and private\-label bakery goods for retail customers nationwide. Based in Pineville in the Charlotte, North Carolina area, our single\-site bakery brings product development and manufacturing together, giving team members a direct connection to the products, people, and decisions that drive our business. Our people are central to our success. We value team members who take pride in their work, share ideas, and build strong partnerships. Our commitment to safety, food safety and quality, operational excellence, and continuous improvement guides how we work and grow. **Your Role as a Continuous Improvement Engineer** The Continuous Improvement (CI) Engineer leads hands\-on improvements on the plant floor to reduce losses, improve production performance, and build reliable processes. This role focuses on the performance and quality components of overall equipment effectiveness (OEE), ingredient and packaging waste, labor utilization, and changeover efficiency. Working with Production, Maintenance, Reliability, Sanitation, and Quality, the CI Engineer identifies the largest losses, leads root cause analysis, and implements improvements that hold over time. The role also serves as the plant's technical liaison for automated baking line startup and commissioning, translating improvements into standard work, training, and daily operating routines. **Key Responsibilities:** **Loss Elimination and Performance Improvement** * Analyze OEE, downtime, scrap, and production data by line and shift to identify, prioritize, and address the largest performance losses. * Lead projects that reduce ingredient, material, and packaging waste; improve labor utilization; and increase throughput and available capacity. * Troubleshoot manufacturing issues, lead root cause analysis, and implement corrective and preventive actions. Verify sustained results and reduce recurring equipment\-related losses. * Facilitate rapid changeover events using Single\-Minute Exchange of Die (SMED) methods, with clear baselines, improvement targets, action plans, and follow\-up. **Equipment, Automation, and Reliability** * Lead startup and commissioning activities for highly automated baking lines as the plant's technical liaison with original equipment manufacturers (OEMs), controls integrators, and Maintenance. * Participate in factory and site acceptance testing (FAT/SAT), equipment debugging, punch\-list closure, and ramp\-up to rated speed and required product quality. * Lead Total Productive Maintenance (TPM) activities for new and existing equipment with Maintenance and Reliability; establish routines that improve equipment care and reduce repeat breakdowns. * Diagnose mechanical and automation issues using programmable logic controller (PLC) and human\-machine interface (HMI) alarms, input/output and sensor status, and machine sequences; partner with Maintenance and controls specialists on repairs and countermeasures. * Support material\-handling flow design for new or expanded lines, from raw materials and packaging delivery through finished goods transfer to shipping. **Standard Work, Training, and Operating Discipline** * Develop, maintain, and audit standard operating procedures (SOPs) for new automated equipment and improved processes; confirm procedures are practical for the teams using them. * Lead SOP training for Production, Sanitation, and Maintenance employees, verify understanding, and coach teams to identify and solve problems. * Support the site's Management Operating Structure (MOS), including daily and weekly performance reviews, department metrics, action tracking, and timely follow\-through. **Additional Responsibilities:** * Model safety, food safety, product quality, Good Manufacturing Practices (GMPs), and housekeeping expectations. Follow equipment safeguards and applicable safe\-work procedures during troubleshooting and startup. * Promptly report hazards and food safety or quality concerns, support audits, and close assigned corrective actions on time. Never compromise employee safety, food safety, or quality to improve speed or cost. * Partner respectfully across departments and shifts, encourage employee improvement ideas, and provide hands\-on support during startups and other critical operating periods. * Perform other related duties as assigned to support continuous improvement and business needs. **What Matters Most** **Required Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in engineering, food science, operations management, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience. * Three to five years of hands\-on manufacturing experience applying continuous improvement or Lean methods, with demonstrated, measurable results. * Hands\-on experience starting up and commissioning automated production equipment, including FAT/SAT, debugging, and ramp\-up to rated performance. * Demonstrated root cause analysis and problem\-solving skills, with working knowledge of GMPs and food safety requirements. * Strong verbal and written communication skills, including facilitating meetings and training employees; proficiency with Microsoft Office and production data analysis. * Sound independent judgment, strong organization, and the ability to manage several projects and competing priorities in a results\-driven environment. * Flexibility to work nonstandard shifts, weekends, and holidays, particularly during equipment startups and critical project milestones. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience in food, baking, or other process manufacturing. * Lean Six Sigma Green Belt certification or higher, and hands\-on experience with TPM, SMED, and OEE improvement. * Strong mechanical aptitude and working knowledge of PLC/HMI systems sufficient to diagnose faults; PLC programming is not required. * Familiarity with manufacturing execution systems (MES), OEE platforms such as Redzone, and enterprise resource planning (ERP) data. * OSHA 30\-hour or comparable safety training. **Skills for Success:** * Hands\-on ownership: Works at the line with employees and follows through. * Analytical judgment: Uses reliable data to identify losses, prioritize work, and verify that completed projects deliver measurable improvement. * Problem\-solving discipline: Resolves root causes and verifies lasting results. * Collaboration and influence: Builds trust across functions and shifts and leads improvement without direct supervisory authority. * Coaching and standardization: Explains technical concepts clearly and turns successful changes into repeatable, trained, and audited practices. **Measures of Success:** * First\-year goals will use agreed baselines and track the following outcomes: * Measurable OEE improvement and reduced ingredient, packaging, and labor losses on assigned lines. * Shorter changeovers against targets established for each SMED effort. * Documented SOPs and completed training for new automated equipment before handoff to Production. * Established TPM routines and fewer recurring equipment breakdowns. * Timely closure of root cause analyses and corrective actions, with verified, sustained results. **Work Environment and Physical Demands** * This onsite, plant\-floor\-based role works in a high\-volume industrial bakery and at a computer for analysis, documentation, and project coordination. * Work involves standing and walking through production areas, observing equipment and processes, and accessing equipment areas for troubleshooting and startup support. * Conditions may include heat, noise, moving equipment, and material\-handling traffic. Required personal protective equipment and food safety and hygiene practices must be followed. * Work may include nonstandard shifts, weekends, and holidays, especially during startups. Travel is expected to be minimal. Essential functions may be performed with reasonable accommodation. **Come Join Us!** Help turn plant\-floor challenges into lasting improvements. At Carolina Foods, your technical skills, curiosity, and teamwork can strengthen bakery performance and help our teams succeed. If you enjoy solving problems, launching automated equipment, and making improvements last, we invite you to apply and grow with us.

jobs.title: Applied Innovation Engineer
jobs.description: PURPOSE The Director of Applied Innovation leads the team that builds, deploys, and runs Central Valley Ag's custom business applications — products such as RouteForge and Gravis, the grower portal, and the applications that follow them. This is a working leadership role. The Director sets direction, develops the team, and also writes code, reviews it, and carries the hardest problems personally. The team is small on purpose and fast on purpose. It uses AI\-assisted development as a normal part of how work gets done, and it is measured on working software in the hands of CVA employees and growers — not on documents, roadmaps, or demonstrations. The Director is accountable for the availability of every application in the portfolio, for the experience of the people who use them, and for equipping CVA's support organization to carry routine support over time. ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES * Lead, coach, and develop a team of two: an Applied Innovation Engineer and an Applied Innovation Analyst. Hire into the team as it grows. * Personally design, develop, and review application code. This position ships. * Own the application portfolio roadmap. Run intake with business leaders, set priorities against business value, and decide what the team will not build. * Establish and hold a delivery cadence that puts usable software in front of users in weeks rather than quarters, and report against it. * Own production availability for the portfolio: deployment, release management, monitoring, and incident response. * Establish and enforce engineering practice — version control, testing, code review, release and change management, and documentation. * Establish the team's AI\-assisted development practice: tooling, review standards, guardrails, and the appropriate handling of company and customer data. * Partner with Enterprise Architecture so that applications conform to CVA's architecture, integration, and data standards. * Partner with IT Infrastructure and IT Security on hosting, identity, access management, and secure development practice. * Equip CVA's support organization to support business applications: build the documentation, runbooks, training, and knowledge transfer that let tier 1 and tier 2 support be carried outside this team. Serve as the escalation point. * Hold the boundary with the data organization: Applied Innovation builds the operational applications that run the business, while tools and agents whose purpose is answering questions from CVA's data belong to the Director of Data \& AI Enablement. Partner with that team rather than duplicating it. * Manage vendor relationships, cloud spend, and licensing for the application portfolio. * Report delivery, risk, and portfolio health to the Chief Technology Officer and to business leadership. * Other duties as assigned. SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES **Directly supervises two positions:** Applied Innovation Engineer and Applied Innovation Analyst. Carries out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with Central Valley Ag policies and applicable laws, including interviewing and hiring, planning and assigning work, coaching and performance management, and addressing employee concerns. INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY All work product created in the course of employment with Central Valley Ag Cooperative — including software, source code, applications, integrations, data models, reports, documentation, designs, processes, analyses, inventions, and any other developments, whether created during or outside normal working hours and whether or not created using CVA equipment — is the sole and exclusive property of Central Valley Ag Cooperative. Employment in this position is contingent upon agreement to CVA's confidentiality, intellectual property, and non\-disclosure terms. QUALIFICATIONS To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE * Seven or more years building and supporting business software, including substantial time in a hands\-on engineering role. * Demonstrated leadership of a team, a product, or a significant delivery effort. Formal management experience is not required where the leadership track record is clear. REQUIRED SKILLS AND KNOWLEDGE * Hands\-on proficiency with a modern application stack — for example TypeScript/JavaScript with React or Next.js, C\#, or Python — and with relational databases and SQL. * Cloud application delivery: deployment, application hosting, identity and authentication, secrets management, monitoring, and cost control (AWS and/or Microsoft Azure). * System and data integration: APIs, file interfaces, and integration with ERP or third\-party platforms. * Judgment on scope. Able to decide what not to build and to ship a narrow first version that earns the next one. * Strong written and verbal communication with non\-technical stakeholders. Able to run an intake conversation with a business leader and leave it with a decision. * Demonstrated ownership of production systems, including release management and incident response. PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE * Bachelor's degree in a technology\-related field such as computer science, computer information systems, or management information systems. * Working fluency with AI\-assisted development — coding agents and assistants, prompt\-driven development, and reviewing AI\-generated code to the same standard as hand\-written code. This is how the team works. Strong engineers without this experience who are eager to adopt it will be considered. * Experience in agriculture, commodities, logistics, or a cooperative. * Experience establishing or turning around a small delivery team. PHYSICAL DEMANDS The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently required to: * Sit and stand for extended periods of time. * Use hands and fingers with dexterity to operate a computer keyboard and mouse. * Occasionally lift and transport computer equipment and peripherals. * Be available for occasional after\-hours work in support of deployments and production issues. * This position may be based at any Central Valley Ag location or worked remotely. Periodic travel to CVA locations is expected for user engagement, onboarding, and team meetings. Central Valley Ag Central Valley Ag is a farmer\-owned cooperative headquartered in York, Neb. CVA has locations in Iowa, Kansas, and Nebraska. CVA is an innovative leader providing products and services in grain, agronomy, feed, and energy. You can find more information about Central Valley Ag by visiting www.cvacoop.com. EOE race/color/sex/sexual orientation/gender identity/disability/veteran **Stay in touch with us on:** LinkedIn, Facebook, Twitter, Instagram, and Pinterest **Updated:** September 2026

jobs.title: Senior Mechanical Engineer, Pyrolysis
jobs.description: About Charm Our mission is to return the atmosphere to 280 ppm CO₂. We convert excess inedible biomass into carbon\-rich bio\-oil and inject it into underground storage for permanent carbon removal. At scale, we can use bio\-oil to make fossil\-free iron. Our carbon removal efforts began in 2020 with initial purchases from customers like Stripe, Shopify, and Microsoft. Since then, we’ve scaled to **thousands of tons of carbon removal**, grown to over a hundred employees, and established three locations in San Francisco, Colorado, and Louisiana. We're expanding our team of ambitious, creative, and hands\-on problem solvers. We value psychological safety, collaboration, and continuous learning. We take calculated risks and treat mistakes as opportunities to improve. If you're excited about tackling big challenges, we encourage you to explore **our company values**. Come help us reverse climate change. Gigatons or bust! ### **About the Role** As a Senior Mechanical Engineer based out of our Fort Lupton facility, you’ll be responsible for designing the next generation of pyrolysis technology, implementing and troubleshooting mechanical systems in production, and collaborating with the broader engineering team, including electrical, automation, and manufacturing engineers, as well as fabricators, technicians, and operators. This group collaborates to overcome design/build/test challenges and successfully execute commissioning and production handover campaigns. This role involves designing new mechanical systems, selecting electromechanical actuators, sensors, pumps, etc. and continually improving on our pyrolysis and biomass processing equipment. You’ll turn wrenches to help bring your designs to life and work with our testing team to ensure your systems meet overall design intent. Often, you will be tasked with updating the configuration of legacy systems in order to validate novel design pathways or new subsystems, informing the architecture of our next generation of pyrolysis equipment. In order to meet Charm’s overall production and throughput goals, the role will leverage mechanical and system expertise to provide troubleshooting support for production machines based on issues observed by our Operations partners. This role will report to the Lead Pyrolysis Engineer based out of Fort Lupton, Colorado. Someone successful in this role will enjoy bringing new designs to life and helping to test and commission their new equipment. This person takes pride in delivering robust mechanical solutions that work in the real world, and loves stepping through the root cause analysis process when systems are not performing as intended. This person also takes an analytical approach to problem solving and is not afraid to step out of their comfort zone when tackling new problems. A great attitude in the face of difficult and fast\-paced environments is a must! We have ambitious goals, help us make them possible! ### **Your Responsibilities** * Design unique solutions for our next generation operations pyrolyzer: Develop mechanical and electromechanical systems for production use while considering interfacing systems, operating requirements, operator burden, and regular service and maintenance. Consider what technology needs thorough R\&D to simplify and redefine our machine architecture. Learn from previous successes and failures to develop and integrate novel vessels and process steps that tie back to real business needs. Work with our testing team to validate performance before operations integration. * Conduct thorough engineering analysis: Work with process engineers to develop thermal and flow models to inform system design. Process piping and vessels are important components in our greater pyrolysis system, refine their mechanisms to deliver an industrial solution. * Troubleshoot and resolve issues: Identify and troubleshoot mechanical system malfunctions and performance gaps. Determine why a failure mode is observed and implement a corrective action to return the system to optimal performance. * Develop and execute test plans and commissioning campaigns for production hardware: Take direct ownership of your designs beyond pressing print on your drawings. Validate performance before and after machine installation. * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams: Work closely with electrical engineers, software developers, and other mechanical engineers to implement mechanical systems into the larger pyrolysis package * Support on\-call production support as needed, if our frontline Engineering Technician group needs help solving critical Operations problems ### **You Bring** * *Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, or a related field* * Seasoned mechanical design experience (5\-8 years) * CAD knowledge is a must, we use OnShape * Experience reviewing and releasing detailed fabrication and assembly drawings with a high attention to detail and strong configuration control practices * Skilled in modes of heat transfer, sensor and actuator selection for robust operations, and building project requirements from ambiguity * Skilled with basic fabrication techniques and the design principles around them * Familiarity with piping standards, flange interfaces, gasket selection, and mechanical integration of process systems. * Hands\-on mechanical troubleshooting and assembly experience * A strong willingness to get your hands dirty and intimately interact with all pyrolysis system components * Documentation skills that demonstrate your thought process and design process when making improvements * Skilled with electromechanical systems and design for material handling, think conveyors, pumps, and blowers * Experience designing mechanical weldment under load and process pressure * A desire to work alongside Electrical \& Controls Engineers and fabricators to turn solutions into physical, installed hardware as quickly as possible. Use quick implementation skills to make quick and long\-term fixes to the pyrolysis system in service of system improvement. * Ability to communicate priorities, system progress, and work cross functionally * Hands\-on mechanical troubleshooting and assembly experience * An excitement for scaling up hardware that has the potential to positively impact climate change! ### **Bonus, if You Bring** * A Masters degree in Mechanical Engineering, or a related field * Onshape modeling experience * Experience with process piping and vessel design in high\-temperature or industrial environments * Design of operations facing industrial equipment * Experience with 24/7 operations **What We Offer** * Equity ownership through stock options * 100% employee healthcare premiums covered * Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage with multiple plan options * Employer\-funded HSA contributions for eligible HDHP plans * Traditional and Roth 401(k) with a 50% match on contributions up to 6% * Paid leave, including parental and medical leave * PPE and workwear allowances * Annual professional development stipend * Employee recognition programs that celebrate impactful work and team contributions * Opportunities for internal growth, career development, and transition into climate from a range of industries and backgrounds **Visa Sponsorship Policy** Since we are a small startup, certain accommodations for visa sponsorship may not be within our capability. At this time, Charm Industrial is only sponsoring E3 and TN visas. **Our Commitment** Charm Industrial is an equal opportunity employer. We hire based on skills, experience, and passion for our mission. Climate challenges require a wide range of perspectives and expertise, and we welcome applicants from all backgrounds. We’re excited to grow our team with people who bring unique strengths and help us improve as a company. At Charm, we may use AI\-enabled tools to support certain aspects of the hiring process, including organizing candidate information and highlighting experience that may be relevant to a particular role. In a world where AI\-assisted resumes, synthetic content, and deepfakes are increasingly common, these tools help our team navigate the process thoughtfully and efficiently. Every application and resume is reviewed by a member of our hiring team, and hiring decisions are made by people, not algorithms. Our recruiting process is designed to ensure candidates are evaluated fairly, consistently, and in alignment with our equal employment opportunity commitments. AI tools support our team's work, but they do not replace human judgment or determine hiring outcomes.

jobs.title: Site Reliability Engineer
jobs.description: **It’s a great time to join COMC – Millions of Cards. Endless Joy.** Our industry is thriving, and COMC is investing in the technology, infrastructure, and customer experiences that will power our next stage of growth. We’re building a team passionate about making collecting easier, more engaging, and more enjoyable while expanding the reach and capabilities of our marketplace. **Reports To:** Director, Engineering**Travel Required:** No **Summary** The Site Reliability Engineer is responsible for keeping COMC’s marketplace fast, available, and secure for the collectors and consigners who depend on it every day. This role sits at the intersection of software engineering and operations, owning the reliability, scalability, and observability of the production systems that power our website, consignment workflows, order processing, and warehouse operations. The Site Reliability Engineer partners closely with software engineering, product, and operations teams to define service\-level objectives, automate infrastructure, lead incident response, and build the tooling and practices that allow COMC to grow with confidence. **About You** You care deeply about uptime, but you care even more about eliminating the toil and fragility that put it at risk. You are equally comfortable writing code, tuning a database, and calmly running an incident bridge at 2 a.m. You think in systems, measure before you change things, and leave every process a little more automated and better documented than you found it. You communicate clearly with both technical and non\-technical colleagues, and you take pride in building infrastructure that other engineers trust and enjoy working with. **Responsibilities/Duties*** Own the availability, latency, performance, and capacity of COMC’s production systems, including customer\-facing web applications, APIs, databases, and internal operations platforms, and write production\-quality code to improve them. * Define, implement, and report on service\-level indicators (SLIs), service\-level objectives (SLOs), and error budgets in partnership with engineering and product leadership. * Design, build, and maintain cloud and platform infrastructure using infrastructure\-as\-code practices, ensuring environments are consistent, repeatable, secure, and easy for engineers to self\-serve. * Lead the modernization of legacy systems by migrating workloads from Azure\-hosted infrastructure (VMs, App Service, and legacy deployment pipelines) to modern platforms such as Vercel and Render, planning phased cutovers with zero\-downtime deployments, rollback paths, and clear success criteria. * Refactor and re\-architect legacy applications and services (including .NET and Windows\-hosted workloads) into containerized, stateless, twelve\-factor services that run cleanly on managed platforms, with preview environments, environment\-based configuration, and automated deploys on every merge. * Contribute directly to the codebase by building features, APIs, internal tools, and shared libraries alongside software engineering, participating in code reviews, and raising the bar on testing, code quality, and maintainability. * Build and improve CI/CD pipelines that enable fast, safe, and frequent deployments, including automated testing, preview deployments, progressive rollouts, and reliable rollback, and migrate legacy Azure DevOps pipelines to modern Git\-based workflows such as GitHub Actions. * Develop and maintain monitoring, logging, tracing, and alerting systems that provide clear visibility into system health and reduce alert noise. * Participate in and help lead the on\-call rotation; respond to and resolve production incidents, coordinate communication during outages, and drive timely recovery. * Lead blameless post\-incident reviews, identify root causes, and track corrective actions through to completion. * Identify and eliminate operational toil by writing automation, services, and self\-service tooling in languages such as Python, Go, C\#, or TypeScript, treating internal tools as real software with tests, versioning, and documentation. * Conduct capacity planning and performance testing to prepare for growth and high\-traffic events such as major product releases and promotional sales. * Partner with engineering teams on system design, code, and architecture reviews to build reliability, scalability, and observability into new services from the start, and to guide decisions on database, caching, and hosting strategy during platform migrations. * Maintain and test backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity plans for critical systems and data. * Collaborate on security and compliance practices, including patch management, access controls, secrets management, and vulnerability remediation. * Manage cloud and platform costs and resource utilization, comparing legacy Azure spend against Vercel, Render, and similar platforms, and recommending optimizations that balance performance, developer velocity,  als and proficiency in at least one programming language such as Python, Go, C\#, or TypeScript/Node.js, with experience writing, testing, reviewing, and shipping production application code, in addition to scripting in Bash. * Experience migrating or modernizing legacy applications and infrastructure, such as moving workloads from Azure or on\-premises environments to managed platforms like Vercel or Render, including data migration, DNS and CDN cutover, and minimizing downtime. * Solid working knowledge of Linux and/or Windows server administration, networking fundamentals (DNS, TCP/IP, load balancing, CDNs), and web application architecture. * Experience operating and tuning relational databases (e.g., SQL Server, PostgreSQL, or MySQL) in production environments. * Hands\-on experience with observability tools such as Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, New Relic, or the ELK stack. * Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using tools such as GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, or GitLab CI. * Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot complex, distributed systems under pressure and communicate clearly during incidents. * Strong understanding of security best practices for cloud infrastructure and production systems. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document systems clearly and collaborate across teams. * Ownership mindset, sound judgment, and a commitment to continuous improvement. **Education \& Experience*** 5\+ years of experience in site reliability engineering, DevOps, infrastructure engineering, or a related software engineering role. * 3\+ years of experience supporting high\-availability, customer\-facing production systems, preferably in e\-commerce or marketplace environments. * Experience participating in an on\-call rotation and leading incident response. * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * Relevant cloud certifications (e.g., AWS Certified DevOps Engineer, Azure DevOps Engineer Expert, Certified Kubernetes Administrator) are a plus. **Benefits Offerings*** Competitive salary * 9 paid company holidays per year * Paid Time Off of up to nearly 4 weeks per year * 401(k) program with company match * Employer\-provided medical and dental plan options * Employer\-provided long\-term disability and life insurance * Short\-term disability for employees outside Washington State * Employee discount on COMC * Employee Assistance Program **Work Environment \& Physical Requirements** This position primarily operates in a professional office environment and may involve prolonged periods of sitting, standing, and using computers and other standard office equipment. Participation in an on\-call rotation, including occasional work outside of standard business hours, is required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position. **Additional Information** This job description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or qualifications associated with the position. Employees may be required to perform other job\-related duties as assigned, consistent with business needs and the skills and experience of the employee. This document does not create a contract of employment, either express or implied. Employment with COMC is considered at\-will. **Equal Opportunity Employer** COMC is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. We strongly encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply. Schedule: Monday through Friday, standard business hours, with participation in a scheduled on\-call rotation

jobs.description: **Let’s be unstoppable together!** At Circana, we are fueled by our passion for continuous learning and growth, we seek and share feedback freely, and we celebrate victories both big and small in an environment that is flexible and accommodating to our work and personal lives. We have a global commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion as we believe in the undeniable strength that diversity brings to our business, employees, clients, and communities. With us, you can always bring your full self to work. Join our inclusive, committed team to be a challenger, own outcomes, and stay curious together. Circana is proud to be Certified™ by Great Place To Work®. This prestigious award is based entirely on what current employees say about their experience working at Circana. Learn more at www.circana.com (http://www.circana.com). **What will you be doing?** We are seeking a skilled and motivated Data Engineer to join our growing team. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, building, and maintaining robust data pipelines and infrastructure on the Azure cloud platform. You will leverage your expertise in PySpark, Apache Spark, and Apache Airflow to process and orchestrate large\-scale data workloads, ensuring data quality, efficiency, and scalability. If you have a passion for data engineering and a desire to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply! **Job Responsibilities** ***Data Engineering \& Data Pipeline Development*** * Design, security throughout the data lifecycle * Ensure data availability, reliability and performance through monitoring and automation. ***Cloud Data Engineering:*** * Manage cloud infrastructure and cost optimization for data processing workloads * Implement CI/CD pipelines for data workflows to ensure smooth and reliable deployments. ***Big Data \& Analytics:*** * Build and optimize large\-scale data processing pipelines using Apache Spark and PySpark * Implement data partitioning, caching, and performance tuning for Spark\-based workloads. * Work with diverse data formats (structured and unstructured) to support advanced analytics and machine learning initiatives. ***Workflow Orchestration (Airflow)*** * Design and maintain DAGs (Directed Acyclic Graphs) in Airflow to automate complex * Foster a collaborative environment and promote best practices for coding standards, version control, and documentation. * Engage directly with clients to understand business needs, communicate timelines, mitigate risks **Requirements** * 8\+ years of experience in data engineering with expertise in Python, PySpark, Spark, and Airflow. * Strong programming skills in Python, SQL with the ability to write efficient and maintainable code * Deep understanding of Spark internals (RDDs, DataFrames, DAG execution, partitioning, etc.) * Experience with Airflow DAGs, scheduling, and dependency management * Knowledge of Git, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, and apply best practices of DevOps for CI/CD workflows * Excellent problem\-solving skills and ability to optimize large\-scale jobs.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
jobs.description: About Circular Solutions Circular Solutions, established in 2018, is an established company that has successfully launched its own software platform and is transforming how businesses manage recycling, supply chain data, and regulatory compliance. Our platform, Circular OS, helps organizations verify recycling activity, track materials throughout the supply chain, and navigate emerging Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) regulations. While we have the experience and foundation of an established business, we operate with the speed, flexibility, and small\-team mentality of a startup. Decisions happen quickly, and product priorities evolve as we respond to customer needs and changing regulations. We value execution over bureaucracy and believe great engineers can accomplish extraordinary things with the right tools and autonomy. Website: www.circularsolutions.eco The Opportunity We are looking for a highly motivated, adaptable Lead Full Stack Software Engineer to take ownership of the continued development of Circular OS. **Our priority is speed to market without sacrificing the reliability of the platform.** We need someone who thrives in a fast\-moving environment, embraces new technologies, and can turn concepts into functional software quickly. You will work directly with leadership to translate business needs, product concepts, and prototypes into production\-ready solutions. This is not a role where you will spend months developing a single feature. We are looking for someone who can think independently, solve problems creatively, and continuously deliver meaningful improvements. As the company grows, you will also help shape our engineering practices and future development team. What You'll DoProduct Development \& Execution · Own the development, maintenance, and deployment of Circular OS across the full technology stack. · Rapidly translate product concepts, workflows, and prototypes into functional, production\-ready features. · Prioritize speed to market, delivering incremental improvements rather than waiting for perfect solutions. · Independently identify technical challenges, evaluate alternatives, and implement practical solutions. · Build compelling, functional product demonstrations to support sales and customer engagement. AI \& Emerging Technologies · Leverage AI development tools daily to accelerate coding, debugging, testing, and deployment. · Continuously evaluate emerging technologies that can improve development speed and platform capabilities. · Build AI\-powered features, including document extraction, intelligent assistants, automated workflows, and data reconciliation. · Identify opportunities to automate repetitive development and operational processes. Platform Ownership \& Scalability · Manage frontend, backend, database architecture, integrations, and deployment. · Develop scalable systems capable of handling complex regulatory requirements and large datasets. · Maintain strong standards for security, platform reliability, and data integrity. · Support security and compliance initiatives, including ISO 27001\. · Maintain practical documentation that allows future engineers to contribute efficiently. Collaboration \& Adaptability · Work directly with leadership and nontechnical stakeholders to understand evolving business priorities. · Adapt quickly as customer requirements, regulations, and business opportunities change. · Communicate progress, challenges, and tradeoffs clearly. · Take ownership of outcomes rather than simply completing assigned tasks. What We're Looking ForTechnical Experience · Strong experience with TypeScript, React, Next.js, and Node.js in production web applications. · Strong backend development skills and experience with PostgreSQL. · Experience working with PostgreSQL, SQL migrations, and modern database tooling; experience with serverless Postgres and modern TypeScript ORMs strongly preferred. · Hands\-on experience using AI development tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, Lovable, or similar platforms. · Experience designing and implementing automated document extraction and processing systems, including OCR, AI\-powered data extraction, document classification, and structured data validation. · Experience building software that processes, reconciles, and analyzes data from multiple sources. · Experience integrating LLM APIs, automations, and third\-party services. · Ability to independently manage the development lifecycle from initial concept through production deployment. Our Current Technology Stack Circular OS is an existing, production software platform. You should be comfortable working within an established codebase, understanding its architecture, and shipping improvements without unnecessary rewrites. Experience with our core stack is especially valuable. Familiarity with every supporting tool is not required, and we will walk you through the full setup once you join. · **Core:** TypeScript, Next.js, React, and Node.js. · **Data:** PostgreS  · **Ownership:** You take responsibility for the entire product experience, not just the code you write. · **Pragmatism:** You understand the difference between what needs to be perfect and what needs to be delivered. · **Communication:** You can explain complex technical concepts in simple terms and collaborate effectively with business teams. · **Initiative:** You proactively identify opportunities to improve the product without waiting for detailed instructions. **We care more about your ability to execute than the number of programming languages on your resume.** Nice to Have · Experience building supply chain management, logistics, recycling, or enterprise data management software. · Experience developing platforms that track materials, transactions, or assets across multiple organizations. · Familiarity with regulatory compliance, financial technology, or audit\-grade data systems. · Experience building automated data reconciliation, document verification, and reporting workflows. · Experience working at an early\-stage startup or as a founding engineer. · Experience with payments and billing integrations such as Stripe. · Familiarity with ISO 27001 or SOC 2 security frameworks. · Interest in sustainability, recycling, or environmental technology. Why Join Circular Solutions? · **Meaningful Ownership:** Take a leading role in building and shaping a growing technology platform. · **High Impact:** Your work will directly influence our product roadmap, customer experience, and business growth. · **Direct Access to Leadership:** Work closely with decision\-makers without layers of management. · **Modern Development Environment:** Use AI and emerging technologies to maximize development efficiency. · **Flexibility:** Fully remote work environment with collaboration during US Eastern business hours. · **Growth Opportunity:** Play an important role in shaping the future engineering team. · **Competitive Compensation:** Competitive salary with potential for additional long\-term incentives. How to Apply **We want to see what you've built, not just read about your experience.** Along with your resume, please submit examples of previous work or relevant projects you have personally developed and delivered. Examples may include: · Links to live applications, software platforms, or products you have built. · GitHub repositories, technical portfolios, or product demonstrations. · Projects involving AI, automated document extraction, data processing, or workflow automation. · Supply chain, logistics, compliance, or enterprise software projects. · Examples of products or features you have taken from initial concept through production. For each relevant project, please briefly describe: · **Your Role:** What did you personally design, develop, and deliver? · **Technology:** What tools, frameworks, and AI technologies did you use? · **Timeline:** How long did it take to go from concept to a working product? We understand that some projects may be confidential. Public demonstrations, screenshots, walkthrough videos, or descriptions of your contributions are welcome. Our Hiring Process · **Introductory Conversation:** Discuss your experience, development approach, and interest in the opportunity. · **Product Walkthrough:** Show us something you personally built and shipped, including your development process and timeline. · **Leadership Conversation:** Meet with our leadership team to discuss working style, expectations, and long\-term opportunities. What Matters Most We are not looking for someone who simply writes great code. We are looking for someone who can build great products, move quickly, adapt to change, and take genuine ownership of results. If you thrive in an environment where your work goes from concept to production quickly and your contributions have an immediate impact, we would love to hear from you. Pay: $120,000\.00 \- $140,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Flexible schedule * Flextime * Work from home Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: AI Researcher
jobs.description: **The application window is expected to close on:** 11/19/2026Meet the Team The Outshift by Cisco team is one of the Cisco’s most visible innovation organizations, driving the next generation of transformative technologies and business opportunities. You will collaborate with some of the company’s most forward\-thinking researchers, engineers, and technology leaders. Your Impact The embodied AI team works across robotics orchestration, navigation, perception, and manipulation spanning cloud/edge model orchestration, world models, and mobile robot platforms. We're looking to add a researcher with a strong general foundation in computer vision and machine learning who can contribute broadly across these research threads rather than a single narrow specialty. * Research and prototype learning\-based approaches to perception, planning, and control for embodied agents and robots. * Collaborate with team members working on orchestration, navigation, and manipulation to bring computer vision and ML expertise to their systems. * Evaluate and adapt pioneering vision and ML models for real\-world robotics use cases. * Contribute to publications and/or patents as the team builds out its embodied AI research portfolio. Minimum Qualifications * PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, or a closely related field. * 1\+ year relevant research experience (industry, postdoctoral, or equivalent). * Experience in computer vision and/or machine learning, with experience using deep learning frameworks (e.g. PyTorch, TensorFlow). * Experience in one or more of the following languages (C\+\+, Java, Python) * Experience delivering research outcomes through peer\-reviewed publications, patents, prototypes, or other measurable technical contributions. Preferred Qualifications * Exposure to robotics systems, simulation environments, or real\-world robot deployment. * Familiarity with reinforcement learning, generative models, or multimodal / vision\-language\-action models. * Experience collaborating across a multi\-disciplinary research team. Why Cisco? At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. We are Cisco, and our power starts with you. U.S. employees are offered benefits, subject to Cisco’s plan eligibility rules, which include medical, dental and vision insurance, a 401(k) plan with a Cisco matching contribution, paid parental leave, short and long\-term disability coverage, and basic life insurance. AI strategy, where your work directly shapes the future of how the organization operates. * Access to Citi's full suite of AI capabilities and a growing ecosystem of AI agents, giving you cutting\-edge tools to solve complex, real\-world problems. * Structured learning and development opportunities to deepen your technical expertise and grow your career within one of the world's leading financial institutions. * Wellbeing and financial support programs designed to help you thrive professionally and personally. * The opportunity to mentor and develop the next generation of AI practitioners within Citi, building lasting impact beyond your immediate team.
