Join our diverse, inclusive and talented workforce of more than 11,000 team members who are at the heart of what makes Denver, Denver. **What We Offer** ----------------- The City and County of Denver offers competitive pay commensurate with education and experience. New hires are typically brought into the organization between $157,385\.00 \- $208,000\.00\. We also offer generous benefits for full\-time employees which include but are not limited to: * A guaranteed life\-long monthly pension, once vested after 5 years of service * 457B Retirement Plan * 140 hours of PTO earned within first year \+ 12 paid holidays, 1 personal holiday, 1 Wellness Day and 1 volunteer day per year * Competitive medical, dental and vision plans effective within 1 month of start date **Location \& Schedule** ------------------------ The City and County of Denver supports a hybrid workplace model. Employees work where needed, at a job site several days a week and off\-site in the field, as needed. Employees must work within the state of Colorado on their remote days. In this position you can expect to work on site at least 3 days per week at the **Denver Wastewater Building** (2000 W. 3rd Ave., Denver, CO 80223\). **Who We Are \& What You’ll Do** -------------------------------- The Department of Transportation and Infrastructure (DOTI), through its employees, enhances the quality of life in Denver by efficiently delivering effective, high quality, safe and equitable public infrastructure, and services. For more information, please visit the DOTI website. DOTI’s Commitment to Equity: * DOTI is committed to providing attention and resources to the areas, assets and people of the city with the greatest need. Through equitable contracting, equitable investments, and equitable workforce development. * DOTI’s culture revolves around four key principles: (1\) Invest in Our People, (2\) Operate with Discipline, (3\) Use Data to Drive Decisions, and (4\) Deliver Results. DOTI is seeking an experienced and collaborative leader to serve as the Director of Wastewater Policy. This position will provide strategic direction and leadership for the Policy Division within Denver's Wastewater Enterprise Fund and will be responsible for establishing and coordinating enterprise\-wide policy, planning, asset management, financial programming, regulatory alignment, stakeholder engagement, and long\-range investment strategies. The Policy Division provides overall wastewater program direction and operates at a functional and authoritative level similar to the Wastewater Implementation and Wastewater Operations divisions. The Director will lead a team of approximately 20 employees, including managers, supervisors, professional staff, and consultants, and will provide leadership for Asset Management, One Water, Water Quality, MS4, and Master Planning. The Director will work closely with the Wastewater Enterprise Executive, City Engineer, Core Infrastructure leadership, Wastewater Operations and Implementation Directors, senior DOTI leadership, Department of Finance, regulatory agencies, elected officials, and other internal and external partners and stakeholders to establish a coordinated, sustainable, and forward\-looking approach to management of Denver's wastewater enterprise fund and associated infrastructure. Specifically, as the Engineer Director of Wastewater Policy**,** you will: **Strategic Leadership \& Policy** * Establishes and advances a long\-term vision and multi\-year strategy for the Wastewater Enterprise Fund and associated Policy Division, aligning people, resources, programs, and investments with Wastewater Enterprise, DOTI, and citywide priorities. * Develops and directs implementation of goals, objectives, policies, procedures, work standards, and annual and multi\-year work plans. * Provides overall policy direction and strategic coordination across the Wastewater Enterprise in collaboration with Operations and Implementation leadership. * Advises senior leadership on complex wastewater infrastructure, organizational, financial, regulatory, and policy matters. * Resolves complex and sensitive issues by bringing together technical, financial, regulatory, operational, and stakeholder perspectives. **Asset Management \& Long\-Range Planning** * Provides strategic jobs.description: **About Us** Clayco is a full\-service, turnkey real estate development, master planning, architecture, engineering, and construction firm that safely delivers clients across North America the highest quality solutions on time, on budget, and above and beyond expectations. With $8\.1 billion in revenue for 2025, Clayco specializes in the "art and science of building," providing fast track, efficient solutions for mission critical, industrial, life sciences, power \& energy, aviation, commercial, institutional, residential and sports \& entertainment related building projects. **The Role We Want You For** Cloud Engineering owns the day\-to\-day operation, evolution, and reliability of our cloud estate. The majority runs in Azure (application gateways, App Service Environments, storage, contains, Functions, VMs, and Azure SQL), with traditional lift\-and\-shift constructs still doing real work alongside more modern patterns. AWS is a meaningful and growing part of the picture too. This is the team that keeps that environment running well: provisioning, optimizing, troubleshooting, securing, and moving workloads onto code\-defined patterns. This role brings modern IaC, automation, and engineering discipline to the cloud estate directly, and helps raise the bar on what "production\-ready" looks like here. his is an AI\-forward position. Senior leadership is all\-in on AI, and we want someone who genuinely uses it every day for code, troubleshooting, documentation, and reasoning. Not as a buzzword. As a daily multiplier. **The Specifics of the Role** * Design, provision, and operate production workloads across our Azure and AWS environments. Anticipate growth and establish infrastructure patterns that scale with the business. * Own workload reliability and performance. Troubleshoot incidents, resolve underlying problems, and improve capacity, resilience, and supportability. * Modernize existing workloads through practical, incremental improvements. Adopt containers, Kubernetes, and other modern hosting approaches where they improve reliability, portability, and operational efficiency. * Manage infrastructure, configuration, and images as code. Build reusable automation, bring operational changes back into code, and use established delivery workflows in partnership with Platform Engineering. * Own application traffic management and workload connectivity requirements, partnering with Network Engineering on the underlying connectivity and shared network services. * Build security into workload design and operation through appropriate identity and access controls, secret management, network segmentation, hardened configurations, and policy enforcement. * Build observability into everything you design and operate. Maintain dashboards, monitors, and service\-level objectives as code, with actionable alerts that help on\-call engineers identify and resolve problems quickly. * Treat cost as an ongoing engineering responsibility. Improve visibility and allocation, right\-size resources, tune scaling behavior, and eliminate unnecessary consumption. * Design and build out high availability and disaster recovery capabilities. Evaluate and select same\-provider and multi\-cloud resiliency patterns based on workload criticality, recovery objectives, cost, and operational complexity. Establish documented, tested backup, failover, and recovery procedures. * Use AI tools in daily engineering work and build AI\-assisted operational automation where it provides measurable value. Reduce repetitive work in troubleshooting, incident triage, runbook execution, drift detection, and documentation while validating results and maintaining operational control. **Requirements** * **Cloud platforms:** 7\+ years of hands\-on cloud experience, with strong Azure expertise and working familiarity with AWS. Substantial experience designing, operating, and troubleshooting production workloads across compute, storage, networking, and application hosting. * **Architecture and modernization:** Experience modernizing existing workloads through containers, Kubernetes, and other modern hosting patterns. Ability to anticipate scale and design for reliability, portability, and operational simplicity while evaluating cost and platform dependencies. * **Infrastructure as code and automation:** Production Terraform experience, including modules and state management, plus scripting in PowerShell, Python, or Bash to provision, configure, and operate workloads using established delivery workflows. * **Reliability and observability:** Experience diagnosing production incidents, tuning workload performance, and implementing dashboards, actionable alerts, and log analysis. Familiarity with maintaining observability configuration as code and validating backup, failover, and recovery procedures. * **Security and networking:** Working knowledge of cloud networking, including private connectivity, DNS, and network access controls. Experience applying identity and access controls, secret management, and policy enforcement in partnership with network and security teams. * **Cost management:** Practical experience improving cloud cost visibility and efficiency through tagging, right\-sizing, scaling policies, and ongoing review of resource utilization. * **Engineering practices and applied AI:** Strong ownership, clear communication, and a habit of turning recurring operational work into automation. Regular use of AI tools for code, troubleshooting, analysis, and documentation, with sound judgment and validation of their output. **Preferred Experience** * Direct experience with Datadog, Ansible, Packer, CloudFormation, or cloud security and policy tooling. * Portfolio\-level FinOps, including cost allocation, chargeback, and optimization across teams or services. * Operational workflow or agent\-based automation, using platforms such as n8n for incident triage, runbook execution, drift detection, or similar use cases. * Relevant Azure or AWS certifications. **Some Things You Should Know** * This position will service our clients regionally. * No other builder can offer the collaborative design\-build approach that Clayco does. * We work on creative, complex, award\-winning, high\-profile jobs. * The pace is fast! **Why Clayco?** * 2025 Best Places to Work – St. Louis Business Journal, Los Angeles Business Journal, and Phoenix Business Journal. * 2025 ENR Top 400 – Top Data Center Contractor (Top 3\). * 2025 ENR Top 100 Design\-Build Firms – Design\-Build Contractor (Top 5\). * 2025 ENR Top 100 Green Contractors – Green Contractor (Top 3\). **Benefits** * Discretionary Annual Bonus: Subject to company and individual performance. * Comprehensive Benefits Package Including: Medical, dental and vision plans, 401k, generous PTO and paid company holidays, employee assistance program, flexible spending accounts, life insurance, disability coverage, learning \& development programs and more! **Compensation** * The salary range for this position considers a wide range of factors in making compensation decisions including but not limited to: Education, qualifications, skills, training, experience, certifications, internal equity, and location. jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer, CBCI
jobs.description: Description: **Job Title:** Principal Software Engineer, CBCI **Job Type:** Full\-time **Location:** Hybrid \- Denver, CO (3 days on\-site per week) **About CloudBees** CloudBees helps organizations build, run, and govern software factories, giving enterprises the confidence to ship software better, faster, and safer. Writing code is no longer the bottleneck. Governing what reaches production and validating its impact is. As enterprises adopt agentic coding, software is created faster than most teams can review, secure, and validate. Without consistent governance, organizations risk shipping code they cannot explain, audit, or trust. CloudBees addresses this challenge without asking teams to replace the tools they already use. Across every toolchain a customer runs, CloudBees makes each change, human or AI, visible, auditable, and accountable before it reaches production. CloudBees Unify is the product behind this: a governance layer, with context and control\-plane capabilities, that enforces consistent policy and evidence across every tool, team, and workflow. Founded in 2010, CloudBees is backed by Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley, Bridgepoint Capital, HSBC, Golub Capital, Delta\-v Capital, Matrix Partners, and Lightspeed Venture Partners. Visit us at www.cloudbees.com. **About the Role** CloudBees CI helps enterprises build and deliver software with confidence. Built on Jenkins, with a core written in Java and deployments running on Kubernetes, it brings together the challenges of distributed systems, an extensible plugin ecosystem, and the reliability customers expect from critical delivery infrastructure. We are looking for a Principal Software Engineer to set technical direction for the CloudBees CI product area and turn that direction into working software. You will lead architecture and execution across teams while staying close to the code: solving the hardest engineering problems, improving an established codebase, and helping other engineers do their best work. You bring deep expertise in Java, Kubernetes, and distributed systems, together with a product mindset. You understand that an architectural decision is only valuable if it improves the customer's experience. You know when to simplify, when to invest in a deeper change, and how to move an established product forward without compromising the workflows customers depend on. Requirements: **What You'll Do** **Shape the technical direction:** * Build a deep understanding of the existing CloudBees CI architecture, Jenkins internals, and customer workloads. Use that evidence to identify the changes that will make the greatest difference. * Define the technical roadmap with engineering and product partners, connecting architectural investments to customer needs and measurable improvements in reliability, performance, and maintainability. * Lead the design of resilient distributed systems running on Kubernetes. Make tradeoffs around scale, failure handling, compatibility, and operational complexity explicit, and document the reasoning behind key decisions. **Stay hands\-on with the hardest engineering work:** * Write production\-quality Java and own critical refactors, performance improvements, and stability fixes. Lead difficult changes from design through testing, release, and follow\-up. * Diagnose complex JVM and distributed\-system problems, including memory leaks, thread contention, classloading issues, and failures that emerge across components. * Evolve plugin\-based architectures and service boundaries while protecting compatibility and upgrade behavior. Simplify where possible and introduce new abstractions only when they solve a clear problem. **Bring the team with you:** * Earn the trust of an established engineering team. Listen first, explain your reasoning, and build alignment through technical judgment and working code. * Drive initiatives across teams by breaking ambiguous problems into achievable milestones, coordinating dependencies, anticipating risks, and unblocking delivery. * Lead rigorous design and code reviews. Mentor Staff and other senior engineers, share knowledge, and establish engineering standards that teams can apply consistently. **Make quality and customer outcomes the default:** * Strengthen secure coding, automated unit and integration testing, and release practices. Ensure changes are tested against realistic workflows, failure modes, and upgrade scenarios. * Use profiling, metrics, logs, and incident evidence to find root causes and validate improvements. Turn recurring problems into durable fixes and better engineering practices. * Partner with support, product, and engineering colleagues to resolve complex customer issues. Improve the feedback loop from code to customer, removing delivery bottlenecks while maintaining confidence in each release. **What You'll Bring** * 12\+ years of relevant software engineering experience, including technical leadership at Staff or Principal scope and a track record of delive trong point of view and update it when the data says otherwise. You argue for the best answer regardless of who's in the room, and once a decision is made, you commit to it fully. * **Hard Work** — You own the end result, not just your slice of it, and you go beyond what's expected to get there. You work smart as well as hard, and you find real reward in building something demanding alongside people who do the same. * **Ship Excellence** — You hold a painfully high quality bar and keep raising it, while shipping with urgency instead of waiting for perfect. Every iteration is something you learn from. * **Direct Feedback** — You give honest, constructive feedback regardless of seniority or tenure, and you actively ask for it in return. You deliver it with enough care that people want to hear it from you. **What You'll Get** * The opportunity to shape the technical direction of CloudBees CI, with hands\-on ownership of consequential engineering work. * A global, collaborative team that takes its craft seriously, shares knowledge, and invests in each other's growth. **Compensation \& Benefits** * Base Pay Range: $200,000 \- $230,000 annually In accordance with applicable law, this represents a reasonable estimated compensation range for this role. Actual compensation will be determined based on skills, experience, and geographic location and may be more or less than the amount shown above. Outside of base compensation, CloudBees also offers stock options and variable bonuses. **What CloudBees Offers** * **Time that's actually yours.** Our BEE\-Flexible PTO policy folds vacation, sick time, and personal days into one unlimited plan. Plus paid U.S. holidays and 2 dedicated Bee\-Giving Days to volunteer for a cause you care about. * **Health coverage from day one.** You're eligible on your start date, not 90 days in. Choose from medical, dental and vision options designed to support your healthcare needs. Choose an HDHP plan and we will contribute to your HSA on top of your own pre\-tax contributions. * **Real money toward your future.** Invest in your future with a competitive 401(k) company match, offering both pre\-tax and Roth options to help you reach your financial goals. * **Protection we pay for entirely.** We fully fund your Life and AD\&D, Short Term Disability and Long Term Disability protection. Plus our Employee Assistance Program is fully covered too. * **Support for your headspace \- literally.** All Bees have access to a company\-sponsored Headspace account. Plus, a dedicated Care Concierge service in the U.S. so you never have to decode a benefits question alone. * **A home office that works.** A stipend every month toward your work\-from\-home setup in addition to the opportunity to work (hybrid for Denver, CO employees) in an office with your peers. * **Upside when we win.** Base salary is the floor. Our bonus plan rewards for the goals you deliver and the growth we drive together. * **People who sweat the craft.** A team that takes its work seriously and invests in each other's growth. * **A global, collaborative team** that lives by our values: Customer Obsessed, High Agency, Truth Seeking, Hard Work, Ship Excellence, Direct Feedback. **EEO Statement** CloudBees is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All employment decisions are made based on qualifications, merit, and business need, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws. **Disclaimer** This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, and qualifications required of employees assigned to this position. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Examples: * Find and patch a vulnerability in a real codebase, such as memory corruption, an injection flaw, or an authentication bypass. * Analyze a suspicious binary and report what it does, how it persists, and how to detect it. * Audit a cryptographic implementation and fix misuse of keys, nonces or randomness. * Investigate logs or a packet capture to reconstruct an intrusion and identify the root cause. * Harden a misconfigured service, container or CI pipeline. * Find and fix a weakness in an ML system, such as a poisoned dataset, an unsafe model loading path, or a prompt injection hole in an agent. * Build each task’s environment, including the code, data and dependencies, and write a reference solution. * Write automated tests that check whether a solution is correct, with consistent results on every run. * Run your task against a leading AI model, review its attempt, and adjust the task until the model fails because the problem is truly hard, not because the instructions are unclear. **Who we are looking for** * A PhD in computer science, security, machine learning, engineering or another STEM field. PhD candidates and students are welcome to apply. * Hands\-on experience in security, such as vulnerability research, reverse engineering, applied cryptography, malware analysis, secure systems or AI/ML security. Ten or more years of experience is ideal. * At least one publication, academic or professional (for example a paper, CVE write\-up, conference talk or technical advisory). * Comfort with Python, the Linux command line, Docker and Git. * Familiarity with tools such as Ghidra, gdb, Wireshark or similar analysis tooling is a plus. * Experience with ML frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow is a plus. * Experience with experimental design, benchmarking or testing AI systems is a plus. * Peer review experience, or experience building technical tests, CTFs or assessments, is an advantage. * Able to work independently in a remote setting and explain technical findings clearly. **Why Cobalt AI** * **Advance frontier AI where it counts.** Apply your expertise to the data frontier labs cannot get any other way, where your reasoning directly shapes how the next generation of models solves technical problems. * **Grow professionally.** Expand your influence through evaluation projects, advisory roles and research collaborations, while deepening your understanding of how frontier models are trained and assessed. * **Work with a top\-tier network.** Collaborate with researchers and engineers from leading institutions and labs on high\-impact, flexible work. * **Set your own schedule.** Flexible 10 to 40 hour weeks that fit around your current role and your life. * **Competitive pay.** Paid per accepted task, with higher rates for consistently strong work. jobs.description: **Job Description** =================== About us\- Cognex is the largest, most successful and recognized global player in industrial machine vision! We are a financially strong, international company with no debt and have been in business for over 40 years. Using advanced optics, image sensors and artificial intelligence software Cognex vision and ID systems capture an image then analyze it to make sense of what’s being seen. This role has a high degree of customer interface and is expected to provide a high level of customer service and satisfaction. Typical Industry applications include: parcel and pallet conveyors, sorters, interfacing with in\-motion scales, dimensioners, label printer/applicators, scanners and sensors and PLC controls software. Our TSE’s are often the first call that our customers make when they need support. Our TSE’s can solve technical issues remotely, exhibit a Customer First attitude, and Persevere until the job gets done correctly. TSE’s are based in a Cognex Office in different locations globally. **Essential Functions** * Provide expert, front\-line product technical support submitted through web or phone call by asking meaningful troubleshooting questions, providing clarification on customer questions, directing customer to useful resources, etc. * Maintain high customer satisfaction level through timely, attentive, and polite interactions * Maintain open communication and provide consistent case updates to customer. * Ensure appropriate equipment is in place to set up common use cases for troubleshooting. Reproduce reported issues and resolving or providing suitable workarounds. * Create, update, and close cases in CRM. * Maintain complete and coherent case notes, and ensure all relevant data is captured. * Develop and maintain technical bulletins and knowledge base articles for complex problems that are easy to understand for non\-technical and technical audience both internal and external. * Interface and coordinate with global technical support group to facilitate troubleshooting and ensure timely resolution. * Utilize experience to create internal FAQs and share with the Technical Support Team. Reviews FAQs created by junior team members. * Escalate product issues to engineering and product marketing teams to solve certain topics and report product and manual bugs. * Respond timely to requests from engineering for additional information or troubleshooting on customer setup * Participate in required technical trainings to keep skills up to date with current technology, new products and industry standards or trends. May also deliver training to junior team members. * Drive continuous improvement of technical support processes based on employee and customer feedback. **Knowledge, Skills \& Abilities** * Ability to guide customers in how to use Cognex products and explain the cause of more complex trouble in an easy\-to\-understand manner. * Understand when and how to react and maintain composure and professionalism when handling different types of customers. * Understand different types of communication and when to apply them. * Active listening skills and the ability to gain a full and accurate understanding of the customer point of view. * Strong ability to demonstrate empathy and establish a good customer relationship * Strong ability to de\-escalate customer frustrations and maintain focus on the issue at hand. * Understand how to set realistic customer expectations and the ability to explain product capabilities to customers. * Specialized knowledge of image processing, analysis, and deep learning techniques. * Advanced knowledge of machine vision systems, optics, and lighting techniques for machine vision applications. * Expertise in all relevant Cognex products/ technology (DataMan barcode reading, In\-Sight platforms, VisionPro, Deep Learning, etc.) * Advanced knowledge of networking and industrial communication protocols such as TCP, FTP, EIP, Devicenet, Profinet, SLMP, Modbus, etc. * Ability to replicate setups, reproduce complex issues, and resolve difficult problems efficiently. * Strong understanding when you need more information from the customer and how to ask questions to get appropriate information. * Advanced knowledge of factory automation process, industrial controls, industrial robotic controls, and a general knowledge of PLC ladder logic programming. * Deep understanding of software programming and debugging of both script\-based and object\-oriented applications. * Ability to read and interpret complex wire and engineering diagrams. * Advanced ability to read programming documentation. * Advanced knowledge of specific programming languages in use by Cognex (Javascript, C\#, C\+\+, VB) * Practical, hands\-on knowledge of prioritize, multitask and work under pressure * Strong note taking and organization skills and the ability to effectively hand\-off cases. **Minimum Requirements** * Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in experience preferred. * Ability to travel internationally as required. * English language proficiency (spoken and written) * Ability to speak on the phone for extended periods of time * Ability to use jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer
jobs.description: **SALARY RANGE (Grade 15\) CSA216: $89,993\.11/yr. \- $134,991\.01/yr.****(Commensurate with experience)** **GENERAL STATEMENT OF DUTIES:** The Senior AI Engineer designs the architecture for, builds, and deploys AI\-enabled applications in OSA's Microsoft GCC environment. Working with the Innovation Assistant Director and Cloud Engineering, the role shapes OSA's AI reference architecture and turns it into production Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) applications, agent workflows, the data pipelines that feed them, and cost\- and performance\-aware model deployments. The role builds applications on existing foundation models accessed through approved platforms such as Azure AI Foundry; it does not train or develop LLMs. The primary focus is the Audit division, delivering AI services that measurably improve audit planning, research, and analysis across OSA's statewide audit portfolio. The role also builds AI\-enabled programs for OSA's administrative and operational units, including Human Resources, Administration \& Finance (A\&F), Occupational Schools, the Division of Local Mandates (DLM), and the Bureau of Special Investigations (BSI). OSA does not expect candidates to know every tool named in this description. Solid architecture and engineering fundamentals and hands\-on experience delivering LLM applications matter most. **SUPERVISION RECEIVED:** Reports to the Innovation Assistant Director and works within OSA's IT Innovation group. Collaborates closely with the Manager, System and Process Improvements, Cloud Engineering (e.g., platform security, IaC, APIM/Entra), Enterprise IT, the Data Analytics Unit, data engineering staff, contractors, and business stakeholders across Audit and OSA's operational units. The Manager, System and Process Improvements maintains the backlog of Audit process\-improvement opportunities, designs and measures pilots of AI\-assisted audit process steps and recommends adoption; Audit and agency leadership decide whether to adopt changes to audit processes. The Innovation Assistant Director runs intake for OSA's other units, sets IT Innovation work priorities in line with the IT Governance Council, manages staff and contractors, and decides technology and build\-versus\-buy choices. This role owns the technical design and engineering of the solutions and does not supervise staff. **DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:** **AI Solution Architecture** ---------------------------- * Design solution architectures for AI applications — components, integrations, data flows, security boundaries, and deployment topology — and document them in diagrams and architecture decision records. * Lead the definition and maintenance of OSA's AI reference architecture, including standard patterns for RAG, agents, API exposure, logging, and evaluation, with review and approval by the Innovation Assistant Director. * Work with Cloud Engineering to extend Azure Landing Zone patterns (CAF/WAF) for AI workloads: subscriptions, Azure Policy, VNets/NSGs, private endpoints, Key Vault, and managed identities. * Define microservice and API boundaries (REST, APIM) so AI capabilities are reused across audit and operational applications rather than rebuilt for each one. * Lead technical design reviews, and provide technical assessments of new Azure AI services, vendor tools, and build\-versus\-buy options to inform technology decisions by the Innovation Assistant Director. * Design for cost from the start: model and hosting choices, budgets, and tagging so AI consumption is visible and attributable by project. **Software Development** ------------------------ * Write, test, and maintain production Python and TypeScript/JavaScript code for AI\-enabled applications, services, and user interfaces. * Build REST APIs and backend services that connect LLMs to OSA documents, data sources, and business systems. * Write automated unit, integration, and evaluation tests; set code review and Git/GitHub branching standards for AI projects. * Build the automated tests, evaluation harnesses, and quality metrics used in OSA's software quality assurance process for AI applications (distinct from the audit Quality Assurance function), which data engineering staff and testers use to carry out testing. * Use AI\-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot responsibly, reviewing generated code for correctness and security. * Troubleshoot and improve the AI components of applications running in production. **AI Application Engineering** ------------------------------ * Own retrieval design for RAG applications — hierarchical/semantic chunking, embedding choices, hybrid (keyword \+ vector) search, cross\-encoder reranking, and citation fidelity checks — working with data engineering staff who build ingestion, schema, and embedding pipelines. * Engineer agent and tool\-calling workflows with Microsoft Agent Framework; lead migration of existing Prompt Flow orchestration and evaluation into supported pathways. * Define and instrume sful candidate will possess and/or demonstrate:* * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience. * 5–7 years of professional software engineering experience, including at least 2 years building production applications that use LLMs (e.g., RAG, agents, or tool\-calling features). * Demonstrated design ownership of the architecture for at least one production system, including documentation of design decisions. * Strong Python; working proficiency in TypeScript/JavaScript and SQL. * Hands\-on building RAG systems with hybrid search and reranking; experience with embeddings and vector stores (e.g., Azure AI Search, pgvector, Qdrant, Weaviate). * Experience designing and deploying applications on Azure (or AWS/GCP with a willingness to work in Azure), including identity, private networking, and secrets management. * Experience with Docker and Kubernetes, infrastructure as code (Terraform or Bicep), and CI/CD pipelines. * Experience designing REST APIs and service boundaries, and writing automated tests. * Experience handling sensitive data (PII/PHI) under least\-privilege access and encryption controls. * Clear written communication, including architecture documentation, and the ability to explain technical trade\-offs. **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:** * Azure Government/Microsoft GCC experience, including Azure Landing Zones and Cloud Adoption Framework implementation. * Microsoft Azure certifications at the associate or expert level (e.g., AI engineering or solutions architecture). * Microsoft Agent Framework and Prompt Flow migration; LangChain/LangGraph; structured outputs and function/tool calling across providers. * Deeper Kubernetes experience on AKS: Helm charts, ingress, autoscaling, and workload identity. * Knowledge graphs, taxonomies, or ontologies (e.g., RDF, SPARQL); familiarity with Synaptica Graphite. * Data engineering with Databricks (Unity Catalog, Delta Lake) or Microsoft Fabric; data governance frameworks (e.g., DMBOK), metadata and lineage management, and MDM. * RBAC/ABAC design, Purview classification, DLP labels, Defender for Cloud, and policy\-as\-code. * Understanding of LLM serving trade\-offs: quantization (FP8/INT4\), KV\-cache strategies, MoE models and expert parallelism, and open\-weight serving stacks (vLLM, TensorRT\-LLM, SGLang). * Experience in government, healthcare, or financial services, including shared platform or data standards across multiple agencies or business units. * Experience integrating TeamMate\+ and external sources into AI\-driven research workflows. * Experience mentoring developers or serving as technical lead on a project. * Exposure to AWS or GCP data and AI services (e.g., Vertex AI). Salary is commensurate with experience. The Office of the State Auditor is committed to providing equal employment opportunities. Employment actions such as recruiting, hiring, training, and promoting individuals are based upon a policy of non\-discrimination. Employment decisions and actions are made without regard to race, color, gender, religion, age, national origin, ancestry, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, disability, military status, genetic information, political affiliation, or veteran’s status. jobs.description: Description: Concept Solutions is seeking a **Full Stack Developer** to join a dedicated team of Information Technology (IT) professionals supporting the Federal Aviation Administration's (FAA) Command, Control, and Communications (C3\) office. The C3 office carries a critical strategic mandate: ensuring FAA managers maintain daily situational awareness and uninterrupted continuity of communications during severe national emergencies, natural disasters, or critical equipment malfunctions. Should disruptions occur, the C3 office is chartered with executing rapid disaster recovery and restoring essential communication services expeditiously. This position is **remote within 2 hours drive of Washington DC.** The Mid\-Level Full Stack Developer focuses on building, maintaining, and modernizing critical enterprise web applications, bridging legacy on\-premises systems with the Amazon Web Services (AWS) cloud. The primary objective of this role is to participate in a team effort to refactor and migrate legacy web applications and workflows from Microsoft SharePoint Subscriber Edition (On\-Premises) to modern, open\-source technology stacks hosted on AWS (including AWS GovCloud and AWS Outposts environments). This effort will include the use of Artificial Intelligence (AI) to refactor legacy code. Working as a member of the DevSecOps team, this role ensures all front\-end and back\-end code is highly performant, accessible, and robustly secure, supporting highly available mission\-essential functions under a FISMA Moderate framework. This position is vital to modernizing legacy application interfaces into secure cloud architectures, remediating findings from automated security pipelines, and establishing resilient, error\-tolerant workflows for continuity of operations. Requirements: * Bachelor's degree in a technical discipline (Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field). * 5 Years of Experience in Full\-Stack Web Application Development, with a proven track record of refactoring monolithic/legacy platforms and migrating workloads to AWS. Expertise in the following prioritized areas is required: **1\. Front\-End Frameworks \& UI Modernization:** * Three or more years of practical experience building and maintaining complex, responsive, and accessible web interfaces. * Proven experience refactoring and modernizing legacy SharePoint pages, customized Master Pages, InfoPath forms, and web parts into clean, open\-source UI frameworks. * Deep understanding of modern styling and layouts (HTML5, CSS3, modern JavaScript/TypeScript) to provide superior user experiences independent of SharePoint structures. **2\. Back\-End Development \& API Refactoring:** * Strong proficiency in server\-side open\-source development (such as .NET Core, C\#, Node.js, or Python) and designing secure, modular RESTful APIs. * Proven experience replacing proprietary SharePoint server\-side Object Models (SSOM) and Client\-Side Object Models (CSOM) with standard open\-source API architectures. * Experience decomposing monolithic logic into microservices or serverless applications to optimize for scalability and maintainability. **3\. SharePoint Decoupling, Content Migration \& Databases:** * Practical experience in legacy discovery and analysis, including assessing existing SharePoint site hierarchies, document libraries, lists, and complex item\-level permissions. * Proven capabilities migrating custom SharePoint list data into relational database models (such as Microsoft SQL Server, PostgreSQL, or Amazon RDS) and optimizing queries. * Experience refactoring legacy SharePoint workflows (SharePoint Designer, Power Automate, or K2\) into modern cloud\-native workflow engines like AWS Step Functions or serverless event\-driven architectures. **4\. AWS Cloud Hosting \& CI/CD Pipelines:** * Familiarity with refactoring and optimizing legacy applications for native deployment in cloud environments, specifically AWS GovCloud and AWS Outposts architectures. * General understanding of working with CI/CD automated deployment pipelines (such as Azure DevOps, GitLab CI, or GitHub Actions) to run automated SAST/DAST security scans and deploy code. * Participate on the DevSecOps team to build out code layers with the redundancy, error\-handling, and failover capabilities necessary to support continuity of operations (COOP). **5\. Security, Compliance \& Federated Identity:** * Strong proficiency implementing strict secure coding principles (OWASP Top 10\) to satisfy NIST SP 800\-53 security controls within a FISMA Moderate framework and remediating findings from pipeline scans. * Experience aligning custom SharePoint permissions and AD security groups with AWS IAM, AWS IAM Identity Center (formerly SSO), and modern federated identity protocols (OAuth2, OIDC, SAML). **Preferred Professional Certifications:** * AWS Certified Developer (Associate) or AWS Certified Solutions Architect (Associate) * CompTIA Security\+ (required within 6 months of hire to satisfy IAM\-II compliance) * Professional Certifications in Front\-End Methodologies (React, Angular, Vue) **Location and Schedule** * Location**:** Washington, DC * Schedule**:** 40 hours per week, Monday through Friday, with core working hours from 9:00 a.m. to 3:00 p.m. local time. * Security Requirement: Public Trust * Travel: 0\-10% Salary: $ 110K to $114K **Company Profile:** Founded in 1999 and headquartered in Reston, Virginia, Concept Solutions, LLC (CS) is a leading small business in technology, engineering, and management consulting. We are the innovative and agile force behind strategic solutions that enhance organizational efficiency and safeguard our nation across Aerospace, Defense, and National Security sectors. jobs.description: SUMMARY The Power Platform and AI Specialist scopes, designs, delivers, and supports Power Platform and AI solutions for managed services and project\-based client work. jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Machine Learning
jobs.description: **STAFF ENGINEER, MACHINE LEARNING** Current is a leading consumer fintech platform transforming financial access for everyday Americans with over 6 million members. We provide access to financial solutions that seamlessly work together to solve the needs of our members and enable all Americans to build better financial futures. Based in NYC, our results\-driven environment drives us to build better products, grow faster and empower everyone on our team to have an impact on our business and mission to improve financial outcomes. Current's Engineering team is dedicated to building our products and infrastructure. With our applications running on Google Cloud Kubernetes Engine, we support a proprietary banking core that can scale to handle millions of transactions a day. Our services run on MongoDB, with data exported to Google Cloud Storage and BigQuery for analytics. Batch feature computation runs on the JVM using Apache Beam and Dataflow, with dbt for the analytics estate and Airflow for orchestration. Our ML stack includes an in\-house feature store and model registry with a serving proxy, and our data scientists develop models in Python. Machine learning drives decisions across the business: underwriting for liquidity products, fraud detection and risk exposure, marketing acquisition and spend. Models that ship faster and behave predictably in production are worth real money and real member trust. We are looking for a Staff Engineer, Machine Learning to join our Infrastructure team in New York. This role has a salary range of $240,000 \- $325,000\. You will lead ML engineering initiatives across Current, with the goal of optimizing our model lifecycle: improving how we build, validate, deploy, and change models, and making that path faster and more repeatable as our model portfolio grows. This is a hands\-on individual contributor role without direct reports, with room to grow into a team. The ideal candidate has built and operated ML systems in production end to end, not only models, and has a track record of setting technical direction and delivering against it. This person should be comfortable leading from an ambiguous problem to a shipped solution, and should treat data scientists as their customer. **WHAT TO EXPECT:** * Owning technical direction for the ML stack end to end: feature definition and computation, training data generation, training infrastructure, model serving, and production monitoring, along with the contracts between them * Building tooling for training/serving consistency across analytics, batch computation, and live serving, accounting for differences in data sources and timing * Designing how every deployed model stays linked to its dataset, feature versions, labels, and training code, to the standard model risk management expects * Enabling data scientists to generate reproducible, point\-in\-time\-correct datasets and run standard validation without an engineering ticket * Setting the working contracts between the groups that build, consume, and govern models, and keeping the stack legible to people who don't read the code * Measuring delivery time, engineering effort, and rework, and using that evidence to prioritize improvements * In your first year: * + Establishing a delivery baseline and proving the workflow on one production model with versioned features, a reproducible dataset, and reusable validation + Extending those capabilities to additional models and measuring adoption and improvement against the baseline + Standardizing model monitoring and defining production\-readiness gates with Data Science, Risk, and service owners + Evaluating build\-versus\-buy options for ML platform tooling against real production requirements * Partnering daily with engineers across our squads and with data scientists and analysts, and regularly with Risk, Marketing, and Finance, who own the decisions our models support **ABOUT YOU:** * 3\+ years experience building and operating ML systems in production, including feature pipelines, the training data path, the serving layer, and the monitoring around them * A track record of improving ML delivery workflows, and the ability to explain the trade\-offs, results, and lessons from those decisions * 8\+ years of overall software engineering experience, including strong production skills in Python and SQL, experience building production systems in a JVM language, and 3\+ years of experience building and maintaining ML platforms * Sound reasoning about time in data: point\-in\-time correctness, label leakage, feature availability, and training/serving skew * Experience setting a long\-term technical direction and turning it into an achievable roadmap, delivering useful improvements along the way * Experience leading initiatives from an ambiguous problem through scoping, stakeholder agreement, and delivery * Experience establishing engineering standards, mentoring engineers, and helping teams adopt shared infrastructure * Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain trade\-offs clearly and find workable solutions across engineering, data science, risk, marketing, and finance * Fluency with AI tools, including coding agents, in your own engineering work, with the judgment to evaluate their output and own the quality of what you ship * Feature store, feature platform, or ML platform experience at a company where models make consequential decisions is a plus * Experience in financial services, credit, fraud, or another regulated decisioning domain, and familiarity with model risk management, is a plus * Experience with streaming and change data capture, large\-scale batch on Apache Beam or Spark, or distributed training is a plus **BENEFITS:** * Competitive salary * Meaningful equity in the form of stock options * 401(k) plan * Discretionary performance bonus program * Biannual performance reviews * Medical, Dental and Vision premiums covered at 100% for you and your dependents * Flexible time off and paid holidays * Generous parental leave policy * Commuter benefits * Fitness benefits * Healthcare and Dependent care FSA benefit * Employee Assistance Programs focused on mental health * Healthcare advocacy program for all employees * Access to mental health apps * Team building activities * Our modern NYC based office with open floor plan, stocked kitchen, and catered lunches

To date, the platform has powered more than $10 trillion in transactions, partnering with hundreds of firms, including leading global institutions such as Blackstone, Nuveen, LaSalle, CBRE IM, MetLife, Newmark, New York Life, UBS, Manulife, DWS, and Principal. By bringing together the only private exchange for institutional real estate listings, investment data, and intelligent execution workflows into a single platform, Dealpath enables firms to capture more opportunities, make faster decisions, execute efficiently, and deliver superior returns. Our company is led by an experienced team and backed by a combination of top tier venture capital firms and strategic industry partners including: Blackstone, Nasdaq, 8VC, JLL Spark, WTI, GreenSoil Investments, LeFrak, Milstein, Bechtel, and Morgan Stanley Expansion Capital. The ideal candidate will have strong SQL skills and be comfortable independently working through large, complex relational datasets. **Key Responsibilities** * Data Migration \& Business Logic Conversion * Data Quality \& Reconciliation * QA \& Validation * Data Analysis \& Investigation **Technical Skills** **Required** * Strong SQL and relational database skills, particularly with SQL Server. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving ability. * Experience performing data validation, reconciliation, data profiling, migration testing, or database\-level QA. * Ability to write SQL to compare and analyze large datasets across complex database structures. * Demonstrated ability to quickly learn unfamiliar database schemas, data models, and business processes. * Strong data reconciliation skills, including the ability to identify, investigate, and resolve discrepancies across multiple systems. * Ability to reverse\-engineer existing reports, processes, data models, and business rules. * Natural curiosity and investigative mindset with a passion for understanding how data moves through enterprise systems. * Ability to work from incomplete documentation and independently develop appropriate validation and reconciliation approaches. * Ability to collaborate with engineers, business stakeholders, and AI\-assisted tools to solve complex data problems. **Preferred** * Microsoft SQL Server / T\-SQL experience. * Experience validating ETL, ELT, or data warehouse processes. * Experience with data migrations and large\-scale system conversions. * Experience migrating reporting logic from legacy systems to modern data platforms. * Experience with healthcare or health\-plan data. * Experience using AI\-assisted analysis and development tools to accelerate data analysis, validation, and documentation. **What We Offer:** * Competitive pay * Rich medical, vision and dental benefits with low premiums. jobs.title: Partnerships Solutions Engineer
jobs.description: **About Dust** ============== **Work is being rewritten, and the people holding the pen are the ones who actually run it.** With enterprise\-grade governance, flexible model choice, and a collaborative interface for humans and agents to work together, Dust empowers AI Operators at the world’s fastest\-moving companies to rewire how work gets done. With 70%\+ weekly active users, people stick with Dust as much as they do with Slack and Notion. We don't get piloted and shelved. We land once, and spread. **We're at an exciting stage of our journey, and growing fast.** We're serving great customers like Datadog, 1Password, Cursor, Clay, Vanta and Persona, and aim to x5 our growth by the end of 2026\. Dust is backed by Sequoia with a determined team of optimists (coming from Stripe, OpenAI, and Stanford) who like to focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously while doing so. The Generalist named us among the Future 50\. **The Role** ============ We're looking for a Partnerships Solutions Engineer to help build the technical foundation of Dust's partner ecosystem in the US. You'll work closely with our Partnerships, Sales Engineering, Product, and partner teams to turn relationships into repeatable solutions and customer outcomes. You'll help partners develop AI offerings on Dust, establish the frameworks to deliver them successfully, and build the technical capabilities to bring those solutions to market. This is a hands\-on role for someone who enjoys working at the intersection of AI, technical implementation, and go\-to\-market strategy. **What You'll Do** ================== **Build partner offerings** * Collaborate with consulting and technology partners to develop packaged AI solutions and service offerings built on Dust. * Translate partner expertise and customer workflows into reusable agent templates, demos, and solution blueprints. * Help identify compelling use cases that partners can take to market and replicate across customers. **Develop repeatable delivery frameworks** * Create practical implementation playbooks covering discovery, solution design, deployment, and customer onboarding. * Build reusable technical assets and reference architectures that help partners deliver Dust\-powered solutions more efficiently. * Work with partner delivery teams to establish the skills and processes needed to implement solutions independently. **Enable partners technically** * Lead technical workshops, solution design sessions, demos, and proofs of concept with strategic partners and customers. * Help partners understand Dust's capabilities, integrations, APIs, and MCP ecosystem. * Equip partners with the knowledge and materials to confidently position, demonstrate, and deliver Dust. **Drive cross\-functional execution** * Partner with Sales Engineering, Product, and Engineering to address technical blockers and improve partner solutions. * Bring feedback from partner implementations into product and integration priorities. * Work with Partnerships to support joint opportunities and identify where repeatable solutions can drive pipeline and adoption. **What We're Looking For** ========================== * Experience in Solutions Engineering, Technical Consulting, Forward Deployed Engineering, or a similar customer\-facing technical role. * Hands\-on experience building AI applications, agents, automations, or enterprise software integrations. * Strong understanding of MCPs, APIs, technical architecture, and connecting business systems and workflows. * Ability to translate customer problems into practical technical solutions and repeatable implementation approaches. * Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with technical teams, consultants, and business stakeholders. * A builder mindset: comfortable with ambiguity, able to prioritize, and motivated to create repeatable processes from scratch. **Nice to have** * Experience working with consulting partners, systems integrators, or technology alliances. * Familiarity with MCP, LLMs, and modern AI tooling. * Experience developing partner solutions, implementation playbooks, or packaged consulting offerings. **What Success Looks Like** =========================== * Partners can confidently demonstrate and implement Dust\-powered solutions. * Partners have repeatable offerings and delivery frameworks they can use across multiple customers. * Successful implementations translate into reusable assets, faster delivery, and less reliance on Dust's internal teams. * Partner\-led opportunities and deployments increase as the ecosystem matures. **Location** ============ We're prioritizing building our team with an in\-person culture at our offices in Paris, London, San Francisco, and New York because we value the magic that happens when talented people work closely together. We have an office\-first culture. Some of the best things about building at Dust are the energy, the fast decisions, and the unexpected conversations that unlock a hard problem, which happen because we are in the same room. Being together is not a formality, it is how we do our best work, and it is something we actively protect. That said, we hire people with strong judgement and we extend that trust to how they manage their time. When working from home makes more sense for what you need to get done that day, we trust you to make that call. **Why Dust** ============ The models are powerful enough. What's missing is the product layer where AI meets how companies actually work. That's what we're building: the infrastructure that lets any team turn scattered knowledge and tools into coordinated execution with agents they build, own, and run themselves. We use Dust ourselves every day. We get to shape how humans and agents collaborate while solving our own problems with the product we ship. That loop is rare, and it's why we move fast. If you're excited about defining a new category and want to join a determined team of optimists who focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously, we'd love to talk. *Even if you don't check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist.* **Learn how we think and work.** * Our product constitution, *a story about our mission* * Your Next Co\-Worker Isn’t Human, **Stanislas Polu**, VivaTech 2026\. A conversation about AI agents taking on larger parts of work and how teams collaborate with them. * Dust: Gabriel Hubert on Enterprise AI, **Gabriel Hubert**, Nasdaq, published May 7, 2026\. On Dust’s approach to enterprise AI and building the company in Europe. Compensation Range: $240K \- $300K

This role will lead the end\-to\-end lifecycle of GenAI initiatives, from translating business requirements into AI\-powered prototypes to delivering scalable, production\-ready solutions across AWS, GCP, and Snowflake ecosystems. The candidate will also establish engineering best practices around prompt governance, model guardrails, benchmarking, and performance optimization. **Responsibilities: Generative AI Solution Design** * Architect and implement enterprise\-scale GenAI solutions using LLMs, foundation models, and agentic AI frameworks. * Design reusable AI patterns, accelerators, and reference architectures to enable rapid solution development. * Translate business problems into scalable AI workflows and production\-ready proof\-of\-concepts. * Drive AI platform modernization through adoption of emerging GenAI technologies and best practices. **Prompt Engineering \& LLM Governance** * Develop and maintain sophisticated prompt engineering frameworks for controlled and reliable LLM outputs. * Implement prompt versioning, prompt lifecycle management, and testing strategies. * Design AI guardrails to mitigate hallucinations, bias, security risks, and compliance concerns. * Establish best practices for prompt optimization, response consistency, and output quality management. **AI Workflow Orchestration \& Automation** * Design and build scalable orchestration pipelines using frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel, or equivalent. * Develop reusable AI components, tools, agents, and workflow templates for enterprise adoption. * Implement multi\-agent systems and autonomous workflows to support complex business use cases. **Prototyping \& Business Enablement** * Partner with business stakeholders to identify high\-value AI opportunities. * Rapidly develop AI prototypes and MVP solutions using synthetic and enterprise datasets. * Convert prototypes into production\-ready applications adhering to scalability, security, and reliability standards. **Cloud \& Data Engineering** * Build scalable GenAI architectures across AWS, GCP, and Snowflake platforms. * Leverage cloud\-native AI services including Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker, Vertex AI, Snowflake Cortex AI, and related ecosystems. * Design robust RAG (Retrieval\-Augmented Generation) architectures incorporating vector databases, embeddings, and semantic search. * Optimize model deployment, inference performance, and infrastructure cost efficiency. **Evaluation \& Performance Optimization** * Establish AI evaluation frameworks to measure accuracy, relevance, latency, safety, and business impact. * Develop benchmarking methodologies for comparing prompts, models, and workflows. * Define KPIs, observability frameworks, and monitoring strategies for GenAI applications. * Continuously improve model performance through prompt tuning, retrieval optimization, and workflow enhancements. * Qualifications: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field. * 8\+ years of experience in software engineering, machine learning, data engineering, or AI solution development. * 4\+ years of hands\-on experience with Generative AI, LLMs, and foundation models. * Strong experience designing enterprise GenAI solutions utilizing advanced LLM architectures and prompt frameworks. * Expertise in building scalable AI workflows, orchestration pipelines, and reusable AI components. * Proven ability to translate business requirements into production\-ready AI solutions and prototypes using synthetic data. * Deep understanding of prompt versioning, prompt governance, guardrails, and controlled LLM outputs. * Strong knowledge of AI evaluation frameworks, benchmarking methodologies, and optimization techniques. * Experience with vector databases, embeddings, semantic search, and RAG architectures. * Strong proficiency in Python and modern AI/ML development frameworks.

jobs.title: Senior Platform Engineer
jobs.description: ### **About EarnIn** As one of the first pioneers of earned wage access, our passion at EarnIn is building products that deliver real\-time financial flexibility for those with the unique needs of living paycheck to paycheck. Our community members access their earnings as they earn them, with options to spend, save, and grow their money without mandatory fees, interest rates, or credit checks. We're fortunate to have an incredibly experienced leadership team, combined with world\-class funding partners like A16Z, Matrix Partners, DST, Ribbit Capital, and a very healthy core business with a tremendous runway. We're growing fast and are excited to continue bringing world\-class talent onboard to help shape the next chapter of our growth journey. **POSITION SUMMARY** We are the Platform\-as\-a\-Service Engineering team at EarnIn. We build the foundational "Paved Road" that enables our product teams to ship with velocity and safety. Our stack is built on AWS, EKS, and ArgoCD, but our future is Agentic. We are shifting from manual configuration to AI\-augmented orchestration, where the platform anticipates developer needs and self\-heals through intelligent automation. We're seeking a Senior Platform Engineer (I4\) to design, build, and operate the agentic systems and core infrastructure that power our platform. You will work across Kubernetes (AWS EKS), GitOps (Argo CD), CI/CD (GitHub Actions), and our developer portal (Cortex), building AI agents and automation that reduce operational toil and increase platform leverage for engineering teams across EarnIn. As a Senior engineer, you independently design and implement solutions to well\-scoped but complex problems, re\-architect components, adopt new technologies, and improve existing processes with minimal guidance. You'll build agents that handle real slices of incident triage, environment provisioning, config generation, and developer self\-service, and you'll partner with Staff engineers and your manager to align your work with the team's broader technical direction. The base salary range for this full\-time position is $228,000\-$279,000, plus equity and benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. This is a hybrid position in Mountain View (Headquarters) and will require in\-office work 2 days a week. *Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States. We are able to support H\-1B and O\-1 employer transfers but are NOT able to provide new visa sponsorship or consider candidates working pursuant to OPT or CPT for this position* **WHAT YOU'LL DO** * AI\-Agent Design and Build: Design, build, and operate AI agents in production, following established governance patterns for model selection, evaluation, and safety. Contribute to infrastructure\-as\-code practices for agentic systems, ensuring prompts, tools, and evaluation criteria are versioned, reviewed, and tested like any other critical component. * Technical Execution: Implement agentic patterns for cloud infrastructure in your area of ownership, applying and helping refine team best practices for production AI agents. Support and mentor less experienced engineers on agentic patterns, LLM integration, and prompt engineering as opportunities arise. * Platform Operations: Operate and improve high\-availability distributed systems on AWS, identifying and resolving performance, scalability, and stability issues within your domain. Use AI\-driven observability and anomaly detection to catch problems early. Evolve infrastructure\-as\-code and automation standards for the services you own, incorporating agentic pattern recognition and automated remediation where it adds value. * Developer Platform: Contribute to the evolution of our developer control plane (Cortex) as an AI\-augmented self\-service platform, building features that let engineers scaffold services, debug deployments, and resolve issues through natural language. Help encode platform standards and security policies into AI\-powered golden paths. * Reliability and Documentation: Document agentic architecture, best practices, and operational procedures for the systems you build. Participate in on\-call rotations, and use post\-mortems as a feedback loop to improve system reliability and your team's agentic automation. **WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR** * Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field. * 4\+ years in cloud infrastructure, working on large\-scale, high\-availability, customer\-facing distributed systems. * Experience mentoring junior engineers and leading well\-scoped platform initiatives within your team. * Hands\-on experience building and operating AI\-driven systems in production, including agentic workflows that perform operational tasks. You should be able to speak to specific agent designs or automation you've built. * Experience reducing operational toil through agentic AI (e.g., LLM\-powered incident diagnosis, intelligent CI/CD with test selection, self\-service assistants) on at least one meaningful workflow. * Strong working knowledge of AWS (EKS, Lambda, Bedrock, etc.) and experience with containerized and serverless architectures. * Solid expertise in Kubernetes at scale and ability to implement complex, resilient solutions with guidance from senior/staff engineers. * Strong knowledge of infrastructure\-as\-code tools (Terraform, Ansible) and experience applying both traditional IaC and agentic automation. * Strong command of Datadog and observability practices, using metrics to drive decisions. Experience building AI\-driven alerting or root\-cause analysis systems is a plus. * Strong adherence to security, privacy, and compliance best practices, with awareness of governance considerations for production AI systems (model safety, prompt injection prevention, data isolation). * Experience with LLM orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, or custom agentic architectures) and production prompt engineering. * Strong coding ability in Python and/or Go, with experience treating infrastructure and agentic systems as software. * Ability to collaborate effectively across engineering, product, and security teams on cross\-functional work. * Experience with service mesh (Linkerd, Istio) and traffic management at scale is a plus. * Proficiency with GitOps (Argo CD, Flux CD) and CI/CD orchestration (GitHub Actions, Argo Workflows) is a plus. * Experience with MLOps or LLMOps concepts (model versioning, evaluation frameworks, production monitoring for AI systems) is a plus. * Familiarity with security frameworks relevant to AI systems (guardrails, audit logging, data governance for LLMs) is a plus. \#LI\-Hybrid At EarnIn, we believe that the best way to build a financial system that works for everyday people is by hiring a team that represents our diverse community. Our team is diverse not only in background and experience but also in perspective. We celebrate our diversity and strive to create a culture of belonging. EarnIn does not unlawfully discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, or related medical conditions), gender identity, gender expression, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, legally protected medical condition, family care status, military or veteran status, marital status, registered domestic partner status, sexual orientation, genetic information, or any other basis protected by local, state, or federal laws. EarnIn is an E\-Verify participant. EarnIn does not accept unsolicited resumes from individual recruiters or third\-party recruiting agencies in response to job postings. No fee will be paid to third parties who submit unsolicited candidates directly to our hiring managers or HR team.

jobs.title: Research Engineer – Robotics & Embodied AI
jobs.description: **About Us** ------------ We are a well\-funded, early\-stage AI lab focused on building the next generation of frontier multimodal AI models. Founded by former DeepMind researchers, including Andrew Dai, who was previously a leader on Gemini. Our team currently consists of 20 world\-class scientists and engineers. We raised $55M in seed funding from Striker Ventures, Menlo Ventures, Altimeter Capital, and NVIDIA. We are tackling some of the hardest problems in artificial intelligence, and we are growing fast. **About the Role** ------------------ As a foundation model company, Elorian aims to empower robotics developers through advanced visual reasoning, spatial understanding, and high\-quality robotics data solutions. We are looking for researchers and engineers with a background in robotics who want to apply their domain expertise to foundation\-scale AI. Instead of focusing solely on isolated robot hardware or narrow policies, you will collaborate closely with our core foundation model research team to infuse physical\-world priors into our models, address real\-world robotics challenges, and develop foundational capabilities that generalize across a broad spectrum of robotics applications. **What You Will Do** -------------------- * **Develop Visual \& Spatial Intelligence for Robotics:** Advance and evaluate visual reasoning, 3D spatial understanding, and physical affordance capabilities directly within our multimodal foundation models to support downstream robotic perception and control. * **Architect Robotics Data Pipelines:** Design scalable data pipelines—including data collection, teleoperation and trajectory annotation, automated quality assessment, and evaluation frameworks for multi\-modal robotic data. * **Explore Foundation\-Driven Embodied Reasoning:** Investigate and implement novel approaches to robotic task planning, hierarchical reasoning, and decision\-making powered by multimodal foundation models and Vision\-Language\-Action (VLA) architectures. * **Bridge Foundation Models \& Robotics Applications:** Collaborate closely with core foundation model researchers and robotics partners to identify real\-world bottlenecks, evaluate model capabilities, and build impactful foundational AI solutions for the robotics ecosystem. **What We Are Looking For** --------------------------- * Strong background in robotics (research or engineering), with first\-hand experience in robotic perception, planning, control, or robot learning. * Genuine excitement to transition robotics domain knowledge into large\-scale deep learning, multimodal architectures, and foundation model research. * Solid experience with machine learning and hands\-on familiarity with modern LLMs, multimodal foundation models (VLMs), or transformer architectures. * Strong research and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to independently investigate open\-ended, complex technical challenges. **Nice to Have** ---------------- * Experience with robotics simulation environments (e.g., Isaac Sim, MuJoCo) for large\-scale data generation, policy evaluation, or model pre\-training. * Experience with robotics datasets, trajectory annotation, task decomposition, and benchmark evaluation for physical systems. * Experience applying, fine\-tuning, or developing LLMs, VLMs, or Vision\-Language\-Action (VLA) models for robotics problems. * Background working with real\-world robotic systems (manipulation, navigation, or autonomous agents) and understanding the practical limits of deploying policies to physical hardware. * Deep expertise in robotic planning, 3D spatial reasoning, affordance modeling, or embodied intelligence.
