jobs.title: Senior Application Developer
jobs.description: **City** -------- Irvine**State** --------- California**Job Location** ---------------- Irvine Regional Office (Derian)**Position Type** ----------------- Regular The **Senior Application Developer** designs, builds, and supports moderate to highly complex applications on a serverless, cloud\-native architecture using an AI\-first, agentic development workflow. AI coding agents such as Claude Code write most of our code; our developers own what makes it worth shipping: the architecture, the requirements and specifications, the tests, and the code review. This role suits an experienced full\-stack engineer who wants to be at the forefront of how software is now built. The Essex Technology team is an all\-inclusive group of passionate technologists dedicated to supporting each other while supporting and driving Essex to a tech\-forward future. If you love solving problems, can appreciate well\-architected systems, and enjoy making a big impact with your contributions, then this role is for you! **WHAT YOU WILL DO:** * Design and develop web applications for internal and external customers, using agentic AI tools to plan, implement, and iterate quickly while applying sound usability concepts. * Build on our serverless architecture (e.g., AWS, Vercel) across front\-end UI, back\-end APIs, and data, using low\-code tools where they fit, to deliver scalable, secure, user\-centric solutions. * Work with business stakeholders to shape requirements and translate them into clear functional specifications and acceptance criteria that drive AI\-assisted implementation. * Define architecture, data models, and design patterns, and guide AI agents to implement within them. * Own test strategy: unit, integration, and regression suites that validate AI\-generated code. * Take a lead role in code quality, security, and performance, critically reviewing AI\-generated code. * Maintain, support, and modernize existing applications, using AI to analyze, document, and refactor legacy code. * Help lead architecture and design reviews, backlog refinement, and other scrum meetings. * Triage and resolve production issues, and deploy changes through automated CI/CD pipelines. * Contribute to technology best practices, including the secure, responsible use of AI tools. * Perform other tasks as assigned. **WHAT YOU WILL NEED:** * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering or related discipline. * 8\+ years of hands\-on full stack web application development across the full lifecycle: requirements, design, build, test, deployment, and support. * Deep knowledge of software architecture and design patterns (e.g., separation of concerns, modular design, API design). * Strong automated testing skills (unit, integration, end\-to\-end, regression) and test\-driven development. * Proficient in capturing workable requirements from end users and business stakeholders and writing specifications clear enough for an engineer, or an AI agent, to implement without ambiguity. * Strong code\-review skills to assess AI\-generated code for correctness, security, and maintainability. * Experience with AI coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor), or a demonstrated eagerness to adopt them. * Experience building serverless applications (e.g., AWS Lambda, Vercel) with CI/CD and DevOps practices. * Strong knowledge of HTML5, CSS, JavaScript, and at least one backend language. * Preferred: .NET, C\#, TypeScript, Next.js, React, Vue.js, and building AI/LLM\-powered features. * Strong knowledge of SQL. Experience with Snowflake and PostgreSQL/MySQL/SQL Server. * Experience implementing responsive design and Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) standards. * Proficient with Git and with integrating web services and APIs (REST and SOAP). * Experience developing in web content management frameworks. * Proficient in creating clear system design, process, and user documentation, including context files for AI agents. * Experience in agile software development, with a proven track record of on\-time delivery. * Able to communicate technical concepts to non\-technical associates and mentor junior developers. **WHAT THE JOB REQUIRES:** * Work is primarily conducted in an office setting. Requires sitting at a desk or workstation for extended periods. Involves the use of standard office equipment such as computers, phones, and printers. * Requires the ability to work Monday through Friday. Entails in\-person office requirements for a minimum of 4 days per week: Mondays, Tuesdays, Wednesdays, and Fridays located at Essex's corporate offices in Irvine or Woodland Hills. * Requires the ability to sit or stand for extended periods. Minimal physical effort in the day\-to\-day tasks. * Minimal travel may be required for occasional meetings, training, or conferences. **WHAT YOU WILL BRING TO THE TABLE:** * Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Strong organizational and analytical skills. Ability to provide efficient, timely, reliable and courteous service to customers. Ability to effectively present information. * Ability to comprehend, analyze, and interpret documents. Ability to solve problems involving several options in situations. Requires intermediate analytical and quantitative skills. * A collaborative attitude, actively engaging with team members to share knowledge, resolve challenges, and foster a productive and inclusive work environment. * A quality\-first, verify\-don’t\-assume mindset and the curiosity to keep learning as AI evolves. * Decisions made with thorough knowledge of procedures and company policies to achieve set results and deadlines. Responsible for setting own project deadlines. Errors in judgment may cause short\-term impact to co\-workers and supervisor. * No formal supervisory responsibilities in this position. May provide informal assistance such as technical guidance and/or training to coworkers. May coordinate work and assign tasks. All full\-time regular associates are offered competitive salaries, experience career growth, and are eligible for benefit packages that include medical, dental, vision, paid parental leave, 401k employer match, excellence rewards, wellness programs, and much more. With our 12 paid holidays and 15 PTO days, work/life balance is a priority! Additionally, most positions are eligible for a housing discount of 20%. Essex provides great communities in which to live, work and invest. We are a purpose\-driven company, and we pride ourselves on promoting an internal culture of growth and opportunity by engaging, enabling, and empowering our teams. Working at Essex is not a destination. It is a journey where you can confidently build your career. New hires generally start between $123,000\.00 \- $153,000\.00 per year. The final salary offer will be determined after reviewing relevant factors, including but not limited to skill sets; relevant experience; internal equity; and other business and organizational needs. This role is also eligible to participate in Essex’s discretionary Annual Bonus program that is commensurate with the level of the position.

jobs.title: AI/ML Engineer
jobs.description: **Company Description** Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate. The Eurofins network of companies is the global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in agroscience Contract Research Organisation services. It is one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and in the support of clinical studies, as well as having an emerging global presence in Contract Development and Manufacturing Organisations. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialised and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in\-vitro diagnostic products. In over 30 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to 58,000 staff across a decentralised and entrepreneurial network of 900 laboratories in over 54 countries. Eurofins companies offer a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products. In 2021, Eurofins generated total revenues of EUR 6\.72 billion, and has been among the best performing stocks in Europe over the past 20 years. **Job Description** We are seeking a highly motivated AI/ML Engineer to support the development of Generative AI\-based digital tools and platforms in a pharmaceutical R\&D environment. The successful candidate will join the Automation and Robotics team, focusing on designing, prototyping, and implementing AI\-driven solutions for pharmaceutical applications. This role provides hands\-on experience with machine learning (ML), large language models (LLMs), automation, and data engineering, contributing to next\-generation digital tools that accelerate innovation in the pharmaceutical industry. **Responsibilities** * Develop and maintain knowledge graphs and retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) systems for scientific data. * Design, prototype, and deploy AI\-driven solutions for chemical process optimization. * Implement AI/ML models for predictive analytics and decision support in chemical synthesis. * Build robotic control systems to orchestrate workflows using modular lab equipment. * Create new applications leveraging the Jupyter framework for web\-based tools. * Integrate and visualize experimental data within applications where applicable. * Develop and maintain Python\-based pipelines for data acquisition and workflow automation. * Collaborate with scientific stakeholders to refine requirements and iterate on prototypes. * Work with APIs, databases, and internal data pipelines for seamless integration. * Document code and workflows in compliance with internal best practices and quality standards. **Qualifications** * Education: BS with 5\+ years of experience OR MS in Computer Science or related field (or expected graduation before start date). * Proficiency in Python, Jupyter Notebook, Dataiku DSS, and REST APIs. * Experience with Large Language Models (LLMs) and Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG). * Familiarity with RDKit for cheminformatics applications is preferred. **Additional Information** * Position is **Monday\-Friday, 8\-5\.** Overtime as needed. **On\-site role based in Groton, CT** * May be requested to work on weekends, overtime, and holidays based on business needs * Candidates currently living within a commutable distance of Groton, CTare encouraged to apply. * Excellent full\-time benefits, including comprehensive medical coverage, dental, and vision options * Life and disability insurance * 401(k) with company match * Paid vacation and holidays * **\#LI\-EB1** * Authorization to work in the United States indefinitely without restriction or sponsorship **Eurofins USA PSS Insourcing Solutions is a Disabled and Veteran Equal Employment Opportunity employer.**

search, matching, workflow automation, communication, and recruiter productivity tools. * Develop AI agents, prompts, structured workflows, and human\-in\-the\-loop solutions for real\-world iterate. * Integrate the platform with HR systems, job boards, background screening, email/calendar, and other third\-party applications. * Build with enterprise requirements in mind, including long\-term roadmap for the platform. **What Were Looking For** * 5\+ years of software engineering experience with demonstrated full\-stack application development. * Experience taking applications skills, including schema design, query performance, indexing, capacity planning, backup, restore, and lifecycle management. * Experience with observability, incident response, structured logging, metrics, tracing, service KPIs, and debugging distributed systems. * Experience with Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD, automated quality gates, staged rollout, rollback, and production change control. * Strong understanding of cloud and IoT security, including IAM/RBAC, PKI/TLS, secrets, device identity, and certificate lifecycle. * Ability to collaborate effectively with US team. **Preferred Skills**: * Experience establishing a new product as the pilot for a reusable multi\-device platform architecture. * Experience with factory provisioning, certificate injection, device identity, manufacturing validation, or supplier\-facing engineering workflows. * Experience building telemetry, data collection, orchestration, or feature pipelines that support ML development and continuous product improvement. * Familiarity with on\-device software, embedded systems, firmware workflows, hardware debugging, or device log collection. * Experience operating global or China\-region cloud infrastructure and supporting services across geographic boundaries. * Experience with cloud\-cost optimization, FinOps, service consolidation, and reducing operational complexity. * Experience with secure remote diagnostics, controlled support tooling, and customer\- or factory\-facing operational dashboards. * Experience designing safe staged migrations from complex or legacy architectures without interrupting existing services. **Why You’ll Love This Role** ----------------------------- * A creative, fast\-moving environment where ideas turn into action. * Competitive compensation Your Community donation matching * Monthly Fitness Stipend * Summer Fridays * Paid Parental Leave * Generous discount on Fellow products * Best coffee anywhere The salary range for this position is Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.* * Under the guidance and direction of the Chief Technology Officer, oversees the management and operations of information security and cybersecurity tools, documentation, standards, and processes to ensure an operating environment that is effective, sound, secure, sustainable, scalable, and compliant with Bank policies and regulatory requirements. * Provides information and cyber risk guidance for IT projects, including the evaluation and recommendation of technical controls and security policies and procedures. Monitors developments and trends in information security and cybersecurity and formulates strategy accordingly. * Works with key individuals throughout the organization to develop business cases for new security projects and risk assessments of existing and planned information systems. Supports a proactive culture to align activities and measurement with internal policy and regulatory requirements. * Fosters collaborative and cooperative working relationships with security stakeholders, including IT team members, executive leadership, operations, business lines, risk management, and internal audit. * Prepares and presents accurate and timely information in response to audits and regulatory exams. Develops effective relationships with the internal audit department. * Provides support and collaborative mentorship to the IT team on information security and cybersecurity matters. Supports IT team members on escalations of security incidents by providing subject matter expertise and guidance. * Provides leadership and technical and administrative support for the bank’s disaster recovery and business continuity program and implements appropriate and effective controls to mitigate identified risks and threats. * Responds to potential threats such as phishing, malware, and network attacks with a detailed written assessment, including timelines, to assist in the determination of whether it is necessary to declare a security incident. * Under the direction of the Chief Technology Officer, leads incident response to security events with a high degree of personal accountability. jobs.title: Senior Power Plant Engineer
jobs.description: Are you ready to build America’s energy future? Form Energy is an American manufacturing and energy technology company. We’re revolutionizing energy storage with cost\-effective, multi\-day technology designed to keep the electric grid secure and reliable, even during extended periods of stress. By strengthening the electric system and reimagining what’s possible, we’re giving clean energy a whole new form! In recent years, Form Energy has earned a number of accolades, including being named by *TIME* as a “Best Invention”, *MIT Technology Review* as a “Top Climate Tech Company To Watch”, and *Fast Company* as “One of the Next Big Things In Tech”. We are making rapid progress on our mission of delivering energy storage for a better world, and our team is growing just as rapidly to meet demand. We have signed contracts with leading electric utilities across the United States and production of our iron\-air batteries is underway at our first high\-volume manufacturing facility in West Virginia. Working for Form Energy is more than just a job, it’s a chance to be part of something extraordinary. And now \- right as we significantly scale up battery manufacturing \- might be the most exciting moment in the company’s history to join. We are assembling a team of highly talented and driven individuals across the country. Driven by our core values of humanity, excellence, and creativity, our team is determined to deliver on our mission and transform the energy landscape for the better. **Feeling energized to make a meaningful impact on the world? Then keep reading \- you’ve come to the right place.** **Role Description** -------------------- Form Energy is hiring a Senior Power Plant Engineer to support the modeling and validation of our power plant controls as they relate to grid interconnection. As part of our team, you'll help verify that our power plant controller meets interconnection and compliance requirements across our DC\-coupled plant architecture, using hardware\-in\-the\-loop and simulation environments to validate system\-level behavior before it reaches the field. This is a great opportunity for an early\-career engineer with a strong power systems/controls foundation to grow into plant controls validation work on breakthrough energy storage technology. *Relocation assistance is available.* ### **What you'll do:** * Support modeling and validation of our power plant controller (PPC) against grid interconnection requirements, partnering closely with senior staff on test planning and execution * Serve as a key point of contact with third\-party conversion equipment and controls suppliers, managing interface documentation, tracking open items, and professionally coordinating Form's hardware and controls requirements, interface specs, and test results across organizations * Build and run hardware\-in\-the\-loop (HIL) test cases (e.g., in Typhoon HIL) verifying that our DC/DC converters and DC bus behavior integrate cleanly with plant inverters in our DC\-coupled architecture * Develop and maintain simulation models in Simulink and PSCAD representing plant\-level electrical behavior and control interactions ahead of hardware validation * Validate grid compliance behavior (e.g., IEEE 1547, IEEE 2800\) once DC bus dynamics are factored into overall plant response * Support integration and testing of SCADA interfaces and meter data as part of plant controls validation * Document test plans, results, and findings, translating HIL/simulation outcomes into clear recommendations for senior staff and the broader controls team * Troubleshoot discrepancies between simulated and hardware\-in\-the\-loop results, escalating root causes as needed ### **What you'll bring:** * + Master’s or PhD in Electrical Engineering or related discipline, with a focus on power systems or power electronics + 3\+ years of experience in power systems, power electronics, or controls engineering — internship, co\-op, research, or equivalent strong academic project experience welcome + Foundational knowledge of power systems fundamentals (per\-unit analysis, three\-phase power, grid interconnection basics) + Exposure to power plant controls, grid compliance standards (e.g., IEEE 1547, IEEE 2800\), or inverter\-based resource behavior through coursework or projects + Familiarity with simulation/modeling tools such as Simulink, PSCAD, or HIL platforms (e.g., Typhoon HIL) + Exposure to SCADA interfaces, metering, or similar plant communication/data systems is a plus + Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain design decisions, summarize observations, absorb information and requirements from other teams, and spearhead engagement with 3rd party vendors *\#LI\-Onsite* *Humanity is a cornerstone of Form Energy’s culture, and we make sure our compensation and benefits reflect that. Form Energy offers competitive salaries, stock options, and a holistic benefits package to ensure all employees have what they need to thrive while working here.* *When it comes to you and your family’s health, we cover 100% of medical, dental, and vision premiums for full\-time employees \- and 80% of healthcare premiums for dependents. This starts from day one. We also offer at least 12 weeks of paid leave for new parents (up to 20 weeks for birthing parents), and generous vacation policies to give employees time to recharge when needed.* *To build America’s energy future, we need everyone at the table. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply to our open jobs.* *If you may require reasonable accommodations to participate in our interview process, please contact accommodations@formenergy.com. Requests for accommodations will be treated with discretion.* *Form Energy is committed to maintaining the privacy of our applicants. Please be aware that we will* ***never*** *solicit sensitive personal information such as Social Security numbers or bank account details during the recruiting or hiring process.* Compensation Range: $128,662 \- $168,844

jobs.title: Robotics Field Service Engineer
jobs.description: **Who we are:** Formic is on a mission to reshape American manufacturing by making automation accessible to every factory. As labor constraints rise, costs increase, and global competition intensifies, automation is no longer optional for manufacturers that want to stay competitive. We deliver automation through a Robotics\-as\-a\-Service model that combines industrial robotics, proprietary software, and full\-service support into a single, integrated solution. and industrial compliance * Participate in RCA sessions, audits, and continuous improvement initiatives * Continuously expand technical depth across robotics, controls, networking, and industrial systems **What makes you a great fit:** * 3\+ years of hands\-on field service experience supporting robotic or industrial automation systems * Strong troubleshooting skills across electrical, mechanical, PLC, or robotic control systems * Ability to read electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, and pneumatic drawings * Experience using CMMS platforms to track and report maintenance activity * Comfortable with local travel up to 80% and overnight travel up to 50% * Clear written and verbal communicator capable of producing structured service documentation * Demonstrated commitment to safety and disciplined field execution **Bonus points if you have:** * Experience with 6\-axis robot brands such as FANUC, KUKA, Yaskawa, ABB, or Universal Robots * Familiarity with palletizing, case packing, pick\-and\-place, or conveyor systems * Experience in food, beverage, packaging, CPG, or other high\-speed manufacturing environments * Prior customer\-facing field experience * Spanish language proficiency **What we look for:** We're building this company from the ground up, and every person we hire has an outsized impact on our culture, performance, and trajectory. While each team member brings unique strengths and perspectives, we look for people who align with our Operating Principles and embody them in action. You believe in the mission, aren't paralyzed by risk, and fear inaction more than failure. You see ambiguity as opportunity and bring energy to building what doesn't yet exist. * **Create the Magic:** You absorb complexity so customers don't have to. Whether your customer is external or internal, you focus on delivering experiences that are clear, fast, value\-added, and outcome\-driven. You don't say "not my job." You make things work. * **Today, Not Tomorrow:** You have a bias to action. You close the loop. You take extreme ownership. You understand that speed compounds, and you don't confuse activity with results. * **Seek Truth:** You think from first principles. You value data over ego and strong opinions loosely held. You're willing to challenge assumptions, including your own, in pursuit of the best answer. * **Made of Rubber:** You are resolute and adaptable. When things break or priorities shift, you rebound stronger. You treat setbacks as learning moments and move forward with grit. * **One Formic:** You operate without silos. You practice radical helpfulness, document clearly, and make clean handoffs. You assume positive intent and prioritize team success over individual credit. **Equal Opportunity Employment:** Formic is an equal opportunity employer. jobs.title: Data Engineering & Architecture Manager
jobs.description: Overview: We are looking for a Data Architecture Manager to help lead Electric Boat’s transformation toward a modern, scalable, AI‑ready data ecosystem. Instead, we need a leader who can bridge our current environment and our future state—someone who understands how to work within a complex legacy landscape while designing and implementing a modern data foundation that supports analytics, AI, automation, and next‑generation applications. This position requires a forward‑thinking architect who can balance pragmatism with innovation: knowing when to modernize, when to integrate, and when to redesign—while ensuring stability for mission‑critical operations. The ideal candidate is comfortable navigating a large enterprise, influencing across organizational boundaries, and translating business goals into practical, actionable technology and architecture decisions. **Key Responsibilities:** **Enterprise Data Architecture \& Strategy** * Develop and evolve the enterprise data architecture strategy in alignment with business and technology objectives. * Define target\-state data architecture and practical transition paths from current to future\-state environments. * Establish architecture principles, standards, patterns, and governance that promote scalable, consistent, and secure data solutions. **Build the Foundation for AI and Advanced Analytics** * Define the data architecture required to support the organization’s AI and machine\-learning strategy. * Help establish trusted, accessible, well\-governed data that can be effectively used by analytics and AI teams. * Partner with data science, AI, product, and business teams to understand emerging data requirements. * Evaluate new technologies and architectural approaches for data platforms, AI, real\-time data, data products, and analytics. * Help ensure that data is discoverable, appropriately governed, secure, and usable across the enterprise. **Lead and Develop a Team** * Build, lead, and mentor the Data Architecture team, advancing EB’s modeling, ontology, integration, and metadata capabilities. * Provide clear direction while empowering architects and engineers to solve complex problems. Qualifications: **Required:*** Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Information Technology, or Engineering * Significant experience in data architecture, enterprise architecture, data engineering, or a related technology discipline. * 8\+ years of experience in IT, data\-focused technical roles, or enterprise systems. * 4\+ years of supervisory experience * Experience partnering across enterprise, solution, application, infrastructure, security, and AI architecture domains. * Experience developing enterprise data strategies and multi‑year technology roadmaps. * Ability to obtain and maintain a Secret security **Preferred:*** Experience with modern data platforms, data lakes/lakehouses, streaming architectures, APIs, and event‑driven architectures. * Experience supporting AI/ML, generative AI, or advanced analytics initiatives. * Experience with data governance, data quality, metadata, master data, and information management. * Experience with semantic layers, ontology development, or enterprise modeling. * Experience working in complex, highly regulated enterprise environments. * Experience with cloud‑based data platforms and modern data architecture patterns. * Experience defining target‑state architectures and building transition roadmaps.

You will also play a critical role in cultural transformation — partnering across the enterprise to enable broad adoption of new AI technologies. **Key Responsibilities** * **Architecture \& Strategic Leadership****.** Contribute to enterprise AI strategy and roadmap to become an AI\-enabled enterprise. This includes the compute, cloud, networking, storage, data, identity, security, observability, and operational capabilities required to support AI workloads. Develop patterns for using foundation models, agentic systems, RAG, AI applications, machine learning, and other emerging technologies within our enterprise environment. Understand the realities of a large legacy environment and develop practical approaches for integrating modern AI capabilities without requiring the entire technology ecosystem to be rebuilt first. * **Lead AI platform** **and service** **engineering.** Establish reusable platforms, services, APIs, tooling, and deployment patterns that enable teams across the business to build and consume AI capabilities safely and efficiently. * **Evaluate rapidly changing technology.** Stay current on developments in AI models, agent frameworks, AI infrastructure, inference technologies, developer tools, and the broader AI ecosystem. Develop AI\-related standards and best practices. * **Enterprise Cultural Transformation****.** Champion and drive AI adoption across the enterprise. * **Team Leadership and Talent Development.** Attract, develop, and lead highly capable engineers and architects while creating a culture of responsible innovation, engineering rigor, and delivery. Our team’s mission in Trust and Safety is to partner with model and product teams to deliver trusted and helpful generative AI experiences with velocity. As deep experts in the trust and safety and responsible AI space, we deliver on our mission by defining product safety strategy, providing holistic insights on risks and opportunities and analyzing mitigations to drive strategic decisions. As a Senior Engineering Analyst/Tech Lead within Trust and Safety SAGE, you will lead the architecture and scaling of automated safety evaluation and enforcement platforms powering next\-generation generative AI products. You will own the transition from bespoke evaluation scripts to high\-throughput, low\-latency LLM\-as\-a\-judge autorater infrastructure supporting continuous offline testing and real\-time launch decisions. Your role demands both deep technical acumen and a strong passion for GenAI integrity and AI abuse. In this role, you will act as a leader across critical, high\-scrutiny domains—including Health (YMYL clinical accuracy), Civics and Elections (misinformation and electoral integrity), and AI Ecosystem —ensuring our models operate with authoritative consensus, robust safety guardrails, and sub\-100ms enforcement mitigations. Benefits include, but not limited to: Comprehensive health, dental and vision coverage, retirement benefits (401k match up to 4%), and flexible PTO.* **Why Harvey** ============== At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise\-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come. This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product\-market fit and world\-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched. Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you. At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started. **Role Overview** ================= As a Member of Technical Staff, Data \& Evals in Harvey Research, you’ll build the data and measurement systems that power our post\-training, benchmarking, and agent capability efforts. We recently post\-trained our first model built for legal work, and we’re now building the team to scale up our post\-training efforts. You’ll own synthetic data pipelines, evaluation design, the tasks and grading behind training environments, and the systems that turn feedback from domain experts into training signals and rewards. These are tasks where correctness often can’t be verified automatically, so defining and measuring quality is a core research challenge. You’ll join a small, high\-bar team of hands\-on engineers and researchers, where each person owns a large part of the work. We’re looking for research engineers who can build reliable data and evaluation systems, question what a metric actually tells us, and work closely with researchers and legal experts to turn model failures into measurable improvements. Learn more about our work at harvey.ai/research. **What You'll Do** ================== * Build synthetic data pipelines that generate, filter, and curate training and evaluation samples for complex legal reasoning and agentic workflows. * Design evaluations and verifiers that reflect real legal work, calibrate them against expert judgment, and investigate where they fail. * Build and maintain capability benchmarks like our Legal Agent Benchmark (LAB), along with product\-focused evals that track how models perform on real customer workflows. * Work with legal domain experts to define quality metrics, rubrics, and other grading mechanisms for training and evaluation. * Own training and evaluation data quality, including provenance, coverage, and safeguards against contamination. * Close the loop from product usage and customer feedback to new evaluations and training data, so models improve where customers need them most. * Partner with researchers to investigate model failures, distinguish real gains from misleading metrics, and use findings to guide training and release decisions. **What You Have** ================= * Experience building data pipelines, ML evaluation systems, or experimentation tooling, with strong Python skills and ownership of production\-quality code. * A rigorous approach to measurement, including statistical reasoning, experimental design, and understanding when a metric can mislead. * The ability to translate ambiguous goals or expert judgment into structured datasets, rubrics, and measurable criteria. * Experience with synthetic data, LLM evaluations, automated raters, or preference data is a plus. Strong data and measurement engineering experience close to ML model development is valuable even without prior LLM work. We are hiring for this role across multiple levels. **Compensation** ================ $230,000 \- $450,000 USD ### **Depending on your location, an Applicant Privacy Notice may apply to you. jobs.title: Full Stack Developer
jobs.description: **WHY HILLPOINTE?** *Hillpointe is a fully integrated real estate development and investment management firm focused on developing market\-rate workforce housing across the Sun Belt. Ranked at the top of NMHC's list of Builders and Developers, our team ensures best\-in\-class execution.* *Built on its long and proven track record of real estate development, the firm's investment approach is centered around its in\-house general contracting expertise, enabling direct control of cost and delivery timeframe. For each project, Hillpointe directly controls land acquisition, land development, construction, procurement of building materials, asset management, and capital markets. This is more than just a job \- it's a career\-defining opportunity! At Hillpointe, you'll be part of a dynamic, innovative team that has tangible impacts on day\-to\-day operations and contributes directly to overall success.* **Full Stack Developer** Hillpointe is hiring a Full Stack Developer to help build HPOS, the property management platform for our vertically integrated multifamily real estate business, from scratch. This is a greenfield engineering role. You will help establish the architecture, design the data model, ship the first services, and set the patterns the rest of the platform will inherit. Expect a zero\-to\-one cadence. Design an API contract in the morning, ship a Postgres migration before lunch, push a Bicep change to staging by end of day. We optimize for engineers who can hold the full stack in their head, make sound architectural decisions, and ship working software at pace. **The Role at a Glance:** * *Scope*: Schema to UI: Database design, API contracts, frontend components, infrastructure. No tier is off\-limits. * *Surface*: Greenfield build: Property management platform built from scratch. Multi\-tenant from day one. Operator tooling, leasing, accounting, capital markets. * *Cadence*: Zero to one: Trunk\-based development, short\-lived branches, feature flags, working software in staging on a daily rhythm. * *Impact*: Foundational: What you ship in the first year becomes how the platform works for the next ten. **Key Responsibilities:** * **React surfaces**: First\-generation operator and resident\-facing applications. React 18 with TypeScript, Vite, TanStack Query v5, React Hook Form, Zod. Component composition against the PDS Foundation design system. The patterns set here will be inherited by every surface that follows. * **Service layer**: TypeScript services on Node 20 LTS with NestJS or Express. OpenAPI contracts shared with the front end through code generation. JWT and OAuth flows, RBAC enforcement, structured audit logs, request\-scoped tracing. The shared libraries that every future service will depend on. * **Postgres data model**: Multi\-tenant schema design on Azure Database for PostgreSQL Flexible Server. Tenant isolation strategy, normalization tradeoffs, index strategy from day one, audit trails baked into the data model. Migrations through Prisma or Knex. * **Warehouse integration**: Stand up change data capture from Postgres into the Bronze layer of Enzo, our medallion warehouse. Establish read models surfaced from Gold\-layer views back into product. Contract\-first design with the data team. * **Event\-driven backbone**: Asynchronous workflows over Azure Service Bus. Idempotent consumers, dead\-letter handling, exactly\-once where the business requires it. The async patterns the rest of the platform will adopt. * **Infrastructure and Observability**: Bicep modules for App Service, Functions, Container Apps, Service Bus, Key Vault, and managed identities. Multi\-stage Azure DevOps pipelines. Structured logs, OpenTelemetry, and SLO definitions in place before we ever take production traffic. * **Stack**: + *Front End*: React 18 \+ TypeScript 5 - React 18 with Suspense and concurrent features, TypeScript 5\.x strict, Vite, TanStack Query v5, React Hook Form with Zod, the PDS Foundation design system through Figma MCP. + *Back End*: Node 20 \+ NestJS - Node 20 LTS, NestJS or Express, TypeScript strict mode, Prisma against Postgres, BullMQ on Redis for background work, OpenAPI 3\.x contracts generated for both sides. + *Data*: Azure Postgres \+ Fabric - Azure Database for PostgreSQL Flexible Server, Azure Data Factory for orchestration, Microsoft Fabric lakehouse with Bronze/Silver/Gold layers, Power BI Premium, Python and PySpark on the data team. + *Cloud*: Microsoft Azure - App Service Premium, Function Apps, Container Apps, Service Bus with sessions, Key Vault with managed identities, Application Insights, Front Door Premium, private endpoints throughout. + *Devops*: GitHub \+ Azure DevOps - GitHub for source and PR review, Azure DevOps multi\-stage YAML pipelines for CI/CD. Trunk\-based development, required reviews, automated test gates, environment promotion via parameters. + *Infrastructure*: Bicep \+ Terraform - Bicep modules for first\-party Azure, Terraform for cross\-cloud and third\-party providers. Remote state in Azure Storage with locking, drift detection in pipelines. **Qualifications:** * **Required:** + Five\-plus years in production: building web applications. You have taken a system from greenfield to production, or rebuilt the foundations of one that needed it. + TypeScript depth: generics, conditional types, discriminated unions, branded types. You know when to reach for them and when to stop. + React expertise: hooks, render optimization, error boundaries, Suspense. You can diagnose a re\-render storm and you've written a custom hook that earned its keep. + Production Node.js: event loop awareness, streaming and backpressure, memory profiling, graceful shutdown, structured logging. + Relational data modeling: schema design, normalization tradeoffs, index strategy, partitioning, query plan analysis. You catch N\+1 in code review. + API design: REST conventions, idempotency, versioning, pagination, OpenAPI specifications, authentication patterns (OAuth 2\.0, JWT, session). + Azure or equivalent: production experience with App Service, Functions, identity, networking, observability. AWS or GCP at the same depth is fine. + CI/CD and IaC discipline: pipeline\-as\-code, environment promotion, automated test gates, infrastructure as reviewed artifacts, no clicks in the portal. * **Preferred**: + Postgres extensions in production: pg\_stat\_statements, pgvector, pgcrypto, PostGIS, logical replication. + Lakehouse and BI tooling at production scale: Microsoft Fabric, Power BI Premium with DAX, Python and PySpark on the data plane. + Event\-sourced architectures, CQRS, sagas, or domain\-driven design applied to a real codebase. + LLM\-assisted engineering: Claude Code, Cursor, or retrieval\-augmented internal tooling shipped to other engineers. + Real estate, property management, financial services, or other regulated\-industry domain experience. + RUST development experience.

jobs.title: Systems Engineer
jobs.description: Systems Engineer Job Description \| Network Headquarters Systems \& Impact Team Department: Systems \& Impact Reports to: Manager of Technology Services \& Operations Location: Hybrid with Required Days in Office in St. Louis, MO Travel: Up to 10%, predominantly to Hope Ignites affiliate locations. Employment status: Exempt Key Job Summary Hope Ignites is looking for a hands\-on Systems Engineer to be the go\-to technical resource for our infrastructure and end\-user systems. As part of a small, collaborative technology services team, you will resolve complex escalations and deliver practical improvements across Microsoft 365, identity and access, endpoints, automation, backup and recovery, and networking for Network Headquarters and our affiliates. You will report to the Manager of Technology Services \& Operations and coordinate with outside consultants. Documentation is central to this role: you will create and maintain the runbooks, configurations, and diagrams that keep our systems recoverable and our team informed. We are looking for an organized, execution\-focused problem solver who communicates clearly. **Key Responsibilities** Resolve Tier 1\-3 Issues and Strengthen the Service Desk * Handle assigned support requests and technical escalations across identity, Microsoft 365, devices, security, and infrastructure, working in Jira Service Management and communicating status clearly. * Investigate root causes and turn recurring issues into permanent fixes, automation, or self\-service options, escalating to consultants or vendors when needed. Produce and Maintain Technical Documentation * Create and maintain clear, current documentation for systems, configurations, scripts, network diagrams, credentials, dependencies, and operational runbooks so any team member or consultant can pick up the work. * Write knowledge articles, how\-to guides, and incident and project notes, and update documentation as part of every fix, change, and project. Engineer Microsoft 365 and Identity Services * Administer and improve Microsoft Entra ID, Exchange Online, SharePoint, Teams, and Defender under established standards and approved change processes, including multifactor authentication, Conditional Access, and security baselines. * Support onboarding, offboarding, licensing, and permissions, and respond to phishing, compromised accounts, and other identity incidents. Own Endpoint Engineering and Technical Hardware Support * Engineer and maintain Intune enrollment, policies, application deployment, and patching for Windows and macOS devices. * Build repeatable device setup processes and support team\-member devices, office workstations, printers, phones, and conference room technology. Build Automation and Support Integrations * Automate routine administration and support work using PowerShell, Microsoft Graph, Power Automate, and other approved tools. * Support Single Sign\-On, the Hope Ignites Application Launcher, and other integrations, keeping scripts, configurations, and runbooks documented and recoverable. jobs.title: Senior Staff Full-stack Engineer, Global Payments Network
jobs.description: Posted Date 10/29/2026 Description Senior Staff Full\-stack Engineer, Global Payments Network Capital One has grown from a promising credit card startup into a Fortune 100 company. Our businesses span Card, Retail Banking, Commercial Banking, and Financial Services, backed by an Enterprise Services group that is Capital One's digital and technology backbone. Within that enterprise, the **Global Payment Network (GPN)** is one of the company's most ambitious builds: the unification of three legacy networks — Discover Network, PULSE, and Diners Club International — into a single, modern payment network. Rather than three separate acceptance footprints, three separate data models, and three separate operating teams, GPN is being rebuilt from a clean sheet so that a card issued anywhere on the network works everywhere on the network. This is the kind of ground\-up platform build most engineers only read about — a chance to define how data moves through one of the largest payment networks in the world, not maintain what's already there. **What You'll Do:** The **Senior Staff Full\-stack Engineer (IC)** for GPN will be responsible for architecting and delivering the real\-time and batch data infrastructure that every other team on the network builds on — ingestion, streaming, the canonical data model, and the catalog and metadata layer that gives the network a single source of truth. This role sits at the cross\-section of Core Network, Fraud/AML, Analytics, and the Modeling teams building on top of this data, and offers the rare opportunity to define how a payment network's data platform gets built from the ground up rather than inheriting one. A deep understanding of distributed systems, real\-time streaming architecture, data modeling at scale, and cloud infrastructure is required. This is a highly visible and influential individual\-contributor role, with no direct reports, that requires a combination of deep technical skill, setting vision and architecture, and effective partnership across engineering, data science, product, and risk. **Key Responsibilities:** * Architect the real\-time, event\-driven data pipelines that move authorization, transaction, settlement, and fraud\-relevant events across the network with the latency and exactly\-once delivery guarantees a payment network requires — this is not a dashboard\-refresh pipeline, it is infrastructure fraud and risk decisioning will run on. * Define the canonical data model that reconciles three legacy schemes — each with its own merchant hierarchies, participant identities, and transaction semantics — into one shared model, with legacy formats translated at the network's edge only, never propagated inward. * Design and build the catalog and metadata layer (schema registry, lineage, data contracts, access policy) that gives every downstream team — fraud models, analytics, canonical modeling — one trustworthy source of truth instead of each team reverse\-engineering its own. * Set the technical architecture and standards for streaming, storage, and low\-latency serving at network scale, and serve as an evangelist for data standardization both internally and with the partner teams building on this platform. * Operate as the deep technical authority and trusted advisor across the data engineering function, reimagining what a modern, portable data platform should look like — favoring open, well\-understood components over one\-off tooling, so the platform is something new engineers can reason about on day one. * Partner directly with Fraud/AML, Analytics, and Canonical Modeling leadership so your architecture directly unblocks their roadmaps rather than trailing behind them. * Mentor and raise the technical bar for engineers across the organization, acting as a force multiplier on a brand\-new network build without owning a reporting chain of your own. **Basic Qualifications:** * Bachelor's Degree or higher in Computer Science or a related quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Engineering) * At least 9 years of experience in all of the following: + Software engineering and solution architecture + TypeScript and SPA frameworks) + Designing and building distributed HPC and ML systems + Cloud computing (AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud) + Data architecture * Deep experience designing event\-driven, real\-time streaming architectures at scale (e.g. Kafka, Flink, or equivalent) * Experience with distributed storage, catalog, and metadata/lineage systems (e.g. Iceberg, data lakehouse architectures) * Experience designing canonical  signing and building distributed HPC and ML systems + Cloud computing (AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud) + Data architecture * Deep experience lakehouse architectures) * Experience designing canonical or shared data models that unify disparate or legacy systems Experience architecting high\-availability, low\-latency distributed systems in a regulated, high\-stakes domain (payments, fraud, financial transaction processing, or similar) * ***Capital One will consider sponsoring a new qualified applicant for employment authorization for this jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: Fin, now part of Salesforce, is on a mission to help businesses provide perfect customer experiences. Our AI Agent Fin is the highest\-performing AI Customer Agent on the market today, enabling businesses to deliver impeccable, always\-on customer support across the customer journey, from service, to sales, to ecommerce. Powered by our own AI models, Fin resolves complex customer issues end\-to\-end across every channel, with minimal set\-up and integration. Fin can also be combined with our natively integrated Intercom help desk, giving modern support teams one single system. Together with Salesforce, the \#1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success, we're building the future of customer experience. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn't a buzzword, it's a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing, and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI. Ready to level up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place. Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce. **What's the opportunity?** --------------------------- As Fin becomes mission\-critical for our most strategic customers, we’re growing our team of Forward Deployed Engineers to help bridge the gap between customer needs and product innovation. As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you’ll work hands\-on with strategic customers, partnering closely with our R\&D and Go\-to\-Market teams to design and deliver high\-impact solutions. You’ll go beyond implementation \- helping shape product direction, influence roadmap decisions and ensure Fin delivers real, measurable business outcomes in complex, real\-world environments. If you’re excited by ownership, creativity and solving ambiguous problems, and want to work at the frontier of applied AI while collaborating with Product, Engineering and Go\-to\-Market teams, this role offers a rare opportunity to combine technical excellence with real customer impact. **What will I be doing?** ------------------------- * Drive adoption of Fin by helping customers unlock the power of our AI capabilities to automate and scale their support operations. * Embed deeply with strategic customers to understand their business challenges and technical requirements, and provide the insight needed to achieve outstanding results with Fin. * Work hands\-on with customers’ technical teams as a trusted technical expert, coding side\-by\-side to drive projects through to completion. * Collaborate closely with Sales, Success and Product teams to ensure seamless customer experiences, successful project delivery and actionable product feedback. * Contribute to the evolution of Forward Deployed Engineering by codifying best practices and sharing insights from customer engagements to help the team scale and grow. **What skills do I need?** -------------------------- * A strong engineering background and experience building software with real\-world usage. Experience building a SaaS product is a plus, but not a requirement. * Interest in AI and machine learning, and the ability to quickly build an understanding of novel problems, capabilities and architectures \- including their trade\-offs and limitations. * Strong cross\-functional collaboration skills, with the ability to navigate organisational boundaries and bring people together to achieve the best outcomes for our customers. * Deep knowledge of at least one high\-level programming language, such as JavaScript, Python or Ruby. It doesn’t need to be a language we use today \- great people learn quickly and can introduce us to better ways of working. * The ability to prototype and ship software quickly while maintaining a high bar for quality and a clear focus on business goals and outcomes. * Proficiency using and writing REST APIs to integrate systems effectively. * Strong communication skills. You can comfortably discuss the same topics with engineers and non\-technical audiences, adapting the depth and detail as needed. * Willingness to travel and work on\-site with customers to build strong relationships and deeply understand their needs. * Proof of eligibility to work in the United States is required. The base salary range for candidates within the Chicago area is $160,000 \- $213,300\. Actual base pay will depend on a variety of factors such as education, skills, experience, location, etc. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. All regular employees may also be eligible for the corporate bonus program or a sales incentive (target included in OTE) as well as stock in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs). **Unleash Your Potential** When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world. In the United States, compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, job level, job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, and benefits. At Fin, we want to give people what they need to do the best work of their careers. Our benefits and programs are designed to support your health and wellbeing, your family, your time away from work, and your financial future. Offerings vary by location in line with local practices and requirements. Learn more about working at Fin and the benefits we offer at fin.ai/careers. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring, Salesforce will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. **Policies** Fin has a hybrid working policy. We believe that working in person helps us stay connected, collaborate easier and create a great culture while still providing flexibility to work from home. We expect employees to be in the office at least three days per week. We have a radically open and accepting culture at Fin. We avoid spending time on divisive subjects to foster a safe and cohesive work environment for everyone. As an organization, our policy is to not advocate on behalf of the company or our employees on any social or political topics out of our internal or external communications. We respect personal opinion and expression on these topics on personal social platforms on personal time, and do not challenge or confront anyone for their views on non\-work related topics. Our goal is to focus on doing incredible work to achieve our goals and unite the company through our core values. Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non\-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

jobs.title: Senior Data & AI Engineering Consultant
jobs.description: Description: A senior Microsoft\-focused consulting role spanning discovery, architecture, engineering, governance, and client enablement. \~ Client\-Facing (Discovery/Architecture/Delivery) \~ Microsoft Cloud (Azure \& Microsoft Fabric) \~ Data Engineering (Trusted Data Foundations for Analytics \& AI) Interlink Cloud Advisors is looking for a **Senior Data \& AI Engineering Consultant** to help clients build modern, scalable data platforms on Microsoft Azure and Microsoft Fabric. In this client\-facing role, you'll lead discovery, design pragmatic architectures, and deliver end\-to\-end solutions that turn raw data into trusted, analytics\-ready datasets for BI, reporting, advanced analytics, and AI use cases. You'll work across Fabric (OneLake, Lakehouse, Warehouse) and Azure data services to ensure solutions are secure, governed, maintainable, cost\-conscious, and operationally ready. **WHAT YOU'LL DO** * Lead client discovery to understand business goals, the data landscape, constraints, and success metrics, then translate findings into a clear delivery plan. * Design and recommend data lake, lakehouse, data warehouse, and analytical data store architectures on Azure and Microsoft Fabric aligned to client needs. * Implement, or guide implementation of, ingestion, transformation, and orchestration pipelines using Microsoft Fabric experiences and Azure services such as Data Factory, Synapse, and Databricks. * Integrate data from operational systems, APIs, and third\-party sources and transform raw data into curated datasets ready for consumption. * Build and maintain analytics\-ready data models and schemas; implement enrichment, business rules, and reusable patterns for consistency across projects. * Enable multiple compute engines \- SQL, Spark/PySpark, Spark SQL, and KQL \- against shared datasets to support diverse analytics scenarios. * Prepare governed data products and reusable datasets for BI, advanced analytics, and AI use cases, including retrieval\-ready data patterns when relevant. * Establish data quality practices, including validation, reconciliation, testing, and monitoring; troubleshoot failures and continuously improve pipeline resiliency. * Optimize transformations, query performance, and pipeline execution to meet client service level and cost objectives. * Implement logging, metrics, and operational runbooks, and support deployments, cutovers, and hypercare as needed. * Design and implement security, governance, and compliance controls, including access, least privilege, data protection, and lineage across Azure and Fabric. * Facilitate workshops and communicate architecture tradeoffs, partnering with client stakeholders, architects, analysts, and BI developers to deliver trusted datasets. * Produce clear consulting deliverables, including design documents, diagrams, implementation guides, and enablement materials, to support adoption and a smooth handoff. Requirements: **Required Qualifications** * Experience designing and delivering modern analytics platforms using lakehouse and/or data warehouse patterns on Azure and/or Microsoft Fabric, including client\-facing delivery. * Strong SQL skills with experience building transformations and dimensional or analytical models. * Hands\-on experience with Spark (PySpark/Spark SQL) and/or KQL for data engineering and analytics workloads. * Experience applying software engineering practices to data solutions, including modular design, source control, automated testing, code review, and technical documentation. * Experience building reliable data pipelines, including orchestration, scheduling, error handling, and automated monitoring. * Knowledge of data quality practices, including validation, reconciliation, testing, incident triage, and root\-cause analysis. * Working knowledge of Power BI, including semantic modeling concepts, to support end\-to\-end analytics delivery; Power Apps experience is a plus. * Understanding of security and governance concepts for data platforms, including access controls, least privilege, compliance, and lineage. * Strong communication skills, with the ability to present recommendations, align stakeholders, and manage expectations in a client environment. **Preferred Qualifications** * Direct experience with Microsoft Fabric components \- OneLake, Lakehouse, Warehouse, Data Factory in Fabric, and Real\-Time Analytics/KQL databases \- including platform administration, capacity planning, and standards. * Experience with Azure services commonly used in data platforms, such as Azure Data Factory, Synapse, Databricks, ADLS Gen2, and Key Vault. * Working knowledge of Azure architecture fundamentals across identity, networking, storage, monitoring, resiliency, and cost management. * Familiarity with AI\-enablement patterns \- such as preparing governed enterprise data for Azure AI Search or Microsoft Foundry, retrieval\-augmented generation, or agent\-based solutions—is valued. Deep agent application development experience is not required. * Experience implementing CI/CD and Infrastructure as Code, including environment strategy and release management for data solutions. * Familiarity with semantic modeling and BI enablement patterns, including Power BI datasets, self\-service analytics, and governance guardrails. * Current Microsoft certifications relevant to the role are valued, especially Microsoft Certified: Fabric Data Engineer Associate (DP\-700\), Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate (PL\-300\), and, for broader architecture responsibilities, Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ\-305\). Equivalent current Microsoft credentials and experience mentoring or enabling client teams are also welcome. **About Us** Interlink is a nationally recognized IT consultancy, offering the flexibility of a small company while providing stability and benefits usually found at enterprise firms. We work with a "family first" attitude, so we look to hire motivated individuals who understand that getting work done while having fun is important. As the winner of The Best Places to Work Award for five consecutive years, we know what it takes to care for our employees and clients. **Interlink Advantage** We are the premier Microsoft Cloud consulting company based in Mason, OH. We are a team of trusted experts who know how to navigate the intricacies of Microsoft's technologies, guiding and educating clients to avoid overspending on tech licenses while optimizing their tools. At Interlink, we believe working in an innovative, fun, and collaborative environment is key to success. Get to know us and our company culture more at: http://www.interlink.com/about\-us/company\-culture. *Interlink Cloud Advisors is an equal\-opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability status.*

This includes requirements definition, prototyping, detailed design, coding, testing, deployment, and support of the day\-to\-day operation of production systems. jobs.title: AI Security Engineer
jobs.description: **Who We Are:** Interra Health is a fast\-growing healthcare technology company transforming how providers and patients navigate the prescription journey. Formed through the merger of DoseSpot, Arrive Health, and pVerify, Interra Health delivers trusted eligibility, real\-time coverage and pricing insights, prescribing tools, and pharmacy transparency at the point of care—helping providers make informed decisions and patients access the right medications with greater clarity and affordability. Backed by strong market momentum and a bold vision for the future of connected care, Interra Health offers the chance to join an innovative, mission\-driven team working at the intersection of software and healthcare to reduce friction, improve access, and make the healthcare experience better for everyone. Interra Health is expanding its use of artificial intelligence and machine learning across a fast\-moving, highly regulated healthcare market. As an AI Security Engineer on the Security Engineering team, reporting to the Lead Security Engineer, you will help secure the models, data pipelines, and AI solutions. This role is hands\-on and technical: you will assess AI systems for vulnerabilities, build guardrails against risks like prompt injection and data leakage, and partner with Engineering and Data \& Analytics to bake security into how AI is designed and shipped. You will independently assess and resolve AI security risks across multiple workflows, escalating complex or high\-impact issues to senior security leadership as appropriate. The right person is genuinely curious about how AI systems can fail, and wants to build the guardrails before something goes wrong, not after. **WHAT YOU'LL DO** * Lead security assessments of AI/ML jobs.title: Principal Engineer, AI Solutions
jobs.description: **Overview** ------------ The AI Solutions \& Transformation team builds the engineering backbone that turns Intuit's commercial strategy into production AI systems — the agentic pipelines, creative tooling, and automation that let the business move at the speed AI now demands. As Principal, you own the engineering organization behind that work: you lead the broader product development team, and you're accountable for the technical direction, delivery quality, and growth of everyone building inside this team. This is not a maintain\-the\-roadmap role. The AI landscape this team builds against changes every quarter — sometimes every month — and the job is to build a team that treats that as normal rather than disruptive: ship something real, learn fast from what the model, the tooling, or the business actually needs, pivot without drama, and build again. You'll be the person who decides what's worth doubling down on, what gets killed, and how a group of engineers and engineering leads keeps shipping enterprise\-grade AI solutions while the ground underneath them keeps moving. You'll report into GBSG Commercial organization, and you'll work in close, daily partnership with the AI Solutions product management team, who own the product bets this engineering organization builds against. That means part of the job is translating between two worlds: you need enough technical depth to set direction, make build\-vs\-pivot calls, and earn credibility with your engineers — and enough business fluency to turn product management's priorities into a technical roadmap, and explain what the team is building, and why it matters, in terms a commercial, brand\-first audience immediately understands. **Responsibilities** ### **Lead the engineering organization** * Manage and grow a team of engineering contractors and FTEs to leading the product development squads building the team's AI systems. * Set the technical direction and engineering quality bar across the full AI Solutions \& Transformation portfolio. * Own the build\-pivot\-kill calls: decide where the team doubles down, where it cuts losses, and where it re\-architects as new models, tools, and business priorities emerge. * Build the org's structure and capacity plan so it can run multiple concurrent AI initiatives without you being the bottleneck. ### **Own delivery and impact** * Be accountable for the delivery, reliability, and quality of the AI systems your organization ships into production for the commercial business. * Turn ambiguity into an execution plan: take loosely defined, fast\-changing product priorities from the AI Solutions product management team and convert them into a staffed, sequenced build plan for your team. * Establish the operating cadence — planning, prioritization, and review — that keeps a fast\-iterating AI team shipping rather than thrashing. * Serve as the escalation point for technical, delivery, or resourcing issues that need a group manager's judgment and authority to unblock. ### **Partner across the business** * Partner day\-to\-day with the AI Solutions product management team as your primary counterpart — translating product priorities into a staffed technical roadmap, and surfacing technical tradeoffs, risk, and pivots back to them in terms they can act on. * Represent engineering to brand and other cross\-functional partners on progress, risk, and the pivots the team is making and why. * Build trust with non\-technical stakeholders by communicating clearly, not just correctly. ### **Build the practice** * Establish engineering practices suited to rapid AI iteration: fast experimentation, clear criteria for scaling or killing a bet, and reusable infrastructure so each new capability ships faster than the last. * Set the hiring bar and run the interview loop for engineers and engineering leads joining the team during a period of rapid growth and change. * Coach and develop the managers and leads on your team, including Ashton and Jaga, and own their performance and career growth. **Qualifications** **What You'll Bring** --------------------- * 8\+ years of software engineering experience, including meaningful time leading engineering managers or leads (Group Manager / Senior Manager level), not just individual contributors. * Hands\-on technical depth in modern AI and agentic systems — LLMs, RAG, agent orchestration and tool use, prompt engineering * A track record of shipping production AI systems, not demos or proofs of concept, under real delivery pressure. * Demonstrated comfort with fast, repeated iteration: building something, learning it's wrong, pivoting without losing the team's momentum, and building again. * Experience managing engineering within or adjacent to a commercial, brand, or marketing organization, with the ability to translate business and brand goals into technical execution. * Strong stakeholder management and the judgment to partner with senior, non\-technical executive leadership. * Experience scaling a technical practice: hiring, leveling, interview loops, and engineering standards. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. **Preferred** ------------- * Experience building enterprise\-grade AI solutions: RAG pipelines, multi\-agent systems, content generation, compliance/QA automation, or similar agentic tooling. * Background in fintech, SaaS, or brand/creative technology. * Experience leading a team through a significant strategic or organizational pivot. * Experience managing managers specifically, rather than only a team of individual contributors.
