jobs.title: Staff AI Scientist (Fintech Risk AI/ML)
jobs.description: **Overview** ------------ **The team** ------------ Money Movement Risk AI/ML is a team of AI scientists and ML engineers in Intuit's Fintech Risk organization. Our models decide, in real time, whether money moves for small businesses on QuickBooks: card and ACH payments, money coming in, money going out, when funds are released, and how long a payment is held. Every decision has two failure modes. Approve the wrong transaction and Intuit takes a fraud or credit loss. Decline or hold the right one and a small business waits for money it has already earned. Our job is to push both down at the same time. Our mandate: **AI touches every money movement risk decision.** That covers deciding (authorize, fund, release), acting on the decision (queue, investigate, hold), and accounting for it (expected loss). **The role** ------------ You will be the technical owner of one money movement risk capability: its models, its evaluation, its production health, and its business outcome. You will design, train, validate, and ship the models yourself, and you will set direction for the scientists and engineers who build with you. This role is for an AI producer. You will build new models from first principles and put them in front of live money. It is not a role for wiring an existing LLM into a product surface. **What you will work on** ------------------------- Depending on fit and team needs, you will own one or more of these areas: * **Authorization risk.** Real\-time fraud and loss models that approve, decline, or step up card and ACH transactions, for both money coming in and money going out. * **Funding and settlement risk.** Models that decide when funds are released and how long payments are held or delayed, so good customers get paid faster and risky payments are caught before money leaves. * **Balance and account\-level money risk.** Risk on stored balances and on the accounts behind them, as more money stays inside Intuit. * **Day\-1 risk for new money products.** Risk decisioning that is ready when a new payment or funding product launches, often with almost no labeled history. * **Agentic money movement.** Transaction risk for payments and money actions initiated by AI agents and assistants: agent identity, consent, and intent. * **Risk\-ranked queueing.** Ranking cases for risk operations by dollars at risk, so analysts spend time where the loss is. **Responsibilities** **What you will do** -------------------- * **Own outcomes, not just models.** Define success in loss, approval rate, hold rate, and time\-to\-funds. Ship models that move those numbers, and own them in production. * **Solve the hard statistics of risk.** Delayed and noisy labels (chargebacks and returns arrive weeks later), extreme class imbalance, and selection bias from models whose decisions shape their own training data. Use holdouts, reject inference, and counterfactual evaluation to measure what actually happened. * **Build for adaptive adversaries.** Detect fraud rings, account takeover, and new attack patterns with graph, sequence, and anomaly\-detection methods. Test models against attackers who probe, retry, and adapt. * **Make models production\-grade.** Partner with ML engineers on real\-time features, low\-latency serving, automated retraining, and monitoring for drift, data quality, and loss. * **Turn Intuit's data into an advantage.** Build reusable, versioned features and labels from transaction, account, and network data that other models on the team can build on. * **Set the evaluation bar.** Establish offline and online evaluation, experimentation, and adversarial testing standards for your area. * **Lead across functions.** Work with risk policy, product, engineering, risk operations, and finance. Explain trade\-offs between loss and friction in plain terms and drive decisions. * **Raise the team.** Mentor senior and early\-career scientists and engineers, lead design and model reviews, and help hire. **Qualifications** **What you bring** ------------------ **Required** * 8\+ years building and deploying ML models in production, including significant work in fraud, payments, credit, or another adversarial or financial\-risk domain. * MS or PhD in Statistics, Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Operations Research, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * A track record of owning models that made real\-time, high\-stakes decisions, with measured business impact. * Deep expertise in gradient\-boosted trees, deep learning, and anomaly detection, plus the statistics to validate them: calibration, imbalance, delayed labels, and selection bias. * Strong Python and SQL, and hands\-on large\-scale feature engineering with Spark or similar. * Experience shipping models with ML engineers: real\-time features, serving, retraining, monitoring. * Sound experimental judgment in a risk setting: A/B tests, holdouts, and their limits when attackers can exploit them. * Clear communication with risk, product, and business leaders. **Preferred** * Payments risk experience: card and ACH authorization, funding, chargebacks, returns, or settlement. * Graph ML or network analysis for fraud rings and collusion. * Sequence or representation learning on transaction and behavioral data. * Experience building or evaluating LLM and agentic systems, especially for risk or operations. * Model risk management and explainability in a regulated financial\-services environment. * Experience leading a technical area across teams and mentoring scientists. **Why join** ------------ * **Your work moves real money.** Your models decide whether small businesses get paid, and how fast. * **Hard problems.** Millisecond decisions, adaptive attackers, labels that arrive weeks late, and models that shape their own training data. * **Full ownership.** Scientists here own their models from problem framing to production. Nobody hands you a spec. * **An AI\-native risk org.** We are building toward AI making every money movement risk decision, and this role helps define how. CICRS is designed to pay or deny indemnity claims against the Postal Service when there is loss or damage to insured articles in the mail stream. architects, and Java teams to design data contracts, migration plans, and real\-time/batch integration patterns. **Test Automation \& Quality Engineering:** Build and enforce comprehensive automated testing suites across the software lifecycle, utilizing Playwright for end\-to\-end and functional testing, alongside unit, regression, and performance frameworks. **DevOps \& Continuous Delivery:** and maintain code consistency using cutting\-edge developer tooling, specifically GitHub Copilot and VersionOne for Agile lifecycle management. **Qualifications** ================== **Minimum development, including Struts, JavaScript, TypeScript, JSP, HTML, JQUERY, CSS, JSON, etc. * Must expertise in Java, including J2EE, Spring framework, and Struts to maintain and expand current applications. * Must expertise with Kubernates, containerized micro\-services, event\-driven application with Kafka. * Must experience in writing functional tests with automation testing framework, like Playwright **Required Experience** * **7\+ years** of professional Java software development experience, including at least **3 years** in full\-stack engineering. * Proven track record architecting, developing, and supporting enterprise web applications and high\-throughput batch systems. * Strong hands\-on experience with Oracle database design, complex SQL query development, and ORM persistence using Hibernate within the Spring Framework. * Solid background in cloud engineering, deployment automation, and DevOps workflows on AWS. * Comprehensive experience implementing test automation across unit, functional, regression, and performance testing suites. * Hands\-on experience developing automated end\-to\-end test suites using Playwright and integrating them into Jenkins CI/CD pipelines. * Demonstrated experience delivering software within Agile/Scrum frameworks using VersionOne (Digital.ai Agility). **Required Technical Skills** * **Core Java \& Frameworks:** Advanced expertise in Java/J2EE and the Spring Framework (e.g., Spring Boot, Spring Batch). * **API Architecture:** Expert\-level capability in designing, building, securing, and maintaining scalable RESTful APIs. * **Frontend Technologies:** Strong proficiency in server\-side and client\-side web development using HTML, CSS, JavaScript/jQuery, JSON, JSP, and Apache Struts. * **Distributed Architecture:** Working knowledge of microservices patterns, container orchestration with Kubernetes, and event\-driven messaging architectures using Apache Kafka. * **AWS Cloud Services:** In\-depth knowledge of core AWS infrastructure and managed services, including EC2, ECS, SQS, ElastiCache, DynamoDB, and streaming data solutions. * **Version Control:** Strong command of modern Git workflows, repository management, and version control best practices. * **System Migration:** Ability to evaluate modern frameworks and emerging technologies to drive legacy system modernization and cloud migrations. * **AI\-Assisted Development:** Practical experience leveraging advanced AI developer tooling, specifically GitHub Copilot, to optimize code generation and delivery velocity. ### **Core Competencies \& Soft Skills** * **Migration \& Integration Communication:** Ability to articulate complex architectural concepts, reconcile legacy business logic, and collaborate smoothly across batch jobs, and database tiers. * **Quality \& Detail Focus:** Commitment to writing clean, maintainable, self\-documenting code with proactive security, automated test coverage, and documentation standards. * **Autonomous Execution:** Comfort navigating ambiguous migration requirements, balancing immediate system stability with strategic technical debt reduction. **Job Category:** Developer jobs.title: Principal Engineer, Embedded Systems & IoT
jobs.description: King Technology is a Minnesota\-based innovator that designs and manufactures smart water care solutions for pools and hot tubs. Known for its patented technologies and purpose\-driven culture, King Technology is committed to making water care easier while “Enriching Lives Daily” for customers, employees, and communities. The Principal Engineer will own the technical direction of King Technology's first company\-owned IoT device and companion mobile app. This role is the senior technical authority across the full embedded stack: device firmware, wireless connectivity, device\-to\-cloud integration, and native mobile applications, with end\-to\-end responsibility for architecture, hardware supplier selection, and delivery. This position is responsible for identifying, evaluating, and recommending the hardware supplier(s) and platform, lead firmware development on that platform, define how the device connects to King's Azure\-based cloud backend, and build the native iOS and Android experience customers use every day. The ideal candidate has spent a career shipping connected products across multiple layers of the stack, makes sound architectural decisions with incomplete information, and is comfortable owning outcomes rather than executing a predefined plan. **Essential Functions:** * Architecture \& Technical Strategy: Define and own the end\-to\-end architecture for King's IoT device, mobile app, and cloud integration, including technology choices, interfaces, security model, and long\-term roadmap. * Hardware Supplier Selection: Identify, evaluate, and recommend hardware suppliers, modules, and platforms (including development partners and contract manufacturers). Lead technical due diligence, supplier engagement, and platform bring\-up. * Firmware Development: Design, develop, test, and maintain production firmware in C/C\+\+ on ARM Cortex\-M, ESP32, or similar platforms, built on an RTOS (FreeRTOS, Zephyr, or similar). * Sensor \& Peripheral Integration: Interface with sensors and peripherals using I2C, SPI, and UART, including driver development and signal handling. * Wireless Connectivity: Implement and support BLE, Wi\-Fi, and other wireless technologies, including secure device provisioning, pairing with the mobile app, and robust reconnection behavior. * OTA \& Device Lifecycle: Design and implement secure over\-the\-air firmware updates, device provisioning, and fleet\-level lifecycle management. * Cloud \& Telemetry Integration: Define the device\-to\-cloud contract (protocols, data models, provisioning, security) and collaborate closely with King's cloud consultant(s) on the Azure\-based backend to deliver reliable telemetry and device management. * Mobile Application Development: Design and develop native iOS and Android applications that interact with the device over BLE and the cloud, hands\-on and by directing additional engineers or contractors as needed. * Dashboard Development: Contribute to internal and customer\-facing dashboards and reporting for new product analytics. * Hardware Integration \& Debugging: Troubleshoot hardware and firmware interactions using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and JTAG/SWD tools. * Security \& Compliance: Apply IoT security best practices across device, app, and cloud. Support wireless and safety regulatory certification (such as FCC and UL) with test labs and suppliers. * Product Ownership: Take full ownership of deployed firmware and app systems, including field issues, releases, and ongoing improvement. * Technical Leadership \& Collaboration: Partner with engineering, product, consultants, and external vendors. Set technical standards, mentor engineers, and help build the team as initiatives require. * Other duties as assigned **High Priority** * Deep, proven C/C\+\+ embedded development experience on production products. * Strong RTOS experience (FreeRTOS, Zephyr, or similar) on microcontroller platforms such as ARM Cortex\-M or ESP32\. * Track record of architecting and shipping connected products from concept through production, across device, mobile, and cloud layers. * Native mobile app development experience (iOS and Android). * Strong troubleshooting and debugging skills at the hardware/firmware boundary. * Experience evaluating and selecting technology vendors, hardware platforms, or contract manufacturers. * Ability to independently learn and understand existing codebases and systems. **Medium Priority** * Cloud\-connected devices and telemetry systems; experience with Azure IoT services. * Wi\-Fi and other wireless protocol experience (LoRa, cellular, or similar). * Secure OTA update and device provisioning design. * IoT security best practices (secure boot, encryption, credential management). * Python scripting and automation. * Dashboard development and data visualization. * Hardware test equipment and debugging tools (oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, JTAG/SWD). **Nice to have’s** * Experience leading or mentoring engineering teams. * Experience with FCC, UL, or similar regulatory certification of wireless products. * Experience with Embedded Linux * Experience working with outside consultants and development partners. **Job Qualifications:** * BS degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related technical field (or equivalent experience). Advanced degree a plus. * 15\+ years of professional experience in embedded systems, firmware development, or full\-stack IoT engineering, with a record of progressive technical leadership. * Professional experience developing embedded software in C/C\+\+ on RTOS\-based platforms. * Demonstrated experience delivering at least one connected product to market, spanning firmware, mobile, and cloud. * Experience with hardware debugging tools including oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and JTAG/SWD. * Excellent communication skills, including the ability to explain technical trade\-offs clearly to non\-specialists and leadership. * Highly self\-driven, quick to learn, and comfortable owning outcomes with a high degree of autonomy. * Embrace and foster company values of Excellent, Selfless, Courageous, Integrity and Safety. **Compensation:** * + Estimated annual base salary range: $175,000 – $185,000, plus eligibility for performance\-based bonus compensation. ***Relocation:*** *This position does* ***not offer relocation assistance****. Candidates must currently reside within a commutable distance or be willing to relocate at their own expense.* **What is it like working at King Technology?** Our culture is built on our Mission, Vision, and Values. They are more than words on a wall. They guide how we work, how we treat one another, and how we serve our customers every day. At King Technology, you'll find people who lead with Integrity, act with Courage, strive for Excellence, prioritize Safety, and demonstrate a Selfless attitude in their interactions with teammates, customers, and partners. These values are reflected in everyday actions, from small acts of kindness to major business decisions. We believe our differences make us stronger, and each team member contributes their own talents, experiences, and perspective to our culture. Together, we create an environment that encourages collaboration, innovation, accountability, and personal growth. We're looking for people who not only have the right skills, but who genuinely align with our values and want to make a positive impact on their team, our customers, and our community. Join us at King Technology and help shape a culture where people, purpose, and innovation thrive together.

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager, AI
jobs.description: LTK's mission is to empower the world's premium lifestyle Creators to achieve maximum economic success. We have a huge opportunity ahead of us and we're looking for team members who want to create, innovate and disrupt an industry. We empower our team members to drive innovation, create value, and continue to spearhead the creation of this industry — a game changer when it comes to career growth. **Position Title**: Principal Product Manager, AI **About the role** For more than a decade, LTK has helped shape the creator economy by connecting thousands of creators and brands with millions of consumers. Today, our platform powers more than $6 billion in annual retail sales. Behind that scale is over a decade of commerce data on how people discover products, how creators influence purchasing decisions, and how brands and consumers connect. As **Principal Product Manager, AI,** you'll use that foundation to shape the next generation of creator and agentic commerce. You'll define how AI helps brands find the right creators, turns commerce intelligence into better decisions, and enables agents to work on behalf of customers—always with their goals in mind. Your scope will span LTK's Creator Management Platform (CMP) agent harness and LLM judges, in\-house ML models, and the proprietary knowledge graph connecting our creator, brand, campaign, and marketplace intelligence. This is a deeply technical role and one of LTK's most senior individual contributor product positions, paired directly with our Machine Learning and Data Science team. You'll work together to define model capabilities, shape data and system requirements, establish rigorous evaluations, and make trade\-offs across quality, reliability, latency, and cost. With influence across product strategy, technical direction, and investment decisions, you'll turn LTK's data and relationships into products that change how creators build businesses, brands reach customers, and consumers shop. **How you will make an impact** * **Define the long\-term vision and multi\-quarter AI product strategy** for LTK's proprietary ML models, agent infrastructure, and evaluation systems, including the agent harness for our customer\-facing experiences, LLM judges, and proprietary knowledge graph. * **Work directly with Machine Learning and Data Science teams** to translate customer problems into model capabilities and experiments, and shape the data quality, coverage, and feedback loops that improve model performance over time. Partner with Engineering on model selection, retrieval, tool use, and build\-versus\-buy decisions, balancing quality, reliability, latency, and cost. * **Define how agents understand customer goals and act on their behalf**, including the tools and information they can access, when they need approval, and how customers understand, control, and override their actions. Build privacy, transparency, and appropriate human oversight into these experiences. * **Own product evaluation and launch criteria**, partnering with Machine Learning and Data Science to build representative evaluation datasets, investigate failures, and monitor quality in production across task success, reliability, latency, and cost. * **Raise the bar for AI evaluation across LTK**. Stay close to emerging research and industry guidance on evaluating non\-deterministic experiences, test new approaches, and evolve shared frameworks, tools, and quality standards. Help other PMs build effective evaluations and strengthen launch readiness and production monitoring. * **Partner closely with Product leads across LTK** to identify where AI can deliver the greatest value for creators, brands, and consumers. Translate customer needs into a focused set of opportunities for new models, agent capabilities, and shared infrastructure, then work together to validate their impact and bring them into customer\-facing products. * **Champion responsible AI development,** balancing innovation with reliability, privacy, transparency, and appropriate human oversight. * **Elevate AI\-native product thinking across teams,** influencing senior leaders and helping shape LTK's long\-term AI opportunities. **What you will bring to LTK** * 8\+ years of Product Management experience, including ownership of complex technical products, multi\-quarter strategy, and demonstrated influence on product direction and business outcomes across teams. * Demonstrated experience shipping and improving AI/ML products in production, including LLM applications, AI agents, or model\-backed workflows, with measurable customer adoption and business impact. * Strong technical fluency and experience working directly with ML engineers and applied scientists to define model requirements, guide experiments, and translate results into product decisions. You can point to concrete contributions involving model behavior, system architecture, data quality, reliability, latency, and cost. * Deep expertise in evaluating AI\-powered products, including non\-deterministic model and agent behavior. You've built evaluation frameworks, investigated failure patterns, and helped teams adopt better evaluation practices. You actively follow advances in AI evaluation and can distinguish promising new approaches from those ready for production use. * Hands\-on experience using prototypes, evaluation tools, and data analysis to validate product ideas, diagnose AI behavior, and improve product quality. * Strong product judgment, with the ability to identify valuable AI opportunities, translate complex technical capabilities into intuitive customer experiences, and balance innovation with business priorities and technical constraints. * Demonstrated experience leading complex, cross\-functional initiatives, influencing strategic product and investment decisions, and building alignment with senior leaders without direct authority. * Understanding of responsible AI product development, including reliability, privacy, safety, transparency, and appropriate human oversight. * Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience. * A mindset focused on seizing opportunities and moving with urgency * Dedication to fierce prioritization and operational excellence * Adaptability to a dynamic, fast\-moving environment * A growth mindset and openness to feedback\#LI\-KB1 ### **What we offer for full\-time salaried employees** * The opportunity to be part of the leading global company in creator commerce * A remote\-first, productivity\-first environment * Competitive compensation and benefits package to meet the needs of you and your family * 401(k) with LTK company matching * Medical Insurance, Vision Insurance, Dental Insurance * Paid Maternity Leave and Paid Paternity Leave * Summer Fridays and Flexible PTO * For temporary full\-time employees, benefits eligibility may vary ### **About LTK** Founded in 2011, LTK is the global technology platform purpose\-built to empower lifestyle creators to monetize their content. The full\-service platform connects brands, creators, and shoppers with a world\-class shopping app and trusted tools and technology that make content instantly shoppable. Today, premium lifestyle creators in 160\+ countries drive more than $5 billion\+ in annual retail sales through their LTK Shop profiles. More than 40 million consumers turn to LTK Shops in the LTK shopping platform each month to find inspiration and instantly shop the styles recommended by their favorite creators. More than 8,000 retailers and 1M brands partner with LTK to gain access to its global creator network for content that converts against performance\-driven, cross\-channel KPIs. LTK is headquartered in Dallas, TX, and currently operates on five continents. ### **Our mission** To empower the world's premium lifestyle Creators to achieve maximum economic success. ### **Our values** * Here to win * Commit to the journey * Work well ### **Commitment to diversity** LTK believes diversity, equity, and inclusion are fundamental obligations that strengthen our team. We employ a diverse, multi\-disciplinary team to build a meaningful company and culture. *For US\-Based Roles: We are not offering new sponsorships opportunities at this time for persons requiring employment visas, such as an H\-1B; authorization to work in the U.S. is a precondition of employment.* *Any unsolicited resumes/candidate profiles submitted through our website or to personal email accounts of employees of LTK are considered the property of LTK and are not subject to payment of agency fees*. *LTK is an Equal Opportunity Employer.* \#LI\-Remote

translate their needs into data solutions. * You build sound relationships, communicate effectively, and can influence, motivate, and train others while handling sensitive information with care. * Most importantly, you value dependable data and the practical insights it enables. **What You'll Bring** * Five to eight years of similar or related experience. * A bachelor’s degree, or formal industry\-recognized certifications considered equivalent to a bachelor’s degree, such as qualifying information technology certifications. * The ability to maintain and evolve a data platform built on Microsoft Fabric and Azure. * The ability to support data engineering and ETL workflows that ingest core banking data, APIs, and flat files into OneLake. * The ability to maintain and evolve data models across business units, including loans, deposits, and general ledger domains. * The ability to develop and maintain dashboards and reports using Tableau or similar business intelligence tools. to support technical and business stakeholders. **What We Offer** * Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits * Retirement savings and employer contributions * Generous paid time off * jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff - ML Research Engineer, Pre-Training Data
jobs.description: **Location** ------------ San Francisco **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- Hybrid **Department** -------------- Research \& Engineering Overview **About Liquid AI** ------------------- Spun out of MIT CSAIL, we build general\-purpose AI systems that run efficiently across deployment targets, from data center accelerators to on\-device hardware, ensuring low latency, minimal memory usage, privacy, and reliability. We partner with enterprises across consumer electronics, automotive, life sciences, and financial services. We are scaling rapidly and need exceptional people to help us get there. **The Opportunity** ------------------- You'll join the Pre\-Training Data team, which decides what Liquid Foundation Models learn from: which data we source, filter, synthesize, and mix, and in what order. Public data sources are plateauing, so model quality increasingly depends on purpose\-built datasets and on knowing which data changes actually help. We treat data as a research problem, not an infrastructure problem. You'll work alongside our pre\-training researchers on a small team, run the experiments that settle data questions, and build the pipelines that carry the answers into training runs. **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- We need someone who: * **Thinks like a researcher, ships like an engineer:** You build the pipelines and you make the model\-facing calls about what goes into them. You don't hand off either half. * **Leads with a hypothesis:** Before changing a dataset, you can say what it should do to the model, what you'll measure, and what could fool you, such as contamination or a noisy benchmark. You hold views on pre\-training pitfalls, and you test them. * **Owns problems end to end:** You take ambiguous work from open question to shipped result with little direction or process, do the unglamorous parts that get it there, and don't care whose job it was. **The Work** ------------ * Source web\-scale and public datasets, and build the pipelines that filter, deduplicate, and decontaminate them * Design data mixtures and curricula for pre\-training and midtraining, and decide what goes into each run * Build synthetic data generation systems using LLMs, structured prompting, and distillation to cover what web data can't * Run proxy experiments and ablations to measure what each data change does to model quality, and decide what scales up * Build evaluation sets you can trust, and keep data lineage clear enough that any training run can be traced and reproduced **Experience \& Capabilities** ------------------------------ **What you'll need:** * Deep, hands\-on pre\-training data work you did yourself: web\-scale sourcing and curation, synthetic data generation, mixing and curriculum design, deduplication and decontamination. This is where depth matters most. * The ability to reason from a data decision to its effect on training: how data interacts with model size, architecture, and training dynamics, why more data can hurt, and which changes matter as models scale * Experiments you designed to test data changes, such as baselines, scaling ladders, small\-scale proxies, and held\-out loss, with a clear account of what a change did and why * Production data pipelines you built and owned, not only research prototypes * Solid ML fundamentals: you've trained, evaluated, and iterated on models in Python (PyTorch preferred) * 3\+ years of relevant experience with an M.S., 1\+ year with a Ph.D., or 5\+ years with a B.S. **Helpful, not required:** * Distillation, long\-context, or architecture\-specific data strategy * Designing evaluation frameworks and benchmarks for pretrained models * Data work across both pre\-training and post\-training * Small, efficient models or on\-device deployment * Startup experience, or a track record of connecting model work to product needs **What Success Looks Like (Year One)** -------------------------------------- * You own a critical pre\-training data pipeline end to end * Data systems you built or improved have measurably moved model performance * You've identified and integrated at least one external dataset that moved the needle **What We Offer** ----------------- * **Upstream of every model:** Pre\-training data shapes every Liquid Foundation Model. On a small team, the mixtures, filters, and synthetic data you build go straight into the models we ship. * **Compensation \& Equity:** Competitive base salary plus equity, so you share in what we build. Final offers reflect skills, experience, and location. * **Time Off:** Unlimited PTO, plus company\-wide Refill Days, long weekends when the whole company rests together. * **Health \& Wellbeing:** Comprehensive health coverage, with details varying by location. * **Paid Leave:** Paid leave for pregnancy, parenting, medical needs, and caring for family.

jobs.title: Software Engineer (Time & Billing)
jobs.description: **About Us** At Litify, we're powering a new era for the legal industry. Since its founding in 2016, Litify has helped law firms and corporate legal departments turn operations into impact through its leading AI\-native Platform of Action. Over 55K legal professionals and 450\+ enterprise clients across plaintiff, insurance defense, immigration, and the Fortune 500 trust Litify to combine cloud\-based technology, configurable AI\-native workflows, agentic AI, and powerful business analytics into one open ecosystem that moves legal teams from systems of record to systems of action. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and recognized as an Inc. 5000 and Deloitte Technology Fast 500 fastest\-growing private company, Litify is at the center of legal innovation. Headquartered in New York, we're building the last legal platform our customers will ever need. **About the Team** Lawyers bill in six\-minute increments, and every one of them counts. Litify Time \& Billing turns that time into revenue: time entry, billing rules and rates, pre\-bills and invoices, payments, e\-billing, and a two\-way sync with Accounting Seed. If you like problems where a rounding rule matters and an invoice has to be right every time, this is your team. **About the Role** Litify is looking for a Software Engineer to join our Time \& Billing team. The code you ship decides how firms capture their time, bill their clients, and get paid. We recently integrated with an AI time\-capture partner, so the work lawyers do during the day becomes time entries that flow straight into billing. That is the kind of work this team takes on, and on a small team, your part in it is visible. We want a strong, versatile engineer who works across the stack and is eager to dig into new technologies. Our product runs on Salesforce. Prior Salesforce experience isn't required: if you come from Java, C\#, TypeScript, or a similar stack, senior engineers on the team will help you learn the platform. **AI\-assisted development is how this team works.** We use AI coding assistants every day to plan, write, test, and review code. We want someone who already builds this way, knows how to check what the assistant produces, works within solid guardrails, and helps teammates do the same. AI makes each of us faster, but the team still designs, reviews, and decides together. **How we work:** We value speed and follow\-through. If you like shipping steadily and seeing your impact in the numbers, you will fit in here. * We are a team of four engineers, part of a team of nine with an engineering manager, a product manager, a UX designer, and two QA engineers * We work in two\-week agile sprints, where engineers and Product refine the work together and we estimate story points as a team * We track what we complete each week and look at how AI helps us deliver more * Features start from Figma designs and go through full QA and a package regression pass before each release * We ship three major releases a year as Salesforce managed packages, plus patch releases, on a set schedule rather than through continuous deployment * We keep meetings to a minimum and work through Jira and Slack **In this role, you will:** * Design and build features for time capture, billing, and invoicing, from the data model to the UI * Help lead how the team builds with AI, from agent workflows and shared prompts to review practices * Build and maintain integrations, from our Accounting Seed sync to AI time\-capture partners * Help build, test, and ship our releases * Go beyond the code: help shape requirements with Product, test your work end to end with QA, and refine UI details with UX * Contribute to project documentation and knowledge bases **To be successful in this role, you have (required):** * 4\+ years of experience with a typed back\-end language (for example Java, C\#, TypeScript) * Front\-end experience with modern JavaScript, a component framework such as React, and CSS styling * Solid data modeling and SQL skills, including working with large data sets and designing code that scales * A habit of writing tests * Daily, hands\-on experience building software with AI coding assistants * An ability to communicate clearly with Engineering and Product, including teammates in other time zones **Nice\-to\-have:** * Prior experience developing on Salesforce (Apex, Lightning Web Components, SOQL), or Salesforce Administrator or Platform Developer certifications * Experience at a Salesforce ISV, such as releasing managed packages and passing security review * Legal billing knowledge, such as fee arrangements, rates, write\-downs, and LEDES e\-billing * Experience with Accounting Seed or another finance or ERP product * Experience building AI tooling, such as custom agents, MCP servers, or shared prompt libraries **Where you can grow:** * Learn the Salesforce platform with support from senior engineers * Use professional development funds for courses, conferences, and certifications, including Salesforce certifications * Grow into owning an area of the product, from design through release * Help shape the team's AI practices and grow into leading them * Build toward a senior role at a company that likes to promote from within **Disclosure:** This job is fully remote, with the exception of employees living in New York City and New Jersey. Our NYC/NJ employees adhere to our hybrid schedule, which involves working in our Manhattan office 6 days a month. The estimated base salary for this role is $115\-120k. You may also be offered a bonus and benefits. Our salary ranges are based on paying competitively for our size and industry, and are one part of many compensation, benefits and other reward opportunities we provide. Individual pay rate decisions are based on a number of factors, including qualifications for the role, experience level, skill set, and balancing internal equity relative to peers at the company.

responsibility for the reliability and performance of Loft's ground platform infrastructure**, including message queues, CI/CD, and observability * **Have the opportunity to take part in spacecraft Loki, etc) * Familiarity with AI tooling * Frontend development with Vue and Web Components ### **Some of Our Awesome Benefits:** * 100% company\-paid medical, dental, and vision insurance option for Disability insurance * Flexible Time Off policy for vacation and sick leave, and 12 paid holidays * 401(k) plan and equity options * Daily catered lunches and snacks * International exposure to our jobs.title: Sales Enablement and Operations Lead
jobs.description: **About Us** ------------ Lorikeet is redefining what customer support looks like — and we're just getting started. We build AI that handles complex, high\-volume support for fintechs, healthtechs, marketplaces, and delivery services. Not chatbot\-tier AI. The kind that actually resolves tickets, gives support teams their time back, and raises the bar for what software can do. We're backed by over $50M USD from QED, Blackbird, and Square Peg, with backing from operators like Claire Hughes Johnson (ex\-Stripe COO) and Cristina Cordova (Linear COO), plus founders of Canva, Atlassian, and Airwallex. We're the first company since Canva to be funded at early stage by all three of Australia's top VC funds — which tells you something about the calibre of people who've looked closely at what we're building and said yes. Our customers include some of the largest telehealth, fintech, and marketplace companies in the US and Australia — many handling over a million support tickets a year. The problems are real, the scale is real, and the work matters. If you want to build something that genuinely changes how businesses and customers interact — this is the place. **About the role** ------------------ We're hiring our first Sales Enablement \& Operations team member. Our go\-to\-market team is growing fast (AEs, a new BDR team, demand gen, and a GTM Engineer), and the systems, processes, and knowledge that got us here were built by founders on the fly. This role exists to turn that into a real operating engine: one where every rep ramps quickly, knows exactly how to tell the Lorikeet story, and spends their time selling instead of fighting the CRM. You'll own training, operations, and process not just for sales, but for our Forward Deployed team too. We sell into regulated, high\-stakes businesses, and our buyers are sharp. A Head of Support at a telehealth company wants to know how the AI handles a compliance edge case; a fintech CX leader wants proof it won't get someone's money stuck. Our reps need to go deep on product, industry, and objections, and you'll be the person who makes sure they can. You'll sit at the centre of sales, marketing, product, and our Forward Deployed team, and you'll own both sides of the job: the *enablement* (onboarding, playbooks, messaging, coaching) and the *operations* (CRM, pipeline hygiene, forecasting, reporting, tooling). **What You'll Do:** ------------------- * Own onboarding and training for every new GTM and Forward Deployed hire. Design a ramp program that gets AEs, BDRs, and Forward Deployed team members confident in front of customers in weeks, not quarters * Build and maintain the sales playbook: ICP and personas, discovery frameworks, qualification criteria, objection handling, competitive positioning, and vertical\-specific plays for fintech, healthtech, marketplaces, and delivery * Turn product launches and customer wins into enablement: talk tracks, demo flows, case studies, and battlecards reps actually use * Own the CRM as the source of truth: pipeline stages, required fields, deal hygiene, and the automations that keep it clean without nagging * Run the pipeline and forecasting cadence with sales leadership: weekly pipeline reviews, dashboards, and the metrics that tell us where deals stall and why * Manage the GTM tool stack (CRM, sequencing, call recording, enrichment, etc.) and decide what we add, cut, or build ourselves * Partner with our GTM Engineer to build AI\-powered workflows with Claude Code: deal summaries, call insights, account research, automated CRM updates, rep coaching * Use call recordings and win/loss data to spot patterns, coach to them, and feed what you learn back into product and marketing * Support territory planning, quota setting, and comp plan mechanics as the team scales **You might be a fit if you:** ------------------------------ * Understand what it takes to sell, whether from a sales role yourself or from working closely alongside reps in enablement or ops (ideally in B2B SaaS) * Have experience building an enablement program from the ground up * Are equally at home running a training session and building a pipeline report. You like both the people side and the systems side * Get genuinely annoyed by messy data and broken processes, and fix them rather than work around them * Can take a complex, technical product and make it simple for reps to explain (and for buyers to understand) * Are already using AI to automate parts of your work and want to go much further (bonus points if you've built something for yourself or your team) * Are comfortable owning things end\-to\-end without a playbook, because you'll be writing it * Earn trust with reps by making their lives easier, not by adding process for its own sake **Nice to have:** experience selling into or enabling teams that sell to customer support / CX leaders, or into fintech, healthcare, or other regulated industries. **What's unique about this opportunity?** ----------------------------------------- **A culture that's genuinely different.** Low ego, high trust, no tolerance for talented jerks. We work efficiently, keep hours flexible, and actually mean it — because life outside work matters. We're committed to building a diverse team and actively encourage applicants from underrepresented backgrounds. We care far more about user obsession and eagerness to learn than traditional credentials. **A front\-row seat to building something meaningful.** We're Series A and moving fast. You'll have real scope to shape the product and the company — not just execute someone else's vision. **Performance recognized in real time, not on a calendar.** Promotions happen when you're ready — leadership meets every six weeks specifically to identify and recognize strong performers, so you're never waiting for an arbitrary review window to move up. **We're AI\-native, and we'll make you AI\-native too.** Every person at Lorikeet uses AI in their day\-to\-day work (current favourite: Claude Code), with unrestricted access and no usage limits. You'll leave with skills that matter for the next decade of work. **Twice a year, the whole company flies to Hawaii.** Headquartered in Sydney, with teams spanning the US and UK — which means getting everyone in the same place is something we invest in seriously. We spend the time hacking on ideas, building things together that wouldn't otherwise exist, and making memories that remind you why you joined a startup in the first place. **A recruitment process built on respect, not hoops.** We keep it simple: a couple of informal chats to share our story and hear yours, followed by a paid \~two\-day work trial. The work trial is genuinely the best part — you'll work on real problems alongside the actual team, get a true feel for how we operate, and we'll both come out of it knowing whether this is the right fit. No trick questions, no take\-homes that disappear into a void. Just real work, done together. If you're from an underrepresented background and don't tick every box, please reach out anyway. We know firsthand that diverse teams perform better, and we're proud that our team reflects a broad spectrum of identities and lived experiences.

jobs.title: Firmware Engineer
jobs.description: At Luna Innovations, we measure and manage light in optical fiber. Our Optics/Polarization product line, based in Chino, CA, specializes in industry\-leading components, modules, and test equipment for the characterization and control of optical polarization. Our instruments, ranging from dynamic optical delay/phase management and high\-speed polarization state management to full\-function polarization light analyzers, are critical for optical communications, silicon photonics testing, and fiber optic sensing. **Role Overview** We are seeking a Firmware Engineer II, with flexibility to hire at the Senior level for the right candidate, to join the engineering team for our photonics instrumentation. Final level and pay will be based on experience, skills, and qualifications. You will write the embedded firmware that controls precision optical components, drives high\-speed data acquisition, and enables communication between our instruments and host software. You will work closely with hardware, optical, and software engineers to bring up new boards and turn new instrument designs into reliable products. If you enjoy working close to the hardware and want to build the firmware behind state\-of\-the\-art optical test equipment, we want you on our team. **Key Responsibilities** * **Firmware Architecture \& Design**: Design, develop, and maintain firmware for embedded systems, including bare\-metal and real\-time platforms. * **Embedded Hardware Integration**: Interpret electrical schematics and IC datasheets to understand hardware functionality, develop firmware interfaces, and support embedded system integration. * **Real\-Time Control \& Data Streaming**: Develop real\-time firmware for precise timing, closed\-loop control, high\-speed data acquisition, data processing, and streaming between embedded hardware and host systems. * **Board Bring\-Up \& Debug**: Bring up new boards in the lab with the hardware team and troubleshoot firmware and hardware issues. * **Hardware–Software Interface**: Integrate communication protocols and command interfaces between embedded instruments and host applications, working closely with hardware and software teams. * **Documentation \& Testing**: Create and maintain firmware requirements, design documents, test plans, and release procedures. **Required Qualifications: Firmware Engineer II** * Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, or a closely related engineering discipline. * 3\+ years of professional embedded firmware development experience, ideally for instruments, test equipment, or other hardware products. * Proficiency in embedded C/C\+\+ programming. * Experience with Git and version control. * Experience with microcontroller or ARM\-based systems, including bare\-metal firmware or real\-time operating systems (RTOS). * Experience developing firmware for hardware interfaces, data acquisition, and real\-time control, including timing\-sensitive operations and hardware–firmware integration. * Ability to read electrical schematics and hardware datasheets. * Hands\-on experience with PCB bring\-up, hardware troubleshooting, and firmware debugging using laboratory test equipment, including oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and JTAG debuggers. * Strong communication skills and ability to work in a fast\-paced, team\-oriented environment. **Additional Required Qualifications: Senior Firmware Engineer** * 5\+ years of professional embedded firmware development experience. * Experience designing firmware architecture for embedded systems, including real\-time control, hardware interfaces, or data acquisition. * Hands\-on experience with FPGA development using Verilog/VHDL, including design, simulation, debugging, and hardware integration, or equivalent FPGA development experience on processor–FPGA SoC platforms. * Working knowledge of processor–FPGA SoC integration, including hardware–software interfaces and system\-level integration. * Ability to lead technical design decisions and mentor other engineers. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with embedded Linux development and maintenance, including BSP, Device Tree, and hardware integration. * Experience with high\-speed communication interfaces. * Experience with digital signal processing or numerical computation. * Experience with firmware build automation, continuous integration, or automated testing. * Experience with instrument communication protocols. * Experience developing firmware for scientific instruments, industrial automation, or other electronic hardware products. **Equal Employment Opportunity** Luna is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. Luna will consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records in accordance with the California Fair Chance Act.

jobs.title: Fleet Operations & Analytics Engineer
jobs.description: ### **About Mainspring** Mainspring Energy manufactures and delivers fuel\-flexible, low\-emissions local power solutions that rapidly add new capacity and deliver reliable, affordable, and sustainable electric power. The company began commercial shipments of its Mainspring Linear Generators in 2020 and today has hundreds of megawatts in advanced development and field operations for leading Fortune 500 companies, data centers, and utilities. Mainspring also partners with global energy leaders including AEP, NextEra Energy Resources, Schneider Electric, and more. The core values that ground our work, guide our decisions, and connect us together: * Pragmatic Optimism * Excellence without Ego * Proactive Collaboration ### **Job Overview** The Linear Generator is a sophisticated, automated, and integrated system spanning a wide range of engineering disciplines including thermodynamics, mechanical, electrical, software, and controls. As a member of our Fleet Operations \& Analytics Team, you will be part of a dynamic group that delivers the best product and experience that Mainspring Energy has to offer. This includes operation and monitoring of our fleet of Linear Generators (LGens), debugging issues, management of incident resolution and advanced data analysis aimed at improving our product and communicating on our fleet performance. This is a highly cross\-functional role in a rapidly\-scaling company function, and there is an enormous opportunity to influence how this work is done now and into the future. The breadth of this role is perfect for an engineer who wants to use their advanced analytical and technical skills in a fast\-paced and challenging environment. We are looking for an ambitious and curious individual excited to work at the interface of operations, systems engineering, and analytics. ### **Responsibilities** * Manage daily operations of Mainspring Energy’s growing Linear Generator fleet, including remote operation, troubleshooting, and incident resolution * Contribute to a cross\-functional team that designs, implements, and uses a compliance metrics and ensure ongoing adherence to regulatory requirements * Identify and communicate major opportunities for performance and reliability improvements * Track and document operational issues along with their root causes and resolutions * Generate accurate, detailed data reports for customers and regulatory agencies * Improve automation and reporting workflows by developing and assurance, reliability engineering, product validation, test engineering, and software development * Support team growth by helping to identify, onboard, and train new team members in a rapidly scaling organization ### **Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in an engineering discipline, preferably in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering * Demonstrated ability to build and maintain highly disciplined operations and training processes, including methodical workflow documentation, clear hand\-off communication, and detailed incident reporting/analysis * Strong organizational skills and tools and processes (Python preferred) This position is **Hybrid/Menlo Park** or **Remote/East Coast**.The salary will be adjusted to reflect local market conditions based on employee location as well group IT leaders on a dotted line * **Enterprise:** 11 business groups, 120\+ businesses, 28,000\+ employees, $14B\+ revenue * **Key partners:** Business group presidents, corporate functions, jobs.title: Research Engineer - AI Safety Systems and Guardrails
jobs.description: We are seeking an experienced Research Engineer to join the System Safety team within Product \& Applied Research org at Meta Superintelligence Labs. This role will focus on researching and developing advanced machine learning models, novel algorithms, and scalable systems that improve the safety of Meta's AI products, including Meta AI and conversational, multimodal, and agentic experiences.You will bring current AI safety research into practical product safeguards, with a primary focus on guardrails, policy\-adaptable risk detection, adversarial robustness, and safe agent behavior. This is a hands\-on technical leadership role with end\-to\-end ownership of a significant safety area—from setting research direction and developing methods through rigorous evaluation, cross\-team language models, multimodal models, and AI agents, addressing harmful assistance, jailbreaks, prompt injection, unsafe tool use, and unauthorized information disclosure across individual interactions and complete agent tasks * Set the technical direction and research roadmap for a significant system safety area, leading complex initiatives across research, alignment, evaluation, product, and infrastructure teams * Architect and optimize reusable safety components and machine learning pipelines, combining learned detection with explicit runtime controls and delivering scalable, low\-latency safeguards for real\-world applications * Develop high\-quality training data, synthetic and adversarial examples, and representative benign cases * conduct rigorous experimentation, ablation studies, and independent held\-out evaluation to improve safety, generalization, and robustness * Measure the effectiveness of safeguards within the fully deployed system, balancing risk reduction with false refusals, legitimate task completion, privacy, latency, cost, and reliability * Collaborate closely with model researchers, product managers, engineers, and evaluation, security, and policy partners to translate product needs and safety requirements into validated, production\-ready solutions * Monitor, maintain, and iterate on deployed safety models and systems, using approved data and privacy\-preserving workflows to identify emerging failure patterns, create regression tests, and drive lasting system or model improvements * Stay at the forefront of research and industry trends in AI safety, LLMs, multimodal modeling, adversarial robustness, and agentic systems * reproduce, critically evaluate, and extend promising methods for product deployment. Mentor engineers and researchers to influence architecture and research decisions, and communicate findings through technical documentation, internal presentations, and external publications where appropriate ### **Minimum Qualifications:** * Proven track record of research in one or more of the following areas: AI safety, deep learning, adversarial robustness, language models, multimodal machine learning, or agentic AI, demonstrated through original or materially improved methods and rigorous experimental evidence * 3\+ years of experience in deploying machine learning models and systems at scale in an industry setting * Demonstrated up\-to\-date expertise in relevant machine learning research advancements, including the ability to reproduce, critically evaluate, and adapt emerging methods to real\-world systems * Hands\-on programming experience in Python and deep\-learning frameworks such as PyTorch, including developing, training or fine\-tuning, debugging, and evaluating machine learning models * Demonstrated experience independently defining technical direction and leading complex research or machine learning initiatives end\-to\-end, aligning multiple researchers ### **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience developing AI safety guardrails, policy\-adaptable classifiers, reliable model\-based judges, or adversarial defenses for deployed AI systems evaluation * Experience with efficient model inference, distillation, cascaded models, or distributed ML systems under latency, throughput, cost, and reliability constraints ### **About Meta:** Meta jobs.title: Continuous Improvement Engineer
jobs.description: SPF America is adding a Continuous Improvement Engineer to our team! We are a precision fabrication/contract manufacturing facility serving OEM markets and have operated in Fort Smith, AR since 1977\. At SPF America, our Continuous Improvement program is the heartbeat of our operational success. We are looking for a hands\-on Continuous Improvement Engineer to lead and elevate the CI program at our Fort Smith manufacturing facility. In this role, you will be the bridge between data\-driven strategy and shop floor reality. You will spend a significant portion of your time on the floor, engaging directly with our machine operators, understanding their challenges, and leading Kaizen initiatives to make their work safer, easier, and more efficient. **Key Responsibilities** * **Champion the 5S Program:** Lead, sustain, and audit our 5S initiatives across the shop floor, ensuring a safe, organized, and highly efficient working environment. * **Lead Kaizen Events:** Facilitate continuous improvement events, engaging cross\-functional teams to identify root causes and implement sustainable, practical solutions. * **Empower the Shop Floor:** Meet daily with machine operators and production staff to gather feedback, build trust, and collaboratively solve process bottlenecks. * **Process \& Data Analysis:** Perform data analysis on production metrics, time studies, and operational workflows to identify high\-impact areas for improvement. * **Project Management:** Take ownership of various shop improvement projects from initial concept through execution and standardization. * **Technology Adoption:** Learn and utilize our internal technology stack (including our ERP system and digital dashboards) to support and track CI initiatives. **What We’re Looking For** * **Experience Level:** 2 to 4 years of experience in a manufacturing environment driving continuous improvement. *(Note: Highly motivated entry\-level candidates with a strong aptitude for Lean and manufacturing processes are also encouraged to apply; we are willing to train the right person).* * **Exceptional People Skills:** You must be highly approachable, emotionally intelligent, and capable of communicating effectively with everyone from frontline operators to management. * **Lean Foundation:** Practical experience with core Lean tools, specifically 5S, Kaizen, and root cause analysis. * **Analytical Mindset:** Comfortable working with data to guide decision\-making, coupled with the practical sense to apply those insights on the factory floor. **Eagerness to Learn:** No prior experience with our specific software stack (CAD, ERP, automation platforms) is required on Day 1—we will provide comprehensive training. You just need the willingness to dive in and learn. If you have a strong foundation in Lean principles, excellent people skills, and a hunger to learn our custom technology stack, we want you on our team. Scheduling interviews quickly so apply now! jobs.title: Network Technician
jobs.description: **Company Overview** -------------------- Milestone Technologies is a global IT managed services firm that partners with organizations to scale their technology, infrastructure and services to drive specific business outcomes such as digital transformation, innovation, and operational agility. Milestone is focused on building an employee\-first, performance\-based culture and for over 25 years, we have a demonstrated history of supporting category\-defining enterprise clients that are growing ahead of the market. The company specializes in providing solutions across Application Services and Consulting, Digital Product Engineering, Digital Workplace Services, Private Cloud Services, AI/Automation, and ServiceNow. Milestone culture is built to provide a collaborative, inclusive environment that supports employees and empowers them to reach their full potential. Our seasoned professionals deliver services based on Milestone’s best practices and service delivery framework. By leveraging our vast knowledge base to execute initiatives, we deliver both short\-term and long\-term value to our clients and apply continuous service improvement to deliver transformational benefits to IT. With Intelligent Automation, Milestone helps businesses further accelerate their IT transformation. The result is a sharper focus on business objectives and a dramatic improvement in employee productivity. Through our key technology partnerships and our people\-first approach, Milestone continues to deliver industry\-leading innovation to our clients. With more than 3,000 employees serving over 200 companies worldwide, we are following our mission of revolutionizing the way IT is deployed. **Job Overview** ---------------- The Network Technician is responsible for supporting the physical\-layer network infrastructure within hyperscale AI and accelerated computing data center environments. This role focuses on deployment, maintenance, troubleshooting, and lifecycle management of structured cabling systems, fiber plant infrastructure, optics, network hardware, out\-of\-band (OOB) management networks, and console connectivity systems. The Network Technician serves as the primary onsite resource for physical network operations, ensuring the reliability and integrity of the network infrastructure supporting mission\-critical computing environments. The role works closely with customer network engineering teams, data center operations personnel, OEM partners, and deployment teams to support network expansion, break\-fix activities, and operational readiness. This position requires strong technical discipline, attention to detail, and the ability to execute customer\-directed activities within highly controlled operational environments. How You Will Make an Impact Fiber Plant Operations * Install, route, label, and maintain fiber optic infrastructure supporting production and non\-production environments. * Support MPO/MTP trunk deployments, patching, and remediation activities. * Perform fiber testing, certification, and validation using approved testing methodologies and equipment. * Troubleshoot physical\-layer connectivity issues and support fault isolation efforts. * Verify compliance with bend radius, cable routing, and fiber management standards. * Support contamination prevention programs, fiber inspection, and connector cleaning procedures. Structured Cabling \& Physical Infrastructure * Install, route, terminate, label, and document structured copper and fiber cabling systems. * Support deployment and expansion activities for new racks, pods, and network infrastructure. * Validate cabling installations against customer standards, floor plans, and port maps. * Conduct physical audits and quality inspections of deployed network infrastructure. * Maintain cable management systems and infrastructure documentation. Network Hardware Support * Install, replace, and validate network hardware components, including: * Optics and transceivers * Network switches * Console servers * OOB management devices * Patch panels and associated infrastructure * Support directed hardware replacement and maintenance activities. * Assist customer network engineers with troubleshooting and restoration efforts. * Participate in hardware acceptance testing and operational readiness activities. OOB \& Console Infrastructure * Support Out\-of\-Band (OOB) management networks and console connectivity infrastructure. * Install and maintain console cabling and access systems. * Verify console connectivity and operational readiness. * Assist with troubleshooting console access and management network issues. * Support customer\-directed changes within OOB environments. Network Deployment \& Expansion * Support deployment of network infrastructure associated with new site launches, hall expansions, and capacity growth initiatives. * Execute physical\-layer tasks associated with network turn\-up activities. * Participate in deployment readiness reviews and acceptance tes ding physical network infrastructure best practices. * Support onboarding and training activities for operational personnel. * Participate in continuous improvement initiatives focused on network reliability and deployment quality. * Demonstrate professionalism and customer\-focused communication skills. Minimum Qualifications * High school diploma, GED, or equivalent experience. * 3\+ years of experience supporting structured cabling, network deployment, or data center infrastructure environments. * Experience installing and troubleshooting fiber optic and copper cabling systems. * Familiarity with optics, transceivers, and physical\-layer networking concepts. * Ability to read deployment documentation, rack elevations, floor plans, and network diagrams. * Strong attention to detail and documentation accuracy. Preferred Qualifications * Experience supporting hyperscale, cloud, AI, HPC, or enterprise data center environments. * Experience with MPO/MTP infrastructure, fiber certification, and network testing methodologies. * Familiarity with leaf\-spine network architectures and large\-scale data center deployments. * Experience supporting OOB management networks and console infrastructure. * Knowledge of structured cabling standards and industry best practices. * Experience working within 24x7 mission\-critical operational environments. * Vendor certifications such as BICSI, FOA, Cisco, Juniper, Arista, or equivalent are preferred. * Experience supporting commissioning, deployment, and expansion activities. Physical Requirements * Ability to stand and walk for extended periods within active data center environments. * Ability to lift, carry, and move equipment weighing up to 50 pounds. * Ability to work in confined spaces, overhead cable pathways, and rack environments. * Ability to distinguish cable labeling, connector types, and color\-coded infrastructure. * Ability to safely use ladders and perform elevated work activities when required. Work Environment This position operates within a mission\-critical data center environment supporting advanced AI and accelerated computing infrastructure. Work includes fiber plant operations, structured cabling deployment, optics replacement, network infrastructure support, OOB connectivity management, and deployment activities supporting highly available computing environments. The Network Technician plays a critical role in maintaining the integrity, performance, and scalability of the physical network infrastructure that enables customer production operations. **Compensation** ---------------- Estimated Pay Range: 49\.43 Exact compensation and offers of employment are dependent on circumstances of each case and will be determined based on job\-related knowledge, skills, experience, licenses or certifications, and location. **Our Commitment to Diversity \& Inclusion** -------------------------------------------- *At Milestone we strive to create a workplace that reflects the communities we serve and work with, where we all feel empowered to bring our full, authentic selves to work. We know creating a diverse and inclusive culture that champions equity and belonging is not only the right thing to do for our employees but is also critical to our continued success.* *Milestone Technologies provides equal employment opportunity for all applicants and employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, marital status, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, national origin, or any other category protected by applicable federal and state law, or local ordinance. Milestone also makes reasonable accommodations for disabled applicants and employees.* *We welcome the unique background, culture, experiences, knowledge, innovation, self\-expression and perspectives you can bring to our global community. Our recruitment team is looking forward to meeting you.*

jobs.description: **Who we are:** Motive empowers the people who run physical operations with tools to make their work safer, more productive, and more profitable. For the first time ever, safety, operations and finance teams can manage their drivers, vehicles, equipment, and fleet related spend in a single system. Combined with industry leading AI, the Motive platform gives you complete visibility and control, and significantly reduces manual workloads by automating and simplifying tasks. Motive serves nearly 100,000 customers – from Fortune 500 enterprises to small businesses – across a wide range of industries, including transportation and logistics, construction, energy, field service, manufacturing, agriculture, food and beverage, retail, and the public sector. Visit gomotive.com to learn more. **About the Role:** ------------------- As a Staff Software Engineer on the Equipment Monitoring team, you will build the backend systems that give fleets unmatched visibility into the location, utilization, and health of their equipment \- trailers, reefers, construction machinery, and small assets. We are seeking a Senior Silicon Product Architect to define the technical strategy for next\-generation products by connecting silicon capabilities, customer workloads, and system\-level opportunities! As part of Silicon CoDesign, you’ll connect silicon capabilities with customer workloads, develop innovative features and system\-level solutions, and guide product strategy. You’ll own the Product Soul, advise engineering teams, and mentor engineers across the computing stack **What you’ll be doing:** * Product vision: Own the Product Soul, turning customer needs and workloads into clear performance, power, and efficiency goals, priorities, and tradeoffs. * Performance and power co\-design: Architect next\-generation performance and power management features and system\-level solutions, partnering across teams from concept through silicon to shipping products. * Competitive edge: Benchmark competing architectures and prioritize investments that improve performance, power efficiency, product differentiation, and customer value. * Product decisions: Define operating points, configurations, and binning strategies with engineering teams; validate models against silicon data and flag gaps and risks early. Team impact: Mentor engineers, lead technical reviews, and set a high standard for data analysis, technical reasoning, and clear communication. * **What we need to see:** * MS or PhD in EE, CE, CS, systems engineering, or equivalent experience. * 12\+ years in silicon or system performance and power, with ownership of product architecture or technical strategy. * Strong judgment in turning customer and business needs into measurable product goals and architectural decisions. * Deep silicon performance and power expertise, including device behavior, voltage\-frequency characteristics, process variation, power management, and electrical and thermal limits. * Broad CPU, GPU, or SoC architecture knowledge, including memory, interconnects, and hardware/software co\-design. * Experience with first\-principles modeling, workload analysis, competitive benchmarking, statistics, and data analysis. Strong technical writing, presentation, and mentoring skills, with experience influencing decisions across global and offshore teams. * **Ways to stand out from the crowd:** * Understanding of LLM architectures and training or inference workloads. * Experience with rack or datacenter performance and power, or across client, embedded, automotive, and networking products. * Hands\-on experience with silicon bring\-up, performance and power characterization, operating points, or binning. A record of proposing novel system\-level concepts or features with measurable product value. * Join NVIDIA to help solve some of computing’s most challenging problems. \#LI\-Hybrid You will also be eligible for equity and benefits . Applications for this job will be accepted at least until November 3, 2026\. This posting is for an existing vacancy. NVIDIA uses AI tools in its recruiting processes. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, NVIDIA Kubernetes
jobs.description: NVIDIA is recognized as one of the technology world's most desirable employers, driving groundbreaking developments in Artificial Intelligence, High\-Performance Computing, and Visualization. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As a Senior Software Engineer on the Management Plane area, you will own building and delivering software that creates, upgrades, scales, and operates Kubernetes clusters on customer\-managed infrastructure. This infrastructure supports demanding AI and high\-performance computing workloads. You will set technical direction, lead cross\-team development, and mentor other engineers while shipping high\-quality, production\-ready software. **What You’ll Be Doing:** * Develop and build management plane capabilities such as cluster lifecycle operations (compose, upgrade, scale, repair, delete), node management, and fleet\-wide health and status reporting, from development through production. * Architect and implement Kubernetes controllers, operators, and custom resource definitions (CRDs) in Go, with reliable, idempotent reconciliation. * Drive automated cluster provisioning across bare metal, virtualized, and cloud environments, using Cluster API\-style concepts and infrastructure providers. * Lead technical build: write build docs, run build reviews, and align partner teams across the software and hardware stack. * Diagnose and improve the performance, reliability, and security of complex, asynchronous distributed systems, including debugging issues in production. * Own test strategy (unit, integration, end\-to\-end) and automate build, test, and release pipelines. * Mentor engineers, improve code reviews, and keep documentation and runbooks clear and current. Prioritize various tasks while maintaining high code quality. * **What We Want To See:** * BS/MS in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent experience. * 8\+ years of relevant software engineering experience, including building and operating production distributed systems. * Strong proficiency in a systems language (Go, C\+\+, Rust, or Java), with solid data structures and algorithms fundamentals and the ability to become productive in Go quickly. * Strong understanding of Kubernetes and container orchestration, including the API server, controllers, and reconciliation loops. * Background in distributed system build and development, including consistency, availability, and failure handling at scale. * Experience in automation using tools like Ansible and Terraform, along with experience establishing and managing CI/CD systems. * Solid Linux fundamentals and an understanding of performance, security, and reliability in distributed environments. Track record of leading technical builds and mentoring other engineers. * **Ways to Stand Out from the crowd:** * Broad experience with Go, especially concurrency and testing, and with client\-go / controller\-runtime. * Significant hands\-on production experience operating Kubernetes at scale, including control plane or etcd scalability and availability. * Experience with Cluster API or infrastructure providers on bare metal, vSphere, OpenStack, or AWS, along with solid experience using GitLab, Jenkins, or other CI/CD platforms. * Expert knowledge of Linux kernel and system internals, or experience with GPU/DPU\-accelerated infrastructure. Open\-source contributions to Kubernetes or related cloud\-native projects. * Widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers, NVIDIA offers highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package. As you plan your future, see what we can offer to you and your family www.nvidiabenefits.com/ Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and other objective job\-related factors. The expected base salary ranges for this position are: 184,000 USD – 287,500 USD for Level 4; and 224,000 USD – 356,500 USD for Level 5\. You will also be eligible for equity and benefits . Applications for this job will be accepted at least until November 3, 2026\. This posting is for an existing vacancy. NVIDIA uses AI tools in its recruiting processes.
