jobs.title: Software Engineer, ML Performance
jobs.description: NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self\-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in an inclusive, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world. Join us at NVIDIA and be part of a team that’s crafting the future of technology! Our dedication to innovation and excellence has made us a leader in computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for over 25 years. As we delve into the limitless opportunities that AI brings, we are looking for passionate individuals to help us push boundaries and redefine what's possible. NVIDIA is seeking a dedicated Software Engineer, ML Performance to join our team in Santa Clara, CA. In this role, you will engage directly with the latest AI technologies and work on optimizing performance at an outstanding scale. Your expertise will ensure that our groundbreaking solutions operate flawlessly and continue to lead the industry. **What you’ll be doing:** * Analyze the performance of distributed training and inference workloads throughout the entire stack: model and framework, data loading and checkpointing, compiler and kernels, CUDA and NCCL, host and network. Identify the bottleneck, resolve it or suggest a solution, and provide the supporting evidence. * Define the performance metrics tracked across a fleet of GPUs. Break them down into factors engineers need to debug. Decide which signals the platform collects first. * Drive the analysis of regressions: segment workloads across machines, versions, and configurations to isolate the cause, and turn the method into analysis others can reuse. * Evaluate automated diagnoses: judge whether a finding is accurate, identify misleading results and missed problems, and build the labeled cases that keep the analysis honest. Work closely with build partners on their real workloads, carry findings through to improvements, and feed what the product is missing back into the roadmap. * **What we need to see:** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience. * 12\+ years of relevant software engineering experience, including hands\-on optimization of GPU training or inference workloads in production. * Demonstrated performance work across more than one layer of the stack, with a clear account of the baseline, evidence, alternative explanations and validated outcome. * Experience diagnosing performance across many jobs, machines or tenants, not only tuning a single workload. * Enough familiarity with framework, runtime and compiler interfaces to say where a signal should be measured, even when someone else writes the instrumentation. * Ability to distinguish symptoms from causes, recognize noisy or incomplete measurements and the effects of the measurement itself, and know when the evidence is insufficient. * Strong programming and debugging skills, demonstrated by maintainable analysis code, tests or repeatable investigation procedures, including when using automated development tools. * Clear communication of findings, trade\-offs and remaining uncertainty to the people who own the workload. Proficiency with Python and CUDA. * **Ways to stand out from the crowd:** * Improved operation of both training and inference. * Deep knowledge of one or more of PyTorch, JAX, Megatron, NCCL, TensorRT\-LLM, vLLM, SGLang or Dynamo. * Experience moving between application, system software, driver or hardware roles, and the full\-stack view that comes with it. * Statistical judgment applied to noisy, multi\-node fleet\-scale performance data. Ideally, experience with counter\-factual analysis and segmentation of workloads for diagnosing regressions. Built debugging or performance\-analysis tools used by other engineers, with evidence that they made investigations more effective. * Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and other objective job\-related factors. The expected base salary range for this position is 224,000 USD – 356,500 USD. You will also be eligible for equity and benefits . Applications for this job will be accepted at least until November 3, 2026\. This posting is for an existing vacancy. NVIDIA uses AI tools in its recruiting processes. NVIDIA is committed to fostering an inclusive work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As we highly value diversity in our current and future employees, we do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Computer Engineer or Electrical Engineer
jobs.description: Working at the Naval Nuclear Laboratory we foster pride in belonging to an organization whose culture is made up of these core values: Trust, Empowerment, and Collaboration. Our company promotes a positive culture while ensuring the safety and reliability of our nation's naval nuclear reactors, and training the Sailors who operate those reactors in the U.S. Navy's submarines and aircraft carrier Fleets. Looking for a lifetime career? Apply today! **Job Description** ------------------- Within the Naval Nuclear Laboratory, the Digital Strategic Development Unit is seeking a highly motivated Electrical Engineer or Computer Engineer with a strong interest in software development tool modernization and delivering digital transformation solutions. Specific areas of interest include incorporating artificial intelligence and machine learning, model\-based engineering, and automation into existing processes. The Naval Nuclear Laboratory is a unique, mission\-driven organization that develops in\-house nuclear reactor instrumentation and control (I\&C) systems for the U.S. Navy's aircraft carriers, submarines, and future platforms. This team is responsible for leading the development and deployment of innovative solutions for existing and future I\&C systems on US Navy aircraft carriers and submarines. **Required Combination of Knowledge and Skill** ----------------------------------------------- Bachelors degree from an accredited college or university in a related technical, engineering or science field and a minimum of 4 years of relevant experience; or Masters degree from an accredited college or university in a related technical, engineering or science field and a minimum of 2 years of relevant experience; or Doctorate degree from an accredited college or university in a related technical, engineering, science field; or Currently an Advanced Reactor Training Engineer, Refueling Engineer, or Field (RPCO) Engineer at the Company.**Preferred Skills** -------------------- * Degree in Electrical Engineering or Computer Engineering * Working knowledge of cybersecurity principles * Experience deploying both commercial and custom\-built software development tools * Strong verbal and written communication skills * Strong attention to detail and organizational skills * Demonstrated cross organizational leadership experience * Experience with technical writing * Reactor Plant I\&C design or operating experience * Strong project management skills * Strong Academic performance \- Cumulative GPA of 3\.0 or above on a 4\.0 GPA Scale **Compensation and Benefits** ----------------------------- * Health, Dental, Vision \& Voluntary Benefits * Disability, Life \& Accident Insurance * 401(k) Savings program \& Capital Accumulation Plan * Personal \& Medical Time Off * Paid Parental Leave * Flexible Work Schedules * Tuition Assistance for Eligible Employees * Student Debt Benefit Personal Time Off Sell Program * Employee Assistance Program (EAP) * Wellness Program * Visit us online to view all NNL benefits! **Pay Range** ------------- $86,100\.00 \- $134,600\.00 annually Salary information provided is a general guideline only. Annual salary is based upon candidate experience and qualifications, as well as market and business considerations. The Naval Nuclear Laboratory is operated for the U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) by Fluor Marine Propulsion, LLC (FMP), a wholly owned subsidiary of Fluor Corporation. Naval Nuclear Laboratory personnel are FMP employees who work at four DOE facilities: Bettis Atomic Power Laboratory, Knolls Atomic Power Laboratory, Kenneth A. Kesselring Site, and Naval Reactors Facility, and at the U.S. Department of Defense\-owned Nuclear Power Training Unit\-Charleston. FMP employees also have an established presence at numerous shipyards, satellite, and vendor locations. For more than 75 years, the Naval Nuclear Laboratory has developed advanced nuclear propulsion technology, provided technical support, and trained world\-class nuclear operators to ensure the safe and reliable operation of our nation's submarine and aircraft carrier fleets. The Naval Nuclear Laboratory is a national asset solely dedicated to the Naval Nuclear Propulsion Program. We rely on the dedication and innovation of our nearly 8000 engineers, scientists, technicians, and support personnel. All candidates must be U.S. citizens. Applicants selected will be subject to a Federal background investigation and must meet eligibility requirements for access to classified matter. FMP is a government contractor and maintains a drug free workplace and workforce. All candidates must be able to pass a drug test in compliance with FMP company policy and 10 CFR 707\. Marijuana is a Federal Schedule I controlled substance and illegal under Federal Law. Therefore, FMP is required to test for marijuana. Fluor Marine Propulsion, LLC is an Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability/vets. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, sex, religion, national origin, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other criteria protected by federal, state, or local law.

That’s because we bring new thinking to age\-old problems, like how to use data most effectively in the most efficient possible way. As an Engineer with NetApp, you’ll have the opportunity to work with modern cloud and container orchestration technologies in a production setting. You’ll play an important role in scaling systems sustainably through automation and evolving them by pushing for changes to improve reliability and velocity. **Success profile** ------------------- Ready to be an engineer at NetApp? jobs.title: Software Engineer (Backend & Integrations, TypeScript)
jobs.description: **Software Engineer (Backend \& Integrations, TypeScript)** **Role Overview** At Neurotrack, our mission is to transform the diagnosis and prevention of Alzheimer’s and related diseases by giving people direct access to the most effective, most broadly available, scientifically validated digital assessments and therapeutics to prevent cognitive decline. You’ll be a backend engineer on our API platform, working closely with our Director of Engineering. We run several REST APIs on serverless AWS Lambda, backed by DynamoDB, all written in TypeScript. You’ll help us build them, run them, and keep them healthy, and you’ll give the team real depth on the systems our products depend on. We also run a rich portfolio of integrations with our healthcare customers: SFTP file exchange on AWS, HL7 interfaces, and our Partner API. Integrations will be your first focus. You’ll learn each of these approaches in detail: the steps, the options, and the trade\-offs. Then you’ll work hand in hand with our Customer Success team and with customers’ technical teams to pick and refine the right approach, build it, test it, and see it through to go\-live. **How We Work** * **Fast and together.** We live in Slack. We help each other throughout the day, keep each other unblocked, and regularly surprise ourselves with how fast we can go. * **AI\-native.** We practice spec\-driven development and use Claude for much of the execution, with humans in the loop at all the right steps. * **Quality and privacy first.** Our product is Software as a Medical Device, and we operate under a Quality Management System. Our commitment to quality, privacy, and the people we serve shapes how we build. **Key Responsibilities:** *APIs \& Platform* * Design, build, and extend features across our TypeScript REST APIs on AWS Lambda and DynamoDB. * Design and document APIs with OpenAPI so they’re reusable across current and future products. * Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions. * Instrument and monitor services with Datadog, and help triage, diagnose, and fix production issues. *Customer Integrations* * Own customer integrations end to end: scope them with Customer Success and the customer, configure or implement them, test them, and take them live. *AI\-Supported Development* * Write specs, collaborate with Claude to execute them, and review the results with care. * Keep work and knowledge current in Jira and Confluence. **Qualifications:** *Required:* * 5\+ years as a software developer, with significant backend API experience. * Strong TypeScript and Node.js. * Hands\-on AWS experience; Lambda, DynamoDB, and serverless architectures are a strong plus. * Experience with GitHub Actions and with designing APIs using OpenAPI. * Comfort working directly with customers and partners on technical integrations. * Solid grounding in software design: clean architecture, domain\-driven design, design patterns. * Experience using AI coding tools in your day\-to\-day work, or real eagerness to work that way. * A focus on quality and collaboration, and the ability to thrive in a fast\-moving environment. *Preferred:* * Healthcare integration experience (HL7, FHIR, SFTP\-based data exchange). * Experience with Auth0 and Datadog. * Experience in a regulated environment (medical device, HIPAA, ISO 13485, or similar). **Working at Neurotrack** * Location: Remote (US) * Schedule: Full\-time * Travel: Minimal * Benefits: Comprehensive health coverage (medical, dental, vision, LTD, STD), equity options, unlimited PTO, and a wellness account. At Neurotrack, you’ll be part of a mission\-driven team committed to improving lives through better brain health. You’ll work with innovative technology, collaborate with passionate colleagues, and make a real impact on the systems and integrations that connect our platform to the healthcare organizations we serve.

jobs.title: Contract Faculty, Department of Computer Science & Engineering
jobs.description: The Department of Computer Science and Engineering at the NYU Tandon School of Engineering invites applications for full\-time, non\-tenured, renewable faculty positions in Computer Science at the level of Industry Assistant Professor or Industry Associate Professor, with a start date of September 2027\. **Job Description** Industry Professors at NYU Tandon are core members of our instructional faculty, dedicated primarily to pedagogical excellence, curriculum development, and student mentorship. Key aspects of this position include: * **Focus** : Classroom instruction and educational innovation; there is no research requirement. * **Teaching Load** : Standard full\-time teaching load (typically 3 courses per semester / 6 per academic year across undergraduate and graduate levels). * **Service** : Contribution to departmental service, such as curriculum committees, student club advising, and program development. * **Contract Term** : Initial multi\-year renewable contract with clear pathways for promotion. We invite applicants for classroom and laboratory teaching in all areas of Computer Science, with particular emphasis on algorithms, software engineering, artificial intelligence, machine learning databases, operating systems, and cybersecurity. *Required* : Master’s degree (MS) or equivalent in Computer Science or a closely related discipline, along with demonstrated teaching effectiveness or substantial industry background. *Preferred* : Ph.D. in Computer Science or a closely related discipline, a strong record of industrial practice, or experience designing modern, hands\-on CS curricula. Please submit the following materials: * Cover letter * Current CV * Teaching statement * Research statement or writing sample * Names and contact information for three references. **Process** We will begin reviewing applications on December 1, 2026, and continue until the position is filled. Early submission is strongly encouraged. For questions, please contact Assistant Professor Rosanna Bellini via @bellini@nyu.edu. **Additional Information** In compliance with NYC’s Pay Transparency Act, the annual base salary (9\-month) range for this position is: * Industry Assistant Professor: $119,000 – $145,000 * Industry Associate Professor: $114,000 – $166,000 **About Us** New York University (NYU) is one of the top private universities in the United States with an unparalleled network of global campuses and academic centers. NYU’s Tandon School of Engineering, located in the heart of Brooklyn, dates back to 1854, the founding year of both the New York University School of Civil Engineering and Architecture and the Brooklyn Collegiate and Polytechnic Institute. Backed by an historic commitment investment of $1 billion and under the leadership of **Juan de Pablo** as the University’s Executive Vice President for Global Science and Technology and Tandon’s Executive Dean, the Engineering School is recruiting world\-class faculty, and conducting groundbreaking basic and applied research in key areas. We are home to a community of renowned faculty and undergraduate and graduate students united in a mission to understand and create technology that powers cities, enables worldwide communication, fights climate change, and builds healthier and safer real and digital worlds. The school’s culture centers on encouraging rigorous, interdisciplinary collaboration and research; entrepreneurial thinking, academic and technological innovation and the creation of accessible pathways for lifelong learning in STEM. **For people in the EU, click here for information on your privacy rights under GDPR:** **www.nyu.edu/it/gdpr** NYU is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is committed to a policy of equal treatment and opportunity in every aspect of its recruitment and hiring process without regard to age, alienage, caregiver status, childbirth, citizenship status, color, creed, disability, domestic violence victim status, ethnicity, familial status, gender and/or gender identity or expression, marital status, military status, national origin, parental status, partnership status, predisposing genetic characteristics, pregnancy, race, religion, reproductive health decision making, sex, sexual orientation, unemployment status, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis. All interested persons are encouraged to apply for vacant positions at all levels. **Sustainability Statement** NYU aims to be among the greenest urban campuses in the country and carbon neutral by 2040\. jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: **Job ID:** 19184 **Alternate Locations:** **Newell Brands** is a leading consumer products company with a portfolio of iconic brands like Graco®, Coleman®, Oster®, Rubbermaid®, Sharpie® and Yankee Candle® \- and 24,000 talented teammates around the world. Our culture is built on values in action: Integrity, Teamwork, Passion for Winning, Ownership, and Leadership. We work together to win, grow, and make a real impact—supported by a high\-performing, inclusive, and collaborative environment where you can be your best, every day. We are building AI\-enabled capabilities that help our marketing, eCommerce and content teams work faster and smarter, starting with content optimization and extending to other needs as they come up. The Forward Deployed Engineer designs and builds the solutions. You will work directly with the teams who own content, product data, creative, syndication and other marketing and eCommerce workflows, learn how their work gets done and build with them. This role is focused on building, and you will report to the Head of Digital Product \& Innovation, eCommerce, who leads product strategy and stakeholder alignment. You will work closely with your leader on the product vision, using what you learn in the field to inform what we build next and why. What you build in the field informs what gets productized, and what gets productized is then deployed back into the business. This is a hands\-on, high\-visibility role. **Responsibilities** **Discover and Design** * Work with New Item Setup, Marketing, Brand, eCommerce, Content, Media, Commercial and IT teams to map how work gets done and find where data issues, handoffs and rework slow teams down * Take on new marketing and eCommerce needs as they come up, from workflow automation to analytics and reporting, and help prioritize them alongside ongoing work * Find the underlying problem behind each request, and turn business requirements into scoped technical solutions with clear specifications and success metrics * Contribute to architecture choices for each AI solution, including models, orchestration and data design, in partnership with enterprise IT, and recommend a different approach when the request is not the best fit **Build and Deploy** * Build and own technical components from design through deployment, testing and monitoring in production * Rapidly prototype and deploy solutions such as AI agents, workflow automations, integrations, data pipelines and lightweight applications, then take them from prototype to production to meet enterprise standards * Build and deploy AI agents and workflows that take action in business systems, including prompts, tool calls, retrieval and context layers * Develop classification and enrichment models, such as those that map, validate and generate product attributes and categories against our taxonomy and retailer requirements * Train, tune and deploy machine learning models that extract and classify information from text, images and documents, such as product attributes against our taxonomy, at scale * Choose the right approach for each use case, from rules and classical models to fine\-tuned and LLM\-based extraction, and design feedback loops that retrain models using human corrections * Connect copy and generative AI content capabilities into connected workflows, using a blend of AI within custom Azure solutions and enterprise tools such as Adobe and Salsify * Build data pipelines and integrations across Azure, enterprise data platforms and the commercialization stack: product information management (PIM), syndication and digital asset platforms (Stibo, Salsify, Adobe) * Work with enterprise IT to meet requirements for security, access control and data governance, and to integrate with legacy systems * Use Claude Code and similar AI\-assisted development tools daily to build and test faster **Operate and Improve** * Test AI output with defined test sets, quality metrics and human review * Measure extraction and classification performance by attribute using precision, recall and F1 on labeled datasets, and track confidence thresholds, error patterns and model drift over time * Monitor deployed solutions, find the root cause when issues occur and fix them * Build dashboards that report solution health and business results: cycle time, data quality, cost avoidance and content readiness * Help measure and report impact in terms stakeholders and finance care about, such as time saved, cost avoided, revenue influenced and quality improved * Document solutions and train business teams to use and extend them independently, gathering feedback and iterating until the solution is part of how the team works **Inform the Product** * Contribute to the product vision and roadmap alongside your leader, combining what you learn in the field with their strategy and priorities * Turn repeated field needs into reusable capabilities, and help decide what to build once, what to configure and what not to build * Bring data, working demos and clear technical recommendations to stakeholder discussions to help reach decisions * Keep stakeholders informed by communicating progress, tradeoffs and risks clearly to both working teams and senior leaders * Stay current on new AI tools and methods, and recommend when to adopt, build or retire a capability **Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, data science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience * Five or more years in software engineering, data engineering, solutions engineering or a similar role such as forward\-deployed engineering or consulting, including technical delivery for customers or business teams * Strong Python and SQL skills * Software engineering fundamentals, including version control, code review and automated testing * Experience with Azure and DevOps practices, including CI/CD, infrastructure as code and cloud deployment * Experience in data science, including feature engineering, model selection, validation and statistical evaluation, and moving models from experiment to production * Hands\-on machine learning for information extraction and classification, such as named\-entity recognition, multi\-label and hierarchical classification, embeddings, and fine\-tuning of transformer or large language models * Experience building with large language models, agent frameworks and orchestration, prompt and context design, evaluation and monitoring * Experience with classification, taxonomy mapping or entity\-resolution models * Working knowledge of current AI tools and methods, with examples of what you have built or tested \#LI\-MC2 Newell Brands (NASDAQ: NWL) is a leading global consumer goods company with a strong portfolio of well\-known brands, including Rubbermaid, Sharpie, Graco, Coleman, Rubbermaid Commercial Products, Yankee Candle, Paper Mate, FoodSaver, Dymo, EXPO, Elmer’s, Oster, NUK, Spontex and Campingaz. We are focused on delighting consumers by lighting up everyday moments. Newell Brands and its subsidiaries are Equal Opportunity Employers and comply with applicable employment laws. EOE/M/F/Vet/Disabled are encouraged to apply.

jobs.title: Full stack Developer
jobs.description: **Location: Remote \| Type: Contract** **About Newpage Solutions** Newpage Solutions is a global digital health innovation company helping people live longer, healthier lives. We partner with life sciences organisations which include, pharmaceutical, biotech and healthcare leaders, to build transformative AI and data driven technologies addressing real\-world health challenges. From strategy and research to UX design and agile development, we deliver and validate impactful solutions using lean, human\-centered practices. We are proud to be a ‘Great Place to Work®’ certified company for the last three consecutive years. We also hold a top Glassdoor rating and are named among the "Top 50 Most Promising Healthcare Solution Providers" by CIOReview. As an organisation, we foster creativity, continuous learning and inclusivity, creating an environment where bold ideas thrive and make a measurable difference in people’s lives. **Your Mission** We are hiring Forward Deployed Engineers who treat AI as the substrate of how software gets built—not a tool to be cautious of, not something they are "exploring," but the medium they work in. You will sit close to clients and product leaders, reframe vague problems into something concrete, and ship working software end\-to\-end. You won't wait for a refined backlog, a PM in the middle, or a separate platform team. You will shape the idea, build the thing, and stand it up in production yourself. This is a builder\-first individual\-contributor role for engineers who live at the current edge of AI development and work fluently with Claude Code, Cursor, agents, eval harnesses, MCP, and modern TypeScript and Python. **What You’ll Do** **Problem / Opportunity Discovery** * Sit with a business or clinical leader and reframe an idea or problem into something concrete and buildable. * Know what to build by the end of the conversation; have a working prototype to react to by the end of the week. * Partner closely with product, design, and client stakeholders to translate ambiguous ideas into software that ships. * Demo live without a slide deck. Reframe problems out loud. Don't get stuck waiting for someone else to make the decision. * Lead POCs, innovation sprints, and internal research experiments to validate emerging AI techniques. ### **Build (fast) with AI** * When the brief is clear, head down and produce. * Build modular backends in Python or TypeScript aligned with clean architecture, OOP, SOLID, and domain\-driven design. * Create full stack applications, APIs, agents, workflows, and similar systems using frameworks such as Next.js, React, Fast API, Fastify, FastMCP, and Hono. * Architect and ship production\-grade agentic applications using Lang Graph, AutoGen, Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Assistants, or your own orchestration layer. * Integrate frontier and self\-hosted LLMs (Claude, GPT, Gemini, open\-weight models) with tools, data, and external systems through MCP and custom connectors. * Apply RAG techniques where they actually help: vector databases (Pinecone, Chroma, Weaviate, pgvector), hybrid retrieval with Elasticsearch or Solr, and BM25 \+ similarity search. * Work across relational, document, key\-value, and graph stores as the problem demands; use event\-driven patterns where they fit, not by default. * Design prompt and context engineering frameworks that optimize accuracy, repeatability, cost, and latency. * Use AI\-assisted development tools (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Codex) through structured workflows, native instructions, templates, and sub\-agents—with discipline and review. * Fine\-tune or adapt models where the problem genuinely calls for it. ### **Test, Deploy, Productionize** * Spin up the infra, write the evals, wire up the MCP servers, deploy the agents, and harden the bits that survive contact with real users. * Deploy on AWS, Azure, Cloudflare, or Vercel using containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) or serverless—chosen for fit, not preference. * Treat evals as a first\-class discipline: hands\-on harnesses, not theoretical frameworks. Build with a clear\-eyed view of where current AI tooling helps and where it falls short. * Apply engineering practices that hold up in production: TDD, secrets management and rotation, SAST/DAST, structured logging, metrics, tracing, and automated CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Jenkins). * Own what you build end\-to\-end, including the infrastructure and operations that keep it running. * Mentor others on system design, agentic patterns, and AI engineering best practices. **What You Bring** * 3\+ years relevant experience building production applications using AI / agentic development approaches—full stack applications, agents, workflows, MCPs, and more. * Hands\-on experience with agents, not just prompted models. jobs.title: Software Engineer, Infrastructure
jobs.description: **About Niantic Spatial** AI has learned from almost everything online, but it still struggles with the physical world, where 99\.5% of economic activity happens. It doesn’t know where things are, how spaces fit together, or what changes over time. That’s one of the biggest unsolved problems in AI, and it’s the one we’re solving at Niantic Spatial. We build spatial AI models and services so people and machines can reason, learn and act safely in the physical world. We turn camera imagery, video, sensor data and archives into accurate, AI\-readable representations of real places that robots can train in and machines can use to know exactly where they are. In physical AI, mistakes have real consequences. That’s why we build AI grounded in measured reality, not guesswork, so the people and machines relying on it can trust it to get things right. Our team built some of the world’s most widely used maps. Now we’re building something bigger: a living, measured record of the real world that machines can query, learn from and use to understand how places change over time. If you want to help AI understand the world we actually live in, come build with us. **About the Role** You’ll join a small infrastructure team with broad, shared ownership — the engineers who keep Niantic Spatial running. The team covers the cloud platform, the developer tooling every engineer depends on, and the edge services our customers’ requests pass through. You’ll work across SRE, infrastructure, and developer platform alongside teammates who know the stack well, and you’ll grow into owning parts of it yourself. Because every engineer here builds on what this team provides, your work will also shape how the whole engineering org builds, ships, and operates. **What You'll Do** * **Cloud and SRE:** Build and maintain cloud infrastructure as code, and help improve reliability through monitoring, alerting, and service\-level objectives. * **Developer Platform:** Help run our source control, CI/CD pipelines, and build infrastructure so engineers can ship quickly and safely. * **Production Operations:** Share on\-call, take part in incident response and follow\-up, and automate away repetitive operational work. * **Edge and Delivery:** Help run the edge API gateway, CDN, and authentication and authorization systems with the rest of the team. * **Compute and GPU Management:** Help provision and monitor compute and GPU capacity across teams. * **AI\-Assisted Operations:** Use AI tools to help build, automate, and maintain our infrastructure, and help shape how the team uses them. **What You'll Bring** * **Years of Experience:** 3\+ years in infrastructure, SRE, DevOps, or platform engineering. * **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. * **Infrastructure as Code:** Experience managing infrastructure as code with tools such as Terraform, Pulumi, or similar. * **Cloud:** Hands\-on experience with GCP, AWS, or another major cloud provider in production. * **CI/CD:** Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines in GitLab, GitHub Actions, or similar. * **Containers:** Production experience with containers and container orchestration, such as Kubernetes. * **Core Technical Skills:** Proficiency in at least one programming language such as Python, Go, TypeScript, or C\+\+, plus shell scripting and Linux systems. * **AI in Your Workflow:** Comfort using AI\-assisted tools in your engineering work, or a strong interest in building that habit. We’ll help you ramp up on how we use AI here. **Nice to Have** * Familiarity with API gateways, load balancers, or CDNs. * Familiarity with modern authentication and authorization, such as OAuth 2\.0, OIDC, or cloud IAM. * Experience with GPU workloads or ML infrastructure. * Experience with message queuing systems. **Location \& Work Model** This role is based in our San Francisco or Sunnyvale, CA office, or in Bellevue, WA. We work in a high\-collaboration environment and ask team members to be on\-site a minimum of 3 days per week. **Compensation \& Benefits** The base salary range for this position is $171,000 \- $230,000 for Bay Area candidates and $162,500 \- $218,500 for Seattle/Bellevue candidates. jobs.title: AI Engineer, Design
jobs.description: **About Nu** ============ Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human\-centered services. Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability. Visit our Institutional Page **About the role** ------------------ We're looking for an outstanding AI Engineer with both a passion for design and experience architecting modern AI implementations. Nu's design and research function is roughly 260 people. Over the past year they have been building their own tooling: something like 100 AI\-assisted solutions and 30\+ local knowledge repositories, each built inside a business unit to solve that unit's problem. Most of them work. None of them talk to each other. The Design Center of Excellence exists to turn that kind of local invention into systems the whole function can build on. It has design ops and research ops. It does not have an engineer — which means the CoE can identify a need, specify a tool, and then has no one to build it. This is that hire: the first engineer in the CoE, and the person who architects the systems that let design at Nu scale. You'll work directly with the designers and researchers who use what you build, and the person who scopes a system is the person who builds it. **What you'll work on** ----------------------- **NuBrain** — the first priority. A global knowledge system for the design and research function, consolidating the 30\+ local repositories that already exist. The hard part is not merging content; it's the context architecture — how retrieval is structured, how token consumption stays sane, and how content reaches people and agents at the moment it's useful. **New tools that enable superlative creative marketing and brand expressions at scale**. As Nu scales globally, we are inventing new ways to express our brand in the product and through our marketing. Instead of hiring fleets of marketing designers in every country, we aim to build tools that enable consistent high quality creative expression to be driven centrally. **Canonicalizing what already exists.** Roughly 100 AI solutions have been built locally by designers and researchers. Someone needs to understand what they are, decide what becomes standard for the function, and retire the rest before the duplication compounds. **Deciding the shape of the answer.** Plugin, MCP server, agent, Claude skill, or a full platform — that call is yours to make and defend. Part of the job is telling the CoE that the tool they asked for should be something else. **What you'll do** ------------------ * Architect and build the systems design at Nu runs on — increasingly agentic ones. * Sit with designers and researchers, understand the need underneath the request, and turn it into something scoped and buildable. * Stand up or reuse the infrastructure, write the code, and ship it to the function. * Instrument what you build. Metrics and observability are part of the deliverable, not a follow\-up. * Own the roadmap for CoE tooling: prioritize, sequence, say no, and keep things moving without a PM behind you. * Be the technical voice in a design organization — make trade\-offs legible to people who don't read code. **What we're looking for** -------------------------- **An outstanding, deeply experienced AI engineer.** This is an engineering hire first. You've spent years building systems other people build on, and recent years working with AI models on things like token consumption, rate limiting, response latency, MCP servers, and other modern AI engineering challenges. **A track record architecting UX systems.** Before AI, you designed and built the foundations of user experience at scale — design systems, component platforms, UI frameworks, front\-end infrastructure used by many teams. **A love for design that shows up in your work.** Since AI, you've used it to build compelling examples and more sophisticated systems than were possible before. We'd like to see them. **Agentic systems that help design scale.** Ideally you've built them — agents, tooling, or infrastructure that let designers do more, faster, and better. This is the strongest signal for the role. **A protagonist.** You'll serve a 260\-person function as a centralized hub. That means navigating stakeholders, leading projects, and pushing work through an organization that doesn't report to you. You drive the work yourself rather than relying on someone else to run the project. **Evidence you've shipped.** Send us GitHub, live tools, demos, and systems you can walk us through. We are not asking for a design portfolio. ### **Backgrounds that tend to fit** * Design systems and UI platform engineers at design\-led product companies. * Engineers at design tooling companies. * Engineers who have been building AI and agentic tools for designers — in their day job, in open source, or in public. * Founders and technical leads who were the engineer behind a design\-led product. ### **What this role is not** * Not a designer who codes. The engineering bar is the bar. * Not a generalist backend or infrastructure role. UX systems experience is core. * Not customer\-facing mobile product work. This is internal systems and tooling for the design function. * Not a research or modeling role. (The "design modeling" profile — building the models AI consumes — is a different conversation, later.) Our recruitment process may involve the use of artificial intelligence–enabled tools, such as automated interview transcription and analysis, to support the evaluation process. Artificial intelligence is not used to make final hiring decisions; all decisions are made by human reviewers. To maintain a consistent and fair process for every candidate, Nu does not provide individualized technical feedback. See how our policy works here

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: Onto Innovation is a leader in process control, combining global scale with an expanded portfolio of leading\-edge technologies that include: 3D metrology spanning the chip from nanometer\-scale transistors to micron\-level die\-interconnects; macro defect inspection of wafers and packages; metal interconnect composition; factory analytics; and lithography for advanced semiconductor packaging. Our breadth of offerings across the entire semiconductor value chain helps our customers solve their most difficult yield, device performance, quality, and reliability issues. Whether you are launching your career or bringing years of deep expertise, what matters most is how you think: we need someone who can hold a global, system\-level view of a complex inspection platform—optics, mechanics, electronics, and software—and then zoom into any layer to get into the weeds when a problem demands it. Because AI coding agents can now generate and refactor code effectively, the critical skill we are seeking is the ability to maintain an accurate mental model of a complex system consisting of optics, electrical, and mechanical subsystems, and effectively map customer problems to the right technical solutions. **Key Responsibilities** Responsibilities will be scoped to your experience level; early\-career engineers will focus on the foundational items while senior engineers will take on broader ownership and leadership. Systems Thinking \& Problem Decomposition * Build and continuously refine an accurate mental model of the full Onto inspection platform—optics, motion, electronics, image acquisition, and software stack. * Translate customer problems and application requirements into well\-scoped engineering tasks by reasoning across subsystem boundaries. * Agility to zoom from system\-level architecture down into any specific areas: databases, algorithm performance, hardware, data flow, GPUs, GUIs, etc. * Participate in New Product Development (NPD) alongside hardware engineers, application engineers, Technical Project Managers, and Program/Product Managers. * Algorithms \& Software Engineering * Apply machine learning, image processing, computer vision, mathematics, and optics to develop algorithms integrated into Onto inspection platforms. * Develop or contribute to optical imaging modeling/calibration and/or image segmentation, classification, and detection algorithms. * Write, test, and debug software to ensure high\-quality, reliable operation; optimize for performance and scalability. * Perform or lead (based on experience) requirement analysis, detailed software design, production code development, and associated test plans. * Participate in design/code reviews collaborating with systems engineers, software developers, and other technical staff. * Leverage AI coding agents to accelerate implementation, while maintaining ownership of architecture decisions, design integrity, and code quality. * Continuous Learning \& Collaboration * Stay current with academic research and industrial practices in machine vision inspection, image processing, machine learning, and AI\-assisted engineering. * Document software designs, system\-level rationale, development processes, and troubleshooting steps. * Support teammates and, at senior levels, provide technical mentorship—especially in systems thinking. * Contribute to improving the team's development workflows and tooling, including AI\-assisted practices. * Must be able to travel internationally to customer sites at least 20% of the time, with additional travel as business needs require. **Qualifications** * PhD, MS, or Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Physics, or related field. * Doctorate degree with 0\+ years related experience; or Master's degree with 0\+ years related experience; or Bachelor's degree with 0\+ years related experience. * Demonstrated ability to reason about systems at multiple levels of abstraction—from high\-level architecture down to implementation details. * Strong problem\-solving, analytical, and communication skills; able to articulate complex system behavior clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Competency (or demonstrable coursework) in at least one numerically focused environment such as Python or MATLAB, including linear algebra, image processing, and/or machine learning libraries. * Competency (or demonstrable coursework) in at least one compiled or production language used in large\-scale software systems, such as C\+\+, C\#, or Java. Preferred Qualifications * Experience in semiconductor inspection, machine vision, robotics, or similar highly technical domains where hardware/software co\-design is essential. * Track record of diagnosing cross\-subsystem issues that span optics, electronics, firmware, and application software. * Experience effectively using AI coding agents (e.g., Copilot, Cursor, Aider, or similar) to accelerate development. * Experience with software development methodologies such as Agile, Scrum, or Kanban. * Experience with version control and CI/CD practices. * Experience debugging complex multi\-threaded software environments. * Familiarity with embedded systems, hardware communication protocols, and/or real\-time constraints. **Level Typical Experience** **Expectations** SWE I New grad / 0–2 years Builds foundational system understanding, executes well\-defined tasks (often AI\-assisted), learns to validate outputs against system constraints. SWE II 2–5 years Owns features end\-to\-end, decomposes cross\-subsystem problems, effectively directs AI agents for implementation, and contributes to design. Senior SWE 5\+ years Drives architecture and technical direction, holds the authoritative mental model of the system, leads cross\-team problem\-solving, mentors the team in systems thinking and AI\-augmented workflows. Why Join Onto Innovation? At Onto Innovation, we believe your work should matter—and so should your well\-being. That’s why we offer competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package designed to support you and your family. From health, dental, and vision coverage to life and disability insurance, PTO, and a 401(k) with employer match, we’ve got you covered. You’ll also enjoy access to our Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP), wellness initiatives, and cutting\-edge tools—all within a collaborative, inclusive culture where your contributions are valued and recognized. **Compensation \& Growth** * Base Salary Range: $115,200\.00 \- $172,800\.00, offered in good faith and based on experience, location, and qualifications.* Additional Rewards: Annual bonus opportunities and potential long\-term incentives tied to both company and individual success. Empowering Every Voice to Shape the Future: Onto Innovation is committed to creating a workplace where every qualified candidate has an equal opportunity to succeed. We evaluate applicants based on skills, experience, and potential \- without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We believe diversity of thought and background drives innovation and strengthens our team. jobs.title: Manufacturing Quality Engineer, Data Center Equipment
jobs.description: Compute \- US \- Remote **About the Team** OpenAI and its capital and technology partners are building a global network of data centers for demanding AI workloads. The Infrastructure Quality team sets and verifies qualityance requirements for equipment across that network. We work with manufacturing partners, general contractors, engineers, and operations staff from supplier qualification through commissioning. Together, we verify that equipment arrives ready for installation, startup, and long\-term service. **About the Role** As a Manufacturing Quality Engineer, you will oversee the quality of data center equipment at supplier factories. You will use production data, audits, and test results to identify systemic, recurring, or safety\-related issues and work with suppliers to address them through Closed Loop Learning (CLL). You will work with suppliers and internal teams to define inspections and factory tests for each type of equipment. You will coordinate issue resolution before shipment and manage deviations across multiple suppliers and project sites. **Key Responsibilities** **Manufacturing Monitoring and Supplier Improvement** * Manufacturing monitoring: Work with Manufacturing Operations to monitor production progress, quality controls, inspection results, and test readiness. Flag emerging risks and coordinate a response with suppliers. * Product and process audits: Audit products and processes during and after production against engineering requirements, critical\-to\-quality (CTQ) characteristics, approved procedures, and quality standards. Document findings and track corrective actions to closure. * Manufacturing coordination: Agree on production checkpoints and inspection and testing requirements with suppliers, engineering, sourcing, supply chain, commissioning, and quality teams. Escalate risks to equipment acceptance or delivery. * Manufacturing scorecards: Develop supplier and product scorecards with Manufacturing Operations. Review audit findings, test results, recurring defects, and open issues with suppliers to prioritize improvements. * Drive continuous improvement: Lead the CLL process with suppliers. Track root cause analyses and corrective and preventive actions in a shared register. Verify that each action addresses the underlying problem before closing it. **Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT)** * Standardize requirements and formats: Develop product\-specific FAT requirements and standard test formats with equipment suppliers and OpenAI’s engineering, commissioning, quality, and Manufacturing Operations teams. * Define critical quality requirements: Document the CTQ characteristics each test must verify in an OpenAI\-accepted format. Use CLL findings to revise FAT procedures so future tests check for known failure modes. * Ensure auditable supplier records: Require suppliers to retain test results and make them available for OpenAI audits. * Manage documentation and revision control: Review final FAT records and audit reports for each piece of equipment and maintain a controlled revision history. * Conduct periodic supplier audits: Check that suppliers follow approved test procedures and that their records accurately reflect the tests performed. **Factory Witness Testing (FWT)** * Align checklists and stakeholders: Develop standard FWT checklists with OpenAI subject matter experts, installing contractors, and the construction management team. Agree on requirements before testing begins. * Manage documentation and reporting: Collect and review final witness test reports and supporting records from participants. * Before shipment, confirm that each witness\-test issue is resolved or covered by a documented deviation. Log systemic, recurring, or safety\-related findings in the CLL tracker and verify the effectiveness of corrective actions with the supplier. **Deviation Management** * Assess short shipments and missing or failed tests in partnership with Manufacturing Operations. * Coordinate supplier support to resolve issues at the project site. * Document each deviation and track the agreed actions through closure. **Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in electrical, mechanical, or industrial engineering. * At least 10 years of data center industry experience spanning quality engineering and project management. * Experience coordinating FAT and FWT with suppliers and resolving equipment quality issues. * Ability to develop test checklists, define CTQs, review test results, and maintain auditable quality records. * Experience monitoring supplier production, auditing products and processes during and after production, and using scorecards to improve supplier and product quality. Experience managing controlled documents and deviations. * Ability to coordinate supplier schedules and plan inspections and tests across multiple pieces of equipment. * Ability to communicate quality requirements and coordinate decisions across suppliers, engineering, commissioning, sourcing, supply chain, manufacturing, operations, quality, and construction teams. * Willingness and ability to travel approximately 40–60% of the time to supplier manufacturing facilities and data center project sites. **Preferred Skills** * Technical knowledge of data center infrastructure, including mechanical, electrical, and controls systems. * Experience in supplier performance management for mission\-critical facilities. * ASQ Certified Quality Engineer, Quality Manager, or Quality Auditor. * PMP or equivalent project management certification. * Experience in industrial or high\-volume manufacturing environments. **About OpenAI** OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general\-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core the full spectrum of humanity. discipline, not on any one person's knowledge. **Who You Are** --------------- ### **Required Qualifications** * 8\+ years of experience in Technical Program Management or an equivalent strategic * Experience defining and using delivery metrics (velocity, predictability, cycle time, health indicators) to improve team performance. * Strong prioritization and decision\-making skills with the ability to operate autonomously. * Experience aligning and influencing cross\-functional stakeholders. * Hands\-on experience using **Jira** and other project management tools to manage jobs.title: Staff Product Manager, In Store Offerings
jobs.description: **About Owner** Owner is the AI\-native system local business owners use to succeed, starting with restaurants. We’re building the system that replaces the many tools owners use to run their business. It powers everything from the restaurant’s website, online ordering, CRM, POS, and more. **Product philosophy** Most small business software makes owners do the work to get what they want: sales growth and profit growth. Owner does the work for them agentically. Our system drives demand, converts it, and helps operators run their business day to day. As it improves, the business improves with it. Using Owner should feel like having a team of great operators, engineers, and marketers working for you. **Our vision** We’re starting by helping independent restaurants succeed online. But it’s not just restaurants that need our help. Most local businesses are struggling with these same problems. Huge technology corporations are taking their customers, bleeding their profits, and making it hard for them to survive. Once we nail the solution for restaurants – we’ll scale it into every other local business type. In the future we envision, tens of millions of local business owners will use our technology to succeed in the digital age. **Our traction** Since 2020, we've generated tens of millions in revenue and processed over a billion dollars of online orders. 1 in 5 Americans have used an Owner.com website. More importantly, we’ve helped over 20,000 restaurant owners, and saved them nearly $200 million in fees. **Our team** Our team is now in the low hundreds. We’ve got top talent from the most successful companies in SMB software, including: Shopify, HubSpot, DoorDash, ServiceTitan, Rappi, Faire and Stripe. We’ll be scaling even faster in 2026 to keep pace with our customer growth. **Where we work** Owner is a remote\-first, global company headquartered in San Francisco, with a sales hub in Toronto. For a few of our roles we prioritize in\-person collaboration at one of our office locations. Most of our teammates are distributed throughout the globe. Please review the role description and discuss with your recruiter for more details on location! **Why we’re looking for you** In store is Owner’s big initiative — we started as the best way to help local businesses win online, and realized in store channels can be a crucial accelerant to that. We’ve kickstarted this effort by building and launching the Owner POS, Kitchen Display System and Kiosk all in less than a year. We’re hiring a product leader to support across our in store offering end\-to\-end — a PM who wants to run and build a business line (product \+ operating model), and who is excited to be forward\-deployed. You’ll spend meaningful time in the field building relationships with sophisticated restaurant groups, and you’ll turn that signal into a scalable product \+ operating model. Our ambition is to scale our point of sale and kiosk business lines past $100M\+ ARR. **The impact you'll have** * **Shift restaurant software from outputs to outcomes.** Build experiences that synthesize what matters, explain why it matters, recommend the next best action, and make it easy to act. * **Own the core operator experience across mobile and desktop.** Bring together the workflows restaurants rely on every day, including orders, guest issues, operational settings, business performance, and growth opportunities, into a cohesive product experience. * **Build personalized business guidance.** Show restaurants the value Owner is driving, identify the highest\-impact opportunities, and deliver the right recommendation across product, email, SMS, customer success, and AI agent experiences. * **Scale unified guest and order management.** Help restaurants monitor, manage, and resolve reviews, support requests, forms, order issues, and operational exceptions quickly. * **Productize best\-practice playbooks into simple actions.** Turn proven operator and customer\-success workflows into personalized recommendations, one\-tap actions, and safe automation. * **Earn trust in AI\-assisted execution.** Design the permissions, confirmations, evaluation loops, rollback paths, and failure handling needed for restaurants to trust Owner with increasingly important work. * **Operate forward\-deployed.** Spend meaningful time with restaurant owners and teams — in restaurants, in kitchens, over text, and alongside our support and success teams — to understand what actually happens day to day. Turn that proximity into sharper product priorities, better AI behavior, and products that feel like real leverage for operators. * **Lead through ambiguity.** Align product, design, engineering, data, AI, customer success, and operations around the highest\-impact operator outcomes. **What we’re looking for** * **5\+ years of product management experience, or equivalent building experience**, with a track record of shipping high\-impact products. * **Forward\-deployed customer obsession.** You build conviction by getting close to the work: visiting restaurants, observing live workflows, texting with operators, shadowing frontline teams, and understanding how work actually gets done before deciding what to build. * **AI product instincts grounded in real operations.** You think in loops — signals decisions actions learning — and care deeply about quality, trust, and iteration. * **Excellent product judgment and taste.** You can reduce cognitive load, simplify messy workflows, and design products that feel obvious to busy, non\-technical users. * **Technical depth and strong engineering partnership.** You can reason about systems, data flows, integrations, permissions, reliability, and tradeoffs. * **Bias toward outcomes over features.** You know how to connect product work to customer and business impact, not just launches. * **Strong prioritization and execution.** You can balance speed, correctness, and long\-term maintainability in a fast\-moving environment. * **Cross\-functional leadership.** You can align opinionated stakeholders, create clarity from ambiguity, and keep teams moving. **Compensation and benefits** * The estimated starting base salary range for this role is $220\- $240K, plus a generous pre\-IPO equity package * Other benefits include comprehensive health coverage, remote\-first workplace, unlimited PTO \- plus extra fun perks! **Notice \- Employment Scams** Communication from our team regarding job opportunities will only be made by an Owner team member with an @owner.com email address. We do not conduct interviews over email or chat platforms, and we will never ask you to provide personal or financial information such as your mailing address, social security number, credit card numbers or banking information. If you believe you are being contacted by a scammer, please mark the communication as "phishing" or “spam” and do not respond. \#LI\-AB1

jobs.title: Factory Service Engineer
jobs.description: At Oxford Instruments, we enable the world’s leading industrial companies and scientific research communities to image, analyse and manipulate materials down to the atomic and molecular level. Using Atomic Force Microscopes from Asylum Research, our customers can see how cancer cells respond to new treatments, extend the lifetime and efficiency of renewable energy systems and lithium\-ion batteries, and develop the novel materials required for quantum computing. **Business Unit:** Oxford Instruments AFM **Location:** Santa Barbara, CA (in\-person) **Job Title:** Factory Service Engineer **Reports to:** FactoryService Supervisor **About Oxford Instruments:** Our purpose is to accelerate the breakthroughs that create a brighter future for our world. Our technology and scientific expertise enable our customers to discover and bring to market exciting new advances that drive human progress. We aim to be the scientific instrumentation partner in every significant lab and production facility across the world. Oxford Instruments Asylum Research is a manufacturer of nanotechnology instrumentation for industry and research. Specifically, we design, build and sell Atomic Force Microscopes (AFM) which are used to analyze material topography, elasticity, conductivity, and other properties. We are part of the wider Oxford Instruments Group that includes the Imaging \& Analysis Division. The I\&A Division includes Andor Technology, our Electron Microscopy products, NanoIndentor, Raman products, and NMR product lines. Plasma Technology and X\-Ray Technology are part of the Advanced Technology Division. With a sixty\-year history, and fourteen Queen’s Awards and a King’s Award for Enterprise, our world\-class products and technologies are helping our customers to address the greatest challenges of the 21st century. We want to empower our employees so that they innovate, support our growth, and improve our productivity. We support them to make the right decisions and reach their full potential as they develop their careers at Oxford Instruments. Our ways of working are lived every day and are as follows: * We start with the customer * We succeed by being focused * We make and keep our promises * We work together as one team * We help and trust each other to succeed **About the Opportunity:** Oxford Instruments Asylum Research is seeking a hands\-on Factory Service Engineer to support the factory service, repair, troubleshooting, testing, and continuous improvement of advanced Atomic Force Microscope (AFM) systems and related components at our Santa Barbara facility. This in\-person role partners closely with Production, Test, Engineering, and other teams to diagnose complex technical issues, restore equipment to specification, and deliver reliable solutions that support our customers and internal operations. The Factory Service Engineer also serves as a customer\-focused technical partner, providing timely updates, clear explanations, and responsive support that builds trust and helps minimize customer downtime. **Key job responsibilities include, but not limited to:** * Diagnose, troubleshoot, repair, and test AFM systems, subassemblies, electronics, mechanical assemblies, and related accessories returned for factory service. * Perform systematic fault isolation using schematics, technical documentation, diagnostic tools, test equipment, and established service procedures. * Complete preventive maintenance, calibration, upgrades, refurbishment, and verification testing to ensure serviced equipment meets applicable performance and quality requirements. * Document troubleshooting steps, repairs, parts used, test results, and final disposition clearly and accurately in service and quality records. * Partner with Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, Applications, and field service teams to resolve complex or recurring product issues and provide actionable technical feedback. * Support root\-cause investigations and corrective actions by identifying failure trends and recommending improvements to service processes, documentation, test methods, or product design. * Maintain service work areas, tools, test fixtures, and equipment in a safe, organized, and ready\-to\-use condition. * Communicate status, findings, risks, and priorities effectively with internal stakeholders and, when appropriate, support technical communication related to customer service cases. * Provide responsive, professional technical support for customer service cases by listening carefully, clarifying symptoms and expectations, and communicating troubleshooting findings and next steps in clear, customer\-friendly language. * Build customer confidence and long\-term trust through dependable follow\-up, accurate commitments, and a service\-oriented approach that keeps customers informed throughout the repair or support process. * Support remote troubleshooting and technical guidance, when appropriate, to help resolve issues efficiently, minimize customer downt eting priorities, and time\-sensitive service needs. * Ability to build collaborative relationships with customers and internal teams while maintaining ownership of issues through communication, follow\-up, escalation, and resolution. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Physics, Applied Science, or a related technical field. * Experience servicing, building, testing, or supporting AFMs, scanning probe microscopes, optical systems, motion\-control systems, vacuum systems, or other precision scientific instruments. * Experience in a technical service, depot repair, manufacturing engineering, sustaining engineering, or field service environment. * Familiarity with basic software, networking, or computer hardware troubleshooting used with laboratory instrumentation. * Experience with ERP, CRM, service case management, or quality management systems. * Experience working within ESD\-controlled environments and formal quality systems. * Customer\-facing technical support or field service experience. * Experience providing customer training, remote technical support, or communicating service recommendations and repair outcomes for complex scientific or analytical instrumentation. **Salary:** In accordance with California law, the expected annual salary for this full\-time, benefited position is between jobs.description: **Why this role matters** Hail doesn't give notice. When a storm hits, thousands of claims come in within a few hours, wherever it lands. You are the person who makes sure it does. **Your part** Build and run HailCare Pro, our claims and repair platform for hail damage, used on five continents, including in the US, Brazil, Spain, South Africa and Australia. You'll work fully on\-site in our Lewisville office for the first 4 weeks (2 with our US team, 2 with the scanner team), then hybrid, about half the week in the office, with occasional travel to scanner stations, alongside our COO and our development partner in Germany. Early in your first months, you'll also spend a few weeks with our development team in Berlin to get to know the team and the codebase. Why we're hiring now: Claim seasons are starting in Brazil, Spain, South Africa and Australia, and our US season starts February 1\. Our CCC API access was just approved, and HailCare Pro needs US\-specific features now. **What you'll do** * Build HailCare Pro features for the US market, starting with importing CCC estimates through our newly approved CCC API * Build and maintain integrations: CCC, QuickBooks Online, Microsoft Business Central, and our technician app * Work with our development partner Axonetiq (Berlin\-based, the team behind HailCare Pro): write change requests, review, test, and release * Support live claim operations across all markets during their seasons – find and fix issues fast * Support our Colibri hail scanners on the IT side: software updates, troubleshooting, and the data flow into HailCare Pro * Be available evenings and weekends during active hail season storm events, on call to keep claims moving **First 90 days** * CCC estimates importing into HailCare Pro * HailCare Pro invoices flowing into QuickBooks without manual retyping * You're the first point of contact for HailCare Pro issues across all markets **Required** * Our stack: Angular (plus a legacy AngularJS app), Next.js, Node.js, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis, Camunda (BPMN) * 3–6 years of hands\-on full\-stack development on most of our stack technologies * Experience in integrations between business systems * Strong software engineering fundamentals in web development, including data structures, algorithms, system design, debugging, testing, and code quality practices. This knowledge is essential for directing AI tools effectively and catching their mistakes. * Demonstrated fluency with AI coding assistants and agents (Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Codex, or equivalent). You identify logic errors, security issues, edge\-case failures, performance problems, and design mismatches that AI tools commonly introduce. * Ability to break down ambiguous requirements into clear specifications and context that AI tools can act on productively, then iterate until the output is production\-ready. * Insurance, collision, or claims software experience; CCC ONE experience * Clear communication skills in English with operations staff, developers and business clients * Based near our Lewisville, TX office: fully on\-site for the first 4 weeks, then hybrid, with occasional travel to scanner stations * Available for evening and weekend on\-call work during hail season storm events **Nice to have** * German (our development partner is based in Germany) * Microsoft 365 administration experience **What We Offer** * $100,000–$120,000/year * Health, dental \& vision insurance * Paid time off * AI coding tools paid by us * Laptop provided **How we hire:** A short online coding challenge, then interviews with our COO and the development team.
