jobs.title: Engineer I-III (OMS Analyst)
jobs.description: **POSTING DEADLINE** This position is posted until filled. **DEPARTMENT** Department: DOC Engineering **PREFERENCES** **About DOC Engineering** PNM¿s Distribution Operation Center (DOC) Engineering team supports the operational systems used to monitor and control the electric distribution system, manage outages, and improve operational reliability. DOC Engineers work closely with Distribution Operations, field personnel, technology teams, and system vendors to configure, test, troubleshoot, maintain, and improve these systems. This position will support the phased deployment of PNM¿s new Advanced Distribution Management System (ADMS), along with ongoing operational system support. Responsibilities will evolve throughout the deployment, from configuration, data validation, and testing to commissioning, production support, and implementation of additional capabilities. Later releases will introduce advanced applications such as integrated volt/VAR management (IVVM), fault location, isolation, and service restoration (FLISR), distributed energy resource management systems (DERMS), and wildfire\-related operational functions. DOC Engineering will have a continuing role in validating system performance, supporting operators, and expanding the use of these capabilities. The position will be filled at the Engineer I, II, or III level based on the selected candidate¿s qualifications and experience. Assignments, independence, and technical responsibility will be appropriate to the engineering level. The initial assignment will emphasize the functional area described below, with cross\-training and opportunities to support other SCADA, OMS, and ADMS functions as team needs evolve. Training, mentoring, and hands\-on participation in deployment will develop familiarity with PNM¿s systems, configurations, and operational practices. In addition to day\-to\-day system support, these positions will emphasize proactive engineering, using operational data and system analysis to identify improvement opportunities, recommend changes, and evaluate results. **Position focus** This position focuses on the Outage Management System (OMS) within PNM¿s ADMS. The engineer will work with other DOC Engineers, Distribution Operations, Schneider Electric, and other technical teams to support the applications, data, workflows, and interfaces used to detect, predict, track, and support restoration of electric distribution outages. Primary responsibilities include:* Configure and maintain OMS application settings, outage\-processing rules, workflows, code lists, and operator views. * Validate outage detection, prediction, and restoration processing against expected operational behavior. * Investigate data and interface issues involving the distribution network model, Geographic Information System (GIS), Advanced Metering Infrastructure (AMI), Customer Information System (CIS), and field mobility systems. * Develop and execute functional, integration, acceptance, and regression tests; document results and coordinate defect resolution. * Distinguish application\-configuration issues from source\-data, network\-model, interface, and software defects. * Support cutover, production troubleshooting, controlled configuration changes, software updates, and technical documentation. This role will involve deploying, evaluating, and improving additional OMS and related ADMS capabilities, including switching management, field crew coordination, storm response, and wildfire\-related operational functions. The engineer will analyze outage records, restoration timelines, network\-model and interface data, and operator feedback to identify recurring problems and opportunities to improve outage prediction, restoration support, data quality, and operational workflows. The role will also support validation of how advanced applications, including FLISR, interact with outage processing and restoration workflows as their deployment expands. These responsibilities will combine ongoing production support with proactive analysis, configuration improvements, and evaluation of operational results. **Relevant experience** Electric\-utility OMS experience is required. This should include hands\-on experience with OMS configuration, testing, troubleshooting, or application support, along with an understanding of distribution outage\-management processes. Experience with Schneider Electric¿s EcoStruxure ADMS, particularly its OMS functionality, is preferred but not required. Experience with other electric\-utility OMS platforms is also relevant. Additional desirable experience includes distribution network connectivity, GIS and AMI integrations, customer\-system interfaces, field crew workflows, databases, SQL, and data analysis tools.**JOB DESCRIPTION** **Engineer I** Salary: DOE Personnel in this job title may be covered by NERC CIP cyber security standards. If the position is covered, prior to being hired, promoted, or transferred into the position, the candidate must  ts and applies national, state, and local electrical codes and standards such as IEEE, ANSI, NEC, NESC, ACI, and AISC Prepares clear and concise engineering reports, presentations, and technical documentation for both engineering and non\-engineering audiences Provides technical support and guidance to other associates, contractors, and company personnel as required Represents the company in intermediate engineering matters and contribute to the formulation of company and industry standards Participates in activities that improve system reliability and operational efficiency, including working safely in and around high voltage electrical facilities Assists in coordinating with construction, operations, and maintenance teams to ensure engineering solutions meet practical requirements and safety standards Maintains compliance with NERC CIP cyber security standards where applicable, including passing required risk assessments and training COMPETENCIES: Knowledge of and ability to apply standard engineering principles, practices and regulations, and economic and decision analysis principles to area problems including, but not limited to, generation, transmission, distribution, fuels, system planning, financial and regulatory issues, asset utilization, and environmental controls and regulations. Ability to read, interpret and apply national, state and local codes and standards (IEEE, ANSI, NEC, NESC, ACI, AISC, etc.). Demonstrated good leadership skills, self\-motivation, and good interpersonal skills. Ability to translate electrical theory and physics to utility application for improving system reliability. Comfortable working in and around high voltage (up to 345kV) electrical facilities and equipment. QUALIFICATIONS MINIMUM EDUCATION AND/OR EXPERIENCE: Bachelor¿s Degree in Engineering from a college/university accredited by the Accreditation Board for Engineering and Technology, Inc. (ABET), plus 2 or more years of engineering experience or 1 or more with a Fundamentals of Engineering certificate or 1 or more years plus a Master¿s Degree in Engineering. CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, AND REGISTRATIONS Fundamentals of Engineering certificate preferred. Must possess current, legally valid driver¿s license and meet the Company¿s driving record requirements. COMMUNICATION SKILLS: Ability to read and interpret documents. Ability to write routine reports and correspondence, write speeches, and presentations. Ability to speak effectively before groups of customers, employees, and managers of the organization. COMPUTER SKILLS: In\-depth knowledge of personal computers including demonstrated proficiency with electrical engineering design programs, Autocad, Word, Access, Excel, Windows, etc. ANALYSIS AND PROBLEM\-SOLVING ABILITY: Ability to apply common sense understanding to carry out complex instructions furnished in written, oral, or diagram form. Ability to deal with complex problems involving several concrete variables in complicated situations. Physical Demands Frequent sitting, standing, walking, and exposure to outside elements. Ability to lift up to 50 pounds. Activities include crouching, bending, climbing, and working at various heights. Use of protective equipment such as hard\-hat, safety glasses, and hearing protection is required. Time will be divided between office and field Work Environment Work will be around high voltage electricity, computers, office equipment, and construction equipment. **SAFETY AND ADA STATEMENT** Safety Statement: Safety is a core value at (TXNM Energy/PNM/TNMP) and our vision, "everyone goes home safe", reflects our commitment to promoting an environment conducive to learning, improving and building safety practices. Our safety value is built upon the belief that every employee deserves to work in an environment free from harm. jobs.title: Software Developer

You will take technical problems from the IT department and our business analysts and turn them into working solutions — automation scripts, internal web applications, ERP integrations, and Power Automate and AI\-assisted workflows that remove manual effort from the business. Reporting to the IT Director, you will be the sole software developer in the organization and will work closely with our business analysts, data analyst, and the end users who depend on these systems every day. ongoing support. * Identify automation opportunities proactively by observing how teams work, rather than waiting for requests. **Automation \& Scripting:** * Design, build, and maintain Python and PowerShell automation that eliminates manual, repetitive work across the business. * Build and maintain workflows in Microsoft Power Automate, including approvals, notifications, and system\-to\-system handoffs. * Apply AI and large language model (LLM) capabilities where they add practical value — for example, using AI APIs and Microsoft Copilot services in Python\-based scripts and workflows to classify, summarize, or extract information from unstructured data. * Schedule, monitor, and support automation running on Windows Server and in Azure. **Internal Web Development:** * Build and maintain internal websites, dashboards, and tools used by staff across the company. * Deploy and maintain those applications on internal web servers (IIS) and in Azure. * Apply secure development practices — authentication, authorization, input validation, and least\-privilege access. **ERP \& Business Systems Integration:** * Integrate custom solutions with our ERP platform, Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central, and with our MES and other line\-of\-business systems. * Build and consume REST APIs to move data reliably between systems. * Develop, test, and deploy Business Central extensions as needed, and validate existing customizations against Business Central release waves and updates. * Support our data analyst with data ingestion, pipelines, and transformation work in Microsoft Fabric, and help troubleshoot data quality and pipeline reliability issues. **General IT Support \& Practices:** * Learn our ERP and MES platforms and become a trusted technical resource for both. * Assist the IT team with general support tasks as needed, such as endpoint issues, Microsoft 365 administration, and user support during busy periods or coverage gaps. * Follow change management and version control practices and keep technical documentation current. **Requirements:** * Associate or bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, MIS, or a primary languages of this role. You should be comfortable writing, debugging, and maintaining production\-quality scripts in both for automation, integration, and data work, not just adapting existing examples. * Working knowledge of Windows Server — roles and features, services and scheduled tasks, file systems and permissions, and basic troubleshooting. * Hands\-on experience with Microsoft Azure services relevant to application hosting, identity, storage, and integration (for example App Service, Entra ID, SQL, Storage, DevOps). * Working understanding of computer networking fundamentals — DNS, DHCP, TCP/IP, firewall rules, certificates, and how they affect the applications and integrations you build. * Experience consuming and building REST APIs, including authentication, JSON handling, and error handling. * Familiarity with source control (Git) and disciplined development practices. * Strong written and verbal communication skills — you will be explaining technical work to non\-technical people frequently. * Demonstrated willingness to learn business systems and the operational processes behind them. Genuine curiosity about how the business works is a requirement. * Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and know when to escalate. * Proactive — anticipates opportunities and issues, presents solutions, and leads execution. * Excellent problem\-solving and troubleshooting skills. Lifelong learner and forward thinking. **Preferred Skills and Abilities** * HTML, CSS, and JavaScript — enough to build and maintain functional internal web applications. * Internet Information Services (IIS) — site and application pool configuration, bindings, and certificates. * Microsoft Power Automate — building and supporting flows in a business environment. * Working understanding of AI and large language models (LLMs) — prompt design, calling AI APIs from code, and a practical sense of where these tools are appropriate, where they are not, and the data\-privacy and security considerations involved. * Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central development using AL and Visual Studio Code. * Microsoft Fabric or Power BI experience with data pipelines and reporting. * Cybersecurity fundamentals and secure coding practices. * Experience in a manufacturing or food production environment.

jobs.title: Head of Data & ML
jobs.description: **About Posh** ============== We are all social creatures, but the dominant “social” companies today have evolved into digital loneliness machines, driving isolation, anxiety, and mental health challenges around the world. Human connection is lost. Posh is a beacon guiding us back. Posh enables anyone to build an IRL community based on shared interests, while connecting consumers with the communities of people just like them. Founded by event organizers who were frustrated with the growing loneliness epidemic and the tools available to build their own event brand, we’ve built the ultimate platform for launching, monetizing, and finding IRL communities of people just like you. In just 6 years, Posh has grown to a team of 70, expanded to 10M\+ users, secured $70m in venture funding, and facilitated over $400M in transactions. **About the Role** ================== As our Head of Data and ML, you will own the entire data function. You’ll be accountable for the technical excellence and vision of the team that builds event discovery for 1M MAUs, the experimentation and measurement that guide product investment, and the data platform the whole company relies on to make decisions. This is a rare opportunity to lead a unified data organization, providing clear direction and impact across the business. You’ll lead a talented multi\-disciplinary team of 8 data scientists, machine learning engineers, and analytics/data engineers. Your job is to keep the team’s bar and vision sharp as Posh scales: choosing the right problems, making sound decisions, and shipping work that moves the product forward. Your day\-to\-day will involve: * Balancing team leadership with hands\-on technical work as a true player\-coach * Translating a product\-oriented vision into a technical roadmap the team believes in * Working hands\-on in analysis reviews, experiment critiques, model evaluations, and building prototypes yourself when it moves things forward * Mentoring senior ICs into leaders and helping mid\-level ICs level up * Setting a culture of rigor, urgency, and craft across every discipline on the team **This role is in\-person 5 days a week at our SoHo, NYC headquarters. Relocation bonuses are available for out\-of\-state candidates.** **What You'll Own** =================== * **Be the technical translation layer:** Turn the product vision into focused data and ML bets, and give the team the context to make good calls on their own. When product brings you an idea, you sharpen or debate it, say what’s possible, what it will cost, and what we’ll learn. When something isn’t possible yet, you can explain why and lay out the path to get there. Own the data narrative at All Hands, leadership reviews, and board updates. * **Build Posh’s discovery and search systems:** Advise the team as they build our ranking, recommendation, classification, and search algorithms, from problem framing and baselines to offline evaluation and online testing. Define the metrics that prove discovery is getting better every quarter. * **Make experimentation a source of truth:** Raise the rigor of experiment design, metric selection, and analysis. Bring causal inference to the questions A/B tests can’t answer cleanly, so product and engineering investment follows real evidence. Improve our understanding of ecosystem tradeoffs and marketplace dynamics. * **Scale the data and ML foundation:** improve our data infrastructure, with a focus on AI/ML readiness \- from our warehouse to feature pipelines, observability, and evaluation tooling. Make sure every model and AI feature we ship is built on data we trust. Make build\-vs\-buy calls along the way. * **Make Posh AI\-native with data:** rethink how data work gets done now that agents can write SQL and run analyses. Lead data and and cross\-functional partners to build the semantic layer and AI\-native tools on top of it (text\-to\-SQL, MCP, agentic analytics), so anyone at Posh can get a trustworthy answer on their own. Measure data adoption and close the gaps. * **Raise the bar at every level:** Set what great looks like across DS, ML, and DE. Give senior ICs room to lead, give mid\-level ICs a clear path to their next level, and have hard conversations quickly and with care. **Who You Are** =============== * You believe in the importance of real\-world human connection and are passionate about our mission to help the world connect more meaningfully in real life. * You have 10\+ years in data, including 3\+ years managing DS, ML, and/or DE teams at a high\-growth consumer or marketplace company. * You’re a former Staff\-level IC who still works like one: senior ICs respect your technical judgment because you can add signal in model review, experiment readouts, and architecture discussions. * You’re deep in either causal inference or recommendation/ranking systems, and credible in the other. * You’re bullish on AI\-native data development. You’ve already changed how you and your team works because of it, and you have a clear view of where data roles, tooling, and team shape are heading. * You’ve turned ambiguous product goals into technical roadmaps that shaped critical decisions. * You’d rather multiply a strong team than build a large one. **Ideally:** ============ * You have built a semantic layer or AI evaluation frameworks in production. * You have entrepreneurial spirit and been part of a 0\-1 founding team or a founder yourself. * You have worked closely with a founder or CEO who is deeply involved in product, taste, and pace. Posh provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training. Posh is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application procedures. Please let us know if you need assistance or accommodation due to a disability Compensation Range: $300K \- $350K

You’ll partner directly with engineering leaders and architects, influence how products are designed and delivered, and combine deep security craft with emerging AI capabilities. The fundamentals matter here: AI is a force multiplier, but great security judgment comes first. **Build what’s next, securely** ------------------------------- Pax8 is evolving quickly, and our Platform Security team is growing alongside our product landscape. You’ll join a small, collaborative remote team where you’re trusted to take ownership, work independently, and bring security into engineering conversations early. We’re building at the intersection of cloud, security, automation, and AI. Get to know more about Pax8 and explore our latest developments in the Pax8 US Newsroom . **What you’ll get ownership of** -------------------------------- * **Be a trusted security partner** to your product area, working alongside engineering leads and architects to influence secure design and implementation. * **Lead practical threat modeling** , helping teams understand where risk lives and turning that insight into actionable engineering decisions. * **Go beyond automated findings** with hands\-on code review, design review, and security testing that identifies the issues requiring real human judgment. * **Own the vulnerability lifecycle** , evaluating findings from static application security testing, software composition analysis, dynamic application security testing, and secret\-scanning tools and helping teams prioritize what genuinely matters. * **Make security tooling better** , tuning and maintaining security tooling within delivery pipelines and bringing useful security insight directly into developer workflows. * **Build for the AI era** , creating agentic tooling that can improve vulnerability triage, deduplication, exploitability enrichment, and remediation guidance while maintaining appropriate human oversight. * **Help secure AI\-assisted development** , shaping guardrails for AI\-assisted and agent\-generated code and validating whether those controls work in practice. * **Turn identified vulnerabilities into resolved vulnerabilities** , partnering with engineering teams to reproduce issues, shape remediation, and validate fixes. * **Represent security in architectural decisions** , clearly explaining technical risk, tradeoffs, and practical paths forward. * **Raise security capability around you** , mentoring teammates and engineering security champions while turning recurring defects into focused learning. * Support penetration\-testing findings, bug bounty triage, and security incidents when your application security expertise is needed. **The impact you’ll make** -------------------------- You’ll help bring security closer to the engineering teams building Pax8’s next generation of products. Your work will make application security more scalable, measurable, and useful to developers while helping the business innovate confidently across established cloud products, new financial technology, and emerging agentic AI capabilities. You won’t simply point out risk. You’ll help engineering teams understand it, solve it, and build more securely the next time. * **You’ll thrive here if you bring** * **Substantial application or product security experience** , with a track record of partnering directly with software engineering teams. * Deep practical capability in **threat modeling and manual code review** for web and microservice environments. * Strong understanding of difficult application\-security problems such as **authorization, multi\-tenant isolation, and business\-logic vulnerabilities** . * Hands\-on experience operating application security tooling for **source\-code analysis, dependency analysis, dynamic testing, and secret detection** , including configuration, tuning, pipeline integration, and finding triage. * The technical judgment to distinguish a noisy security finding from an exploitable risk and explain the remediation clearly. * Experience creating **automation or engineering tooling for vulnerability management** . Applying large language models or agents to security workflows is especially valuable. * Practical understanding of security risks in **large language model and agentic applications** , including prompt injection, unauthorized tool use, and potential data\-exfiltration paths. * Proficiency with at least one modern cloud\-native programming language. Our environment includes **Kotlin and JavaScript/TypeScript** , and you should be comfortable reading unfamiliar code. * Working knowledge of **Amazon Web Services, Kubernetes,  : * **401(k) with Company Match** * **Medical, Dental \& Vision Coverage** * **Employee Assistance Program (EAP)** * **Employer\-Paid Life, AD\&D, Short\-Term Disability \& Long\-Term Disability Insurance** * **Flexible Open PTO** * **Paid Sick Leave** * **Paid Parental Leave** * **RTD EcoPass (eligible Colorado\-based employees)** **What’s in it for you?** ------------------------- There's extensive room for a talented individual to grow at pace — whether that's advancing quickly in this role or exploring one of the many opportunities across our global organisation. You'll have access to our internal development hub designed to accelerate your skills and stretch your potential. Alongside specialist Learning \& Development trainers, you'll also tap into AI powered tools, "born in the cloud" mentors, and cross continent collaboration that broaden your perspective and sharpen your expertise. We'll give you the space, trust, and the right projects to help you thrive — and full visibility of what it takes to reach your next level. * **️ Why Pax8?** Our mission is to build the managed intelligence marketplace and empower small businesses to do more with smarter technology. We are a fast\-growing, dynamic, and high\-energy organisation with a start\-up feel, allowing you to make a meaningful impact on the business. Culture is also important to us, and at Pax8, it's business, and it IS personal. We are passionate, creative, and unconventional. We work hard, keep it fun, and expect the best! We Elev8 each other. We Advoc8 for our partners. We Innov8 continuously. We Celebr8 life. **Background checks** --------------------- As part of our hiring process, we are required to undertake pre\-employment checks on all candidates that are successful in their application with Pax8\. As part of these checks Pax8 will request ID verification, reference requests and qualification checks (additional checks may be completed for certain countries, such as criminal and financial). All checks are completed by our third\-party provider, First Advantage. Once checks have been completed all candidates will receive a copy for their records. **Equal opportunities** ----------------------- Pax8 are an equal opportunities employer and welcome individuals who are in possession of the appropriate requirements to work within the country you have applied for. Offered individuals will be asked to undertake identity, security compliance and reference checks. Your privacy is important to us. Your data will be held in accordance with local best practices and processed only in accordance with our recruiting processes. Privacy notice: https://www.pax8\.com/en\-us/terms/job\-applicant\-privacy\-notice/ At Pax8, we care deeply about building genuine, trust‑based relationships — starting with how we hire. To protect our business, our teams, and our customers, we use a range of measures throughout the recruitment process to help confirm authenticity and prevent fraud. These safeguards are designed to be fair, respectful, and proportionate, and may evolve as risks change. By applying, you acknowledge that we take steps to verify identity and representation during hiring. If you’re applying as your authentic self, you have nothing to worry about — we’re excited to meet you. **Perks:** **At Pax8 we believe that your Total Rewards should include a benefits package that shows how much we value our greatest assets. All FTE Pax8 people enjoy the following benefits:** * 401(k) with Company Match * Medical, Dental \& Vision Coverage * Employee Assistance Program (EAP) * Employer\-Paid Life, AD\&D, Short\-Term Disability \& Long\-Term Disability Insurance * Flexible Open PTO * Paid Sick Leave * Paid Parental Leave RTD EcoPass (eligible Colorado\-based employees) * Please take a moment to review our Proprietary Rights and Non\-Competition Agreement — this document outlines important information about your rights and responsibilities if you join our team. jobs.title: Senior Network Engineer
jobs.description: At **PEARCE**, **we've got a career for you!** Pearce is a leading technology\-enabled provider of asset management solutions for mission\-critical electromechanical infrastructure throughout North America. Pearce provides technical maintenance, repair, operations, and engineering services for uninterruptible power supply (UPS) systems, backup power generators, battery energy storage systems (BESS), critical cooling systems, and other electrical and mechanical infrastructure across end markets such as renewable energy, telecom, and data centers. Founded in 1998, Pearce has more than 4,000 employees and 28 locations across the U.S. Pearce is a wholly owned subsidiary of CBRE Group, Inc., the world's largest commercial real estate services and investment firm. To learn more about Pearce visit http://www.pearce\-services.com. Pearce is seeking talented and motivated candidates for the **Senior Network Engineer** role**,** responsible for the design, implementation, administration, maintenance, and optimization of enterprise network infrastructure supporting global data center, cloud, campus, and branch environments. Provides advanced engineering expertise across routing, switching, cloud networking platforms, security, wireless, SDWAN, network segmentation, and load balancing. Serves as a technical lead for complex infrastructure initiatives, ensuring high availability, scalability, security, and operational excellence across all network services. **This hybrid role requires two days per week in a Dallas\-area office. Candidates currently based in the Dallas area are preferred; relocation assistance is not available.** **Key Responsibilities** * Design, deploy, and support enterprise network infrastructure utilizing Cisco Nexus, Catalyst, ASR, ISR, Meraki, and Juniper/HPE networking platforms to include Mist. * Support cloud networking infrastructure across Microsoft Azure, AWS, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including network security, load balancing, connectivity, and hybrid\-cloud integration. * Configure and maintain advanced routing and switching environments using BGP, OSPF, EIGRP, RPVST\+, VPC, and other enterprise networking protocols. * Deploy and support Palo Alto firewalls, VPN technologies, IDS/IPS solutions, URL filtering, Layer 7 security policies, and Zero Trust security architectures. * Engineer and manage Network Access Control (NAC) solutions utilizing Cisco ISE, Forescout, and 802\.1X authentication for enterprise segmentation and policy enforcement. * Manage enterprise wireless infrastructure including Cisco and Juniper Wireless LAN Controllers (WLCs), access points, RF optimization, roaming services, and wireless security. * Configure and maintain F5 load balancing platforms including LTM, GTM, APM, and application delivery services to ensure application availability and performance. * Administer IPAM, DNS, DHCP, certificate services, and related network management platforms. * Design, implement, and maintain WAN and SDWAN solutions including MPLS, DIA, VPLS/EVC, DWDM, and cloud connectivity services. * Administer and optimize Cisco ACI software\-defined networking (SDN) environments to improve network scalability, segmentation, and automation. * Monitor network performance and capacity using NetFlow, SNMP, Syslog, IP SLA, packet capture tools, and other network monitoring solutions. * Perform advanced troubleshooting and root cause analysis across network, cloud, security, and application delivery environments. * Develop automation and scripting solutions to streamline network provisioning, monitoring, configuration management, and operational processes. * Lead infrastructure projects from design through implementation, coordinating with project managers, vendors, security teams, and business stakeholders. * Create and maintain network diagrams, engineering standards, operational procedures, and technical documentation. * Provide mentorship and technical guidance to junior engineers and network operations personnel. * Participate in incident management, change management, capacity planning, and technology lifecycle management activities. * Evaluate emerging technologies and provide recommendations to improve reliability, performance, security, and operational efficiency. **Qualifications** * 8\+ years of progressive experience in enterprise network engineering and infrastructure operations. * Expert knowledge of Cisco and Juniper routing, switching, and data center technologies, including Cisco ACI, Nexus, Catalyst, ASR, and ISR platforms as well Juniper Mist. * Strong experience with Palo Alto firewalls, IPS/IDS technologies, VPN solutions, and network security architecture. * Experience designing and supporting SDWAN, WAN, cloud networking, and enterprise segmentation solutions. * Working knowledge of Azure, AWS, and GCP networking services and hybrid\-cloud architectures. * Experience with Cisco ISE, NAC technologies, wireless networking, F5 load balancing, and network monitoring tools. * Strong analytical, troubleshooting, documentation, and communication skills. * Bachelor's degree in information technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent professional experience. * Industry certifications such as CCNP, CCIE, PCNSE, Azure Network Engineer, AWS Advanced Networking, or equivalent preferred. **Core Technologies** Cloud Networking Azure, AWS, GCP, Cisco ACI, Nexus 9000/7000/5000, Catalyst 9000, ASR, ISR, Catalyst 8000, Cisco Meraki, Juniper Mist, Palo Alto, Cisco ISE, Forescout, NAC, Zero Trust, SASE, VPN, IDS/IPS, BGP, OSPF, EIGRP, MPLS, VPLS, SDWAN, F5 LTM/GTM/APM, DNS, DHCP, IPAM, NetFlow, SNMP, Syslog, and Wireless LAN Controllers. **What We Offer** Pearce offers a family\-friendly and innovative culture with opportunities for growth, competitive compensation, comprehensive health benefits including medical, dental and vision insurance, flexible spending accounts, HSA option. To help you recharge, we have paid vacation and paid holidays. For your future, we offer a company\-matching 401(k) Retirement, Life Insurance, Tuition reimbursement, and professional development training. To help you be successful at work, as required for the role, we will provide a company vehicle, phone, laptop, or tablet along with all necessary tools and safety equipment. We are an equal opportunity employer. All aspects of employment including the decision to hire, promote, discipline, or discharge, will be based on merit, competence, performance, and business needs. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, marital status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic information, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other status protected under federal, state, or local law. Learn more about us at www.Pearce\-Services.com!

jobs.title: Software Engineer In Test
jobs.description: Points North is looking for a Software Engineer in Test who is excited about doing meaningful, high\-impact work on a product that people already depend on and making it better. You will be joining a small, fast\-moving Agile team with the specific mission of modernizing the quality practices around a mature production application. You will be working with systems that real people use every day to do their job, and you are excited to make things measurably better than you found them. If you are the kind of Engineer who gets energized by bringing structure and confidence to a complex codebase, who sees a legacy system as an opportunity rather than a liability, and who wants to build the testing foundation that carries a product into its next era we want to talk to you. **What You'll Be Doing:*** Enable the QA modernization journey. Partner with software engineers, other quality engineers, and product managers to assess where the application stands today and chart a practical path toward modern, sustainable quality practices without over\-engineering the solution. * Balance manual and automated testing. Apply targeted manual testing where it delivers the most insight while systematically expanding automated coverage over time. Know when each approach is the right tool for the job. * Design, develop, and maintain automated test suites for our SaaS products using Playwright, C\# and TypeScript, including end\-to\-end (E2E), integration, and API tests. * Build test tools, frameworks, and utilities that improve coverage, accelerate execution, and make the whole team more effective. * Leverage AI tools as a force multiplier, not a shortcut. Use AI thoughtfully to expand test coverage, accelerate test creation and maintenance, and surface insights. * Participate in code reviews, pair programming, and agile events as a core member of the team. * Help define and evolve testing strategies and best practices across the team as the codebase and product mature. * Follow DevSecOps best practices for CI/CD and contribute to deployment automation. * Continuously learn and grow technically, collaboratively, and in how you think about quality. ### What We Are Looking For: * A hands\-on QA engineer with a developer mindset who is genuinely excited about legacy modernization. We are looking for someone who sees complexity as a puzzle worth solving. * A practical thinker who balances automated coverage with targeted manual testing, and knows that the goal is confidence, not coverage numbers. * Someone who is enthusiastic about AI as an enabler. Someone who is eager to experiment with AI\-assisted tooling to move faster and reach further, while understanding that AI augments good engineering judgment rather than replacing it. * A collaborator who communicates openly, takes pride in their work and their team's work, and leaves codebases and processes better than they found them. * A builder who wants to see their work ship, make an impact, and solve real world problems. ### Qualifications: * 5\+ years of experience in professional software development or software quality engineering. * Proven, professional experience building and utilizing test automation tools and frameworks. * Proficiency with languages such as C\# and/or TypeScript. * Experience testing REST APIs and using tools like Postman or equivalent automation frameworks. * Experience with source control and modern CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions). * Comfortable working with relational databases such as SQL Server. * Strong problem\-solving skills and ability to work as a core member of an Agile software development team. * Solid understanding of modern software engineering principles and best practices. * Experience working in a SaaS company or small, fast\-paced development team. * Familiarity with cloud services (Azure App Services, Azure SQL, Azure Functions). * Experience bringing QA practices to legacy or established codebases. At Points North, we believe that taking care of our team is the foundation of our success. That’s why we’ve created a benefits package designed to support you both personally and professionally: * Health Insurance: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans are available to keep you and your family healthy. * Retirement Savings: Invest in your future with employer\-matching contributions to a SIMPLE Traditional and/or ROTH IRA plan. * Time Off: Generous PTO, paid holidays, and Volunteer Time Off (VTO) are offered so that you can take time to recharge and give back to what matters to you. * Growth Opportunities: Professional development is encouraged whether it be in training, certifications, or other opportunities to boost your career. * Flexibility: Depending on the role, remote or hybrid arrangements may be made available to fit your lifestyle and business needs. For this position the base salary range is $110,000 \- $125,000 per year, plus annual bonus eligibility. Final compensation determinations will reflect your unique experience, skills, and the responsibilities of the role. At Points North, you’ll find an energizing, ambitious and supportive workplace where your contributions make a real impact. Ready to join our team? Apply today to take the next step in your career! jobs.title: FDE AI/ Solutions Architect (AI, Python/Data)
jobs.description: Provectus is an **AWS Premier Partner** and an **Anthropic Strategic Partner**, working at the frontier of applied AI. We help enterprises turn Claude, agentic systems, and their own data into measurable business outcomes — through bespoke applications, managed services, and advisory engagements. With offices in North America, LATAM, and EMEA, we partner with clients worldwide. Our work centers on two verticals — **Financial Services \& Insurance** and **Healthcare \& Life Sciences** — where we deploy five pre\-built AI Blueprints: Submission Flow, Portfolio Lens, Asset Flow, Revenue Flow, and Evidence Lens. Each Blueprint rebuilds a critical business process front to back, shipped from working code and tuned to a client's specific book, regulators, and operating posture. Our team holds 100\+ AWS certifications, is Claude Code certified, and co\-delivers Anthropic's Agentic SDLC program, Cowork Activation, and AI Blueprint engagements. **Where this role sits** ------------------------ You will work in a small, senior pod alongside an FDX; our delivery arc is Sprint Enable Realize: * Forward Deployed Executive (FDX) owns the commercial relationship and the business outcome. Works alongside the client's leadership or C\-suite level to move the client's KPIs — revenue growth, cost reduction, risk reduction. * Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) embeds with a client to change how that client operates. You own the method; nobody hands you a ticket. You map the client workflow as it actually happens, identify the business problem underneath it, build a working AI solution, present to the client in the language of outcomes, and transfer it. Provectus maintains industry Blueprints — working systems that have already shipped for a client in the same industry — so you begin from running code and tuning it to this client's specific book, regulators, and operating posture. You will be measured on whether the Business Unit's number moved, not on hours or scope delivered. ### **What You’ll Do:** **Take the seat** * Sit with the client and the Forward Deployed Executive at the start of an engagement. Learn the function from inside, not from a requirements doc, and redesign the function from first principles. * Reach working fluency in a new domain — insurance underwriting, healthcare revenue cycle, asset flow. **Build** * Design and ship production GenAI systems into the customer’s environment (cloud\-native data, LLM\-based, and agentic AI solutions). Implement and optimize RAG systems for production use cases * Build the evaluation harness before you build the feature. Define what working means, instrument it, and let the evals drive the design. * Write production code across the stack — AI, backend services, data pipelines. We choose tools to fit the customer. * Take systems to production on AWS (GCP or Azure where the customer requires it): containerised, CI/CD, automated testing, monitoring, and maintainable after we leave. Hand the system over to the client. * Start from the blueprint, and feed the blueprint. What you learn in the field becomes the baseline the next engagement starts from. * Lead architecture reviews, produce technical design documents, and contribute to standards. Mentor engineers and share knowledge across the team. **Own the outcome.** * Work in a pair with a FDX who carries the Business Unit’s KPIs. Your work is measured against the same number. * Own the technical direction of technical proposals and scoping. Drive adoption. Change management is part of the engineering job here. * Be credible with the customer’s engineers and their executives. * Shape what we commit to before we commit to it. ### **What You’ll Bring:** **Mindset** * Proactive and self\-directed; identify problems before they're handed to you * Comfort with ambiguity and ownership. Engagements start underspecified by design. Closing that gap is the job * B2\+ English, comfortable collaborating across distributed, multicultural teams **Client Engagement** * You are willing to spend time understanding and doing someone else’s job on the client's side before you write a line of code * Credible with senior stakeholders — you can hold a redesign conversation with a BU head and a scoping conversation with a CTO, presenting outcomes to them * You can produce a scoped, phased delivery plan with clear deliverables, dependencies, and risks — and estimate what it will cost to build and to run **Technical depth** * 7\+ years building and running production systems. * Solid AI/ML foundations. You understand what the models do well enough to reason about failure modes * Designed and shipped to production LLM applications and agentic workflows — not demos, not POCs, not notebooks * Agentic orchestration: multi\-step workflows, graph\-based orchestration, tool use, state management, and recovery from partial failure * Experience with LLM APIs (Anthropic, AWS Bedrock, or OpenAI) and agent frameworks. * Experience building and optimizing RAG systems in production * Strong engineering fundamentals — dropped into an unfamiliar codebase or language, you’re productive. Python and/or TypeScript proficiency; depth matters more than stack. * Experience in making and defending architectural trade\-off decisions * Hands\-on AWS production depth: Bedrock, Bedrock AgentCore, Lambda, ECS, S3, SQS, ECR, or similar. GCP or Azure is a plus * Cloud\-native delivery: containers, ECS or Kubernetes, IaC, and CI/CD applied to AI pipelines * You evaluate. You have built or owned an eval suite for a non\-deterministic system, and you can explain what you measured, how you produced ground truth, and what gated a release * Model and agent monitoring, drift detection * Cost and latency discipline: model tiering, caching, and the ability to say what a workload costs to run before it runs * Hands\-on production experience with the Claude ecosystem — Claude Code, CLAUDE.md, hooks, skills files. Spec\-driven development — writing the intent, constraints, and acceptance criteria before you let an agent build — is a strong plus * MCP: you can say why an agent would prefer it to a REST integration. Having authored a server is a plus ### **Nice to have:** * Prior experience as a founder, CTO, or engineering leader who has chosen to return to individual contribution * Experience in one of the industries: financial services, insurance, healthcare * Consulting, professional services, or other embedded customer\-facing delivery * A2A: you can explain agent\-to\-agent interoperability * AWS and Claude Code Certifications * CI/CD pipeline experience (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI) * Experience in an additional language (Go, TypeScript, or Rust) * Experience with Apache Spark, Apache Airflow, Kafkа ### **What We Offer:** * The chance to shape how leading enterprises across LATAM, Europe, and North America adopt AI, from strategy through first deployment * A forward\-deployed model working in small, senior teams alongside Principal Architects and Forward Deployed Engineers * A growing AI delivery practice where you help build the tooling and frameworks, not just use them * Remote\-friendly culture * Internal training programs with full support for Claude, AWS, and other professional certifications, conference attendance * Career growth; we actively develop our engineers * Access to the latest AI tools and premium subscriptions * Long\-term B2B collaboration * Private medical insurance or a budget for your medical needs * Paid sick leave, vacation, and public holidays * Equipment and all the tech you need for comfortable, productive work ### **How we hire:** * Intro conversation. The role, your background and aspirations, tech questions. * Technical interview with live engineering sessions. Real problems, your own editor, you may use an LLM assistant * HR Interview. Soft skills and expectations * HM interview. Tech questions; a live engineering session is also possible We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Principal/Senior Software Engineer - Mobile App Monetization (Ad Server)
jobs.description: **About the Role** PubMatic is seeking an experienced and technically strong Principal Software Engineer to lead the design and development of next\-generation Mobile App Monetization capabilities. This role is focused on building high\-performance, low\-latency, scalable, and privacy\-safe systems that help maximize publisher revenue from in\-app inventory while improving DSP and buyer spend efficiency. The role requires a deep understanding of mobile app advertising, SSP\-DSP RTB workflows, OpenRTB mobile signals, SDK/mediation integrations, traffic shaping, QPS optimization, mobile attribution, privacy constraints, and performance advertising. The engineer will work on systems that monetize mobile formats such as rewarded video, interstitial, native, banner, app\-open, playable, and video ads. The ideal candidate is a seasoned backend engineer with strong ad\-tech domain expertise and experience building real\-time auction, targeting, decisioning, and optimization systems. You will work closely with Product, Data Science, Marketplace Quality, DSP Partnerships, Publisher teams, and SRE to build ML\-integrated and data\-driven monetization systems that improve yield, bid rate, win rate, fill rate, attribution readiness, latency, and reliability across PubMatic's mobile app ecosystem. **What You'll Do** * Architect and implement scalable backend services powering mobile app monetization, extracting, transforming, and optimizing in\-app behavioral data using on\-device computation, data aggregation, and differential privacy techniques so that publishers can still deliver targeted ads and measure performance without accessing persistent, individual user identities. * Build and optimize SSP\-DSP integration workflows for mobile app inventory, including app bundle validation, device and geo signal handling, privacy\-aware user signal processing, bid response handling, loss reason analysis, and DSP\-specific troubleshooting. * Design mobile\-specific traffic shaping and QPS optimization systems that prioritize high\-value in\-app inventory based on bid probability, win probability, spend potential, app quality, device signals, geo value, ad format, consent availability, and DSP buying behavior. * Improve runtime handling for Mobile App ad formats such as rewarded video, interstitial, native, banner, app\-open, playable, and in\-app video, including format eligibility, creative compatibility, response validation, tracking, completion, and reward\-callback correctness. * Build capabilities that improve buyer/DSP compatibility for MApp inventory, ensuring buyers receive well\-represented, privacy\-compliant, format\-compatible, attribution\-ready, and supply\-quality\-aware mobile app requests. * Develop systems and diagnostics to improve Mobile App supply quality, including app bundle validation, app store metadata checks, app\-ads.txt, sellers.json, SupplyChain object validation, app spoofing detection, invalid traffic indicators, device/geo inconsistency checks, and low\-quality partner supply detection. * Support privacy\-aware and attribution\-ready Mobile App advertising, including ATT/IDFA handling, AAID availability, consent enforcement, COPPA/child\-directed treatment, SKAN readiness, MMP signal passing, click/impression tracking, and privacy\-safe fallback when user\-level identifiers are unavailable. * Partner with MApp SDK and OpenBid/S2S integration teams to define signal\-quality standards, request\-field expectations, placement/ad\-unit semantics, tracking requirements, and partner feedback loops for Mobile App supply. * Build publisher\-facing and buyer\-facing diagnostics for MApp inventory, including missing\-field reports, app quality signals, buyer no\-bid diagnostics, fill and eCPM diagnostics, tracking mismatch analysis, attribution readiness, and supply\-path quality insights. * Work with DSP Partnerships and Marketplace Quality teams to improve buyer confidence in PubMatic's MApp supply by addressing format compatibility, attribution readiness, privacy eligibility, fraud risk, supply transparency, and app inventory quality. * Collaborate with Product, Data Science, Publisher teams, DSP Partnerships, Marketplace Quality, MApp SDK, OpenBid/S2S integrations, and SRE to define and execute the roadmap for differentiated Mobile App advertising capabilities. * Champion operational excellence for Mobile App advertising systems through strong observability, reason codes, structured logs, dashboards, alerts, safe rollouts, latency protection, production debugging, and cross\-team incident response. **We'd Love for You to Have** * Five plus years of backend engineering experience, with a proven track record of building high\-scale, low\-latency systems, preferably in mobile app advertising, SSP, DSP, ad exchange, mediation, mobile SDK, app\-install, or programmatic AdTech domains. * Strong knowledge of mobile app inventory signals, including app bundle, app store URL, SDK version, placement type, rewar rience working with incrementality measurement, retargeting systems, audience segmentation, cohort\-based optimization, or privacy\-safe targeting for mobile performance marketing. * Exposure to privacy\-preserving user ID solutions such as UID2\.0, RampID, publisher first\-party IDs, hashed identifiers where allowed, and frameworks such as SKAdNetwork for iOS post\-ATT monetization. * Experience with cross\-format mobile monetization strategies, including combining rewarded video, interstitial, native, banner, app\-open, playable, and video monetization within the same app session. * Familiarity with real\-time analytics pipelines used to measure mobile monetization KPIs such as bid rate, win rate, fill rate, eCPM, revenue, QPS efficiency, timeout rate, attribution feedback, buyer spend, and yield efficiency. * Publications, patents, internal platform leadership, or speaking engagements in mobile monetization, AdTech infrastructure, RTB optimization, privacy\-safe advertising, or ML for AdTech. **Why Join Us?** * Work on high\-scale mobile monetization infrastructure that directly impacts publisher revenue, DSP spend, and advertiser outcomes across the in\-app advertising ecosystem. * Help shape the future of ML\-powered mobile monetization, real\-time ad decisioning, traffic shaping, attribution readiness, and privacy\-safe performance advertising. * Build systems that improve monetization across premium mobile formats such as rewarded video, interstitial, native, banner, app\-open, playable, and video ads. * Collaborate with industry\-leading engineers, product teams, machine learning experts, DSP partners, publisher teams, and marketplace quality teams. * Competitive compensation, performance\-based incentives, and strong career growth opportunities in a globally recognized AdTech company. **AI\-Enabled Engineering Mindset:** We value engineers who actively leverage Generative AI tools and IDEs (e.g. GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, Windsurf etc.) to accelerate development, improve code quality, automate repetitive tasks, and enhance documentation and debugging workflows. Engineers who demonstrate AI\-first thinking using these tools to drive faster experimentation, ideation, and technical execution will thrive in our high\-scale, performance\-critical environment. **Qualifications:** * Should have a bachelor's degree in engineering (CS / IT) or equivalent degree from well\-known Institutes / Universities. **Additional Information:** **Return to Office**: PubMatic employees throughout the global have returned to our offices via a hybrid work schedule (3 days "in office" and 2 days "working remotely") that is intended to maximize collaboration, innovation, and productivity among teams and across functions. **Benefits**: Our benefits package includes the best of what leading organizations provide, such as paternity/maternity leave, healthcare insurance, broadband reimbursement. As well, when we're back in the office, we all benefit from a kitchen loaded with healthy snacks and drinks and catered lunches and much more! **Diversity and Inclusion**: PubMatic is proud to be an equal opportunity employer; we don't just value diversity, we promote and celebrate it. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. **About PubMatic** PubMatic is one of the world's leading scaled digital advertising platforms, offering more transparent advertising solutions to publishers, media buyers, commerce companies and data owners, allowing them to harness the power and potential of the open internet to drive better business outcomes. Founded in 2006 with the vision that data\-driven decisioning would be the future of digital advertising, we enable content creators to run a more profitable advertising business, which in turn allows them to invest back into the multi\-screen and multi\-format content that consumers demand.

customer\-support teams. * Translate business, clinical, operational, and user requirements into practical technical architecture and engineering priorities. * Evaluate technical tradeoffs among cost, reliability, time to market, cybersecurity, scalability, privacy, and regulatory risk. * Establish engineering standards for code quality, documentation, testing, release readiness, and production operations. * Mentor engineers and technical contributors as the organization grows. * Serve as a technical escalation point for cloud, mobile, connectivity, fleet, and production\-system issues. **Required qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Electrical Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline. * 5\+ years of experience in software engineering, cloud architecture, information systems engineering, platform engineering, or connected\-device development. * 3\+ years of experience designing, deploying, or operating cloud\-based production systems. * Experience building or architecting mobile applications for iOS, Android, or cross\-platform environments. * Experience with at least one major cloud platform: AWS, Google Cloud Platform, or Microsoft Azure. * Experience designing RESTful APIs, event\-driven systems, microservices, serverless architectures, or related distributed\-system patterns. * Experience with device, IoT, hardware\-connected, telecommunications, consumer\-electronics, or sensor\-based product ecosystems. * Understanding of device provisioning, identity management, remote configuration, telemetry, firmware lifecycle management, and over\-the\-air updates. * Proficiency in one or more languages such as Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, Java, Kotlin, Swift, Go, C\#, or C\+\+. * Experience with relational and/or NoSQL databases, data pipelines, logging systems, observability tools, and production monitoring. * Strong working knowledge of cybersecurity principles, cloud IAM, encryption, secrets management, network security, and secure development practices. * Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot complex issues spanning hardware, firmware, connectivity, mobile software, cloud infrastructure, and end\-user workflows. * Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical risks and decisions to nontechnical stakeholders. **Preferred qualifications** * Experience with wearable devices, Bluetooth Low Energy, IoT platforms, remote monitoring, or sensor\-driven products. * Experience in digital health, healthcare technology, medical devices, wellness technology, telehealth, or other regulated technology environments. * Familiarity with HIPAA, SOC 2, FDA cybersecurity expectations, IEC 62304, ISO 14971, ISO 13485, or secure product\-development practices in regulated settings. * Experience with remote patient monitoring, remote therapeutic monitoring, jobs.title: Staff Software Test Engineer
jobs.description: **Description** **Staff SDET — Consumer Quality Enablement** Recognized as the No. 1 site trusted by real estate professionals, Realtor.com® has been at the forefront of online real estate for over 25 years, connecting buyers, sellers, and renters with trusted insights and expert guidance to find their perfect home. Through its robust suite of tools, Realtor.com® not only makes a significant impact on the real estate industry at large, but for consumers, navigating the biggest purchase they will make in their life, by providing a user experience that is easy to use, easy to understand, and most of all, easy to make decisions. Join us on our mission to empower more people to find their way home by breaking barriers to entry, making the right connections, and building confidence through expert guidance. **About the Role** We have an exciting opportunity for an innovative Staff Engineer in Test to join our RDC team. The charter for this team is to build and deliver innovative solutions across the real\-estate ecosystem that deepen relationships with industry players, consumers, and brokers/agents. This role is part of Quality Enablement team. Consumer Quality Enablement is a platform team — not embedded in any single product squad but responsible for the quality infrastructure that serves the entire Consumer Engineering organization: 30\+ scrum teams, 400\+ repositories, and five surfaces (Web, iOS, Android, Backend Services). We operate as Quality\-as\-a\-Service. Our job is to build systems, frameworks, and tooling that make it easier for product engineers to ship with confidence — without requiring a dedicated QA resource on every team. We govern, audit , create paved path and enable engineers with tools , process, framework , reporting and governance **What You'll Do** As a Staff SDET on Consumer Quality Enablement, you are the technical backbone of how we build, evolve, and enforce quality infrastructure at scale. You own the design and delivery of the test frameworks, AI\-powered tooling, and quality\-gate systems that the broader engineering org depends on. This is a senior individual contributor role. You will not manage people directly, but you will set technical direction, establish standards, and pull other engineers — inside and outside the team — toward higher\-quality practices. **What You'll Own** **AI\-Powered Quality Tooling** * Evolve the Genesis AI test\-case generation platform — coverage expansion, prompt engineering, model selection, accuracy measurement. * Build and maintain the AI RCA (Root Cause Analysis) pipeline that surfaces incident and test\-failure context automatically. * Develop the Test Fix Agent: automated triage, flakiness detection, and patch suggestion for failing tests in CI. * Define the evaluation harness and quality metrics for all AI tooling — precision, recall, engineer adoption. **Test Framework Infrastructure (Paved Path)** * Own the "Paved Path" for Web (Playwright\-based) and Mobile (Appium/iOS XCUITest/Android Espresso) — the opinionated, zero\-config test setup that product teams clone to get started. Define the layered testing contract: unit integration* E2E thresholds per surface. * Build and maintain shared test utilities, fixtures, data factories, and environment\-management tooling. * Integrate with CI/CD pipelines (CircleCI) so quality gates run reliably on every PR with no manual setup from product teams. **Quality Gate Enforcement Platform** * Design and operate the quality\-gate system: code coverage gates, PR review gates, build stability gates. * Build enforcement tooling that moves gates from advisory to blocking — with clear escalation paths and override controls that don't silently waive standards. * Instrument and surface gate compliance metrics (repos gated, gate\-fail\-merge rate, PR coverage trends) so engineering leadership has a live quality signal. * Drive SonarCloud configuration hygiene: quality profiles, branch rules, coverage ingestion, and gate\-scoring across all 100\+ repositories. **Quality Observability** * Define and own the quality metrics taxonomy: escape rate, main\-branch stability, attestable coverage (vs. reported), review depth, incident detection ratio. * Build dashboards and alerting so EMs and leads get a team\-level quality picture without manual data collection. Partner with the incident management process to close the loop from production incident root cause coverage gap* remediated test. **Technical Leadership** * Author and maintain the quality engineering standards playbook for Consumer Engineering. * Run architecture reviews for test infrastructure decisions in product squads. * Mentor senior STEs and SWEs on test design, framework usage, and quality patterns. * Represent Consumer Quality Enablement in cross\-functional engineering forums (release, platform, architecture). **What We're Looking For** * 8\+ years of software development or SDET experience with at least 3 years at staff/senior staff scope. * Production\-quality engineering skills: you write code that ships to a shared platform, not scripts that live in a test folder. * Deep experience with at least two of: Playwright/WebdriverIO, XCUITest, Espresso — and a clear framework philosophy, not just syntax familiarity. * Experience designing test frameworks from the ground up — including fixture management, test data strategy, environment isolation, and parallelization. * Working knowledge of CI/CD systems (CircleCI, GitHub Actions, or equivalent) and how quality gates integrate into merge workflows. * Familiarity with AWS services used in CI/CD and data pipelines (Lambda, S3, Bedrock) — enough to own the infrastructure your tooling runs on. * Experience with contract testing (Pact or equivalent) and API\-level quality tooling for microservice or GraphQL architectures. * Hands\-on experience building and evaluating LLM\-powered applications, including eval harness design, production model integration, test\-generation quality measurement, and regression prevention across model upgrades. * Strong software engineering fundamentals: system design, API design, code review, observability, and reliability for internal platforms. * Ability to influence without authority at scale — your platform serves hundreds of engineers; you write docs, run office hours, and make it easy to do the right thing. * Experience in a platform/enablement team that served multiple product squads. * Familiarity with SonarCloud, Xray, or other quality gate and test management tooling. * Python and TypeScript fluency (our AI tooling stack and web test stack respectively). * Prior work building quality metrics systems — escape rate, flakiness rates, coverage trends — not just dashboards but the data pipelines behind them. * Mobile app testing experience across both iOS and Android platforms * Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience. **Nice to Have** * Prior experience in Performance testing for Native apps * Performance and Load testing basic understanding **Success in this Role** Success here is not measured by test count or coverage percentage alone. It is measured by whether the engineering organization ships with more confidence. The challenge isn't finding bugs; it's building systems that catch the right bugs at the right time automatically. * You think at the system level, not the ticket level. * You don't need to be an expert in all of it — but you need to be genuinely curious about all of it. * You are as comfortable in a data pipeline as you are in a test framework. * You solve problems top\-down. * You are a force multiplier, not a ticket\-taker. * You are comfortable with ambiguity and willing to get your hands dirty. * You learn fast, form hypotheses, ship something small, and iterate. * You are the kind of engineer who makes the team around you better. * You give direct technical feedback. You write things down. * You make it easy for product engineers to do the right thing without asking. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. jobs.title: Senior Solutions Engineer
jobs.description: **About Refold** Enterprise integrations are still built by hand, one customer at a time, by a human supply chain of consultants. We think that's the last big software category that hasn't been automated — and we're automating it. Refold is the AI integration delivery layer. Our agents build, test, deploy, and maintain integration workflows inside our customers' own products, white\-labeled, up to 90% faster. Trained on millions of real\-world contexts across SAP, Oracle, Workday, NetSuite, and Salesforce, we turn integration work that used to take quarters into days — and then keep it running, because the agents detect failures and repair mappings themselves. Traction: 30\+ paying enterprise customers, 1,500\+ active users, 10M\+ API calls processed daily, seven\-figure ARR. Customers include Incorta, Kantata, Coupa, Naehas, OvationCXM, and Zycus. The results are the pitch: Kantata ships integrations 75% faster with 8x delivery capacity; Incorta cut time\-to\-go\-live by 70% and recovered 8,000\+ engineering hours; Naehas went from 3–5\-month builds to 90% faster delivery. Refold was founded by Jugal Anchalia and Abhishek Kumar, who have been featured in Forbes 30 Under 30\. We've raised $6\.5M led by Eniac Ventures (early investors in Airbnb \& Uber) and Tidal Ventures, with Better Capital, Ahead VC, Karman Ventures, Z21 Ventures, and Titan Ventures participating. We're assembling a founding team of people who learn fast, raise the bar, and shape the company from day one. This is the second AE seat in the US and the first hired to build the motion, not inherit it. **Key Responsibilities:** * **Own the technical win:** Lead discovery, demos, and architecture conversations from first call to signature. When a deal is won or lost on technical confidence, that outcome is yours * **Build the proof, don't slide it:** Stand up working prototypes against the customer's actual systems and messy data — SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, Workday, Salesforce. Our product is the demo; a deck is a fallback, not a strategy * **Run crisp POCs:** Design focused evaluations with explicit success criteria, timelines, and exit conditions. We're deliberately moving away from 4\-week POCs — help us prove value in days * **Speak both languages:** Translate schema mapping, auth flows, multi\-tenancy, and in\-tenant deployment into terms a CTO trusts and a VP of Professional Services can build a business case on * **Clear security and procurement:** Own architecture reviews, security questionnaires, and RFP/RFI responses. Air\-gapped, in\-tenant deployment is one of our strongest cards — know how to play it * **Hand off clean:** Partner with Delivery and our Forward Deployed Engineers so every go\-live starts from a real technical plan, not a rediscovery exercise * **Feed the platform:** You'll be one of our highest\-signal sources of product truth. Surface the gaps and friction you hit in the field and push them into the roadmap * **Build the SE motion:** Turn what works into a demo library, discovery framework, POC playbook, reference architectures, and competitive teardowns against iPaaS incumbents **Role Information:** * **Partners with:** The founding AE team and the founders directly; backed by Forward Deployed Engineers and Delivery * **Average deal size:** $50–100K land / $200–300K expand * **Average deal cycle:** 3–6 months * **Technical buyers you'll face:** CTOs, CPOs, VPs of Product, VPs of Professional Services / Delivery, plus platform architects and security reviewers * **Ideal customer:** Sales\-led with an integrations page, an internal PS team or SI dependency, and enterprise deals that hinge on connectors * **Competitive set:** iPaaS and middleware incumbents (MuleSoft, Boomi, Workato, SnapLogic) and in\-house build * **Current growth team:** 1 BDR, 1 AE, 2 Marketing, 4 Post\-Sale, plus a 20\-person engineering and delivery org **Required Skills \& Abilities** * **Proven SE:** 5–8 years in solutions engineering, pre\-sales, or technical consulting at a SaaS, data, or AI company. This is a hard requirement — we're not training someone into the seat * **Builder, not just a presenter:** Hands\-on with APIs and data integration, and fluent enough in Python and/or JavaScript/TypeScript to build a working prototype yourself over a weekend * **Enterprise systems fluency:** Real experience with systems of record — SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, Workday, Salesforce, Dynamics — and the messy parts: custom fields, schema mapping, OAuth, retries, idempotency, why an integration broke at 2 am * **Sales instinct:** You've sold to or with product and professional services teams at software companies and understand what changes when your buyer's customer is the end user * **Room\-ready:** You can hold a CTO's attention, survive a security review, and be the calm one when the demo environment misbehaves * **High ownership in ambiguity:** No playbook exists yet. You'll write it while running live deals, and you'll be comfortable doing both at once **Nice to Have** * Background in iPaaS, middleware, integration, or data infrastructure — or a track record of selling against MuleSoft, Boomi, Workato, or SnapLogic * Hands\-on with LLMs and agentic frameworks, not just familiar with the concepts * Experience with air\-gapped, in\-tenant, or customer\-VPC deployments and the security conversations that come with them * Cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, Azure) and containerised environments (Docker, Kubernetes) * First\-SE or early\-stage experience where you built the function, not joined one * Worked day\-to\-day with an offshore engineering or delivery team **Why do you want to work here?** * **Impact**: Fast\-growing seed\-stage company ($6\.5M from Eniac Ventures \& Tidal Ventures) with early Fortune 500\-scale deployments and real, quantified customer outcomes * **Speed:** A category to define and a narrative to own, with founder\-level access and no layers between you and the decision * **Ownership**: Cutting\-edge AI solving a high\-value enterprise problem nobody has cracked — backed by technical founders building a next\-generation infrastructure platform **Compensation:** * **$100,000\-$120,000 (annual)** **Equal Employment Opportunity** We're a small, fast\-growing team, and we're intentional about building an inclusive culture from day one.
