to support 24/7 client coverage, participating in the rotation and serving as the lead point of contact for major incidents and outages. **Infrastructure \& Cloud Engineering** * Architect and implement secure, resilient hosting environments with best practices for redundancy, disaster recovery, and multi\-cloud strategies. * Define and maintain infrastructure as code to ensure consistency and scalability across environments. * Manage Azure services (App Services, Azure SQL, Key Vaults, Application Insights) and legacy AWS infrastructure (EC2, RDS, S3\). **DevOps \& Deployment** * Own and maintain CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps, ensuring reliable and repeatable deployments. * Manage SSL/TLS lifecycle, DNS configurations, and domain services across platforms. * Support SSO integrations and identity configurations tied to hosted applications. **Systems Administration** * Administer Windows Server and IIS environments, including performance tuning, patching, and configuration management. * Oversee WP Engine\-hosted WordPress environments, including updates and platform configurations. **Collaboration \& Client Engagement** * Serve as the senior escalation point for hosting\-related issues, providing root\-cause analysis and long\-term solutions. * Partner with development teams to align infrastructure with application architecture and support go\-live readiness. * Engage directly with clients to gather requirements, communicate technical decisions, and act as a trusted advisor. **Standards \& Continuous Improvement** * Lead the evolution of SilverTech’s hosting practice by improving reliability, security, and operational standards, and ensure they are understood and followed across the team. * Partner with the Chief Innovation Officer on hosting strategy, roadmap planning, budgeting, and vendor relationships, providing regular updates on team performance, risks, and priorities. * Collaborate cross\-functionally to enhance processes, tooling, and overall service delivery. **What You Need to Succeed:** * 7\+ years of experience in systems administration, cloud infrastructure, or hosting environments, including 2\+ years leadership/management. * Expertise in Microsoft Azure hosting services, including App Services, Azure SQL, Key Vaults, Application Insights, and networking. * Strong experience administering Windows Server and IIS in production environments. * Working knowledge of AWS infrastructure, including EC2, RDS, and S3\. * Experience with infrastructure\-as\-code tools (e.g., Terraform) and CI/CD pipeline management in Azure DevOps. * Proficiency in PowerShell scripting and automation. * Solid understanding of cloud security principles, including IAM, network security, and vulnerability management. * Strong communication and client\-facing skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non\-technical audiences. * A service\-oriented mindset with strong ownership, accountability, and responsiveness. **Experience That Will Set You Apart:** * Working with people, not just pipelines. This role involves interacting with internal and external clients. * Advanced experience with Cloudflare, especially in a SAAS setting. * Experience supporting .NET\-based applications in Azure. * Familiarity with WP Engine or similar managed WordPress hosting platforms. * Experience leading or mentoring engineers—assigning work, coaching, and contributing to hiring and performance reviews—and influencing technical direction. **Location:** This role offers flexibility based on candidate location and business needs, with the option to work hybrid from our Bedford, NH office or fully remote within the U.S. **Our Benefits:** * Strong compensation package * Competitive health packages * 401k with company match * Flexible work schedules * Hybrid workweek * Unlimited PTO after 5 years * Your birthday off * Regular learning \& development opportunities * Monthly company\-provided lunches * A fun, collaborative, and innovative team that actually likes working together * Cutting\-edge technology and creative freedom * Regular crew events, outings, and more! *SilverTech, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. jobs.title: Staff DevSecOps Engineer

secure deployment. * Automate tasks using scripting languages like Python, Bash, PowerShell, or similar tools. * Lead vulnerability management initiatives by identifying, prioritizing, and remediating and incident response workflows across cloud environments. * Implement cloud security posture management (CSPM), continuous control monitoring, and automated remediation strategies. * Partner with engineering teams to perform architecture reviews, and security design assessments for new products and services. * Drive adoption of security best practices through technical leadership and organization\-wide enablement programs. **What You'll Bring** * 5\+ years of experience in DevOps, cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, or related roles, with architecture\-level experience. * Strong hands\-on experience implementing DevSecOps practices and security controls across enterprise environments. * Expertise in CI/CD pipeline architecture, automation, and secure software delivery. security. * Strong understanding of IAM, RBAC, secrets management, encryption, certificates, and network security. * Knowledge of security frameworks and compliance standards such as NIST, CIS success. * Lift As We Climb \- Investing in developing others and helping others around us succeed. * Lean \& Nimble \- Working with agility and efficiency to experiment in an often ambiguous environment. **What We Offer** * A mission\- and values\-driven culture and a safe, inclusive environment where you can build, grow and thrive * A comprehensive total rewards package that supports your wellness and provides security for SimpliSafers and their families *(For more information on our total rewards please* *click here**)* * Free SimpliSafe system and professional monitoring for your home. * Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) that bring people together, give opportunities to network, mentor and develop, and advocate for change. We use a market\-based compensation approach to set our target annual base pay ranges and make adjustments annually. We carefully tailor individual compensation packages, including base pay, taking into consideration employees' job\-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and other relevant business factors. Beyond base pay, we offer a Total Rewards package that may include participation in our annual bonus program, equity, and other forms of compensation, in addition to a full range of medical, retirement, and lifestyle benefits. Established enterprises worldwide — including RBC Capital Markets, Bosch, Heineken, PSA Singapore, United Airlines, Schwarz Group, and hundreds more — have built their business around Solace to enable intelligent, real\-time experiences, modernize their application and integration landscape, and create seamless digital journeys for their customers, partners, and employees. So, the next time you drive a car, order furniture online, fly in a plane, check your bank balance on your phone, your positive experience could be a direct result of our technology—and your hard work! **About the Role** Solace is building Solace Diskless Streaming for Apache Kafka® (SSK), by the creators of Nisshi. SSK builds on Nisshi Diskless Streaming for Apache Kafka®, an open\-source project licensed under Apache\-2\.0\. Both implement the Apache Kafka® protocol and separate compute from storage. Stateless Protocol Engines scale out by adding more, and data is stored in object storage rather than on local disks. Other systems depend on this platform, so writes must remain correct under heavy concurrent load. The work covers wire protocols, storage engines, and the coordination problems that arise in keeping order and consistency across stateless engines. The team focuses on scale, security, latency, and robustness, and tunes for tail latency, throughput, and cost per byte; object storage sets its own floor on latency. You will own pieces of the data path end to end, working in Rust. Part of that work takes place in public, in the Nisshi repository. **What You’ll Do** * Design and build core data\-path components: request handling and storage, for a system that must hold strict ordering guarantees under load. * Implement and evolve Apache Kafka® wire\-protocol handling: parsing, framing, versioning, and backward compatibility with Apache Kafka® client libraries. * Build and harden storage engines: offset and sequence coordination, compaction, retention, and correctness under concurrent access. * Diagnose difficult defects: races, consistency edge cases, and security or robustness issues that surface only under real concurrent load. * Profile and tune throughput and latency against measured production numbers. * Work with the open\-source community on Nisshi: review, discuss, and contribute. **What You’ll Bring to the Role** One of the Following, at a Deep Level: * Hands\-on experience building a high\-throughput, log\-based streaming or messaging system, such as Apache Kafka® or a comparable platform: wire protocols, client/server compatibility, and the internals of a system that can’t lose data. * Deep experience with a database’s internals: storage engine, write\-ahead\-log or commit\-log design, replication and consensus, or query execution. Any flavor counts (relational, graph, document, or otherwise). If you’ve solved these problems inside a database, you understand the ones we’re solving. Both Paths Also Need: * Strong systems\-programming fundamentals (Rust, C\+\+, Go, or Java). * A track record of owning hard technical problems end to end, from design through production. * Comfort working remotely and asynchronously, across time zones. Preferred: * Production experience in Rust. * Working knowledge of the Apache Kafka® protocol, client libraries, and ecosystem. * Hands\-on experience working on the internals of a system like Apache Kafka®, Redpanda, Pulsar, WarpStream, NATS JetStream, or Solace Event Broker. * Experience running one of these systems at production scale. * Experience with security hardening, fuzzing, or performance engineering of network services. **Why You’ll Love Working at Solace** At Solace, we’re all about smart people, meaningful work, and good vibes. * **Work with brilliance** – Our team is packed with some of the sharpest minds in the industry. * **Balance matters** – We believe work should fit into your life, not the other way around. * **Hybrid\-first** – Flexibility is built into how we work, so everyone feels included and empowered. * **Values\-driven** – We live and breathe our core values: craftsmanship, trust, courage, freedom, momentum, humility, and human experience. * **Growth mindset** – Our training programs are designed to help you level up, fast. * **Customer Obsessed** – We’re proud of our world\-class customer lineup (we’re not shy about it). * **Keep it fun** – We’re social, we keep things simple, and we know how to have a good time. * **Creative culture** – We’ve got a great sense of humour and we make cool videos on topics like MITT and this (check them out!). **At Solace, we are committed to a fair, inclusive, and transparent recruitment process.** To help identify candidates whose qualifications best align with the role, we use artificial intelligence (AI) tools during the initial stage of resume screening. These tools compare submitted resumes to the job description, focusing on education, experience, and skills. Importantly, all decisions beyond this initial screening—including interviews and final hiring—are made by our human recruitment team. AI is never used to make final hiring decisions. **Let’s Talk** Not sure you meet every requirement? That’s okay — we’re more interested in your potential and passion. If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you. Need accommodations during the hiring process? Just let us know — we’re here to support you. Thanks to everyone who applies! While we wish we could connect with every candidate, only those selected to move forward will be contacted. At Solace, we believe that diversity and inclusion drive innovation and growth, both in business and in life. We strive to create an enriching and safe workplace where you can be who you are. If you want to do the best work of your career and feel supported every step of the way, we encourage you to join us! \#LI\-NM1

jobs.title: Technical Automation Lead
jobs.description: **Technical Automation Lead \| Contract\-to\-Hire \| Stache Cups** Remote \| Immediate start \| Paid implementation engagement, with a path to full\-time employment START AND LAUNCH PRIORITY We need someone available to start immediately and work directly with founder Bo Wicker through the October 30\-November 1 weekend toward a substantial launch on Monday, November 2, 2026\. Please state your earliest start time in Eastern time, specific weekend working blocks, and what you can realistically deliver by November 2\. The launch phase is an intensive, separately paid engagement with agreed extended/weekend coverage, scope, hours and a spending cap established before work starts. THE OPPORTUNITY I'm Bo, Founder and CEO of Stache Cups. We manufacture custom drinkware and already have customers, production infrastructure, an established creative team and demand for our products. We are connecting an automated e\-commerce infrastructure for schools, country clubs, Greek organizations, corporations, resorts and other markets. A substantial amount has already been developed: AI intake processes, Photoshop templates, Blender scenes and rendering systems, Shopify infrastructure and AWS deployments. We need a resourceful technical owner to connect the existing components, resolve the remaining gaps, make the operation reliable and maintain it as we scale. Preserve working components and approved designs. Our targets are 40\+ new storefronts per day per market and ultimately 1,000\+ per week. These are scaling goals, not demonstrated current throughput or guaranteed results. Schools and Clubs come first, followed by Greek and Promo. WHAT YOU WILL OWN \- Connect existing intake, template execution, asset handoffs, rendering, Shopify publication and validation into reliable workflows. \- Run and monitor production queues; handle failures, safe retries, interrupted jobs, duplicate prevention, logging and recovery. \- Maintain Shopify and AWS infrastructure, troubleshoot operating issues and ensure each completed storefront has the correct identity, artwork, products and configuration. \- Integrate new collections and products supplied by the creative team, extend the workflows to additional markets and help develop the main Stache Cups e\-commerce site. \- Establish measurable QA, throughput, manual\-touch and cost reporting; distinguish complete storefront delivery from individual component successes. \- Communicate directly, identify dependencies early and take responsibility for technical execution and ongoing operations. ALL DESIGN IS HANDLED BY OUR CREATIVE TEAM Our creative team handles all artwork, product designs, Photoshop masters, Blender scenes, banners and other visual assets. You will not be responsible for creative design and do not need to be a graphic designer. Your role is to automate, execute, integrate and maintain their approved work. Many templates support JSON, Python or other scripted changes. Others may need AI\-assisted substitutions for the correct organization logo, name, event details or customer information. Make these existing processes repeatable and reliable while preserving approved creative assets and product dimensions. TECHNICAL EXPERIENCE Strong hands\-on experience with Python, APIs, AWS, Shopify, workflow orchestration, AI tools and production automation. Experience scripting or operating Photoshop and Blender automation is especially valuable. We are interested in capable engineers who can learn and manage the existing processes, demonstrate relevant work, troubleshoot independently and take ownership without constant supervision. COMPENSATION AND GROWTH We begin with a paid hands\-on implementation engagement. Its fee, scope, hours, acceptance criteria and cap will be agreed in writing before work starts; the annual salary below describes the proposed post\-launch employee role, not the initial contract fee. Once the system is operational, the goal is to transition the right person into a full\-time position with: \- $40,000\-$50,000 starting annual salary. \- A 40\-hour workweek after launch. \- Paid time off and paid holidays. \- Proposed performance compensation linked to qualifying automated e\-commerce sales. \- Opportunities for salary increases and advancement as the operation grows. We are considering a proposed, time\-limited revenue\-linked incentive of up to 5% of qualifying automated e\-commerce sales after agreed deductions such as applicable taxes, payment\-processing fees, hosting/server costs, refunds and amounts owed to fundraising organizations or participating clubs. This is not a guaranteed or indefinite 5% entitlement. Eligibility, exact calculation, duration/end date, payment timing and scheduled compensation reviews will require a written agreement before any incentive begins. The intended growth path is to transition some or all of that incentive into a higher guaranteed salary by mutual written agreement. Employment conversion and future compensation are subject to a separate written agreement. We want the person who builds and manages this infrastructure to benefit meaningfully from its success and grow into long\-term technical leadership. HOW TO APPLY Tell us: 1\. Your earliest start time in Eastern time and your availability to work directly with Bo through this weekend toward the November 2 launch. 2\. Your own relevant Python/API/AWS/Shopify and Photoshop/Blender automation work, with an attributable example and your personal role. 3\. What complete Schools/Clubs deliverables you could realistically commit to by November 2, the dependencies, and a capped quote for the initial paid engagement. 4\. Your interest in the proposed contract\-to\-hire compensation structure and longer\-term 40\-hour role. 5\. Your weekly working availability, any supporting team, and the tools/costs included in your proposal. Please distinguish demonstrated production results from estimates. We are looking for someone excited to take ownership and grow with an established manufacturing business. Bo Wicker Founder \& CEO, Stache Cups Pay: $40,000\.00 \- $50,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Paid time off Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Cybersecurity Analyst
jobs.description: **Position Summary** ==================== The Cybersecurity Analyst is a mid\-level, hands\-on role within Star Group's IT Security team, reporting to the Cybersecurity Engineer. This position is responsible for day\-to\-day security operations, monitoring, incident response support, vulnerability management, and compliance evidence collection across Star Group's corporate and field environments. The Cybersecurity Analyst works closely with the IT Security Team to maintain and mature the organization's security posture, and serves as a key operational responder for security alerts, tickets, and audit requests. This role is well suited to a candidate with 3–5 years of hands\-on security operations experience who is looking to deepen expertise across endpoint protection, network access control, secure email gateway, application allowlisting, privileged access management, SIEM/SOAR, and vulnerability management in a lean, high\-ownership team environment. The role also offers the opportunity to gain exposure to the strategic development of security policies, the implementation of IT security technologies, and work with cross\-functional teams to deliver targeted security solutions. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities** ========================================= **Security Monitoring \& Incident Response** -------------------------------------------- * Monitor security alerts and events generated by EDR, NAC, SIEM/SOAR, ZTA, email security, and DLP platforms; triage, investigate, and escalate per documented incident response playbooks. * Perform first\-line analysis of phishing reports, malware alerts, and suspicious activity; contain and remediate confirmed incidents in coordination with the IT Security Team. * Support tabletop exercises and post\-incident reviews; contribute to after\-action reports and lessons\-learned documentation. * Maintain and tune detection rules, alert thresholds, and correlation logic to reduce false positives and improve mean\-time\-to\-detect/respond. * Perform after\-hours security event containment and remediation activities as needed. **Vulnerability \& Patch Management** ------------------------------------- * Run and review recurring vulnerability scans across servers, endpoints, and network infrastructure; validate and prioritize findings by exploitability and business risk. * Track remediation of vulnerabilities against SLA targets, including expedited handling of CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV). * Coordinate with broader IT teams on patch deployment cycles for servers, workstations, endpoint devices, and SaaS solutions; verify patch compliance reporting. * Maintain the vulnerability management dashboard and produce recurring metrics for leadership and audit purposes. **Identity, Access \& Endpoint Security** ----------------------------------------- * Assist in administering day\-to\-day operations of Privileged Access Management (PAM) tooling, including onboarding/offboarding privileged accounts, session review, and access certification support. * Support Network Access Control (NAC) operations, including device onboarding, policy exceptions, and unauthorized\-device investigation across 100\+ sites. * Assist with administering endpoint application control / allowlisting policy requests, exception handling, and false\-positive tuning. * Support quarterly and annual user access reviews (UAR) for in\-scope systems. **Governance, Risk \& Compliance Support** ------------------------------------------ * Collect, organize, and validate audit evidence in support of audit requirements, industry assessments and cybersecurity disclosure requirements. * Track and report on security awareness training completion, phishing simulation results, and related compliance metrics. **Documentation \& Process Improvement** ---------------------------------------- * Maintain accurate, current documentation for security tools, configurations, and standard operating procedures (SOPs). * Contribute to the continuous improvement of playbooks, runbooks, and automation to reduce manual effort and improve consistency. * Assist in the evaluation and testing of new security tools and integrations under the direction of the Security Engineer and Director, IT Security. * Support the maintenance and reporting functions of the team's internal security program dashboard, including data quality of tracked metrics. **Required Qualifications** =========================== **Education \& Experience** --------------------------- * Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and/or work experience. * 3–5 years of hands\-on experience in security operations, IT infrastructure/security, or a related technical role. * Demonstrated experience with at least two of the following: EDR/antivirus platforms, SIEM/SOAR, network access control, privileged access management, vulnerability scanning tools, application allowlisting technology, or email security gateways. * Experience supporting or participating in a compliance program for a publicly traded company is strongly preferred. * Valid driver's license, reliable transportation and ability to meet the company's motor vehicle policy. **Technical Skills** -------------------- * Working knowledge of core security domains: endpoint protection, network security, identity and access management, and vulnerability management. * Familiarity with Windows Server and Windows endpoint administration; working knowledge of Active Directory / Entra ID. * Basic to intermediate scripting ability (PowerShell, Python, or similar) for automation, reporting, or log analysis. * Understanding of networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, VLANs, firewalls, VPN) sufficient to investigate, troubleshoot, and adjudicate security events. * Familiarity with common security frameworks (NIST CSF 2\.0, NIST SP 800\-53, CIS Controls, ISO 27000, Secure Controls Framework) is a plus. **Certifications** ------------------ One or more of the following is required or strongly preferred (candidates actively pursuing certification will be considered): * CompTIA Security\+ (required at minimum, or equivalent experience) * GIAC certifications (e.g., GSEC, GCIH, GCIA) * CompTIA CySA\+ * CompTIA SecurityX (formerly CASP\+) * EC\-Council Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH) * ISC2 SSCP **Soft Skills \& Attributes** ----------------------------- * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills; able to triage ambiguous alerts and prioritize effectively under time pressure. * Clear written and verbal communication skills; comfortable documenting findings for both technical and non\-technical audiences. * High degree of personal accountability and discretion when handling sensitive security and compliance information. * Comfortable operating in a small, high\-ownership team where analysts work across the full breadth of the security program rather than a single narrow specialty. * Collaborative team player who works effectively with IT Operations, Internal Audit, and business stakeholders across a distributed, multi\-site organization. **Preferred Qualifications** ============================ * Prior experience in a regulated or publicly traded company environment (audit and reporting obligations). * Experience in a distributed, multi\-site operating environment (retail, field services, distribution, or utilities). * Exposure to M\&A IT/security integration activities. * Experience with cloud security fundamentals (Microsoft 365, Azure, AWS) * Experience with SPF/DKIM/DMARC email analysis. **Work Environment \& Physical Requirements** ============================================= * Primarily an office/hybrid role based at Star Group's Woodbury, NY corporate office (**based in Nassau County**); standard business hours with periodic after\-hours availability for incident response. * Occasional travel (estimated 5–10%) to branch and field locations for security assessments, equipment deployment, or incident support. * Prolonged periods of sitting and computer use; ability to lift/move IT equipment (up to 25 lbs.) occasionally. * Must be available for after\-hours security incident escalations, as needed. **Compensation \& Benefits** ============================ Salary range: $85,000 – $100,000 annually, commensurate with experience and certifications. Final offer will be based on a combination of experience, education, certifications, and internal equity. * Medical and dental coverage * 401(k) * Paid time off, holidays * Plus more! *We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and is committed to a drug and alcohol\-free workplace.* Pay Transparency In order to support the Fair Compensation Strategy by the US Govt., HR Dept., clients are required to adhere to "Pay Transparency Law"; in the impacted states; that have mandated the employers to list the salary ranges in Job advertisements or postings for job opportunities and Job promotions.

jobs.title: Field Service - Electrical Engineer
jobs.description: **Field Service \& Electrical Engineer** Steelhead, Inc. \| San Antonio, TX **Compensation:** $90,000–$120,000 annually, depending on experience Travel: 30–50% \| Employment: Full\-time Love troubleshooting machinery? Enjoy electrical design? We should talk. Steelhead, Inc. designs and manufactures automated water bottling and water treatment equipment for customers throughout North America and internationally. We’re looking for a hands\-on Electrical Engineer who enjoys solving problems, working with industrial machinery, and seeing equipment come to life. This isn’t a position where you’ll spend every day behind a desk. You’ll split your time between designing and improving electrical systems at our San Antonio facility and traveling to customer sites to install, commission, and troubleshoot equipment. We’re especially interested in someone who is naturally curious, enjoys technical challenges, and takes pride in getting complicated machinery running properly. **What You’ll Do** Field Service \& Troubleshooting * Install, commission, and troubleshoot automated bottling and water treatment equipment. * Diagnose electrical, controls, instrumentation, and electromechanical problems. * Troubleshoot motors, VFDs, sensors, valves, pumps, and industrial control systems. * Work directly with customers to resolve technical issues, both remotely and on\-site. * Support equipment startup, testing, and operator training. * Travel approximately 30–50%, primarily throughout North America. Electrical Engineering \& Controls * Design electrical control systems for new and existing equipment. * Develop and modify electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, and control panel layouts. * Select electrical components, instrumentation, and automation hardware. * Support PLC/HMI troubleshooting and system improvements. * Assist with PLC programming and modifications based on experience. * Collaborate with mechanical engineers, production technicians, and field service personnel to improve equipment reliability and performance. Water Treatment Technology * Learn the fundamentals of reverse osmosis, filtration, ozone, UV disinfection, and industrial water treatment. * Support troubleshooting and improvement of water treatment equipment. * Assist with developing equipment operating sequences and controls narratives. * Develop an understanding of how electrical controls, instrumentation, and water treatment processes work together. *Prior water treatment experience is not required. We’re looking for someone interested in learning.* **What We’re Looking Fo**r Required Qualifications * Degree in Electrical Engineering, Electrical Engineering Technology, or equivalent hands\-on industrial automation experience. * Experience with industrial electrical systems and troubleshooting. * Ability to read, interpret, and develop electrical schematics. * Working knowledge of industrial control panels, motors, sensors, VFDs, and instrumentation. * Strong mechanical aptitude and practical problem\-solving skills. * Comfortable working independently with customers and equipment in the field. * Willingness to travel 30–50%. * Strong communication skills and a customer\-focused attitude. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with Siemens or Allen\-Bradley PLCs. * PLC/HMI programming or troubleshooting experience. * AutoCAD Electrical or similar electrical design software. * Experience with industrial automation, packaging equipment, or process machinery. * Familiarity with pumps, valves, fluid handling, or water treatment equipment. * Experience developing equipment operating sequences or controls narratives. The Right Personality Matters The ideal candidate is someone who: * Genuinely enjoys troubleshooting and figuring out how things work. * Likes working with both their hands and their head. * Is comfortable moving between engineering design and the manufacturing floor. * Enjoys traveling, meeting customers, and solving real\-world equipment problems. * Takes ownership of problems and follows through until they’re resolved. * Is curious about new technologies and willing to learn. **Why Steelhead?** Steelhead offers the opportunity to work on complete industrial systems rather than just one small part of a machine. You’ll be involved in electrical design, manufacturing, equipment testing, customer installations, and ongoing improvements. You’ll work directly with an experienced engineering and technical team while developing expertise in industrial automation and water treatment technology. If you’re an electrical engineer who loves troubleshooting machinery and wants a position with variety, responsibility, and hands\-on challenges, we’d like to hear from you. To apply: Submit your resume and a brief description of the types of industrial equipment and control systems you’ve worked with. Pay: $85,000\.00 \- $110,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Retirement plan Location: * San Antonio, TX 78221 (Preferred) Willingness to travel: * 50% (Preferred) Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Principal Engineer, Agentic AI
jobs.description: Steer offers a suite of software tools for today's automotive repair shop. We combine a mix of software tools that a repair shop needs to run a highly profitable shop, in one user\-friendly, cost\-effective platform. Through the Steer suite, we allow the shop owner to get back to focusing on what matters, and to stop worrying about marketing and customer retention. Steer began as an online directory for drivers to find a local mechanic. Fast forward to today, Steer has launched a complete Customer Relationship Management (CRM) marketing suite, complete with text messaging, email automation, direct mail integration, reputation management, appointment reminders, declined/recommended services, and many other features. We are always innovating and we are proud to be a leader in the automotive repair industry. In August 2024 Steer acquired AutoOps \- the leader in modern, intelligent, and fully integrated scheduling software for auto repair shops. AutoOps allows customers to smoothly schedule through a shop's website and Google Business Profile. **About the Role** We're growing our world\-class engineering team to usher our CRM platform into the next generation of software — and we're looking for a **Principal Engineer, Agentic AI** to join our Core Platform Team Most Lead roles at "Big Tech" companies involve maintaining a single microservice or acting as a small cog in a 100\-person machine. At Steer, you aren't just a contributor; you are the architectof a platform aiming for 100% market dominance. This is a **high\-impact role for someone who doesn't just write great code, but who can see around corners, challenge conventions, and lead entire products from vision to launch**. We are actively refactoring our existing teams to be agentic\-first — meaning our engineers don't just use AI as a tool, they architect systems around autonomous, AI\-driven workflows. This is not a future initiative; it is how we build today. We're looking for builders who bring exceptional focus, ownership, and commitment to their work. At Steer, we want engineers who are "all in" on our mission, fully engaged with their work, and invested in our shared success. This means making Steer your primary professional focus and bringing the dedication and accountability needed to deliver exceptional results. **Why Steer?** * **True Ownership:** You will lead massive products from start to finish within lean, high\-velocity teams. * **Hyper\-Growth \& Vision:** We are currently at a fraction of our total addressable market in the automotive industry. The potential for scale is massive, and you will be a leading developer shaping this space * **Freedom to Innovate:** You don't need side projects to explore new techniques. We provide the autonomy and the platform to experiment with and implement the latest tech directly into our core product. * **AI\-First \& Agentic Culture:** We are refactoring our teams to be agentic\-first. We prioritize high\-level problem\-solving and AI/LLM expertise, and we actively encourage the use of AI tools to accelerate coding across any language and to power autonomous production workflows. **What You'll Do** * **Technical Strategy \& Ownership:** Focus on the core components of the Steer CRM, specifically optimizing how we ingest and process data to revolutionize our automation tools. * **Architectural Vision:** Lead the design of reusable full\-stack components and services that ensure our platform remains performant as we scale toward market dominance. * **Adaptive Development:** Pivot at a moment's notice based on evolving business needs, shifting focus between new integrations and core infrastructure to keep our ecosystem seamless. * **Customer\-Centric Engineering:** Partner closely with Product to understand user pain points, ensuring every architectural decision adds tangible value to the auto repair shops we serve. * **Code Excellence:** Champion best practices in security, test automation, and maintainability. Conduct deep\-dive code reviews that elevate the entire engineering organization. * **Modern DevOps \& Agentic Infrastructure:** Influence our CI/CD pipelines, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and IaC practices. Design and maintain AI\-integrated, agentic\-ready infrastructure that enables autonomous workflows. **What You Have** **Must Have:** * 7\+ years of professional experience building complex, web\-based SaaS products. * **The "All\-In" Mindset:** A deep commitment to Steer's mission and success. We look for engineers who take exceptional pride in their work, hold themselves to high standards, and demonstrate full ownership and accountability for their projects. They approach complex, seemingly impossible challenges with determination, proactively drive solutions, and are committed to delivering exceptional results in a fast\-paced environment. * **AI \& LLM Integration:** Hands\-on experience working with LLMs and prompt engineering. You use AI to bridge gaps and accelerate development. * **AI in Production:** Proven experience deploying AI\-powered features and autonomous (agentic) workflows in production\-grade infrastructure. * **AI\-Driven CI/CD:** Hands\-on experience integrating AI tooling into CI/CD pipelines (e.g., automated code review agents, AI\-assisted testing, or agentic workflow orchestration). * **Database Expertise:** Proficiency with both relational (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL (MongoDB, Redis) databases, including schema design and query optimization. * **Exceptional Communication:** The ability to translate complex technical concepts into product outcomes and collaborate effectively with leadership. **Nice to Have:** * Familiarity with our current stack: **.NET, Node.js (TypeScript), and React.** * Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation). * Previous experience as a founding engineer or in an early\-stage startup environment. * Experience building or integrating with **Claude marketplace plugins** (Anthropic ecosystem), including prompt chaining, tool use, or MCP integrations. **Interview Process** * **Initial Screen** — 30 min with Lead Recruiter * **Hiring Manager Interview** — 60 min with the Head of Engineering \& Product * **Technical Interview** — 60 min with a Principal Engineer * **Collaborative Interview** — 30 min with Lead Product Manager **What We Offer** * **Equity Options:** Own a piece of the company's success. * **100% Remote:** Work from anywhere in the US. * **100% Employer\-Paid Medical Insurance.** * **Flexible PTO:** With a 15\-day minimum. * **FSA, HSA, and 401k options.** * **Learning Stipend \& WFH Equipment:** Everything you need for a world\-class home office. * **Innovative Culture:** A seat at the table to influence the latest AI technology in a collaborative, agentic\-first environment. **Why Join Steer?** At Steer, we align our mission of transforming the auto repair experience for shop owners and their customers with your passion for growth, innovation, and excellence. Here, you'll find opportunities to expand your skills, take on career\-shaping challenges, and contribute to the future of the auto repair industry, all while enjoying comprehensive benefits and flexible work arrangements to support your well\-being. Join Steer to be part of a forward\-thinking, flexible, and collaborative culture where you are empowered to do meaningful and impactful work. We value diversity and believe that forming teams in which everyone can be their authentic self is key to our success. We welcome applications from those with diverse backgrounds and industries. Our hiring process looks beyond just credentials. The school you went to at 18 doesn't define your potential to thrive and enrich our culture. Even if you don't meet every requirement, we invite you to apply.

jobs.description: **The Company:** Sungrow North America is a leading provider of renewable energy solutions, specializing in the development and manufacturing of photovoltaic inverters and energy storage systems. Sungrow North America aims to provide sustainable and reliable energy solutions to meet the growing demand for clean power and is known for its commitment to innovation, high\-quality standards, and exceptional customer service. **The Position:** The Service Innovation \& Development Engineer is a hybrid position based in the Sungrow Houston, TX office, reporting to the Service AI Agent product owner within the Strategic Expert team. Today it tracks and escalates unanswered field requests, answers technical questions from archived Q\&A, and identifies spare parts from photos using OCR, image embeddings, catalog retrieval and LLM\-based evidence checking. This is a hands\-on role on a small team, working directly with the field service engineers who use the tool every day. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities:** * Design, implement, test and ship features for the Service AI Agent (Node.js/TypeScript, Microsoft Teams SDK, Azure Bot Framework) across the full stack: Teams ingress, request lifecycle, background workers, retrieval and data layer. * Own the production stack: PostgreSQL schema and knex migrations (pgvector, pg\_trgm), the Python SigLIP image\-encoder worker, public ingress (Cloudflare tunnel today, Azure App Service as the target), and the deployment runbooks. * Extend the spare\-parts identification pipeline: OCR of board labels and barcodes, hybrid retrieval (identifier, text\-embedding and image\-similarity), LLM evidence comparison, company part\-number validation and the human confirmation and learning loop. * Build integrations with Sungrow business systems: PLM 3DEXPERIENCE (parts and BOM), iQMS (serial\-number trace and as\-built records), SharePoint via Microsoft Graph, and the Airtable spare\-parts inventory; later, controlled write\-back for ordering and repair workflows. * Deliver structural\-part PDF drawing matching and BOM linkage, the next planned work package. * Build the real\-data evaluation harness: expert\-labelled test sets, regression suites, accuracy and latency comparisons; use the results to adapt OCR and retrieval models. * Operate the service: monitoring and Application Insights telemetry, incident response, catalog and data refreshes, and permission hygiene (Teams RSC scopes, Graph app roles, Key Vault secrets). * Manage LLM and embedding usage (OpenAI API): prompt and model\-version changes, cost and latency tracking, content\-minimization and data\-handling rules. * Write and maintain design documents, deployment runbooks and user guides for field engineers. * Coordinate with Sungrow HQ R\&D and IT in China on API access, authorization and data sources. * Set coding standards, CI and the release process; review and mentor the part\-time developer on the team. * Gather feedback from field service engineers and the Strategic Expert team, prioritize the backlog with the product owner, and deliver in staged rollouts. * Other duties as assigned. **Minimum Requirements:** * Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical/Computer Engineering, or equivalent experience. * Microsoft Azure certifications (AZ\-204 Developer, AI\-102 AI Engineer) desired but not required. * Solar, battery, power\-electronics or industrial\-service domain experience desired. * 3 plus years of professional software development, including 2 plus years with Node.js/TypeScript in production. * Experience building bots or integrations on Microsoft Teams and Azure Bot Framework (or a comparable messaging platform), and with Microsoft Graph and Entra ID app registrations. * Strong SQL and PostgreSQL: schema design, migrations (knex or similar) and query tuning; vector search (pgvector) a plus. * Hands\-on experience with LLM APIs (OpenAI or similar): prompt design, structured outputs, embeddings, retrieval\-augmented generation and evaluation. * Working Python for ML inference services (PyTorch, transformers, image preprocessing), enough to maintain and extend the SigLIP encoder worker. * REST API design and integration, OAuth2 and token handling, retries and error handling. * Git, automated tests (vitest or similar), CI, Docker, and Linux/macOS server operation. * Must possess effective written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work with field engineers and non\-technical stakeholders. * English Language Proficiency required. * Mandarin Chinese Proficiency desired but not required (coordination with HQ R\&D). **Travel:** * Up to 10% (Sungrow service and training centers and customer sites for user feedback and field testing). **Work Location and Status:** * Contract role based out of Houston, TX. * No visa/legal sponsorship. **Compensation:** * Compensation commensurate with experience * Competitive benefits package and employee programs * Strong personal and company growth opportunities *For candidates in the states of California, Colorado, New York and Washington, the anticipated annual base salary for this role is between $75,000 \- $105,000 This range does not include any other compensation components or other benefits that an individual may be eligible for. engineering disciplines, and mentor other engineers. **Our Environment** * Up to 5%\-10% of travel may be required. jobs.title: AI Information Security Engineer
jobs.description: **Who is Tenable?** Tenable® is the Exposure Management company. Over 40,000 organizations around the globe rely on Tenable to understand and reduce cyber risk. Our global employees support 65 percent of the Fortune 500, 50 percent of the Global 2000, and large government agencies. Come be part of our journey! **What makes Tenable such a great place to work?** Ask a member of our team and they'll answer, "Our people!" We work together to build and innovate best\-in\-class cybersecurity solutions for our customers; all while creating a culture of belonging, respect, and excellence where we can be our best selves. When you're part of our \#OneTenable team, you can expect to partner with some of the most talented and passionate people in the industry, and have the support and resources you need to do work that truly matters. We deliver results that exceed expectations and we win together! **Your Role:** As an AI Security Engineer on Tenable's Information Security team, you will help shape and mature our approach to securing AI both within Tenable's products and across the enterprise. AI introduces a new class of risk at the intersection of application security, cloud risk, and data governance, and you will be on the front lines of defining how we assess, test, and address it. You will apply hands\-on AI engineering experience alongside product security and application security skills to design security controls for AI systems, lead assessments, and help engineering teams ship AI features securely. You will establish security standards for responsible AI use, influence decisions across the organization, and build tooling that raises our security posture. This role is ideal for a practitioner who has spent time building or tinkering with AI systems, looking under the hood of model internals, and wants to channel that experience into a security specialty. **Your Opportunity:** * Design, implement, and maintain end\-to\-end security controls across the AI/ML lifecycle. * Assist in the implementation of robust security guardrails, controls, and boundary mechanisms for Large Language Models (LLMs), Small Language Models (SLMs), and open\-source models. * Continuously monitor the AI landscape for novel vulnerabilities and attack techniques, applying deep engineering experience to proactively defend enterprise AI deployments. * Assist in developing security reference architectures for AI deployment patterns, including MCP servers and agentic AI workflows and harnesses. * Deploy controls to ensure model integrity, governance, and proper access control across models and feature stores. * Build AI\-driven tooling to strengthen cybersecurity posture across identity, incident management, vulnerability management, third\-party risk, and emerging AI threat vectors. * Perform AI safety, security assessments, threat modeling for AI/ML systems, identifying risks such as data poisoning, model evasion, model extraction, adversarial inputs, and integrity attacks. * Collaborate with software engineers, and product teams to integrate security best practices into AI development, training, validation, and deployment processes. * Create security guidance, documentation, and training for internal engineering and development teams; develop metrics that drive desired security behaviors and outcomes. * Assist in researching emerging trends in AI security and contribute to innovative solutions that support Tenable's AI initiatives. **What You'll Need:** * 2 or more years of professional experience in information security or application security, with at least a demonstrated interest on securing AI/ML systems. * Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Data Science, or a related field preferred. * Awareness of AI\-specific security threats, including adversarial ML, data poisoning, prompt injection, model inversion, model evasion, and inference attacks. * Knowledge of data security principles, including encryption, masking, and tokenization. * Knowledge of SSDLC, DevSecOps, and security testing practices, including SAST, DAST, SCA, and threat modeling. * Knowledge of application security architecture best practices and patterns, including modern web applications, Docker, and microservices. * Ability to work cross\-functionally across engineering, product, and business teams. * Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to clearly translate complex AI security risks for both technical and non\-technical audiences. * Strong problem\-solving skills, attention to detail, and ability to lead projects with end\-to\-end ownership. * Self\-motivated and effective working independently and across distributed teams. **And Ideally:** * Hands\-on experience with AI red teaming, adversarial prompt testing, or LLM security assessments. * Basic coding experience in Python and/or Go. * Experience with frameworks \& libraries such as PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, TensorFlow or similar. * Strong understanding of the ML/AI lifecycle and the security risks associated with each stage. * Experience with application security assessment tools (Burp Suite, ZAP, Tenable WAS, etc.) * Knowledge of cloud security platforms: AWS, Azure, or GCP including AI/ML\-related services. * Security certifications: CISSP, CSSLP, SANS GIAC, CEH, or AI\-focused security certifications are a plus, but not necessary. \#LI\-Hybrid \#LI\-MS1 *We're committed to promoting Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) at Tenable \- through all equal employment opportunity laws and regulations at the international, federal, state and local levels. If you need a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please contact* *Recruiting@Tenable.com* *for further assistance.* **Tenable Data Consent Statement** Tenable is committed to protecting the privacy and security of your personal data. Depending on your location, one or more of the following notices may apply to you: General Applicant Privacy Notice California Applicant Privacy Notice EU/EEA/UK Applicant Privacy Notice

jobs.title: AI Infrastructure Engineer [Tooling]
jobs.description: **AI Infrastructure Engineer \[Tooling]** ========================================= **About Tessera Labs** Tessera Labs is redefining how enterprises adopt and operationalize Artificial Intelligence. Backed by Foundation Capital and led by a world\-class founding team, we build multi\-agent AI systems that automate complex business workflows across platforms like SAP, Salesforce, Workday, Snowflake, Databricks, and more. Our mission is simple but ambitious: bring real AI automation to the enterprise — with speed, precision, and measurable impact. We move fast, operate with extreme ownership, and build at the frontier of applied AI. **About the Team** ------------------ The AI Platform team builds and operates the foundational infrastructure that lets Tessera's multi\-agent systems run reliably, securely, and consistently across customer environments. That spans the portable cloud foundation (Kubernetes, networking, automation) and the AI\-specific layer on top of it: model serving, agent runtimes, evaluation and release tooling, and the internal CLIs and services our engineers use every day. The work directly enables us to onboard and operate enterprise customers under strict security and compliance constraints while preserving developer velocity. It reduces integration risk, standardizes operations across hyperscalers, and makes sure product teams can ship AI features safely without infrastructure becoming a bottleneck. **The Role** ------------ As an AI Infrastructure Engineer, you'll design, build, and own the tooling and services that take Tessera's AI agents from a developer's laptop to production in customer clouds. You'll write real software in Python or Go — CLIs, controllers, and internal services — and run it on Kubernetes alongside LLM serving stacks like vLLM. This is a hands\-on IC role open at mid to senior level. Mid\-level engineers will own well\-scoped components end to end; senior engineers will also set technical direction, make architectural calls across the platform, and mentor others. We'll calibrate level based on experience and interviews. **What You'll Do** ------------------ **AI infrastructure tooling** * Build and maintain internal CLIs, SDKs, and services in Python or Go that let engineers provision, deploy, test, and debug AI agents across environments * Deploy, scale, and tune LLM inference using vLLM (and similar serving stacks), including GPU scheduling, autoscaling, batching, and cost/latency trade\-offs * Build infrastructure for multi\-agent systems: agent runtimes, tool and connector execution, sandboxing, state management, and safe rollout of new agent versions * Own MLOps workflows: model and prompt versioning, evaluation pipelines, artifact registries, and promotion from staging to production * Write Kubernetes operators and custom controllers (CRDs) that encode how Tessera's AI workloads are deployed and managed **Cloud platform and reliability** * Design, build, and operate production\-grade AI agent infrastructure on Kubernetes and Terraform * Support Tessera's portable infrastructure across Azure, Oracle Cloud, GCP, and AWS, with primary ownership of at least one cloud variant * Improve observability for AI systems: tracing of agent and LLM calls, token and GPU utilization, latency, error rates, and cost * Strengthen security and reliability for workloads running in customer environments under strict compliance constraints **Automation and developer experience** * Design and own CI/CD for infrastructure, services, and model/agent releases, using GitOps and pipeline\-as\-code * Build self\-service tooling that removes manual work: environment provisioning, secret rotation, dependency updates, compliance checks, and release management * Partner closely with AI, product, and platform engineers to unblock delivery * Champion an automation\-first mindset: if something is done twice, it should be automated; if it's automated, it should be observable and maintained like production code **Must\-Have Qualifications** ----------------------------- * 5\+ years of experience in infrastructure, platform, or backend engineering (7\+ years for senior) * **AI infrastructure tooling:** strong software engineering in Python or Go, with a track record of building and shipping tools, CLIs, or services that other engineers rely on * Hands\-on experience running LLM workloads in production, including serving with vLLM or a comparable stack (TGI, Triton, SGLang, Ray Serve) * Experience building infrastructure for AI agents or LLM applications: orchestration, tool calling, evaluation, or agent runtimes * Practical MLOps experience: model/prompt versioning, evaluation and release pipelines, and observability for ML systems * Strong hands\-on experience with Kubernetes, including writing or extending operators/controllers (Kubebuilder, Operator SDK, controller\-runtime, or Kopf) * Strong hands\-on experience with Terraform and at least one of Azure, Oracle Cloud, GCP, or AWS * Proven experience designing and owning CI/CD systems, GitOps\-driven deployments, and release automation * Solid networking fundamentals * Proven experience deploying and operating real production systems **Nice\-to\-Have Qualifications** --------------------------------- * GPU infrastructure experience: NVIDIA GPU Operator, MIG, KServe, or Karpenter\-style autoscaling for inference * Familiarity with agent frameworks and protocols (LangGraph, Model Context Protocol, OpenAI Agents SDK, or similar) * LLM observability tooling such as OpenTelemetry, Langfuse, or Arize * Experience with FluxCD, ArgoCD, or other GitOps controllers * Cloud security and DevSecOps: security gates, SBOM generation, and compliance checks in CI/CD * Deep networking expertise (service mesh, private connectivity, multi\-cloud networking) * Open\-source contributions to AI infrastructure or Kubernetes ecosystem projects * A passion for clean, unified infrastructure and a builder mindset **Who You Are** --------------- * A builder who writes production\-quality code, not just configuration * Curious about the fast\-moving AI infrastructure landscape and eager to learn new tools * Comfortable owning and defending infrastructure decisions, with clear reasoning about trade\-offs * Experienced in startups and/or big tech environments * Highly self\-motivated with a strong ownership mindset * Someone who enjoys building foundational systems that other engineers rely on **Why Join Tessera Labs** ------------------------- * Work on cutting\-edge AI infrastructure with real enterprise impact * Own foundational systems at an early\-stage, high\-growth company * Collaborate with a sharp, execution\-focused founding team * Shape how AI agents are deployed across the largest enterprise platforms in the world Compensation Range: $200K \- $230K

technologies** . * Experience with platforms such as **Amazon Bedrock, Anthropic Claude, OpenAI models, or comparable enterprise AI platforms** . * Familiarity with **agentic workflows, tool/function calling, prompt engineering, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), and model evaluation** . * Experience with security technologies such as vulnerability management platforms, SIEM/XDR, endpoint security, application security tools, or cloud security platforms. * Experience with **Git, CI/CD pipelines, Jenkins or similar automation platforms, containers, and infrastructure\-as\-code** . * Familiarity with secure coding, vulnerability analysis, threat modeling, or attack\-path analysis. * Familiarity with NIST and other cybersecurity or AI risk management frameworks. **Role its ECCHO® business line. **Key Responsibilities** * Design, build, and maintain **AI harnesses and agentic security workflows** that securely connect advanced AI models with security tools, source code, infrastructure, and security data. * Engineer workflows that use AI to support **vulnerability discovery, attack\-path analysis, threat modeling, secure code analysis, threat hunting, and remediation validation** . * Integrate AI capabilities with existing security platforms, cloud environments, APIs, development pipelines, vulnerability management tools, and security telemetry. * that enable security teams to use multiple AI models and techniques to independently analyze and validate security findings. * Partner with Application Development and DevSecOps teams to integrate AI\-enabled security analysis into the **software development lifecycle (SDLC) and CI/CD pipelines** . * Develop AI\-enabled capabilities to analyze AWS and other cloud environments for configuration weaknesses, vulnerabilities, privilege paths, and potential attack chains. * Work with Security Operations and threat\-hunting teams to develop AI\-assisted workflows for analyzing alerts, identifying suspicious activity, and accelerating investigations. * Evaluate emerging frontier AI models, security tools, APIs, and agent frameworks and determine how they can be safely incorporated into the Information Security program. * Establish technical safeguards for AI workflows, including **access controls, data protection, logging, model and tool permissions, testing, validation, and human oversight** . * Measure the effectiveness of AI\-enabled security capabilities, including improvements in vulnerability identification, remediation time, analyst productivity, and security coverage. * Document architectures, workflows, operating procedures, and security controls supporting production AI capabilities. Support regulatory, audit, and risk management reviews of AI\-enabled security capabilities and demonstrate that implementations operate within established security and governance requirements. * **Skills \& Experience** * Strong hands\-on engineering experience with **AI/LLM platforms, APIs, agent frameworks, or AI orchestration and harness technologies** . * Experience developing production solutions using **Python** and APIs, with the ability to build integrations and automation across security platforms. * Experience with frontier AI models and platforms such as **Anthropic Claude, OpenAI models, Amazon Bedrock, or comparable enterprise AI platforms** . * Strong understanding of **AI agents, tool use/function calling, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), prompt engineering, model orchestration, and automated evaluation** . * Experience integrating AI or automation into **cybersecurity, DevSecOps, vulnerability management, application security, or cloud security workflows** . * Strong AWS experience, including familiarity with IAM, networking, security services, APIs, logging, and infrastructure\-as\-code. * Familiarity with security technologies such as **SIEM/XDR, vulnerability management platforms, endpoint security, source code scanning, cloud security tools, and threat intelligence platforms** . * Understanding of software vulnerabilities, attack paths, secure coding practices, threat modeling, and vulnerability remediation. * Experience with **Git, CI/CD pipelines, Jenkins or similar automation platforms, containers, and modern software development practices** . * Ability to independently prototype new capabilities and then engineer successful prototypes into secure, documented, repeatable production workflows. * Strong communication skills with the ability to explain highly technical AI and cybersecurity concepts to security leadership, engineers, auditors, and risk stakeholders. * Knowledge of security and risk frameworks such as **NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF), NIST AI Risk Management Framework (AI RMF), and secure AI development practices** . **Ideal Candidate** The ideal candidate is a **security\-minded AI engineer rather than a policy and governance manager** . Individual should be comfortable writing code, connecting models to tools and data, experimenting with emerging AI capabilities, and translating successful experiments into controlled production solutions. Individual should combine strong software and cloud engineering skills with sufficient cybersecurity expertise to understand how AI can materially improve vulnerability discovery, threat analysis, secure development, and remediation. **Physical Demands and Work Environment:** The working environment is generally favorable. jobs.title: Lead Research Engineer – AI Evaluation & Benchmarking
jobs.description: **Job Description** ------------------- **Thomson Reuters Labs is seeking a Lead Research Engineer to lead the design and delivery of production\-ready software for artificial intelligence (AI) model evaluation and benchmarking. You will build scalable evaluation infrastructure that enables research and product teams to compare large language models (LLMs), measure quality, cost, and latency, and make informed decisions about model selection and development.** ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- **You will own the engineering approach from early prototypes through reliable, maintainable tools, collaborating closely with research scientists, engineering teams, and product partners while helping shape technical direction and engineering delivery.** --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ * Lead technical delivery and engineering planning: Partner with program and research leaders to define priorities, break projects into delivery stages, estimate effort and cost, recommend staffing and required skills, identify dependencies, and adapt plans to available resources. * Design and build scalable evaluation infrastructure: Extend existing shared tools and services, design new components where needed, and develop production\-quality Python software, APIs, and reusable evaluation frameworks. Deliver useful initial versions, validate them with users, and improve them through iterative development. * Turn research methods into working software: Collaborate with scientists to build automated evaluation pipelines connecting model APIs, test datasets, and agreed scoring methods. Implement reliable workflows for comparing LLMs and other AI models using evaluation datasets relevant to products and customer needs. * Ensure reliable, reproducible model comparisons: Maintain repeatable experiments, separate evaluation data from model development, and make results traceable to evaluation inputs and methods. Measure model quality, operating cost, and latency to support product teams in validating model performance. * Build practical tools for researchers and product teams: Develop clear user interfaces, documentation, evaluation reports, and diagnostic capabilities. Enable scientists and product teams to run evaluations, understand failures, interpret results, and extend tools without depending on the original developer. * Own production reliability, performance, and responsible data use: Integrate automated testing, deployment, and monitoring from the beginning. Address performance, scalability, and operating costs, establish service maintenance and support ownership, and work with data specialists to implement access controls, permitted\-use rules, and retention requirements. jobs.title: Firmware Engineer (Python / Embedded Linux)
jobs.description: #### **About Torus** Torus is headquartered in Utah and is expanding manufacturing at our 545,000\-square\-foot facility in Salt Lake City called GigaOne. **We are** **the world’s first mesh energy infrastructure, uniting communities through resilient, sustainable, and intelligent power.** We design, engineer, manufacture, install, and support our systems end\-to\-end, standing behind them throughout their lifecycle. Torus systems help reduce costs, lower emissions, and protect facilities from outages, while strengthening the security and reliability of the broader utility grid. Torus is committed to American manufacturing, engineering excellence, and building energy systems that last. Torus has raised over $267 million from investors like Magnetar, Mercado, ICONIQ and Origin Ventures. The investments are helping to accelerate deployment of modular power plants across utilities, data centers, and industrial sectors. This investor confidence reflects the strength of our team, technology as well as the scale of the problem we are solving. At Torus, you will be part of something larger than a single product or technology. Your work will help build energy infrastructure that supports and strengthens our electrical grid, critical systems, industry, and communities for decades to come. We value accountability, collaboration, and clear thinking. We are looking for people who want to solve hard problems and build things that matter. #### **About the Role** *Embedded Systems and Firmware @ Torus* We’re building energy storage and management solutions that help: * Commercial and industrial businesses reduce their operating costs while increasing reliability. * Grid operators keep the electricity grid stable and cost efficient. Torus is hiring a **Firmware Engineer** to be an individual contributor on our firmware team, working in close partnership with our Firmware Architect. This is a hands\-on role where you'll translate architectural direction into well\-engineered, production\-grade firmware. #### **Our Tech Stack** Our firmware application layer is Python on Embedded Linux (Yocto)—not C, not C\+\+. This was a deliberate architectural choice: Python gives us speed\-to\-market, flexibility to respond to changing grid program requirements, and a clean separation between hardware and application logic. Our comms are primarily RS\-485, so Python runtime overhead is seldom the limiting factor. *If you've been writing Python to control hardware over serial protocols—in energy, robotics, industrial IoT, or test \& measurement—you'll feel immediately at home here. If you've spent your career in C/C\+\+ and are looking for that, this probably isn't the right fit.* Each Torus device generates over a million data points per day and integrates with our cloud platform via MQTT/AWS IoT. Our systems also participate in Virtual Power Plant (VPP) programs, responding to real\-time dispatch signals from utilities—which means our firmware decisions have direct, measurable impact on grid operations. #### **What You’ll Do** In this role, you will report to our Head of Embedded Systems and will be responsible for: * **Developing firmware** features across our energy storage product lines: telemetry, control loops, cloud connectivity, and hardware abstraction layers. * **Owning system integration**—working closely with hardware, data, and software teams to ensure seamless interoperability across the full stack. * **Driving quality** through design reviews, automated testing, and documentation. (We believe engineers own their own QA.) * **Debugging and optimizing** real\-time embedded applications and serial communication interfaces in the field and in the lab. * **Supporting scaling operations**—deployment tooling, remote monitoring, and root\-cause analysis of field issues across a growing fleet. * **Participate in on\-call rotation** for escalated technical issues. #### **Who Thrives Here** * You're a systems thinker who's comfortable owning a problem end\-to\-end—from a register on a Modbus device to a graph in a customer dashboard. You care about code quality without letting it become a bottleneck. You're energized by the fact that the firmware you write shows up in real buildings, on real grids, doing real work. * You don't need to be an energy domain expert on day one—but you're curious about how the grid works and motivated by the idea that good engineering here has an outsized impact on creating sustainable communities. * You're also comfortable in a structure where a Firmware Architect sets system\-level direction and you're the person who makes it real—bringing deep implementation judgment, surfacing tradeoffs, and pushing back when something won't work in practice. #### **Required Experience** * BS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Embedded Systems, or equivalent practical experience. * 2\-5\+ years of hands\-on experience developing commercial embedded software or firmware applications. * Strong Python proficiency and real production experience running Python on Embedded Linux (Yocto or similar). * Solid understanding of serial communication protocols—RS\-485, Modbus, I²C, CAN, Ethernet. * Experience with real\-time embedded systems: multi\-threading, inter\-process communication, timing constraints. * Ability to read schematics and PCB layouts to troubleshoot hardware integration issues. #### **Preferred Experience** * Experience with IoT device management at scale (fleet OTA, remote diagnostics). * Familiarity with AWS IoT, MQTT, or data telemetry pipelines. * Exposure to energy storage systems, inverters, or grid\-connected hardware. * Knowledge of VPP programs, demand response, or utility interconnection standards (IEEE 1547, UL 1741\). * Experience with containerized embedded deployments (Docker/Balena on Linux targets). * CI/CD practices in embedded or hardware\-adjacent environments. #### **Additional Details** **Background Check** All candidates are subject to a background check. **Location \+ Travel** Remote U.S.\-based role with occasional onsite work in Salt Lake City and surrounding area locations (air\-conditioned and non\-air\-conditioned). Must be available during MT business hours. **Compensation** $135,000 \- 180,000 (Note: We have the flexibility to hire at different levels, which may impact the corresponding pay range.) **Work Authorization** Applicants must already have the legal authorization to work in the US without requiring any employer sponsorship. **Physical Requirements** * Regularly operates a computer and other peripheral office equipment such as a printer or mouse. * Ability to read, identify, observe and recognize details, color\-coding and fine print at close range on associated engineering drawings. * Ability to communicate information so others can understand. Must be able to exchange accurate information in these situations. * Must report to work reliably and with the ability to use full and unimpaired skills and judgment to safely execute your job. * Proficiency in reading, writing, and speaking English required. * When on the production floor, required to don personal protective equipment to include, but not limited to ear protection, gloves, eye protection and/or safety helmet. * When on the production floor, ability to observe, detect and respond to audible and visual machine malfunction warnings. #### **Our Perks \& Benefits** Benefits eligibility is based on employment status. Financial * Employee Rewards Package including equity * 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan * Torus paid life and AD\&D Insurance with options to purchase additional coverage * Voluntary short\- and long\-term disability insurance Health \& Wellness * Health Benefits Package: Choice between traditional PPO or HSA\-eligible medical plans with Torus covering 50% of medical premiums; Dental insurance; and Vision insurance * Plan participants have access to telehealth services, mental health support and coaching, and exclusive discounts on brands, dining, entertainment, and more. Time Off * Unlimited discretionary PTO * 10 paid company holidays * Waiting period\-free 100% paid parental leave Culture \& Community * Regular company\-wide offsites to showcase our progress and learnings. A time to step back, think strategically, and work on the business together. * Team members receive Torus branded gear * Peer Recognition Program * Fully stocked break rooms with free snacks and drinks. Because great work deserves great fuel. Torus is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, or disability status. Torus participates in E\-Verify. Once you accept a job offer, we will provide the Social Security Administration (SSA) and, if necessary, the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) with information from your Form I\-9 to confirm work authorization. \#li\-lw

templates. * Build, enhance, and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions and/or Azure DevOps. * Automate infrastructure provisioning, application deployments, configuration management, and long\-term strategy for retained data, including  and risk remediation. * Develop and maintain backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity procedures, including periodic recovery testing. * business stakeholders. * Coordinate with internal technology teams and external partners as needed. * Provide occasional after\-hours support for critical production incidents. * Stay current with evolving cloud technologies, security practices, and infrastructure automation techniques. **Required Qualifications*** 5\+ years of professional experience in DevOps, cloud engineering, infrastructure engineering, or a related technical discipline. * At least 3 years of substantial hands\-on experience designing, deploying, and supporting Microsoft Azure environments. * Strong working knowledge of Azure SQL, Azure Functions, App Service, Azure networking, Key Vault, and Microsoft Entra ID. * Demonstrated experience developing and maintaining Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, Bicep, or ARM. * Proven experience implementing CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions and/or Azure DevOps. * Proficiency with PowerShell, Azure CLI, or similar scripting and automation tools. * Strong understanding of cloud security, identity and access management, networking, and infrastructure protection. * Experience supporting production cloud environments, including troubleshooting, monitoring, incident response, and disaster recovery. * Working familiarity with AWS services, particularly S3, IAM, and data retention or archival solutions. * Demonstrated ability to work independently, prioritize competing technical demands, and take ownership of infrastructure from design through ongoing operations. * Strong analytical, problem\-solving, communication, and technical documentation skills. **Preferred Qualifications*** Experience integrating MuleSoft Anypoint Platform or comparable enterprise integration and API management platforms with Azure. * Familiarity with infrastructure consolidation, or decommissioning projects. * Familiarity with Azure cost optimization, capacity planning, and cloud financial management. * Relevant Microsoft Azure certifications, jobs.title: Senior Embedded Software Engineer
jobs.description: **About Treeswift:** In the face of rising threats, increasing pressure on affordability, and unprecedented demand for power, Treeswift empowers energy companies to modernize their field work to meet the growth and challenges ahead.
