ROS 2 experience is preferred. * Strong engineering fundamentals for working on a small team: git, code review, ticket\-based workflows, writing unit tests, bench testing, and clear documentation * Comfortable working in Linux from the command line. jobs.title: Equipment Engineer I
jobs.description: The Equipment Engineer ensures the reliability, safety, and mechanical integrity of all extrusion production lines and downstream hardware. hardware improvement projects. **Key Responsibilities:** * Collaborate with vendors to source specialized tooling and equipment upgrades to maintain asset readiness. * Utilize maintenance work order data and machine logs to investigate root causes of mechanical failures, component wear, and structural breakdowns. * Drive projects to eliminate recurring equipment downtime and maximize overall machine uptime. * Lead the installation, commissioning, and optimization of hardware improvements for extrusion lines and ancillary systems. * Develop standard operating procedures (SOPs) and train operators/technicians on equipment features, machine guarding, and LOTO safety protocols. * Collaborate with the Process Engineer to align machine capabilities with optimal process parameters (temperatures, speeds, pressures) to minimize mechanical stress and component wear. * Maintain and upgrade downstream ancillary equipment (including vacuum pumps, water chillers, and pullers) to ensure synchronized line speed. * Maintain, and troubleshoot the material handling infrastructure, including delivery systems, vacuum loaders, blenders, and scrap grinders/shredders. * Manage and optimize the critical manufacturing utilities required to keep the extrusion lines running efficiently. * Design and work with maintenance to execute predictive and preventive maintenance (PM) programs to minimize unplanned downtime. **Qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. * 0\-3 Years of extrusion or relatable experience. * Basic understanding of extrusion process equipment #### **Education** Required* Bachelors or better in Mechanical Engineering or related field Equal Opportunity Employer This employer is jobs.title: AI & Process Automation Developer
jobs.description: Truliant’s mission is to improve lives by putting our members first, providing great service and straightforward financial solutions. Our core values of Member Focus, Service, Guidance, Relationships, and Community define how we interact with members to fulfill our mission of improving lives and providing a foundation on which we conduct ourselves. Our Promise to Our Teammates: Truliant strives to provide all teammates with an enjoyable place to work where they feel valued, empowered and rewarded for all that they do. * **This position is remote within our NC, SC, VA footprint. Although this position is primarily remote, there are occasional events and meetings that may require you to work on\-site at one of our Truliant locations.** **Why this role matters** ========================= At Truliant Federal Credit Union, better technology helps our teams work more efficiently and creates a smoother experience for our members. As an AI \& Process Automation Developer, you’ll help turn business needs into secure, reliable automation and AI solutions that reduce manual effort and improve how work gets done. This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys solving real business problems, building practical technology, and learning alongside experienced developers, architects, and business partners. **What you’ll do** ================== In this role, you’ll help design, build, test, deploy, and support enterprise automation and AI solutions. Your work may include robotic process automation, workflow automation, system integrations, intelligent document processing, and conversational AI. **Day to day, you’ll:** * Build and maintain reusable automation workflows, attended and unattended automations, and conversational AI capabilities using established development standards. * Connect solutions with enterprise applications through REST APIs, SOAP services, SQL databases, message queues, and enterprise connectors. * Test, document, deploy, troubleshoot, and support solutions across development, testing, and production environments. You’ll also partner with developers, architects, business stakeholders, and cross\-functional teams to understand requirements, assess automation opportunities, and deliver solutions that are secure, scalable, and maintainable. **What you bring** ================== We’re looking for a hands\-on developer who combines solid programming and integration experience with a practical understanding of AI and automation. You can move an idea from requirements through testing and support while asking thoughtful questions and working well with both technical and business partners. **This role is a great fit if you have:** **Required Experience:** * 2\+ years of foundational experience with AI or automation technologies such as RPA, workflow automation, conversational AI, intelligent document processing, or an equivalent platform. * 3\+ years of experience using source control, CI/CD processes, and modern software development tools. * 1\+ years of automation development, systems integration, or related experience designing, developing, testing, deploying, and supporting technical solutions. * 2\+ years of experience with REST APIs, SQL, JSON, XML, and system integration concepts. * 3\+ years of experience with Python, Java, React JavaScript, Node.js, or similar programming languages. **Required Skills:** * Develop, test, deploy, troubleshoot, and maintain automation solutions using reusable components and established development practices. * Build and support integrations using APIs, databases, services, and enterprise connectors. * Use source control and CI/CD practices to manage reliable software changes across environments. * Translate business requirements into technical designs, workflow diagrams, specifications, deployment instructions, and support documentation. * Apply unit, integration, and regression testing practices and support User Acceptance Testing. **Education/Certifications required within one year:** * UiPath Advanced Developer Professional Certification. * Kore.AI Automation AI / XO Platform, Kore.AI Agent AI, \& Kore.AI Agent Platform Builder advanced training or developer certification. You should also be comfortable working within Agile delivery, SDLC, DevSecOps, secure coding, change management, and enterprise governance standards, while collaborating closely with senior developers and cross\-functional partners. **What sets you apart** ======================= **You don’t need to check every box, but here’s what will help you thrive in this role:** * A bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience. * 2\+ years of experience working within Agile development teams. * 2\+ years of exposure to cloud\-based platforms, services, and development environments. * 2\+ years of experience in financial services, healthcare, government, or another regulated industry. * Curiosity about emerging technologies such as Generative AI, Retrieval Augmented Generation, prompt engineering, and Agentic AI. **What you’ll get** =================== We believe in supporting our team members both professionally and personally. **In this role, you can expect:** * Meaningful work that improves operational efficiency and supports a better member experience at Truliant Federal Credit Union. * Hands\-on opportunities to build across automation, integrations, conversational AI, and emerging AI technologies rather than being limited to one type of solution. * Collaboration with experienced developers, architects, and business partners who can help you strengthen both your technical skills and business understanding. * A team environment that values secure, maintainable solutions, thoughtful problem\-solving, continuous learning, and high\-quality service. **Ready to Apply?** =================== If you have a passion for member service and would like to invest in a meaningful career with opportunity for growth, we encourage you to apply to Truliant! As a member of the Truliant family, you will enjoy the following full time benefits: * No\-cost employee Medical, dental, vision coverage * Prescription benefits (including mail order) * Paid holidays and Paid Time Off (PTO) * 401(k) plan with contribution matching * Paid community involvement volunteers hours * Paid group life Insurance * Teammate loan discounts * Tuition reimbursement * Short and long\-term disability * Health \& Wellness program * Teledoc (physician video conferencing) * Onsite fitness facilities or health club reimbursement * Employee Assistance Program (EAP) * Medical flexible spending account * Dependent care flexible spending account

jobs.description: **This role is located in Somerville, MA \- We are a hybrid work environment and are in the office 3\+ days/per week.** Tulip, the leader in AI\-native frontline operations, is helping companies around the world equip their workforce with composable, connected apps, leading to higher quality work, improved efficiency, and end\-to\-end traceability across operations. Tulip's cloud\-native, no\-code platform, powered by embedded AI, is driving the digital transformation of industrial environments through composable, human\-centric solutions that go beyond disrupting the Manufacturing Execution System (MES) category. A spinoff out of MIT, Tulip is headquartered in Somerville, MA, with offices in Germany, Hungary, Singapore, Israel and Japan. Tulip has been recognized as a World Economic Forum Global Innovator, a 2024 Deloitte Technology Fast award winner, one of Energage's Top Workplaces USA, and one of Built In Boston's "Best Places to Work" and "Best Midsize Places to Work." **About You:** * You're service\-oriented and get real satisfaction from helping people solve their problems. * You're a problem solver who looks for root causes rather than treating symptoms. * You communicate clearly with technical and non\-technical colleagues, and you keep systems, documentation, and asset records tidy and up to date. * You're comfortable learning and using AI tools to work smarter and handle recurring issues more efficiently. **What skills do I need?** * 1\-3\+ years of experience in an IT support or helpdesk role * Proficiency across macOS, Windows, and Linux, with a basic understanding of networking, Wi\-Fi, and office hardware * Familiarity with common SaaS platforms such as Google Workspace, Atlassian, 1Password, and Slack * Actively uses AI tools as part of daily work for troubleshooting, documentation, and automating repetitive tasks * IT security awareness; compliance experience is a plus * Nice to have: experience with device management platforms (e.g., Kandji or Iru), scripting or automation, or high\-growth startup experience * Bachelor's degree or equivalent working experience **Key Responsibilities:** * Serve as a key on\-site IT support contact at Somerville HQ, resolving hardware, software, and network issues in person when remote support isn't enough. * Triage inbound IT requests via tickets and chat, solving Tier 1 and Tier 2 issues independently and escalating when needed. * Support and troubleshoot endpoints (macOS, Windows, Linux), productivity platforms, and A/V equipment. * Manage user accounts and permissions across the company's SaaS platforms, including onboarding and offboarding (equipment setup, access provisioning, account decommissioning) and periodic access reviews. * Maintain an accurate inventory of IT assets at Somerville HQ and support the full device lifecycle: procurement, tracking, refresh, and recycling. * Create and update support documentation, knowledge base articles, and team runbooks so employees can self\-serve, and turn recurring issues into systemic fixes rather than just closing tickets. **Key Collaborators:** * IT team * Operations and People Ops partners * Operations leadership **Working At Tulip** We know even great candidates experience imposter syndrome. jobs.title: Software Developer - Core Services
jobs.description: **Software Developer \- Core Services** --------------------------------------- *To ensure a fair and consistent evaluation process, candidates are expected to complete all interviews and assessments independently and without the use of artificial intelligence tools (including AI\-generated responses, prompts, or real\-time assistance). Use of AI throughout the application and recruiting process may result in removal from consideration. Our goal is to get to know your authentic experiences, communication style, and problem\-solving approach.* **Pay Range: $95,000 \- 110,000\.** **About the Role:** U\-Haul is seeking a talented and experienced Software Developer to join our Core Services \- Contract Software Development Team. This team is integral to our operations, supporting multiple critical systems that are at the heart of the U\-Haul software ecosystem. As a Software Developer, you will play a key role in designing, developing, and maintaining robust and scalable APIs/services and supporting UIs using the complete Microsoft Stack, .NET, C\#, SQL, Postgres, modern front\-end frameworks and libraries, and supporting technologies. Our systems are built around Kafka event streams, emphasizing resiliency and scalability. **Key Responsibilities:** * Design, develop, test, and maintain software solutions using the full Microsoft stack and supporting technologies. * Implement and manage event\-driven architectures using Kafka event streams. * Apply modern software design principles to design scalable and resilient systems. * Provision, monitor, and maintain cloud\-based resources and systems via Azure Portal. * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams and various businesses within the company to solve unique opportunities. * Troubleshoot, debug, and optimize existing software applications. * Stay up to date with emerging technologies and best practices to ensure continuous improvement. * Understand how systems work together in a big picture sense and integrate multiple applications efficiently. **Common Skills and Requirements:** * **Experience:** Minimum of 5 years in software development and bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field. * **Technologies:** Proficiency in Object Oriented programming languages and design as well as strong database experience. * **Event\-Driven Architecture:** Experience with Kafka or similar event streams and producer/consumer or pub/sub relationships. * **Design Principles:** Strong understanding of modern software design principles and its application in scalable systems, understanding of modern software best practices. * **Problem\-Solving:** Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills. * **Communication:** Strong verbal and written communication skills. Ability to work efficiently and professionally with team members and other teams. jobs.title: Senior Offensive Security Engineer
jobs.description: **About the role** ------------------ You will find our weaknesses before someone else does. Unity's attack surface spans the engine and editor that developers build on, the client runtime shipped in games played by billions of people, a broad portfolio of cloud products and services, a large ads and monetization business, our corporate environment, and a fast\-growing set of AI\-assisted and agentic tools. Your job is to attack all of it the way a real adversary would, and to turn what you find into fixes that stick. This is not a checklist pen\-testing role. You will plan and run realistic attack campaigns, chain small weaknesses into real impact, and explain clearly to engineers and leaders what an attacker could actually do and what matters most to fix. You will work closely with Product Security, Infrastructure Security, Security Operations, and engineering teams, and you will help build the tooling and automation that let a small offensive team cover a very large surface. **What you will own** --------------------- * **Adversary emulation and red teaming**: plan and run objective\-based red team operations against our cloud, corporate, and production environments, modeled on threats relevant to Unity. Run purple team exercises with Security Operations to test and improve detection and response. * **Application testing**: deep security testing of Unity products and services, including web applications and APIs, the engine, editor and client runtime, ads and monetization systems, and developer\-facing platforms. * **Cloud and infrastructure attack paths**: find and demonstrate attack paths across multi\-cloud environments (GCP, AWS, Azure), Kubernetes and containers, CI/CD pipelines, identity, and secrets. * **AI and agentic systems**: test LLM integrations, AI\-native products, and agent workflows for issues such as prompt injection, data leakage, tool misuse, and excessive permissions. * **Findings to fixes**: write clear, prioritized findings with realistic impact, work with owning teams on remediation, and retest to confirm fixes. * **Offensive tooling and automation**: build and maintain tools, scripts, and automation that scale adversarial engineering, testing and turn repeated findings into continuous checks. **What success looks like in the first 12 months** -------------------------------------------------- * A risk\-based testing plan across Unity's highest\-value targets, agreed with security leadership and the owning engineering teams. * Several end\-to\-end red team or adversary emulation operations completed, each with clear findings, If you’re energized by tackling meaningful problems, excited to innovate with purpose, and motivated by work that truly matters, we’d love to hear from you. **The Team** ------------ Upstart's Bank Technology team builds the internal platforms, security automation, and operational systems that enable Upstart Bank to operate securely, efficiently, and at scale. The team partners closely with stakeholders across risk, legal, compliance, security, and operations to create software solutions that support the bank's growth as a licensed financial institution. As a Principal Software Engineer, you will provide technical leadership across a growing portfolio of internal platforms and automation systems. You will drive architectural direction, solve complex technical challenges, and establish engineering patterns that enable the team to deliver secure, scalable, and maintainable solutions for the bank's most critical operational functions. **How you'll make an impact** ----------------------------- * Lead the architecture, design, and implementation of internal platforms, security automation systems, and workflow tooling that support Upstart Bank operations. * Establish scalable engineering patterns, technical standards, and system designs that enable long\-term platform growth and maintainability. * Partner with stakeholders across risk, compliance, legal, operations, and engineering to translate complex business requirements into durable software solutions. * Design and oversee relational data models, authorization systems, integrations, and platform services that support secure and reliable operations. * Identify and mitigate technical risks, making thoughtful decisions around system architecture, platform investments, and build\-versus\-buy tradeoffs. * Mentor engineers through technical leadership, architectural reviews, design documentation, and engineering best practices. * Drive technical strategy for internal platforms and automation initiatives as the bank expands its operational and regulatory capabilities. **Minimum Qualifications** -------------------------- * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience) and 8\+ years of software engineering experience. * Experience designing, building, and operating large\-scale production software systems and web applications. * Experience leading architecture and technical design for distributed systems, platform services, or internal software platforms. * Experience designing relational database schemas, APIs, integrations, authentication systems, and role\-based access control frameworks. * Experience partnering with cross\-functional stakeholders to deliver software solutions supporting operational, compliance, security, or business\-critical workflows. **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * Knowledge of TypeScript, Node.js, Next.js, Prisma, or similar modern application frameworks. * Experience building security automation, governance, risk and compliance (GRC) platforms, or operational workflow systems. * Familiarity with regulated industries such as financial services, banking, healthcare, or other compliance\-driven environments. * Knowledge of compliance frameworks, including SOC 2, NIST CSF, or similar regulatory standards. * Ability to influence technical strategy, drive alignment across teams, and navigate ambiguous problem spaces with sound engineering judgment. ***Position Location \-*** This role is available in the following locations: Remote ***Time Zone Requirements \-*** This team operates on the East/West Coast time zones. At Upstart, your base pay is one part of your total compensation package. The anticipated base salary for this position is expected to be within the below range. Your actual base pay will depend on your geographic location–with our “digital first” philosophy, Upstart uses compensation regions that vary depending on location. Individual pay is also determined by job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process. In addition, Upstart provides employees with target bonuses, equity compensation, and generous benefits packages (including medical, dental, vision, and 401k). United States \| Remote \- Anticipated Base Salary Range $190,600—$263,900 USD **What you'll love** At Upstart, our benefits for full\-time employees are designed to support your health, financial well\-being, family, and personal growth. Here’s what you can expect: * Competitive compensation, including base pay, bonus opportunities, and annual equity grants that vest quarterly * Retirement benefits to help you plan for the future, including a 401(k) or Group Retirement Savings Plan with a company match of $2 for every $1 contributed, up to $15,000 annually (USD in the US, CAD in Canada) * Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) with discounted stock purchase options for eligible employees (US only) * Comprehensive health coverage designed to support you and your family, including medical, dental, vision, and wellness resources for US and supplemental health coverage for Canada. * Health Savings Account contributions from Upstart for eligible plans (US only) * Income protection benefits, including life insurance and disability coverage for added financial security * Paid time off, sick leave, and company holidays, in line with local requirements * Paid family and parental leave to support caregiving and major life moments (duration varies by country) * Family\-centered benefits to support fertility, parenthood, and caregiving needs * Employee Assistance Program (EAP) offering mental health support and life\-centered resources * Financial wellness resources, including access to financial planning tools and a financial concierge service (US Only) * Annual wellness allowance to support your physical and emotional well\-being and personal development, based on what matters most to you * Annual productivity allowance to invest in relevant tools and resources you need to do your best work, no matter where you work from * Connection and community through team events, all\-company updates, and employee resource groups (ERGs) * Onsite perks, including catered lunches and fully stocked micro\-kitchens when working from one of our offices in the Bay Area, Austin, Columbus, and New York City For roles based in Canada, please note that we are not currently able to hire in Quebec. jobs.title: Associate Software Engineer
jobs.description: Overview and Summary: We are Automotive Business Scientists. We empower our clients to turn overwhelming industry data into discovery, action, and measured success. We are unique market leaders because we find and examine possibilities through the clarity of a scientific lens. To solve the toughest client challenges, we need curious, creative, and dedicated people to join our team. We search out individuals who align with our core values and who adhere to the highest standards of integrity and ethics in everything they do. Our company is filled with the brightest minds and the biggest hearts at every level. We recognize that personal success takes on many different forms of the course of our lives – both professional and personally – so we provide a myriad of benefits and programs focused on Wellbeing, Growth, Community and Recognition. One size does not fit all, so we encourage every Urban Scientist to discover their own formula for success including hybrid and remote work options. If this sounds like the kind of company you would like to work with, Apply Now! **POSITION OVERVIEW** We are looking for an Associate Software Engineer with full\-stack development skills to be an important part of building our latest innovative multi\-tenant, micro\-services solutions. We use some of the latest technologies along with some core foundational technologies such as .NET, SQL Server and Angular. Successful candidates will possess a passion for technology, seeking out and learning the best options for solving problems. This **Detroit\-based role** follows a **hybrid schedule, with in\-person work at our Detroit, MI office** two days a week. Flexibility may evolve based on business needs. URBAN SCIENCE DOES NOT AND WILL NOT PROVIDE IMMIGRATION RELATED SPONSORSHIP FOR THIS ROLE, NOW OR IN THE FUTURE. Essential Duties and Responsibilities: **ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES*** Maintain our goal: Our highest priority is to satisfy the customer through early and continuous delivery of valuable software. * Use Agile methodologies to deliver solutions that will support our customers, mainly using the Scrum framework to support solution development, implementation, and support. * Work in a team environment to build our solutions, and with regular retrospection, improve our team culture and processes through continuous inspection. * Actively participate in team technical discussions where design ideas are presented and reviewed resulting in a team decision on the best approach. * Participate in systems design, design reviews, software development, code reviews, quality engineering, and continuous integration and continuous delivery. * Develop and maintain databases in support of application development, modification and creation of queries and integration. * Assist with the creation of necessary technical documentation in support of programming and design activities such as design diagrams, release notes, code comments, use cases, and training materials. * Provide support to internal and external clients currently utilizing software applications, including assisting with the delivery of solutions. Qualifications \- Education and Experience: **KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, ABILITIES, AND COMPETENCIES** To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, abilities, and competencies required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.* Preferred familiarity with, or desire and ability to learn: + Web technologies such as HTML, CSS, JavaScript + Utilization of technologies such as C\#, .Net, WCF, and MS SQL Server + Relational and dimensional database design methodologies and/or unstructured data solutions + Tools such as Visual Studio (VS), Team Foundation Server (TFS), GIT, etc. + Automation testing for quality engineering disciplines such as unit testing, smoke testing, and integration test. + Continuous integration and continuous delivery tools (Azure DevOps). * Requires ability to: + Function on an Agile (Scrum) team utilizing ADO for task management and source control. + Analyze requirements to determine how applications function in order to build effective designs and tests. + Use industry standard design patterns. + Understand and utilize testing methodologies (test driven development, unit testing, performance/load testing). + Learn and follow Urban Science’s Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC). + Develop business awareness and understanding of the business requirements of IT. + Monitor and check work deliverables ensuring high quality, accuracy and having a strong attention to detail. + Prioritize competing demands, manage multiple concurrent tasks and adapt to changing priorities. * Oral Communication: Requires the ability to compose and verbally deliver information of varying levels, using appropriate grammar, tone, inflection and non\-verbal cues, while also listening to and correctly deciphering verbal communication delivered by others. * Written Communication: Requires the ability and capacity to communicate ideas, facts and data in writing using appropriate grammar, syntax and sentence structure including the ability to create technical documents. * Analytical Thinking/Reasoning: Requires the ability to understand a situation by breaking it apart into smaller pieces, and/or tracing the implications of a situation in a step\-by\-step causal way. * Results Orientation: Requires the ability to strive for optimal results by taking responsibility for timeliness, commitment to task and adherence to performance standards. * Ethics/Integrity: Requires the ability to behave in a trustworthy \& transparent manner. * Teamwork \& Cooperation: Requires the ability to work cooperatively with others and be part of a team. * Self\-Control: Requires the ability to keep emotions under control and to restrain from negative actions or behaviors. * Information Seeking: Requires the drive to gain a deeper understanding of work\-related issues or events by making a concerted effort to gather information and seek out development opportunities. * Initiative: Requires the drive to go above and beyond in order to improve or enhance job results. * Concern for Order, Quality \& Accuracy: Requires the ability to monitor and check work related information and deliverables ensuring high quality and accuracy. * Customer Service Orientation: Requires the ability to understand and help/assist both internal and external customers and meet their needs. * Flexibility/Adaptability: Requires the ability to adapt to and work effectively within a variety of situations, individuals or groups, as well as understand and appreciate different and opposing perspectives. * Conceptual Thinking/Critical Thinking: Requires the ability to understand a situation or problem by putting the different pieces together to see the bigger picture. * Interpersonal Understanding: Requires the ability to understand other’s feelings and concerns, and to value individual differences in people. * Self\-Confidence: Requires the ability to express confidence in dealing with challenging circumstances, in reaching decisions or forming opinions and in handling failures or setbacks constructively. * Organizational Commitment: Requires the ability and willingness to align his/her own behavior with the needs, priorities and goals of the organization. * Relationship Building: Requires the ability to effectively build and maintain friendly, warm relationships or networks of contacts with clients/customers. * Assertiveness: Requires the ability and intent to appropriately display assertive behaviors to ensure others follow and comply with given directions. **EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE*** Demonstrated experience with software engineering in an internship, collegiate, or Capstone project. * Must have bachelor's degree in an appropriate IT field such as Computer Science or Computer Engineering from an accredited U.S. college or university or equivalent foreign institution. **WORK ENVIRONMENT** The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. **This description is intended to describe the type and level of work being performed by a person assigned to this position. It is NOT an exhaustive list of all duties and responsibilities required by a person so classified. The job may require additional hours beyond the normal 40\-hour workweek.**

jobs.title: Integration Developer
jobs.description: Remote Position w/ occasional travel Journi – Integration Developer Responsible for design, develop, deploy, and support enterprise integration solutions using Microsoft .NET, C\#, and Azure cloud technologies, middleware systems, document storage and retrieval solutions, cloud hosting, and more, to ensure they technically work seamlessly together for best in class performance. Analyze solution components and their respective integration models. Assess integration options for high\-volume processing. Apply best practices towards leveraging on\-demand open APIs. Identify opportunities to reduce the need for data replication and integration. Drive continuous improvement by enhancing technical integrations, streamlining data flows, and optimizing system performance. Lead the development and implementation of complex solutions that meet tolling project requirements, leveraging CRM, Azure cloud services, IVR technologies, and integrating with external systems as needed. Design and implement robust integrations between SAP, CRM systems, Azure cloud services, IVR systems, and various external systems (e.g., payment gateways, backend databases, traffic management systems). Design and optimize IVR systems to enhance tolling customer interactions and operational efficiency while ensuring seamless integration with CRM and tolling backend systems. Fully document all created work associated with this position, including technical and functional designs and diagrams, test plans, test scripts, impact analysis reports, lessons learned, best practices for others to follow, plus any other documentation as required by the Commission. This documentation shall follow the format and / or templates as instructed by the Commission. Adhere to and follow all The Commission standards, policies, and procedures. Perform tasks and other **duties** as related to this position and role and assigned by the Commission. Minimum Experience Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. Master’s degree preferred. Experience (8\+ years) as a Developer or similar role with knowledge in Azure cloud solutions, IVR systems, and integrations with external systems, specifically in tolling projects. Strong understanding of Microsoft government and commercial cloud platforms (Azure), including IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS offerings. Extensive experience in designing and implementing integrations with various external systems in the context of tolling projects (e.g., toll collection systems, traffic management systems). Desired Skillset 10\+ years of expertise developing complex systems integrations for high\-volume organizations within SAP, MS Dynamics 365 Customer Relationship Management solutions, and Microsoft Azure Cloud hosting solutions. Design, develop, and maintain enterprise integration services using C\#, .NET 8\+ / supported .NET LTS versions, and ASP.NET Core Web API. Develop RESTful APIs, microservices, and custom middleware components. Build Azure Functions using HTTP, Service Bus, timer, and blob triggers. Develop reusable components, shared libraries, and integration frameworks. Implement JSON/XML payload transformations, validation, and data mapping. Strong hands\-on experience with Azure Service Bus, including queues, topics, subscriptions, sessions, and dead\-letter queues. Design and implement secure REST APIs following enterprise API standards. Follow clean coding principles, SOLID design patterns, and secure coding standards. Hands\-on experience with IVR systems design, development, and optimization, preferably in tolling or similar customer\-facing environments. Solid understanding of tolling industry standards, regulatory requirements, and best practices. Certifications / Education Bachelor’s degree in business management or information systems. Notes**:** Remote Position w/ occasional travel VIVA is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants have an equal opportunity for placement, and all employees have an equal opportunity to develop on the job. This means that VIVA will not discriminate against any employee or qualified applicant on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status

jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description: Vynyl's technologists, designers and product strategists are experts at system modernization, new product development, and rescuing projects in distress. We use the best cloud\-native and AI\-enabled tools, and apply a battle\-tested combination of Agile, Lean, and design thinking to collaboratively solve our client's most pressing challenges \- and do it right the first time. We often work in regulated industries, such as healthcare, financial services, government and education. Our work helps detect diseases, identify kids who need special educational support, applies AI to support complex legal settlements, helps people access mental health services, and so much more. **The Role** ============ As a Senior Full Stack Developer, you will be a key leader across the entire software development lifecycle, from conceptual design to deployment and monitoring. You will be responsible for building robust, scalable backend services using Python and AWS Serverless technologies (Lambda, DynamoDB, SQS, EventBridge), developing event\-sourced systems that provide complete state history and auditability. A critical component of this role is a demonstrated fluency with modern AI/ML development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, agentic coding tools, large language models). We are looking for candidates who not only use these tools daily but can articulate a clear, thoughtful perspective on their limitations, security implications, and the strategic opportunities they create for the engineering profession. **Key Responsibilities** ======================== * **Design** **and implement** highly scalable, cost\-efficient backend services using Python and AWS (Lambda, API Gateway, RDS, DynamoDB, SQS, EventBridge). * **Architect and build** event\-sourced systems and event\-driven pipelines, ensuring reliable message processing, idempotency, and eventual consistency across distributed services. * **Collaborate** with product managers and designers to translate requirements into technical designs and shippable code. * **Implement** best practices for security, logging, monitoring, and infrastructure\-as\-code (e.g., Terraform or CloudFormation). * **Perform** rigorous code reviews, mentor junior and mid\-level engineers, and drive technical excellence across the team. * **Actively research, propose, and integrate** new technologies and patterns, with a focus on optimizing development velocity and system performance. * **Clearly articulate** a professional point of view on how to effectively, securely, and ethically integrate AI tools into the software development lifecycle. **Qualifications** ================== **Required** ------------ * **5\+ years** of professional experience in full\-stack software development. * **Expert\-level proficiency** in Python for backend development (including Django). * **Strong** working proficiency with Vue.js (and typescript). * **Deep practical experience** designing, deploying, and maintaining applications using serverless architectures (preferably AWS Lambda, API Gateway, and managed services). * **Proficiency** with SQL, preferably PostgreSQL. * **Solid understanding** of event sourcing and event\-driven architecture patterns, including experience with message brokers or streaming services (e.g., SQS, SNS, EventBridge, or Kinesis). * **Experience** with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and Infrastructure\-as\-Code. * **Demonstrated Fluency in AI\-Assisted Development**: Candidates must be able to demonstrate practical, hands\-on experience using AI\-powered coding tools to achieve specific, quantifiable productivity gains, while also clearly understanding and mitigating the associated risks (e.g., code quality, security, IP concerns). **Nice to Have** ---------------- * **Experience** with advanced AWS services (e.g., Step Functions, Kinesis, SageMaker). * **Experience** working in a regulated or compliance\-focused environment. * **A Bachelor's or Master's degree** in Computer Science or a related technical field. **AI and the Evolution of Software Engineering \& Ops** ======================================================= All candidates must be prepared to discuss and demonstrate the following during the interview process: * **Practical AI Tool Usage:** Specific examples of AI tools used in professional or personal projects to enhance productivity, solve complex problems, or accelerate development. If you have a preferred agentic tool setup, please share! * **Understanding of AI Limitations:** A clear understanding and articulation of the current technical, ethical, and accuracy limitations of modern AI tools in the engineering context. * **Strategic AI Opportunity:** A viewpoint on how AI tools create new opportunities for software engineering, such as shifting focus from boilerplate code to complex problem\-solving or architectural design. * **Evolution of the Engineering Role:** A well\-articulated point of view on how your role has already changed (e.g., new workflows, skills, ways of collaborating) due to the introduction of AI and how you expect the role to evolve in the coming years based on your assessment of coming advancements in AI tools and technologies. **Application Process** ======================= To apply, please submit your resume and a cover letter. Your cover letter should be informed by the "AI and Forward\-Looking Requirements" section above. The hiring process includes: * **Initial** **screening email** * **Technical** **Assessment Interview** * **A Panel Interview** **Salary Range $140,000 \- $175,000** ===================================== **Benefits for Full\-Time Employees** Excellent health, dental, vision, and life insurance Excellent 401(k) plan with annual employer match of 4%

jobs.title: Associate Director - Career & Experiential Learning (Engineering)
jobs.description: **Position Summary:** The Associate Director of Career \& Experiential Learning for Engineering \& Technology leads the development and delivery of pathway\-based career and experiential learning support for students pursuing careers across engineering, technology, computing, data science, and related technical fields. Working in close partnership with the School of Engineering and Career Advancement \& Engagement, the Associate Director integrates career coaching, experiential learning, faculty and academic engagement, and industry knowledge into a cohesive student experience. The position helps students understand the breadth of career possibilities available to them, develop industry\-relevant skills and experiences, and progress intentionally from early exploration through internships and full\-time employment. The Associate Director serves as a primary bridge between Career Advancement \& Engagement and the School of Engineering, partnering with faculty, academic advisers, departments, alumni, employers, and student organizations to reduce fragmentation and create a more coordinated career\-development experience for engineering students. A particular emphasis of the role is integrating career development and experiential learning earlier in the student journey. The Associate Director will help students use projects, research, employer engagement, internships, and other experiences to explore career possibilities, develop professional capabilities, and make informed career decisions well before graduation. **Key Functions and Expected Performance:** **Engineering \& Technology Pathway Development** * Lead the development and execution of career pathways supporting students across engineering, technology, computing, data science, and related technical fields. * Develop pathway\-specific career preparation strategies reflecting the different professional opportunities associated with Vanderbilt's engineering disciplines. * Help students understand both traditional engineering careers and emerging opportunities in technology, product development, AI, entrepreneurship, consulting, and other fields employing technical talent. * Monitor industry trends, recruiting practices, emerging occupations, and skill requirements and translate these developments into student preparation. Partner with academic departments to clarify career possibilities and strengthen connections between academic preparation and professional outcomes. * **Career Coaching \& Student Development** * Provide high\-level individual and group coaching to undergraduate and graduate engineering students. * Help students explore career possibilities, articulate interests and goals, and develop intentional plans for gaining relevant experience. * Support students in translating technical coursework, research, projects, leadership, and other experiences into compelling professional narratives. * Prepare students for technical and behavioral interviewing, networking, recruiting processes, and other industry\-specific expectations. * Develop milestone\-based programming that helps students progress from exploration through experiential learning, internship attainment, and full\-time placement. Work particularly closely with students in disciplines where career pathways may be less visible or recruiting pipelines less established. * **Experiential Learning Integration** * Integrate experiential learning into engineering career development beginning early in the student lifecycle. * Partner with faculty, academic programs, employers, alumni, and Career Advancement \& Engagement colleagues to connect students with internships, projects, research, employer challenges, hackathons, company visits, and other applied experiences. * Help students use experiential learning as a means of testing possible career directions and developing industry\-relevant capabilities. * Connect existing School of Engineering experiential opportunities to broader career development pathways. Collaborate closely with the Associate Director for Employer \& Industry Development to identify student needs that can be addressed through new employer\-sponsored experiences. * **Faculty, Academic \& School of Engineering Partnership** * Build strong working relationships with School of Engineering faculty, academic advisers, program leaders, and department leadership. * Serve as a Career Advancement \& Engagement liaison and embedded partner to the School of Engineering. * Partner with departments to identify gaps in student career preparation and develop coordinated solutions rather than duplicative programming. * Engage faculty as important members of students' career ecosystems while ensuring they are supported rather than expected to serve as career advisers. Identify opportunities to integrate career exploration, Life Design, employer exposure, and professional development into existing academic and co\-curricular experiences. * **Employer, Alumni \& Ecosystem Alignment** * Collaborate closely with the Associate Director for Employer \& Industry Development to ensure employer\-development priorities reflect student interests and academic strengths. * Engage alumni and industry professionals as mentors, speakers, advisers, and sources of career insight. * Support employer\-facing programs that connect students directly with practitioners and organizations. Help create a connected engineering career ecosystem involving students, faculty, alumni, employers, academic advisers, and Career Advancement \& Engagement. * **Outcomes \& Assessment** * Track student engagement, experiential\-learning participation, internship attainment, and full\-time placement outcomes. * Identify gaps in outcomes by engineering discipline, degree level, career pathway, or student population. * Use student, faculty, employer, and alumni feedback to continuously improve pathway programming. * Monitor emerging career fields and changing skill requirements affecting engineering and technology students. Contribute to assessment and reporting on Engineering \& Technology pathway performance and student success. * **Supervisory Relationships:** This position reports administratively and functionally to the Senior Director of Engineering \& Technology Career Pathways and works in close partnership with leadership, faculty, and staff in the School of Engineering. The position collaborates extensively with the Associate Director for Employer \& Industry Development, Career Advancement \& Engagement colleagues, academic departments, alumni, employers, and other university partners. **Education and Certifications** Bachelor’s degree is necessary. Advanced degree in business, engineering, technology, or a related field preferred. **Experience and Skills** * 5–8\+ years of experience in engineering, technology, career development, experiential learning, university\-industry engagement, student development, recruiting, or a related field is necessary. * Demonstrated understanding of engineering and technology career pathways and the professional opportunities available to technically trained students is necessary. * Experience advising, mentoring, teaching, recruiting, or developing students or early career technical talent is necessary. * Demonstrated ability to develop experiential learning or career\-development programs is necessary. * Ability to build effective relationships with students, faculty, academic leaders, alumni, employers, and university partners is necessary. * Strong communication, facilitation, coaching, and program\-development skills are necessary. Ability to operate effectively in a complex, highly collaborative environment is necessary. * **Preferred Qualifications** * Professional experience within engineering, technology, computing, data science, product development, or another technical environment. * Experience working with engineering students or technically trained early\-career professionals. * Familiarity with engineering recruiting, technical interviews, portfolio/project\-based hiring, and evolving technology talent practices. * Experience developing internships, employer projects, research\-to\-career programs, or other forms of experiential learning. * Familiarity with design thinking, Life Design, or other developmental approaches to career exploration. * Experience using AI and emerging technologies in career development, education, engineering, or professional practice. * Familiarity with CRM, Handshake, or similar student and employer engagement platforms.

jobs.title: Process Engineer I, Data and Knowledge Management
jobs.description: ### **Join our Mission to Protect Humankind!** Vaxcyte is a clinical\-stage vaccine innovation company engineering high\-fidelity vaccines to protect humankind from the consequences of bacterial diseases, which have serious and costly health consequences when left unchecked. Working to eradicate or treat bacterial infections such as invasive pneumococcal disease, Group A Strep, and Shigella is just the beginning. Our path to success is clear and well\-defined, and Vaxcyte is set up to go the distance. **WHAT** we do is every bit as important as **HOW** we do it! Our work together is guided by four enduring core values: * RETHINK CONVENTION: We bring creative and intellectual diversity to every facet of the work we do in order to innovate and re\-innovate the way vaccines are delivered. * AIM HIGH: We embody our collectively audacious goal to courageously make the most complex biologics ever attempted to protect humankind. * LEAD WITH HEART: Everyone leads at Vaxcyte with a kindness\-first, inclusive approach to collaboration and vigorous debate that advances our business objectives. * MODEL EXCELLENCE: The magnitude of our challenge requires our shared commitment to demonstrating integrity, accountability, equality and clarity across communications and decision making. ### **Summary:** As we grow, we are seeking a strategic and collaborative Process Engineer I, Data and Knowledge Management to ensure the integrity, accessibility, and effective use of data and knowledge assets across the organization. This role will execute component\-level analysis, utilizing data and knowledge resources critical to our process development, regulatory, and operational activities. The Process Engineer I, Data and Knowledge Management is instrumental in ensuring scientific data integrity, regulatory readiness, and the preservation of institutional knowledge in a dynamic, fast\-paced clinical environment. ### **Essential Functions:** **Engineering Analytics \& Process Insights:** * Assess process trends and discrepancies using engineering knowledge, and evaluate the technical rationale and potential impact of proposed process improvements * Apply chemical and biochemical engineering principles to evaluate relationships between process parameters, unit operation performance, and product quality attributes * Partner with data science team to drive data visualization, reporting, and insights. * Support the use of AI/ML and automation for improved data analysis and knowledge extraction. **Manufacturing Process Data Management \& Governance:** * Acquire, integrate, and technically evaluate manufacturing process data from internal teams and contract manufacturing sites to support process monitoring, continuous improvement, and CMC regulatory submissions. * Develop data management and verification workflows that preserve the accuracy, integrity, and traceability of manufacturing process data. * Lead and own data verification for all commercial regulatory submissions. **Process Knowledge Management:** * Develop structured systems and workflows to capture and retain organizational knowledge, including protocols, study results, lessons learned, and decision rationales. * Develop tools and processes that enable technical teams to access, share, and apply process knowledge to support manufacturing and process improvement. * Champion a knowledge\-sharing culture across technical, scientific and operational functions. **Collaboration \& Technical Leadership:** * Partner with regulatory, quality, R\&D, IT and contract manufacturing teams to understand technical needs and develop appropriate solutions. **Compliance \& Risk Management:** * Ensure compliance with data protection and clinical trial regulations, including GDPR, HIPAA, and 21 CFR Part 11\. * Identify and mitigate risks related to data security, access, and retention. ### **Requirements:** Bachelor’s degree in Chemical Engineering, Bioprocess Engineering, or a related engineering discipline is required. 8\+ years of relevant experience in biopharmaceutical process engineering, Manufacturing Science and Technology (MSAT), process development, manufacturing technical support, or related engineering work, including at least 3 years in the life sciences or biotechnology industry. Other combinations of education and/or experience may be considered. * Experience interpreting manufacturing process data and applying engineering and statistical methods to evaluate process performance. * Proven experience leading enterprise data governance and knowledge sharing initiatives in a highly regulated environment. * Strong technical communication, project management, and cross\-functional collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with engineering, scientific, and manufacturing teams. * Experience with tools like SharePoint, Veeva Vault, Confluence, Tableau, and SQL is highly desirable. **Preferred:** * Experience supporting clinical trials and regulatory submissions (e.g., IND, BLA). * Background in immunology, vaccines, or infectious disease R\&D. * Experience in scaling systems and processes in a high\-growth, early\- to mid\-stage. **Reports to:** Senior Director, Process Validation, Global MSAT **Location:** United States **Work Arrangement (may be adjusted based on business needs, job responsibilities, or changes to company policy):** Remote **Compensation:** The compensation package will be competitive and includes comprehensive benefits and an equity component. **Salary Range:** $121,000 \- $142,000 **Relocation:** This role is not eligible for relocation assistance.**Equal Opportunity** *We are an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or veteran status.* **Recruitment Fraud Notice** *Please be aware of fraud or scams from individuals, organizations and/or internet sites claiming to represent Vaxcyte in recruitment activities. Vaxcyte has an established recruitment process for all positions prior to issuing an offer for employment and we will never extend unsolicited employment offers or ask candidates to provide financial or sensitive personal information as part of the application process. All legitimate communication from Vaxcyte will come from an official @vaxcyte.com email address. Qualified and interested candidates should apply to current openings at* *vaxcyte.com/careers**.*

jobs.description: Veeam is the Data and AI Trust Company, specializing in helping organizations ensure their data and AI are fully understood, secured, and resilient to enable the acceleration of safe AI at scale. As the market leader in both data resilience and data security posture management, Veeam is built for the convergence of identity, data, security, and AI risk. Headquartered in Seattle with offices in more than 30 countries, Veeam protects over 550,000 customers worldwide, who trust Veeam to keep their businesses running. Join us as we go fearlessly forward together, growing, learning, and making a real impact for some of the world’s biggest brands. **About the Role** Securiti, now part of Veeam, builds the Data Command Center for data security, privacy, governance, and AI security. We are looking for a **Staff Security Engineer** to provide hands\-on technical leadership across product and application security. You will shape secure architecture, strengthen the SDLC, lead vulnerability response, and help engineering teams ship secure cloud and AI capabilities at scale. This is a senior individual\-contributor role for someone who can move comfortably from threat models and pull requests to exploit validation, cloud security, software supply chain risk, and customer or auditor discussions. **What You’ll Do** **Product \& application security** * Own and evolve the secure SDLC across the Securiti portfolio, including threat modeling, design reviews, secure code review, and security testing. * Provide security leadership for AI capabilities, including LLM\-powered features, agents, copilots, prompt injection, retrieval leakage, permissions, and model supply chain risks. * Tune and improve SAST, dependency, secrets, container, infrastructure, and SBOM controls so findings are actionable and integrated into engineering workflows. * Lead product vulnerability response from reproduction and severity assessment through remediation, coordinated disclosure, CVE handling, and customer advisories. * Perform targeted penetration testing and security research across applications, APIs, agents, connectors, and cloud services; scope and validate third\-party testing. * Strengthen software supply chain security through SBOMs, signed and reproducible builds, dependency governance, and secure release practices. * Build reusable security libraries, reference implementations, hardening guidance, and developer enablement; help scale security through a Security Champions program. * Track and communicate meaningful security metrics, including remediation time, critical/high findings, scan coverage, and engineering adoption. **Product compliance \& assurance** * Partner with engineering on technical controls and evidence supporting SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001/27701, ISO/IEC 42001, HIPAA, PCI, and FedRAMP Moderate readiness. * Translate applicable requirements such as GDPR, CCPA, the EU AI Act, DORA, and NIS2 into practical engineering requirements and release criteria. * Validate remediation of audit and penetration\-test findings and escalate material risks when needed. * Serve as a technical security partner for customer due diligence, audits, security questionnaires, AI\-risk reviews, and executive briefings. **Technical leadership** * Work across Engineering, Product, Platform, SRE, and Veeam Corporate Security to make security risk visible in architecture and roadmap decisions. * Influence engineering standards and security strategy without relying on direct authority. * Represent Securiti in technical discussions with customers, auditors, standards bodies, and the security research community. **What You’ll Bring** * 8\+ years in security, with substantial experience in application or product security for SaaS or cloud\-native platforms. * Strong coding and code\-review skills in one or more languages such as Go, Python, Java, or TypeScript, with the ability to validate vulnerabilities and build security tooling. * Deep knowledge of multi\-tenant cloud security across AWS, Azure, or GCP, including IAM, Kubernetes, secrets, tenant isolation, and protection of sensitive customer data. * Hands\-on experience securing LLM\-powered applications, including prompt injection, retrieval leakage, agent authorization, and model supply chain risks. * Demonstrated experience building or materially improving a secure SDLC across multiple engineering teams. * Experience leading vulnerability response or coordinated disclosure, including severity assessment, CVE processes, remediation, and customer communications. * Practical knowledge of software supply chain security, including SBOM, signing, SLSA, LLM applications, NIST AI RMF, and privacy\-by\-design principles. * Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CSSLP, OSCP/OSWE, CCSP, or GIAC. * Published security research, CVE credits, conference jobs.title: Associate Director, AI Connect Sales Engineering
jobs.description: ### **When you join Verizon** You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere \& always. Want in? Join the \#VTeamLife. Every AI model trained, every GPU cluster lit, and every inference workload served depends on physical fiber: dark fiber, long\-haul routes, and metro rings that connect campuses, power\-advantaged regions, and cloud on\-ramps. Hyperscalers and neoclouds are committing billions to this build\-out, and they will choose the partner that can design it right and deliver it on time. Verizon is building AI Connect to be the intelligent fabric of the AI economy. As an Associate Director, you will lead the experts who turn that ambition into signed, buildable, and profitable designs for our largest strategic customers. **About the Role** You will lead the sales engineers who design dark fiber, ultra\-long\-haul, metro and campus interconnect solutions for hyperscalers and neoclouds. Your team shapes route strategy, fiber count, diversity, latency and cost inputs before a deal is won, and makes sure what we quote can be built. **The Team You Will Lead** You will lead some of the most experienced people in the industry, typically with 15\-25 years in the field. Many have: * Come up through outside plant (OSP) planning and engineering design, and know what a route costs, how long it takes and where it breaks. * Led ultra\-long\-haul and metro fiber programs from engineering through construction and delivery. * Built cost studies and facility designs that balance customer needs against margin. * Worked inside carriers, fiber builders and construction firms, so they understand every hand\-off from the sales call to the splice. They don't need managing. They need a leader who is technically credible, drives innovation and standardization, clears obstacles, sets direction and makes them more valuable to the customer and to the company. **What You Will Do** * **Set the vision.** Build and execute the strategy for dark fiber and AI Connect design engineering so customers reach AI\-forward outcomes. * **Lead the design team.** Guide sales engineers supporting Verizon's top strategic AI Connect customers across a multi\-billion\-dollar portfolio, driving bookings and revenue growth. * **Direct world\-class designs.** Own solutions for GPU campus interconnect, data center interconnect, long\-haul and intercity routes, metro rings, and cloud on\-ramps. * **Set design standards.** Define standards for ultra\-high\-count fiber, route diversity, latency budgets, splice and handhole strategy, ILA/regen siting and phased growth for multi\-stage AI builds. * **Bring commercial rigor.** Evaluate build, IRU, lease and swap options with Finance and Product, and build ROI and cost models for every large pursuit. * **Connect design to delivery.** Partner with Network Planning, Construction, Right\-of\-Way, Legal and Operations so quoted routes are constructible, on schedule and on budget. * **Differentiate Verizon.** Equip the team to articulate Verizon's advantages across AI Connect, Dark Fiber, Lit Fiber/Wave and Edge Data Centers, and to be recognized as thought leaders. * **Raise efficiency.** Introduce automation and off\-load low\-value work so senior engineers spend time on customer\-facing design. * **Develop talent.** Hire, coach and retain top engineers, maintain certifications and build a succession bench. * **Build a public presence.** Represent Verizon at industry events, in thought leadership and on customer advisory boards. **What We're Looking For** **You'll need to have:** * Bachelor's degree in a technical discipline or directly related equivalent experience. * 10\+ years in engineering and architecting telecom, IT or network infrastructure, with deep expertise in dark fiber and the intersection of physical assets with AI/ML digital transformation. * 3\+ years leading senior technical talent, including workforce planning, coaching and performance management. * Proven record designing and winning large, multi\-year infrastructure deals, including technical qualification, pricing and contract negotiation. * Experience engaging senior executives and delivering effective customer presentations. * Demonstrated financial analysis skills: P\&L, ROI, cost analysis and business\-case development. **Even better if you have:** * MS or MBA. * Direct experience with hyperscalers or neoclouds. * OSP engineering, construction or delivery background, including ULH or metro fiber programs, permitting and right\-of\-way, and contractor management. * Knowledge of AI and GPU cluster networking, including scale\-out and scale\-across topologies and their requirements on the fiber layer. * Familiarity with power\-driven site selection and its effect on network routes. * Experience with IRUs, swaps, anchor\-tenant builds, SLAs and MSAs. * Relevant certifications (for example CCIE/CCNP, optical vendor or FOA CFOS). **Why This Role** * **Real scale and authority.** A multi\-billion\-dollar portfolio and the mandate to set design standards, hiring and operating model. * **A team worth leading.** Work with deeply experienced fiber, OSP and network design professionals. * **A front\-row seat to the AI build\-out.** Your team's designs connect the campuses where the next generation of models is trained and served. * **Competitive rewards.** Base salary, annual incentive, long\-term incentive, and comprehensive health and retirement benefits. **How to Apply** Apply through the Verizon careers site with your resume, and include a brief note on the largest infrastructure design or pursuit you have led and the team you built around it. ### **Where you’ll be working** In this mobile role, you'll primarily work from customer or field location(s), with occasional visits to a Verizon location for in\-person training and meetings.### **Scheduled Weekly Hours** 40### **Equal Employment Opportunity** Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to veteran status, disability or other legally protected characteristics. ### **Benefits and Compensation** Our benefits are designed to help you move forward in your career, and in areas of your life outside of Verizon. From health and wellness benefit options including: medical, dental, vision, short and long term disability, basic life insurance, supplemental life insurance, AD\&D insurance, identity theft protection, pet insurance and group home \& auto insurance. We also offer a matched 401(k) savings plan, up to 8 company paid holidays per year and up to 6 personal days per year, paid parental leave, adoption assistance and tuition assistance, plus other incentives, we’ve got you covered with our award\-winning total rewards package. Depending on the role, employees have the opportunity to receive compensation in the form of premium pay such as overtime, shift differential, holiday pay, allowances, etc. Newly hired employees receive up to 15 days of vacation per year, which grows with additional service. For part\-timers, your coverage will vary as you may be eligible for some of these benefits depending on your individual circumstances. The salary will vary depending on your location and confirmed job\-related skills and experience. This is a commission based position with the potential to earn more. For part\-time roles, your compensation will be adjusted to reflect your hours. The annual salary range for the location(s) listed on this job requisition based on a full\-time schedule is: $130,000\.00 \- $248,000\.00\. The annual salary range for the New York location(s) listed on this job requisition based on a full\-time schedule is: $142,500\.00 \- $248,000\.00\.
