jobs.title: Software Development Engineer- Product Reliability Engineering
jobs.description: **About Us** Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid. At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world. Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you. **Job Description** Every time someone taps, swipes, or clicks to pay\- Visa infrastructure makes it happen in milliseconds, across 200\+ countries. As a Software Development Engineer on the Product Reliability Engineering (PRE) team, you won’t just watch those systems run\- you’ll be one of the engineers building, automating, and evolving them. PRE is not a traditional ops team. We are a software engineering organization that treats infrastructure as code, reliability as a product, and automation as a strategic advantage. You’ll write Python, build agentic AI tools, manage data platforms, and contribute to the distributed systems that process billions of real\-time transactions. From day one, you are an engineer\- and from day one, your work matters. If you are endlessly curious about how large\-scale systems stay resilient, obsess over elegant automation, and want to launch your career at the intersection of AI, infrastructure, and global financial technology — this role was built for you. **Build Automation That Scales** * Design and ship end\-to\-end automation for deployment pipelines, infrastructure provisioning, and release orchestration — code that runs millions of times so engineers never have to repeat themselves. * Write clean, production\-grade Python (and Go or Bash where it counts) to eliminate toil, reduce manual intervention, and make systems self\-managing. * Develop modular frameworks for release scheduling, validation, rollback, and reporting that integrate across the full software delivery lifecycle. **Manage \& Evolve Data Platforms** * Support the build, deployment, and operations of relational database systems, contributing to schema design, architecture decisions, and solution engineering for critical payment data infrastructure. * Gain exposure to real\-time event streaming architectures that support payment processing at scale * Perform database health operations including patching, upgrades, backups, and recovery to maintain the availability and integrity of tier\-1 production databases. * Optimize query performance through index tuning, execution plan analysis, and replication monitoring — targeting metrics like query execution time, CPU usage, and replication latency. * Automate database tasks and configuration management using tools like Ansible and Liquibase, and contribute to CI/CD pipelines that govern schema changes through TEST and PROD environments safely. * Build predictive and reactive monitoring dashboards for database anomalies, surfacing health signals before they become incidents. **Ship Agentic AI \& ML\-Powered Tools** * Build GenAI\-powered engineering assistants that automate deployment orchestration, release governance, and environment lifecycle management. * Integrate LLMs into observability, incident response, and developer support workflows, transforming reactive operations into proactive, AI\-driven intelligence. * Contribute to prompt engineering, model fine\-tuning, and agentic automation initiatives that position PRE as one of the most AI\-forward reliability organizations in financial technology. **Own Observability \& Platform Health** * Build dashboards, alerts, and metrics using Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk, or ELK that give engineers real\-time clarity on complex, globally distributed systems. * Analyze system performance and availability data and turn insights into infrastructure improvements that prevent incidents before they occur. * Contribute to self\-healing and auto\-scaling capabilities that keep critical payment infrastructure resilient without human intervention. **Engineer for Reliability \& Security** * Ensure infrastructure and data platforms meet security and compliance standards across cloud\-native deployments supporting global financial services at scale. * Support zero\-downtime deployment strategies and high\-availability architectures that Visa’s partners and billions of cardholders depend on around the clock. * Participate in threat modeling, vulnerability remediation, and audit readiness activities as part of a team that treats security as a first\-class engineering concern. **Collaborate, Learn \& Grow Fast** * Embed within Agile squads, working alongside senior engineers, product managers, and global PRE peers across sprint planning, reviews, and release discussions. * Document runbooks, SOPs, and engineering guides that make the team smarter, faster, and more autonomous over time. * Participate in on\-call rotations (with robust support structures and mentorship) to build the incident response instincts that distinguish great reliability engineers. Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.**Qualifications** **Basic Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree, OR 3\+ years of relevant work experience **Preferred Qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field (2023–2025 graduates preferred; December 2025 graduates welcome). * Solid foundations in data structures, algorithms, and systems design \-you can reason about complexity, tradeoffs, and failure modes. * Proficiency in Python and comfort writing scripts or tools in at least one additional language (Go, Java, or Bash). * Foundational understanding of relational databases (RDBMS): SQL, data modeling, query optimization, and database connectivity troubleshooting. * Familiarity with Linux/Unix environments and meaningful command\-line fluency. * Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and a conceptual understanding of containerization (Docker, Kubernetes). * Understanding of CI/CD principles and how modern software delivery pipelines are structured and maintained. * Genuine curiosity about GenAI platforms and agentic systems (OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, LangChain, or similar)\- hands\-on exposure is a plus, intellectual interest is a must. **Bonus Points:** * Hands\-on experience with infrastructure\-as\-code tools: Terraform, Ansible, or Pulumi \-even from coursework, a capstone, or an internship. * Experience with database CI/CD tooling, particularly Liquibase for schema change management across environments. * Experience with observability tooling: Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk, ELK, or Datadog. * Database administration exposure: backup/recovery procedures, performance tuning, index management, or replication monitoring. * Familiarity with Git workflows and modern DevOps toolchains (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, ArgoCD). * Academic or project experience with ML frameworks: scikit\-learn, PyTorch, or LangChain / LangGraph. * Understanding of networking fundamentals: DNS, load balancing, service mesh, or TCP/IP. * A GitHub profile, personal project, hackathon entry, or open\-source contribution that shows us how you think and build. **Information for US Applicants** Visa has a comprehensive benefits package for which this position may be eligible that includes Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k), FSA/HSA, Life Insurance, Paid Time Off, and Wellness Program.**Work Hours** Varies upon the needs of the department. **Travel Requirements** This position requires travel 5\-10% of the time. **Mental/Physical Requirements** This position will be performed in an office setting. The position will require the incumbent to sit and stand at a desk, communicate in person and by telephone, frequently operate standard office equipment, such as telephones and computers. **Visa is an EEO Employer** Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protect veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

jobs.title: Principal AI Engineer, Agentic Systems
jobs.description: **Company Description** Vuori is re\-defining what athletic apparel looks like: built to move and sweat in but designed with a casual aesthetic to transition into everyday life. We draw inspiration from an active coastal California lifestyle; an integration of fitness, creative expression and life. Our high energy fast paced retail environment is reflected in the clothes we make. We aim to inspire others to take on all aspects of their lives with clarity, enthusiasm and purpose…while having a lot of fun along the way. We are proud to be an outlet for opportunity and for personal growth and success. **Job Description** As a Principal AI Engineer specializing in Agentic Systems, you will own designing, building and scaling AI\-powered applications, agentic systems and intelligent tooling that enhance how Vuori operates. Partnering closely with business and technology leaders, you will identify high\-value opportunities, develop production\-ready AI solutions, and drive the adoption of capabilities that improve efficiency, augment decision\-making and streamline complex business processes. This role requires a blend of technical expertise, systems thinking and cross\-functional collaboration. You will set Vuori's AI platform strategy, develop reusable AI services, orchestration patterns and engineering standards, while building autonomous and human\-in\-the\-loop solutions that empower teams across the organization. From AI assistants and workflow orchestration to multi\-agent systems and custom AI applications, you will be at the forefront of defining how AI creates value at Vuori. You will combine deep technical expertise with business acumen to deliver solutions that create measurable impact for employees, customers and business operations. **What you'll get to do:** *Set direction and raise the bar* * Define the evolution of Vuori's AI platform and technical standards as the AI ecosystem continues to mature. * Raise the technical capability of engineers across Vuori through review, pairing, and tooling others adopt because it is good rather than because it is mandated. * Make the build\-versus\-buy calls that shape the AI platform for years, and defend them. * Bring clarity to problems before they are well defined, including saying clearly when a workflow should not be agentic at all. * Establish engineering best practices for AI development, testing, evaluation, monitoring, observability and reliability. * Implement governance, security and guardrails to ensure responsible and trustworthy AI solutions. *Build and ship* * Design, build and deploy AI\-powered applications, intelligent agents and agentic workflows that solve high\-impact business challenges. * Develop systems that leverage planning, reasoning, memory and tool usage to automate and augment complex business processes. * Integrate LLMs, enterprise data sources, APIs and business systems to deliver end\-to\-end AI experiences. * Build and maintain scalable agent orchestration, RAG and knowledge retrieval architectures. * Prototype emerging AI capabilities and rapidly translate concepts into production\-ready solutions. *Partner and measure* * Partner with business and technology leaders across the organization to identify opportunities where AI can drive measurable business value. * Monitor solution performance, measure business impact, and continuously improve outcomes through data and feedback. **Qualifications** **Who you are:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science or a related technical field, or equivalent years of experience preferred. * 10\+ years of software engineering experience, including 2\+ years building and operating production AI systems. * Demonstrated experience building and operating agentic systems in production environments \- planning, reasoning, memory and tool\-calling. * Demonstrated experience designing and implementing AI evaluation frameworks, testing methodologies and production monitoring to validate solution accuracy, reliability, safety and business performance in real\-world operational environments. * Strong proficiency in Python, and experience building APIs, backend services and cloud\-native applications. * Deep experience with modern LLM platforms and orchestration frameworks, and the judgment to choose between them rather than fluency in any one. * Experience integrating AI systems with enterprise APIs, databases, SaaS platforms and business systems. * Strong analytical, problem\-solving and communication skills, with the ability to translate business needs into scalable technical solutions. *Preferred Qualifications* * Experience with RAG architectures, vector databases, embeddings and enterprise knowledge retrieval systems. * Experience with low\-code and pro\-code enterprise AI platforms such as Azure AI Foundry, Google Gemini Enterprise, Microsoft Agent 365 or Copilot Studio. * Experience working with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS or Google Cloud Platform. * Experience with AI observability, governance, security and compliance frameworks. * Familiarity with MLOps, model lifecycle management and AI deployment pipelines. * Experience in retail, direct\-to\-consumer, ecommerce or a similar consumer operating environment. * Demonstrated passion for emerging AI technologies and applied innovation. **Additional Information** **Our investment in you:** At Vuori, we’re proud to offer the following to our employees: * Health Insurance * Savings and Retirement Plan * Employee Assistance Program * Generous Vuori Discount \& Industry Perks * Paid Time Off * Wellness \& Fitness benefits The salary range for this role is $197,500 per year \- $264,390 per year. This role is bonus eligible. Vuori is proud to be an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.title: Senior Cloud Engineer
jobs.description: At VyStar, we offer competitive pay, an excellent benefit package that includes a 401(k) Plan, an extensive paid technical and on\-the\-job training program, and tuition reimbursement\-available to all full and part time employees. Part time positions start at a minimum of 30 hours per week. We encourage you to become a part of VyStar Credit Union's family of employees. Senior Cloud Engineer ACCOUNTABILITY STATEMENT: The Senior Cloud Engineer will plan, design, configure and maintain VyStar’s enterprise Azure cloud server and storage environments and will lead the management and further development of VyStar’s private and public cloud infrastructure. The person in this role will work closely with the architecture team, development team, system engineering team and InfoSec team to design and implement cloud resources in an optimal manner. They will review the cloud environments to validate implemented technologies and improve performance and reliability by ensuring security practices are followed. The incumbent will also manage cost optimization and ensure correct structure and tagging are in place for cost awareness and departmental chargeback. This role will serve as a technical subject matter expert by actively participating in configuration consultation, vendor evaluation, and problem resolution of multiple systems. The candidate should have a clear understanding of how to research, design, implement and troubleshoot information systems, cloud technologies and technology solutions in support of business needs. Under limited supervision, the candidate will be required to effectively manage and prioritize assigned tasks and projects, as well as design complex multi\-system solutions to meet the needs of the business. They will be required to make recommendations in these areas with a high level of technical competency. Assigned hours will primarily be standard VyStar corporate business hours but may also include evenings, nights, and weekends to implement changes or for support purposes. This role also participates in an on\-call support rotation.**ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:** * Responsible for day\-to\-day Azure cloud infrastructure operational tasks such as monitoring metrics and logs, responding to alerts, and system troubleshooting. Design, develop, and deploy modular cloud\-based systems. * Manage and maintain cloud infrastructure resources, including compute instances, storage, network configurations, and security. Participate in troubleshooting issues in the environment and takes part in the on\-call rotation with other cloud engineers. * Develop and maintain cloud solutions in accordance with best practices. Foster a DevOps mindset among the various engineering teams utilizing BICEP, ARM, Terraform and YAML templates. * Use of automation such as Infrastructure as Code to create infrastructure and CI/CD pipelines to apply changes. Participate in production deployments with other cloud and software engineers. * Develop scripts and other automation to streamline cloud and on\-premises operations. * Maintain documentation of infrastructures design, related technical procedures, operations manuals, and other guidance. * Other duties as assigned by the supervisor * All employees and business units, as first line of defense, are expected to proactively help identify, assess, manage, and report risks within their domain of work. To enhance a healthy risk culture and support our growth for good pillar, employees will maintain vigilance in safeguarding our operations while ensuring compliance with regulatory mandates. The Risk team serves as the second line of defense by providing risk oversight and credible challenge whereas the Audit team serves as the third line of defense by providing risk assurance. Incumbent is expected to demonstrate each of the following VyStar Excellence behaviors in performing the duties and responsibilities of their job: * Focus \- Focus your full attention by carefully listening to and observing client or member. * Connect \- Consistently be friendly and approachable. Demonstrate your care. * Understand \- Listen empathetically and ask questions (70%/30% rule). * Counsel \- Recommend solutions based on your member’s needs and objectives. * Advance \- Ensure that member’s expectations were exceeded. * Verify necessary follow\-up actions. **JOB QUALIFICATIONS** ====================== **Education** * This position requires a 4\-year degree in Information Systems, Computer Engineering or a related academic area and a minimum of 5 years’ experience as a systems engineer or in a related position. Additional years of related experience in the field may be substituted for the formal education. **Experience** * 5 \- 7 years of Enterprise level work experience in Systems Engineering or in a related position with physical and virtual Microsoft\-based systems; ideally in a financial services organization (or related industry). * 3\+ years of experience managing a production Azure cloud environment * Experience with establishing technology guidelines based on best practices in enterprise level systems engineering. * Demonstrated ability to lead project initiatives from beginning to end. **Knowledge, Skills and Abilities** * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills are required. * Understanding of IT, software development, and DevOps best practices * Expert knowledge of multiple Windows Server versions (2016/2019/2022/2025\). * Knowledge and experience in Microsoft Azure. Google Cloud or AWS (Amazon Cloud Services) a plus. * Experience with automation technologies and the ability to streamline processes * Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform. * Experience with containerization technologies such as Docker and container orchestration platforms like Azure Kubernetes Services (AKS) a plus. * Experience with bash, Python, PowerShell, or equivalent scripting language. * Experience with version control tools such as Git a plus. * Familiarity with Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment tools such as Azure DevOps * Advanced troubleshooting abilities across multiple technologies and vendors. Able to calmly provide support on bridge lines during outages. * Solid understanding of networking concepts and protocols, including TCP/IP, DNS, load balancing, and VPN. * Knowledge of security best practices, compliance standards (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA), and data protection mechanisms in the cloud. * A solid understanding of the financial services industry and the laws and regulations that govern and/or impact the credit union is a plus. * A high level of interpersonal skills and social sensitivity are required. The candidate encounters employees on all levels of the organization. The candidate is a resource to the organization and must be an effective listener and communicator. The candidate must set the example in attitude, behavior, and work ethic within multiple teams. **DISCLAIMERS AND WORK ENVIRONMENT** Nothing in this position description is an implied contract for employment. The position description is intended to be an accurate account of the essential functions. The functions are not all encompassing and are subject to change at any time by management. The work environment characteristics described are representative of those that an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. As required or requested, may exert up to 20 pounds of force occasionally and/or a negligible amount of force constantly to lift, carry, push, pull or otherwise move objects. **VyStar Credit Union is not seeking outside assistance or accepting unsolicited resumes from staffing agencies or search firms for employment or contractor opportunities. Any resumes submitted by an outside vendor to any employee at VyStar via e\-mail, internet, or directly to hiring managers without a valid written search agreement with the Talent Acquisition / HR department will be deemed the sole property of VyStar Credit Union.** **No placement fee will be paid if a candidate is hired as a result of the referral, or through other means.** Thank you for your inquiry regarding our current job opening. Your resume will be carefully reviewed against the position requirements. Should your experience and skills match, you will be contacted by one of our Human Resources department staff members. Thank you again for your interest in this position! *VyStar Credit Union Human Resources*

jobs.title: Software Controls Engineer
jobs.description: ### **Description** **Join us as our newest Software Engineer II and make code that even our telescopes admire!** Are you someone who genuinely enjoys solving problems—even the weird ones that start with “so… this only happens on Tuesdays?” Do you ask good questions, share ideas freely, and collaborate without ego? Do you communicate clearly, write code thoughtfully, and aren’t afraid to admit when you don’t know something? Do you appreciate a workplace where the vibe is friendly, the work is interesting, and humor is very welcome? If so, apply to be our newest Software Engineer II! **What the Software Engineer II Does:** The Software Engineer II spends their days turning ideas into clean, reliable, scalable software—preferably without summoning any new and exciting bugs. They work with friendly humans across multiple engineering disciplines to transform napkin sketches and ambitious brainstorms into real, working features. They review code (theirs and others’) in a way that is constructive, kind, and ideally free of passive\-aggressive comments. They have room to stretch into new areas, experiment with tools they’re curious about, and grow their technical and professional chops along the way. They may also use previous robotics or control systems experiences to understand what design tradeoffs that may exist when updating our software systems implemented in EPICS (Experimental Physics and Industrial Control System). Tapping into any knowledge or previous experiences with motors and electric drives, embedded systems, or DFx would also help out greatly. In this role the Software Engineer II genuinely enjoys solving problems—even the weird ones that start with “so… this only happens on Tuesdays.” They ask good questions, share ideas freely, and collaborate without ego. On a daily basis they communicate clearly, write code thoughtfully, and aren’t afraid to admit when you don’t know something. They appreciate a workplace where the vibe is friendly, the work is interesting, and humor is very welcome.### **Why Choose W. M. Remote employees may be required to travel to an office location based on business needs. This role reports to the Vice President of Artificial Intelligence. **Responsibilities** * Design, build, and orchestrate Machine Learning, GenAI, and Agentic AI applications leveraging foundational models (via AWS Bedrock, SageMaker) for automated billing, cost prediction, and document intelligence. * Design and build production\-grade, scalable Machine Learning (ML) pipelines integrating Optical Character Recognition (OCR), Natural Language Processing (NLP), Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), and agentic decision\-making workflows to process complex medical claims and unstructured data. * Establish end\-to\-end MLOps standards, automated model testing, and robust CI/CD pipelines for automated build, test, and release cycles of both ML models and AI services. * Define, provision, and maintain secure cloud environments for AI/ML services using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as AWS CDK or Terraform. * Leverage modern AI\-assisted development tools (such as GitHub Copilot or Kiro) to accelerate code generation, optimize Python queries, auto\-generate documentation, and maintain high engineering standards. * Develop APIs and microservices to enable seamless integration of ML/AI models into existing business applications. * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams (product, technology, operations, etc.) to align AI solutions with business goals. * Implement techniques to improve transparency in AI decision\-making, ensuring traceability and model explainability. * Ensure compliance with healthcare data regulations (e.g., HIPAA, HITRUST, SOC 2, etc.). **Qualifications** * Bachelor's or Master's (preferred) degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative field. * 5\+ years of hands\-on experience building, deploying, and maintaining production ML, GenAI, and Agentic solutions enterprise\-wide for business applications. * Deep practical knowledge of combining OCR engines (e.g., AWS Textract) with NLP, LLMs, VLMs, and AI foundational models to parse, structure, and query complex healthcare documents. * Proven expertise within the AWS ecosystem (AWS Bedrock, SageMaker, Lambda, ECS/EKS) and proficiency in Python, PyTorch/TensorFlow, and modern GenAI and Agentic frameworks (e.g., Strands Agents, AgentCore, Kiro, etc.). * Strong foundation in algorithm design, data structures, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and ability to deploy ML models as scalable APIs using Flask, FastAPI, or similar frameworks. * Strong hands\-on experience using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools like AWS CDK or Terraform to manage cloud infrastructure, paired with practical experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions, AWS CodePipeline, etc). * Experience working with healthcare data structures (e.g., insurance claims, EHRs, medical billing coding like CPT/ICD, or EDI 837/835 feeds). * Strong understanding of HIPAA compliance, data masking, secure prompt/data handling, and AI safety guardrails. * You are intellectually curious, obsessed with measurable business impact, and naturally inclined to build better solutions. * Strong problem\-solving skills and the ability to work independently. * Must be authorized to work in the United States without current or future company sponsorship. **How to Apply** To be considered, apply through our official Career Site by clicking the **Apply** button and completing the full application. Only applications submitted through our Career Site will be considered. Applications submitted through other channels or third\-party platforms will not be reviewed.

Ensure work uses the approved technology stack and follow the exception process, and that the team applies secure\-by\-design practices and Westinghouse software quality requirements. **Innovation Process**: Provide the engineering inputs and deliverables required for Technology Bricks and AI projects managed under the Westinghouse Innovation Process and Stage Gate Reviews (BMS\-RT\-3\). **Team capacity and growth:** Plan team capacity against the prioritized portfolio, and propose and manage engineer assignments within Data \& AI capacity governance. Scale the team as demand grows by defining hiring needs, leading recruitment and onboarding, and engaging contractors and third\-party companies when needed, while keeping critical knowledge and intellectual property within Westinghouse. **People leadership and development:** Lead the team, overseeing goal setting, performance management, recognition and succession. Mentor team members through coaching, mentoring, career plans and upskilling or reskilling in AI engineering, so that software engineers grow into AI engineering roles. ### **Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in computer science, Software Engineering, Engineering or a related discipline required. jobs.title: Principal DataOps Engineer (DevOps for Data)
jobs.description: **Your work days are brighter here.** We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun\-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too. **About the Team** In 2024, Workday launched the Enterprise Data and Analytics (ED\&A) team with a mission to transform and optimize the way Workday creates and shares trusted data to drive actionable insights and data\-led innovation across the enterprise. **About the Role** As a Principal DataOps Engineer (P5\), you serve as a preeminent technical authority, strategic leader, and primary architect of Workday’s data platform program execution and methodology deployment. Operating at the highest tier of individual contribution, you define the long\-term vision, core execution standards, and multi\-quarter roadmaps for a mission\-critical infrastructure portfolio, ensuring our platforms are structurally positioned to support Workday's hyper\-growth trajectory. You resolve high\-level technical ambiguity, mitigate existential architecture risks, and lead complex multi\-team transformations to deliver data\-as\-a\-product assets at scale. We are at the center of Workday's AI\-forward operating model, defining and governing the structural use of DataOps, Data Product, and Active Data Governance frameworks across the enterprise ecosystem. We provide the overarching operational blueprints for embedding advanced AI capabilities into our continuous delivery lines, building language model solutions and automated workflows that safely power autonomous workloads. Concurrently, we lead the transition to an AI\-first workforce, designing division\-level agent networks inside Sana and Gemini environments to automate routine tasks, manage technical debt, and multiply organization\-wide delivery velocity. **Key Responsibilities** * **Technical Delivery** : Serve as the preeminent technical authority defining the long\-term vision, core execution standards, and multi\-quarter architecture blueprints for a mission\-critical enterprise cloud infrastructure portfolio. Govern global platform administration paradigms and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) architecture standards and, CICD pipelines, mentoring senior engineers and establishing foundational infrastructure modules across the organization * **Knowledge Management** : Establish and govern function\-wide knowledge synchronization standards and "Documentation as Code" paradigms across the global DevOps and Analytics Engineering job families to ensure enterprise architectural clarity * **Incident Response \& Operational Resilience** : Mitigate existential infrastructure and architecture risks across the global enterprise. Design high\-scale zero\-trust data reliability parameters and predictive platform telemetry layers to guarantee unbroken data platform uptime during hyper\-growth cycles * **Agile Operational Facilitation:** Sponsor and chair cross\-functional technical review boards to align technical direction across competing business segments. Drive complex multi\-team infrastructure transformations, navigate platform migration blocks, and manage capital resource planning * **ED\&A Methodologies** : Establish and govern the core operational blueprints for embedding DataOps and Active Data Governance principles directly into our master software continuous delivery pipelines * **AI Productivity** : Pioneer the implementation of an AI\-first workforce strategy by building division\-level agent networks and automated scripts natively inside Cursor IDE, Sana, and Gemini tracks to automate code refactoring, system validation, and portfolio tracking at an enterprise scale **About You** **Basic Qualifications:** * 12\+ years of professional technical leadership experience in DataevOps, DevOps, cloud automation, program management, or platform engineering tracks within enterprise data and analytics. * 12\+ years of experience in managing and scaling a suite of interrelated data platform products, cluster configurations, and C platform environments and manage complex asset lifecycles * Operational Communication \& Collaboration: Superior capacity to successfully navigate high\-pressure corporate environments and complex technical landscapes to secure functional consensus across competing business units, acting as an active change agent and thought leader for the DevOps and engineering communities Open to 50% hybrid reporting to Pleasanton campus * **Workday Pay Transparency Statement** The annualized base salary ranges for the primary location and any additional locations are listed below. Workday pay ranges vary based on work location. As a part of the total compensation package, this role may be eligible for the Workday Bonus Plan or a role\-specific commission/bonus, as well as annual refresh stock grants. Recruiters can share more detail during the hiring process. Each candidate’s compensation offer will be based on multiple factors including, but not limited to, geography, experience, skills, job duties, and business need, among other things. For more information regarding Workday’s comprehensive benefits, please click here . You’ll have opportunities to learn and lead in a forward\-thinking environment, defining your path to a fulfilling career while channeling your skills toward causes you care about—locally and globally. Come make an impact every day at Zebra. **What We're Looking For:** Your Team and Mission: As a WLAN Testing and Solutions Engineer in Holtsville, NY, you will join the Connectivity team within the Zebra Enterprise Mobility and Visibility organization. Our mission is to deliver seamless, robust voice and data network connectivity solutions to our enterprise customers worldwide. These wireless configurations act as the critical lifelines powering mission\-critical business applications, ensuring warehouse personnel, healthcare workers, and retail staff can run their operations globally without interruption. Your Impact: You will play a vital role in validating, designing, and testing complex customer use cases for our next\-generation WLAN and Bluetooth solutions. By maintaining and updating our core lab environments and developing automated test suites, you directly contribute to the quality and reliability of the connectivity modules inside millions of Zebra devices globally. Your work will directly expand our value proposition, ensuring that our mobile hardware remains the industry benchmark for wireless performance and seamless enterprise\-grade roaming. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer I
jobs.description: **WHO WE ARE:** Zinnia is the leading technology platform for accelerating life and annuities growth. With innovative enterprise solutions and data insights, Zinnia simplifies the experience of buying, selling, and administering insurance products. All of which enables more people to protect their financial futures. Our success is driven by a commitment to three core values: be bold, team up, deliver value – and that we do. Zinnia has over $180 billion in assets under administration, serves 100\+ carrier clients, 2500 distributors and partners, and over 2 million policyholders. **WHO YOU ARE:** Zinnia is looking for a **Senior Software Engineer** to join our Enterprise API \& CIAM team. Our Customer Identity and Access Management (CIAM) platform handles authentication and fine\-grained authorization for carriers, distributors, agents, policyholders, and service integrations across Zinnia Live, Market Connect, and our TPA services. You'll extend and scale this production platform by building new identity flows, evolving our authorization model, and helping product teams across Zinnia integrate securely. You'll work closely with the CIAM tech lead, product management, and security and compliance partners in a regulated insurance environment. **WHAT YOU'LL DO:** * Build and evolve authentication flows, including workforce SSO federation (SAML/OIDC), passwordless login for agents and consumers, and machine\-to\-machine access for service integrations. * Design and implement fine\-grained authorization that combines role\-, attribute\-, and relationship\-based access control (RBAC, ABAC, ReBAC) to scope access by carrier, product, distributor, hierarchy, and delegation. * Build automated provisioning and lifecycle handling so access stays current as users are onboarded, transferred, given delegated access, or terminated. * Design, document, and maintain the CIAM APIs that other Zinnia teams consume. * Partner with product teams to onboard new applications onto our CIAM integration pattern. * Own the quality and reliability of what you ship through automated testing, code review, observability, and on\-call participation. * Work with security and compliance teams to implement access controls, support audits, and keep every access decision logged and explainable. **WHAT YOU'LL NEED:** * 6\+ years of professional software development experience, including building and operating production services in the cloud (AWS preferred). * Hands\-on experience implementing OAuth 2\.0, OpenID Connect, and SAML, including federation with external identity providers. * Experience with a CIAM platform such as Auth0 (preferred), Okta, or PingOne. * Experience designing authorization systems beyond basic roles, such as attribute\- or relationship\-based models. * Strong backend skills in TypeScript/Node.js, or a comparable language, with solid fundamentals in API design, testing, and software design. * Working knowledge of CI/CD, infrastructure as code, containers, and monitoring and alerting. * Clear written and verbal communication, and the ability to work with engineers, product managers, and security partners across a distributed team. * Experience working in an Agile/Scrum environment. **BONUS POINTS:** * Experience with OpenFGA, Auth0 FGA, or other Zanzibar\-style authorization systems. * Experience with event\-driven architectures (Kafka/Confluent), API gateways (Kong), MongoDB, Terraform, or Datadog. * Background in insurance, financial services, or another regulated industry, especially agent and distributor hierarchies, licensing and appointments, or delegated access. **WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU?** Zinnia offers excellent career progression and competitive compensation. We offer great benefits, including health/dental insurance, parental leave, 401(k), incentive/bonus opportunity, tuition reimbursement, and so much more. We're looking for the best and brightest innovators in the industry to join our team. At Zinnia, you collaborate with smart, creative professionals who are dedicated to delivering cutting\-edge technologies, deeper data insights, and enhanced services to transform how insurance is done. Visit our website at www.zinnia.com for more information. Apply by completing the online application on the careers section of our website. *We are an Equal Opportunity employer committed to a diverse workforce. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability.* Notice for California residents: Information about how we collect and use your personal information can be found***here*** \#LI\-JW1

jobs.description: **About Zoox** Zoox is an autonomous ridehailing company building the world's first purpose\-built robotaxi — fully electric, bidirectional, with no steering wheel or driver's seat. Backed by Amazon and founded to make transportation safer, cleaner, and more accessible, Zoox designs its vehicles entirely around the rider. We're currently operating in Las Vegas and San Francisco, with Austin and Miami on the horizon, and testing underway across seven U.S. markets. **About Our Contract Student Worker Program** Zoox's contract student worker program puts you at the center of one of the most ambitious challenges in transportation. You'll contribute to real projects, work alongside engineers and researchers pushing the boundaries of autonomous technology, and gain experience that goes well beyond the classroom. We're looking for students who bring strong academic foundations, curiosity that doesn't stop at coursework, and a drive to be part of something that matters. ### **Role Overview** * Build and maintain features for full\-stack QA applications (TypeScript frontend/backend, Python for non\-frontend services), under the guidance of senior engineers * Assist in designing and implementing test/integration/end\-to\-end frameworks and pipeline automation * Contribute to agent\-assisted tooling — e.g., wiring up LLM\-based classifiers, structured tool interfaces, or evaluation scripts for existing agentic workflows, with senior engineers owning architecture and safety\-critical decisions * Write and maintain unit/integration tests, fix bugs, and improve the reliability of existing tools * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to understand test and triage pain points and help build solutions ### **Responsibilities** * Working with our leads * Collaborating with our customers * Software development ### **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree (completed, or in progress/recently completed) in computer science, engineering, or a related field * 0\-2 years of professional or internship experience in software engineering * Working proficiency in Python and/or JavaScript/TypeScript * Familiarity with React (or a similar frontend framework), REST APIs, and Git/version control * Ability to work independently on well\-scoped tasks and ask clarifying questions when requirements are ambiguous * Strong communication skills and eagerness to learn from senior engineers ### **Bonus Qualifications** Familiar with React### **Program Requirements** * Currently enrolled in a B.S. or M.S. program in a relevant discipline. * Available to commit to a minimum three\-month assignment. * Able to commit a minimum of 40 hours per week. * Able to work on\-site at one of our office locations. * Must adhere with Zoox confidentiality requirements, including refraining from using or sharing proprietary company information outside of Zoox, such as in academic research, theses, publications, or presentations. The Part\-Time Student Worker Program is designed to complement your academic experience by providing meaningful, ongoing work alongside your studies. Rather than participating in a cohort\-based program, you'll join a team directly and contribute to real projects with real impact. While the program does not include structured intern programming or a pathway to full\-time employment, it offers valuable opportunities to learn, develop new skills, and gain hands\-on experience in a professional environment. Compensation for this role is $30/hour. This is a contract position; employment will be through a vendor contracted with Zoox. jobs.title: Staff Systems Engineer, Simulation Systems Verification and Validation Lead
jobs.description: Zoox is on an ambitious journey to develop a full\-stack autonomous mobility solution for cities. Simulation lets us test our driving software against far more scenarios than we can drive on public roads. For simulation results to count toward our safety case, we must show how closely the simulator matches reality and how much uncertainty the remaining difference adds to our safety metrics. We are seeking a ***Simulation Systems Verification and Validation (Sim VnV) Lead*** to own that work across the full autonomy stack. You will define how to validate simulation at the sensor, perception, planning, and full\-pipeline levels, lead the cross\-functional program that executes the sim VnV program, and turn the results into clear evidence about when and where simulated miles can support safety clearance decisions. You will work closely with simulation, perception, planning, hardware, safety, data science, and systems engineering teams. This is a highly visible, technical leadership role on the critical path to safely scaling our service. The ideal candidate demonstrates systems thinking, can lead a complex program across teams, and knows how to validate a model of a closed\-loop system that has an AI controller inside it. ### **In this role, you will:** * Own the end\-to\-end simulation V\&V strategy across different levels of integration ranging from sensors\-only through the full system behavior for the purpose of constructing a safety case for fully autonomous driving on public roads. * Define the data sets, metrics, and comparison methods. * Lead a recurring cross\-functional sim validation program with simulation, perception, planning, systems engineering, safety, and data infrastructure teams. Set milestones and cadence, track risks and dependencies, and drive decisions to closure. * Partner with statisticians and data scientists on estimators that combine simulated and real\-world results into safety performance measures. * Write the methodology documents and validation reports, and present results, risks, and recommendations to engineering and executive leadership. * Mentor engineers across teams in V\&V practice and systems thinking. ### **Qualifications** * M.S. or higher in Systems, Aerospace, Mechanical, Electrical, or Robotics Engineering, Computer Science, Physics, Mathematics, or a related field. * 8\+ years of experience in verification and validation of safety\-critical systems that contain software or autonomy (for example autonomous vehicles, ADAS, aerospace guidance and flight software, or robotics). * A record of leading technical programs across several teams, from an ambiguous problem statement to a delivered result. * Working\-level experience validating a simulation or model against real\-world data so that its results could support a decision, preferably for a closed\-loop system with software or a learned controller in the loop. * Strong systems thinking: you can break a system into integration levels, define the interfaces and the evidence needed at each level, and connect component\-level results to system\-level claims. * Experience deriving or implementing estimators that fuse simulated and real data, for example control variates, prediction\-powered inference, Bayesian hierarchical models or power priors, importance sampling, or rare\-event estimation. Similar experience with modeling uncertainties and failure rates is also acceptable. ### **Bonus Qualifications** * Experience with sensor simulation (camera, lidar, radar), neural rendering or generative scene synthesis, or perception evaluation metrics. * Experience evaluating motion planning or behavior in closed\-loop simulation at scale. * Familiarity with model credibility and safety standards, such as NASA\-STD\-7009, ASME V\&V 10/20/40, ISO 21448 (SOTIF), UL 4600, ISO 26262, or ISO 34502\. * Hands\-on Python and SQL. * Ph.D. in a relevant field. **Base Salary Range** There are three major components to compensation for this position: salary, Amazon Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), and Zoox Stock Appreciation Rights. A sign\-on bonus may be offered as part of the compensation package. The listed range applies only to the base salary. Compensation will vary based on geographic location and level. Leveling, as well as positioning within a level, is determined by a range of factors, including, but not limited to, a candidate's relevant years of experience, domain knowledge, and interview performance. jobs.title: Field Engineer
jobs.description: Field Engineer The Field Engineer supports network deployments, structured cabling and data center connectivity construction projects. Working with clients, operations teams and cross\-functional stakeholders, this role plans, designs, migrates and troubleshoots installations, provides subject matter expertise, and manages client expectations and contractual commitments. The role drives implementation milestones throughout the project lifecycle to deliver solutions on schedule and meet technical, business, operational and service\-level requirements. **Position Details** ==================== * **Location:** Abilene, TX * **Travel:** Up to 15% * **Standard site hours:** Two shifts, six days per week: 6 a.m.–6 p.m. and 6 p.m.–6 a.m. **Key Responsibilities** ======================== **Engineering and Deployment** ------------------------------ * Provide post\-sales implementation services for geographically distributed hardware and software network solutions, including requirements definition, implementation planning, end\-to\-end system design, equipment staging, configuration development, testing and deployment. * Assess solution specifications as customer needs evolve and recommend changes that improve value for clients and the organization. * Explain product architecture, functionality, system and data requirements, service delivery and integration with enterprise applications. * Lead field validation of telecom designs and proactively identify conflicts, gaps and installation issues. * Prepare system design and configuration documentation for internal and external clients, maintain current redlines throughout the build lifecycle, and compile closeout documentation. * Validate test results, including OTDR and power meter results, and support quality assurance and quality control (QA/QC) requirements. **Project and Client Coordination** ----------------------------------- * Monitor implementation milestones, participate in client status calls and coordinate across departments to keep projects aligned with scope, schedule and contractual obligations. * Build productive relationships with clients, internet service providers (ISPs), carrier services, hardware and software vendors, and other project contributors to ensure reliable delivery. * Participate in requests for information and proposals (RFI/RFP) and bid processes; review contracts, work orders and purchase orders. * Own change management: identify scope impacts, communicate promptly with stakeholders and drive resolution to maintain schedule and project alignment. * Oversee electronic tracking systems and custom dashboards; use established escalation and exception processes to report performance, resolve issues and recommend improvements. * Anticipate, detect and resolve client issues; remove service barriers and document issues, action plans and outcomes promptly. Meet client satisfaction objectives and internal and external service\-level agreements (SLAs). **Operational Excellence** -------------------------- * Meet financial objectives and leadership\-established key performance indicator (KPI) targets for the role; take corrective action when needed. * Improve, simplify and automate deployment methodologies, processes and day\-to\-day service delivery to strengthen quality, efficiency and the client experience. * Research technology, market and industry trends, benchmarking and relevant analytics to identify and implement best practices. * Continuously develop technical and nontechnical skills, including knowledge of supported operating systems, networking infrastructure, products and services. * Apply safety protocols, processes and procedures, and perform other duties assigned by management. **Qualifications** ================== **Education and Experience** ---------------------------- * Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Management Information Systems, Information Technology, Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience. * At least 5 years of engineering deployment experience in the technology services industry, including post\-sales network engineering, complex client requirements assessment, solution design and implementation. Experience in a managed service provider environment is preferred. * At least 5 years of construction industry experience in a similar role, including large structured cabling projects and/or data center connectivity construction projects. **Technical Skills and Certifications** --------------------------------------- * Strong Layer 2 and Layer 3 networking skills, including cabling, LAN, WAN, telecommunications access methods, DNS\-based Global Server Load Balancing (GSLB) theory, legacy networking technologies and system interdependencies. Cloud and virtualization experience is preferred. * Production experience directly managing routers, switches, global and local load balancing, SSL acceleration, HTTP compression/caching and DNS in high\-availability environments. * Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Visio), SharePoint, ERP systems, AutoCAD, Bluebeam, Procore, Textura, service delivery management tools and related cloud\-based systems. * Knowledge of telecom design validation, cabling test results, redlines, closeout documentation, QA/QC and construction safety requirements. * OSHA\-30 Hour certification is required. If not held at hire, it must be obtained within the first six (6\) months of the assignment. * CCNP, CCNA, CCIE, Microsoft System Engineer (MCSE) or related certifications are preferred. **Core Competencies** --------------------- * **Accountability:** Take ownership of results, connect individual responsibilities to organizational goals and identify improvements beyond the immediate role. * **Customer focus:** Understand internal and external client needs, anticipate emerging requirements and develop creative service improvements that increase efficiency and reduce cost. * **Business acumen:** Make cost\-effective decisions aligned with organizational strategy, use technology to support decision\-making and strengthen cooperation across departments. * **Decision\-making and problem\-solving:** Use analysis, experience and judgment to identify root causes, resolve immediate issues and implement lasting solutions, including during crises. Document outcomes and measure effectiveness. * **Results and continuous improvement:** Maintain high performance standards, meet or exceed service expectations and apply current technology and industry best practices. * **Process and collaboration skills:** Think end to end, design business processes and workflows, and work effectively across functional groups to optimize offerings, deliver a seamless client experience and resolve issues accurately and on time.

You'll be Render's technical face on stage, in workshops, at meetups, and in the developer and AI ecosystems where our users build. DX at Render has two halves. DX Engineering builds and maintains Render's tutorials, sample apps, templates, and video library. DevRel takes Render to developers in person and through the communities and partners they trust, then brings what it hears back into the product. You'll set the technical bar and direction for DevRel, and you'll be the person developers and partners go to for a deep, candid answer about running AI workloads on Render. You'll build the demos and workshop material behind your own talks. When something you build deserves a long life, DX Engineering turns it into a maintained example or template. This is a remote role within the US, with the option to work out of our headquarters in San Francisco. Expect regular travel for conferences and events. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Represent Render at conferences, meetups, hackathons, podcasts, and livestreams, with talks and live demos on building and running AI agents and full\-stack apps. * Design and run hands\-on workshops and hackathons, from the curriculum to the technical setup behind them. * Set DevRel's technical direction: pick the communities, ecosystems, and events worth investing in, and define what good looks like for talks, workshops, and demos. * Be the technical counterpart for ecosystem partners such as AI frameworks, agent tooling, and open source projects: joint workshops, co\-hosted events, and the integrations worth building together. * Go deep in technical communities on GitHub, X, Discord, Reddit, and Hacker News. Answer hard questions, debug real deployments, and show up where Render has a credible voice. * Run the developer feedback loop. Turn what you hear in the field into clear, prioritized input for Product and Engineering, and follow it through until it ships. * Help Render's highest\-potential developers and startups go further on the platform through technical deep dives and architecture reviews, and turn them into c  can build a working agent app live and explain what it needs to run in production, such as long\-running tasks, sandboxed code execution, and retries. The field is young, so we look at what you've done recently. We don't expect years of experience in it. * The engineering depth to be credible with senior engineers. You can deploy a multi\-service app, read logs, trace a failed deploy, and find the root cause in front of an audience. * Working knowledge of cloud infrastructure: containers and Docker, networking basics, CI/CD, environment configuration, and infrastructure as code. * You use coding agents like Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor every day and keep up with the agent ecosystem as it changes. * Examples of developer feedback you turned into product changes: what you heard, the case you made, and what shipped. * Excellent spoken and written communication. You can hold a room of engineers and explain a complex system clearly. **Nice\-to\-Haves** ------------------- * Existing relationships in AI framework, agent tooling, or open source communities. * An existing developer audience through talks, livestreams, a newsletter, or social. * Experience starting or growing in\-person developer meetups. * Experience with durable workflows, background job systems, or sandboxed code execution. * You've used Render before, professionally or on side projects. **Projects You Might Work On** ------------------------------ * A workshop on deploying production agents with Render Workflows, run at a major AI conference and then at our own meetups. * A hackathon co\-hosted with an AI framework partner, including the starter kit and the technical support on the day. * The talk track for an upcoming launch, delivered by you and the rest of DevRel. * A recurring field report for Product on where developers get stuck running agents on Render. If this role excites you but you don’t meet every single requirement, we’d still love to hear from you—your unique experience might be just what we need. **Benefits** ------------ * 4 weeks of paid vacation. * 14 weeks of fully paid parental leave for all parents to bond with a newly born, adopted, or fostered child. jobs.title: Senior / Staff Software Engineer, Data Infrastructure
jobs.description: **About Suno** ============== We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world. Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible. Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA). **About the Role** ================== Suno is growing fast, and we’re hiring Staff and Senior Software Engineers to build and scale the foundational systems that power our data platform and personalized recommendations. You’ll design and operate infrastructure that ingests, processes, and serves PBs of data, helping connect listeners with music they love while supporting analytics, experimentation, and machine learning across the company. This is a high\-impact, senior role at the intersection of Data Infrastructure and ML. You’ll partner closely with Engineering, Data, and ML teams to build the pipelines, feature infrastructure, and low\-latency data services that power recommendations and music discovery. Your work will help turn user interactions and content signals into reliable, fresh data for model training and real\-time personalization. As Suno grows, you’ll help define the long\-term architecture of our data platform, balancing scalability, reliability, latency, and cost. You’ll build systems that are observable and easy to extend, enabling teams to experiment quickly and improve how people discover and engage with music. You’ll own major systems end to end, from design through production operation, and drive architecture and technical direction across teams. Check out the Suno version of this role here: https://suno.com/s/yt9eiMi9aj0rmGX6 **What You’ll Do** ================== * Build and scale the data infrastructure behind personalized recommendations and music discovery, working closely with ML and product engineers. * Design streaming pipelines that transform user interactions and content signals into fresh features for recommendation models. * Develop infrastructure for computing, storing, and serving features across offline model training and online inference, with attention to consistency, reliability, and latency. * Enable recommendation experimentation through reliable impression and interaction logging, supporting model evaluation and measurement of recommendation quality. * Own the architecture and reliability of core streaming and batch infrastructure, using technologies such as Kinesis, Firehose, Lambda, S3, Flink, and Glue. * Build and maintain data workflows and orchestration using Dagster, ensuring pipelines are modular, testable, and observable. * Partner with backend and product engineers to define event schemas, data contracts, and ingestion patterns from production systems. * Improve the reliability and observability of data pipelines through monitoring, alerting, lineage tracking, and automated recovery mechanisms. * Optimize pipelines and storage for performance, cost efficiency, and scalability across AWS and Snowflake. * Implement infrastructure as code (e.g., Terraform) to manage AWS and Snowflake resources in a consistent, reproducible way. * Contribute to data platform standards, including schema evolution, data quality enforcement, and pipeline reliability best practices. * Lead technical design discussions and help shape the future architecture of Suno’s data platform. * Mentor other engineers and raise the bar for engineering quality, reliability, and maintainability. **What You’ll Need** ==================== * 7\+ years of relevant experience in software engineering, data infrastructure, or distributed systems. * Strong programming skills, preferably in Python, and experience building and operating production\-grade distributed systems. * Deep experience building and operating real\-time streaming and batch processing systems. * Experience building data or serving infrastructure for recommendations, personalization, search, or similar ML\-powered product experiences. * Understanding of feature computation, online/offline data consistency, and the latency and freshness requirements of production ML systems. * Experience with streaming and cloud data infrastructure, such as Flink, Kinesis, Kafka, or equivalent technologies. * Experience designing reliable, observable systems, including monitoring, logging, alerting, and recovery. * Strong understanding of data modeling, schema evolution, and data quality. * Ability to collaborate closely with ML, data, and product engineering teams, make pragmatic technical decisions, and deliver in ambiguous environments. * A strong sense of ownership, with a track record of delivering scalable infrastructure and improving engineering practices. Excitement about music, creativity, and AI, and the infrastructure that helps people create and discover music. **Nice to Have** ================ * Experience with AWS services such as Kinesis, Firehose, Lambda, S3, and Glue. * Experience with Snowflake or a similar cloud data warehouse, including performance and cost optimization. * Experience with Dagster, Airflow, or similar orchestration frameworks. * Experience with dbt for transformations, testing, and modular data modeling. * Experience with Terraform or similar infrastructure\-as\-code tools. **Additional Notes** -------------------- * Applicants must be eligible to work in the US. * This role requires working from our Cambridge, MA or New York, NY office five days per week. **Compensation** ---------------- The annual salary range for this role is $228,960 \- 363,510 \+ target equity \+ benefits (including medical, dental, vision, and 401k) **Perks \& Benefits for Full\-Time Employees** ============================================== * Company Equity Package * 401(k) with 3% Employer Match \& Roth 401(k) * Medical, Dental, \& Vision Insurance (PPO w/ HSA \& FSA options) * 11 Paid Holidays \+ Unlimited PTO \& Sick Time * 16 Weeks of Paid Parental Leave * Creative Education Stipend * Generous Commuter Allowance * In\-Office Lunch (5 days per week) Suno is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis under provincial, federal, state, and local laws, regulations, or ordinances. We will also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of state and local laws, including the Massachusetts Fair Chance in Employment Act, NYC Fair Chance Act, LA City Fair Chance Ordinance, and San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance. Compensation Range: $228,960 \- $363,510

jobs.title: Vulnerability Analysis Automation Engineer
jobs.description: The DHS CISA Cybersecurity Division (CSD) Vulnerability Management (VM) Disclosure Branch enables the Government to maintain an analytical edge over adversaries and to support vulnerability coordination activities across the United States. The Disclosure Branch has a requirement to develop a vulnerability ecosystem through partnership and platform development and to create assurance in future software products to deployed in various networks through the expansion of the concept of Software\-Bills\-of\-Materials and other mechanisms to uncover trends, provide solutions, and reduce the risk of products deployed on our Nation’s networks. **Tharros** is seeking a **Vulnerability Analysis Automation Engineer** to support this mission. **This is an automation\-first role.** As the mission scales, the only way to keep pace is to automate aggressively — building pipelines and AI\-driven tooling that do the repetitive work so analysts can focus on judgment. Tharros is seeking a Vulnerability Analysis Automation Engineer whose default instinct is to automate: someone who sees a manual process and immediately asks how to make it run on its own. You will spend the majority of your time designing, building, and hardening automation that accelerates software development, vulnerability analysis, and day\-to\-day operations. **What You'll Do:** * Automate first: identify manual, repetitive, and error\-prone processes and replace them with reliable, observable, maintainable automation. * Design, build, and maintain automated pipelines that reliably build, test, secure, and deploy software to running environments. * Build AI\- and ML\-driven tooling — including LLMs and agentic workflows — to automate analysis, triage vulnerability data, and accelerate engineering and operational work. * Instrument and monitor your automation so it stays trustworthy at scale and continuously expand what the team can run hands\-free. * Manage and support source code repositories and the development workflows that depend on them. * Research and evaluate emerging automation and AI tooling and bring the most promising capabilities into our technical solutions. **What We're Looking For:** * Bachelor's degree in computer science, cybersecurity, or a related field. * Two or more years of experience designing, building, and maintaining code (e.g. Python, Java). * A strong bias toward automation — a track record of eliminating manual work through scripting, pipelines, or tooling. (e.g. Process improvement: identified bottlenecks in existing workflows and implemented automation that improved execution speed and consistency). * A demonstrated ability to learn new technologies quickly and apply them to improve software and technical solutions. * Hands\-on experience with automated build and deployment pipelines, source code management, and modern software development practices (preferred). * Familiarity with applying AI/LLM tooling to automate or accelerate technical work — or strong enthusiasm and aptitude for doing so (preferred). * Strong written and verbal communication skills. * Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite to include Teams or similar workplace chat and videoconferencing tools.
